items.d: A collective list of free APIs
items.z: public-apis 是一个由社区维护的免费 API 集合库，涵盖地理定位、金融、天气、通信等多个领域，提供即用型 RESTful API 接口，支持 Postman 一键调用，助力开发者快速集成第三方数据服务。
items.e: The public-apis repository is a community-curated collection of free, ready-to-use REST APIs across diverse domains like geolocation, finance, weather, and communication, enabling developers to quickly integrate third-party data services via Postman.

items.d: :books: Freely available programming books
items.z: 该项目是免费编程书籍的权威集合，涵盖多语言、多领域的开源学习资源，支持动态搜索和静态网站访问，由非营利组织 Free Ebook Foundation 维护，是全球最受欢迎的开源项目之一。
items.e: This repository aggregates freely available programming books across multiple languages and domains, featuring dynamic search and static site access. Maintained by the non-profit Free Ebook Foundation, it is one of GitHub's most popular open-source projects.

items.d: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
items.z: roadmap.sh 是一个社区驱动的开发者成长平台，提供交互式技术路线图、学习指南和最佳实践资源，覆盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等 30+ 技术领域，支持按初学者/进阶路径定制学习路径，助力开发者系统化职业发展。
items.e: roadmap.sh is a community-driven platform offering interactive technology roadmaps, guides, and best practices for developers. It covers 30+ domains including Frontend, Backend, DevOps, AI, and Data Science, with beginner/advanced learning paths to support structured career growth in tech.

items.d: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.z: Superpowers 是一个面向编码智能体的完整软件开发工作流框架，基于可组合的'技能'和初始指令，确保智能体高效协作。它通过自动触发技能（如需求澄清、设计评审、TDD开发计划生成、子智能体驱动开发），实现从构思到交付的无缝流程，强调 YAGNI、DRY 和测试优先原则，适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流 AI 编程平台。
items.e: Superpowers is an agentic software development framework built on composable 'skills' that guide coding agents through a complete workflow—from idea refinement and design validation to TDD-driven implementation via subagent-driven development. It automates planning, branching, testing, and execution across platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, enforcing best practices like YAGNI, DRY, and red/green testing.

items.d: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
items.z: OpenClaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持在 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack 等主流通讯平台运行，兼容 macOS/iOS/Android 系统，具备语音交互与实时画布渲染能力。其网关为控制平面，核心产品是本地部署的个性化助手，强调隐私、速度与持续在线体验。
items.e: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your own devices across any OS and platform. It integrates with messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack, supports voice interaction, live canvas rendering, and prioritizes local deployment for privacy, speed, and always-on personal assistance.

items.d: An opinionated list of awesome Python frameworks, libraries, software and resources.
items.z: Awesome Python 是一个精选的 Python 框架、库、软件和资源的权威列表，涵盖 Web 开发、数据科学、机器学习、自动化工具等多个领域，为开发者提供高质量的开源工具参考。
items.e: Awesome Python is an opinionated curated list of top-tier Python frameworks, libraries, software, and resources across domains like web development, data science, machine learning, and automation, serving as a definitive reference for developers.

items.d: Repo for counting stars and contributing. Press F to pay respect to glorious developers.
items.z: 996.ICU 是一个由程序员发起的倡议，旨在揭露和抵制中国科技行业盛行的 '996' 工作制（早9点至晚9点，每周6天），倡导劳动者权益保护。项目通过开源社区收集侵权企业黑名单、推广反996许可证，并推动建立尊重员工权益的工作文化。
items.e: 996.ICU is a developer-led initiative exposing and resisting the '996' work schedule (9am-9pm, 6 days/week) in China's tech industry. It builds an open-source blacklist of violators, promotes the Anti-996 License, and advocates for worker rights through community-driven transparency and legal tools.

items.d: This is the repo for Vue 2. For Vue 3, go to https://github.com/vuejs/core
items.z: Vue 2 已于2023年12月31日终止维护，不再接收新功能、更新或修复。该仓库为 Vue 2 的归档版本，官方推荐新项目使用 Vue 3.x。Vue 是一个渐进式前端框架，核心库专注视图层，支持逐步采用，并拥有完善的生态系统（如 vue-router、vuex、vue-cli）。
items.e: Vue 2 reached End of Life on December 31st, 2023 and no longer receives updates. This repository is archived for Vue 2. The actively maintained version is vuejs/core. Vue is a progressive framework for building user interfaces, designed to be incrementally adoptable with a core library focused on the view layer and a rich ecosystem for large-scale applications.

items.d: Free domain registration and practical DNS learning resources for everyone.
items.z: DigitalPlat FreeDomain 是一个面向全球用户的免费域名注册平台，提供 .DPDNS.ORG、.US.KG 等专属后缀域名，支持与 Cloudflare 等主流 DNS 服务商集成。项目由 DigitalPlat 基金会独立开发，已服务超 50 万用户，致力于降低建站门槛，构建开放互联网生态。
items.e: DigitalPlat FreeDomain offers free, unique domain names with extensions like .DPDNS.ORG and .QZZ.IO, enabling individuals and organizations to establish a digital identity without cost. Built by the DigitalPlat Foundation, it integrates seamlessly with popular DNS providers such as Cloudflare and serves over 500,000 users worldwide, promoting an open and accessible web.

items.d: Public repository for Agent Skills
items.z: Anthropic 公开 Claude 智能体技能库，提供文档处理、开发工具、企业工作流等多样化技能模板，支持动态加载与自定义扩展，助力 AI 智能体实现专业化任务自动化。
items.e: Anthropic's public repository for Agent Skills provides Claude with dynamic, modular capabilities across document processing, development tools, and enterprise workflows, enabling specialized task automation through customizable, production-grade skill modules.

items.d: 🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,400+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.
items.z: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 zsh 配置管理框架，提供 300+ 插件（如 Git、Docker、Node.js）和 140+ 主题，支持自动更新。它通过丰富的扩展功能提升终端体验，让用户在开发效率与个性化之间获得平衡，同时保持轻量与易用性。
items.e: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing zsh configurations, offering 300+ optional plugins (e.g., Git, Docker, Node.js) and 140+ themes, with auto-update support. It enhances terminal productivity and personalization through extensible plugins and beautiful themes, balancing power and simplicity for developers.

items.d: :books: 技术面试必备基础知识、Leetcode、计算机操作系统、计算机网络、系统设计
items.z: CS-Notes 是面向技术面试的综合性学习资源，涵盖算法、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库、Java 核心技术及系统设计等计算机基础核心领域。内容结构清晰，包含剑指 Offer 和 Leetcode 题解，适合系统复习与刷题备考。
items.e: CS-Notes is a comprehensive study resource for technical interviews, covering core computer science topics including algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, databases, Java fundamentals, and system design. It features structured content with solutions to 'Jianzhi Offer' and Leetcode problems, ideal for systematic review and coding practice.

items.d: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
items.z: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的安全工作流自动化平台，融合可视化拖拽与自定义代码（JavaScript/Python），支持 400+ 集成和原生 AI 能力（基于 LangChain），提供自托管或云端部署选项，采用公平源代码许可，确保数据控制与可定制性。
items.e: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

items.d: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
items.z: prompts.chat 是全球最大的开源提示词库，涵盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。提供社区驱动的提示词分享与收集平台，支持免费使用及私有化部署，兼具学术引用价值与工业级实用性。
items.e: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

items.d: Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.
items.z: MAS 是一个开源的 Windows 和 Office 激活工具，支持 HWID、Ohook、TSforge 和在线 KMS 等多种激活方式，并提供高级故障排除功能。通过 PowerShell 脚本或传统 CMD 文件一键激活系统，适用于 Windows 8.1/10/11 及 Office 产品，集成自动化与跨平台支持。
items.e: MAS is an open-source activator for Windows and Office using HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS methods, with advanced troubleshooting. It enables one-click activation via PowerShell or CMD scripts, supporting Windows 8.1/10/11 and Office, featuring automation and cross-platform compatibility.

items.d: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
items.z: Dify 是一个生产就绪的 AI 智能体工作流开发平台，支持可视化编排、多模型集成与自动化流程构建，适用于企业级应用开发与 AI 能力快速集成场景。
items.e: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

items.d: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
items.z: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
items.e: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

items.d: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
items.z: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
items.e: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

items.d: Langflow is a powerful tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows.
items.z: Langflow 是一个强大的 AI 智能体与工作流构建平台，提供可视化拖拽界面和 Python 源码级定制能力。支持多智能体编排、API/MCP 部署、LangSmith 可观测性集成，内置主流 LLM 与向量数据库支持，适用于企业级 AI 应用快速开发与部署。
items.e: Langflow is a powerful platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. It offers a visual builder interface, source code customization in Python, multi-agent orchestration, API/MCP deployment, LangSmith observability, and native support for major LLMs and vector databases, making it ideal for rapid enterprise-grade AI application development.

items.d: Java 面试 & 后端通用面试指南，覆盖计算机基础、数据库、分布式、高并发与系统设计。准备后端技术面试，首选 JavaGuide！
items.z: JavaGuide 是 Java 及后端技术面试的权威指南，涵盖 Java 基础、集合、并发、IO、JVM、数据库、分布式、高并发与系统设计等核心知识。提供系统化面试题解析、源码深度剖析及实战项目（如 AI 智能面试平台），支持在线阅读与 PDF 下载，是后端开发者备战大厂面试的首选资源。
items.e: JavaGuide is the authoritative guide for Java and backend technical interviews, covering core topics including Java fundamentals, collections, concurrency, I/O, JVM, databases, distributed systems, high-concurrency, and system design. It offers systematic interview question analysis, in-depth source code breakdowns, and practical projects (e.g., AI-powered interview assistant), with online reading and PDF download options. It's the top resource for backend developers preparing for top-tier tech interviews.

items.d: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
items.z: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
items.e: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

items.d: The agent engineering platform.
items.z: LangChain 是一个构建可靠 AI 智能体的框架，提供标准化的 LLM、嵌入、向量存储等组件接口，支持实时数据增强、模型互操作性和快速原型开发，助力开发者高效构建生产级 LLM 应用。
items.e: LangChain is a framework for building reliable AI agents and LLM-powered applications. It offers standardized interfaces for models, embeddings, and vector stores, enabling real-time data augmentation, model interoperability, and rapid prototyping for production-ready AI solutions.

items.d: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
items.z: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
items.e: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

items.d: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
items.z: free-for.dev 是一个面向开发者和运维人员的精选免费服务清单，涵盖 SaaS、PaaS、IaaS 等基础设施类工具。该列表聚焦于 DevOps 和系统管理员常用服务，强调长期可用的免费层级（非试用），并排除自托管软件。内容由社区协作维护，包含云管理、CI/CD、监控、安全等 30+ 个分类，帮助开发者快速发现并评估适合的免费资源。
items.e: free-for.dev is a curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS services tailored for developers and infrastructure teams. It focuses on tools useful for DevOps, sysadmins, and cloud engineers, excluding self-hosted software and limited-time trials. Maintained by a community of 1600+ contributors, it covers 30+ categories including cloud management, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and more, enabling informed decisions about free developer offerings.

items.d: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
items.z: gstack 是 Garry Tan（YC 创始人）基于 Claude Code 构建的 AI 工程团队工具集，集成 CEO、设计师、工程师、发布经理等 15 个角色，通过 slash 命令实现产品规划、代码审查、QA 测试、安全审计和自动化部署。支持每日 1-2 万行代码的高效开发，适用于技术型创始人、Claude Code 新手及资深技术负责人。
items.e: gstack is Garry Tan's (YC President) AI-powered engineering toolkit built on Claude Code, featuring 15 specialized roles including CEO, designer, eng manager, and QA. It enables ultra-high productivity coding through slash commands for planning, review, testing, security audits, and deployment—ideal for technical founders, Claude Code beginners, and senior tech leads.

items.d: Display and control your Android device
items.z: scrcpy 是一款高性能、低延迟的 Android 设备屏幕镜像与控制工具，支持 USB/TCP 连接，无需 root 或额外应用。具备 30~120fps 流畅传输、1920×1080 高清画质、35~70ms 低延迟、1 秒内启动等特性，并提供音频转发、录制、虚拟显示、键盘鼠标模拟、游戏手柄支持等丰富功能，适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS 三大平台。
items.e: scrcpy is a lightweight, high-performance Android device mirroring and control tool that supports USB/TCP connections without requiring root access or additional apps. It delivers 30~120fps video at 1920×1080+ quality with 35~70ms latency and sub-second startup. Features include audio forwarding, recording, virtual display, HID keyboard/mouse simulation, gamepad support, and more, available on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

items.d: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others
items.z: v2rayN 是一款跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）的图形化客户端，支持 Xray、sing-box 等多种代理核心。提供直观的用户界面，简化了代理配置与管理流程，适用于需要稳定翻墙或网络加速的用户。
items.e: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI client for Windows, Linux, and macOS, supporting multiple proxy cores including Xray and sing-box. It offers an intuitive interface to simplify configuration and management of network proxies for enhanced connectivity.

items.d: :books: 免费的计算机编程类中文书籍，欢迎投稿
items.z: 本项目是免费的中文编程书籍索引库，涵盖操作系统、Web开发、算法、大数据等语言无关和语言相关的计算机技术书籍，提供高质量的学习资源集合，支持社区投稿与更新，助力程序员技能提升。
items.e: This repository provides a curated collection of free Chinese programming books covering computer science fundamentals, web development, algorithms, and major programming languages, serving as a valuable learning resource for developers with community-driven contributions.

items.d: 科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布
items.z: 《科技爱好者周刊》是阮一峰团队推出的科技内容周刊，每周五发布，聚焦前沿科技趋势、AI应用、创业洞察与行业动态，内容涵盖人工智能、互联网经济、软件开发等领域，兼具深度与可读性，是科技从业者与爱好者的重要资讯来源。
items.e: The Tech Enthusiast Weekly is a curated publication by Ruan YiFeng, releasing every Friday with in-depth coverage of emerging technologies, AI advancements, startup insights, and industry trends, targeting tech professionals and enthusiasts seeking actionable intelligence.

items.d: :cn: GitHub中文排行榜，各语言分设「软件 | 资料」榜单，精准定位中文好项目。各取所需，高效学习。
items.z: GitHub中文排行榜是一个按编程语言分类的中文开源项目榜单，涵盖软件与资料两类，提供总榜、增速榜和新秀榜，帮助开发者高效发现优质中文开源项目，降低语言障碍，提升学习效率。
items.e: GitHub Chinese Top Charts is a categorized ranking system of high-quality Chinese open-source projects by programming language, featuring software and knowledge categories, with overall, growth, and new repo rankings to help developers discover and learn from top Chinese projects efficiently.

items.d: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
items.z: ComfyUI 是一款功能强大的模块化扩散模型 GUI 工具，采用节点/流程图界面设计，支持复杂 Stable Diffusion 工作流的图形化编排。它提供无代码可视化操作，兼容 SD1.x/SD2.x/SDXL/SD3/Flux 等多种模型，支持 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon 等全平台 GPU，适用于图像生成、视频处理、AI 艺术创作等场景。
items.e: ComfyUI is a powerful modular GUI for diffusion models featuring a node-based graph interface for building complex Stable Diffusion pipelines without coding. It supports multiple models including SD1.x, SDXL, SD3, Flux, and PixArt, runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS with full GPU support across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple Silicon platforms.

items.d: A fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the internet.
items.z: frp 是一款高性能反向代理工具，专为穿透 NAT 或防火墙设计，支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP、HTTPS 协议转发，提供 P2P 连接模式。具备多协议支持、自定义域名访问内网服务、SSH 穿透、HTTP 文件服务器暴露、HTTPS 加密转发、私有服务暴露、Prometheus 监控、客户端认证等核心功能，适用于远程开发、内网服务访问、IoT 设备连接等场景。
items.e: frp is a high-performance reverse proxy designed to expose local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols, with P2P connectivity. Key features include multi-protocol forwarding, custom domain access to internal services, SSH tunneling, HTTP file server exposure, HTTPS encryption, private service exposure, Prometheus monitoring, and client authentication, ideal for remote development and IoT access.

items.d: Programmer's guide about how to cook at home.
items.z: 本项目为程序员量身打造的居家烹饪指南，采用结构化文档体系提供清晰精准的中式家常菜做法。项目涵盖从基础烹饪技巧到复杂菜品的完整知识库，支持Docker部署和PDF导出，强调标准化流程与可操作性，助力技术从业者提升生活技能。
items.e: A structured cooking guide designed for programmers, offering clear and precise Chinese home-cooking recipes with standardized procedures. Features complete knowledge base from basic techniques to complex dishes, supports Docker deployment and PDF export, focusing on practicality and community-driven maintenance.

items.d:  Now we have become very big, Different from the original idea. Collect premium software in various categories.
items.z: Awesome Mac 是一个精选 macOS 优质软件的资源库，涵盖开发工具、设计软件、效率应用等多个类别。项目规模庞大，支持多语言（含中文、韩文），并提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包形式发布。包含开源、免费、App Store 应用等标签分类，鼓励用户贡献与反馈。
items.e: Awesome Mac is a curated collection of premium macOS software across categories like development tools, design apps, and productivity utilities. It features a vast scale, multilingual support (including Chinese and Korean), and is available via Docker and npm. The list categorizes apps by open-source, freeware, and App Store status, encouraging community contributions.

items.d: Material UI: Comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design. Free forever.
items.z: Material UI 是一个基于 Google Material Design 的 React 组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和主题系统，支持无障碍访问和响应式设计。它经过十年开源社区验证，稳定可靠，适合构建现代化 Web 应用，并通过 MUI X 扩展高级组件功能。
items.e: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library implementing Google's Material Design. It offers battle-tested, accessible, and responsive UI components with a customizable theme system. Trusted by global product teams, it extends functionality via MUI X for advanced use cases.

items.d: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
items.z: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
items.e: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

items.d: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
items.z: Ant Design 是蚂蚁集团开源的企业级 UI 设计语言和 React 组件库，提供高质量、可复用的前端组件与完整的设计系统。支持 TypeScript、主题定制、国际化及 SSR，适用于中后台管理系统开发，具备完善的开发工具链和丰富的设计资源。
items.e: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library developed by Ant Group, offering a comprehensive set of high-quality, customizable components and design resources. Built with TypeScript, it supports internationalization, theme customization, SSR, and modern tooling for efficient enterprise application development.

items.d: 🔥 The Web Data API for AI - Turn entire websites into LLM-ready markdown or structured data
items.z: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
items.e: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

items.d: A Collection of application ideas which can be used to improve your coding skills.
items.z: 本项目是面向开发者的应用创意集合，旨在解决编程灵感枯竭问题。提供从基础到高级的30+个应用项目，每个项目包含明确目标、用户故事、扩展功能和学习资源。项目按难度分为三个层级，涵盖前端交互、数据处理、API集成等场景，适合提升编码能力、技术实验和作品集建设。
items.e: This repository offers a curated collection of application ideas designed to overcome developer's creative blocks. With 30+ projects across three difficulty tiers, each includes clear objectives, user stories, bonus features, and learning resources. Ideal for skill improvement, tech experimentation, and portfolio development.

items.d: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
items.z: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，用于将各类文件（如 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML 等）转换为结构化的 Markdown 格式，专为 LLM 和文本分析流水线设计。它支持 OCR、语音转文本、ZIP 内文件遍历及 YouTube 链接解析，注重保留文档结构（标题、表格、列表等），输出高度兼容主流大模型。
items.e: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts various file types (PDF, Office docs, images, audio, HTML, etc.) into structured Markdown for use with LLMs and text analysis pipelines. It supports OCR, speech-to-text, ZIP extraction, and YouTube URL conversion, preserving document structure like headings and tables for optimal LLM compatibility.

items.d: :tada: A magical vue admin                                                                https://panjiachen.github.io/vue-element-admin
items.z: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
items.e: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

items.d: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
items.z: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
items.e: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

items.d: The Web framework for perfectionists with deadlines.
items.z: Django 是一个高级 Python Web 框架，专为追求高效开发流程的务实开发者设计。它提供开箱即用的功能，支持快速构建安全、可维护的 Web 应用，内置 ORM、管理后台、认证系统和 URL 路由等核心组件，极大提升开发效率。
items.e: Django is a high-level Python web framework designed for developers who value rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It provides built-in features like ORM, admin interface, authentication, and URL routing, enabling secure and maintainable web application development with minimal boilerplate code.

items.d: 🤯 LobeHub - Super-Agents on Your Team. Add super-agents to the chats your team already uses.They take on work by themselves and get better every week.
items.z: LobeHub 是一个面向工作与生活的终极协作空间，致力于构建人类与智能体协同进化的网络。该平台支持多智能体协作、无代码团队设计，并提供智能搜索、知识库、语音交互、插件系统等强大功能，打造下一代 AI 驱动的生产力工具生态。
items.e: LobeHub is the ultimate workspace for human-agent collaboration, enabling multi-agent teamwork, effortless agent orchestration, and co-evolution between humans and AI. It features smart search, knowledge bases, voice interaction, plugin systems, and a growing ecosystem of agent teammates designed to enhance productivity.

items.d: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。
items.z: 该项目开源了国内小初高及大学PDF教材资源，旨在促进教育公平与普及，消除地区间教育贫困。特别聚焦小学数学和初中数学教材，提供人教版义务教育教科书，支持海外华人子女了解国内教育体系，推动以兴趣为导向的学习。
items.e: This project provides open access to Chinese K-12 and university PDF textbooks, promoting educational equity and accessibility. It focuses on elementary and middle school math materials, offering People's Education Press editions to support overseas Chinese families and foster interest-driven learning beyond exam-oriented education.

items.d: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
items.z: Playwright 是一个现代化的 Web 测试与自动化框架，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大浏览器内核的统一 API 调用。其核心优势在于内置智能等待机制、原生支持跨浏览器测试、无人工超时设计，以及自动生成测试追踪与录屏功能，显著提升端到端测试的稳定性与效率。
items.e: Playwright is a modern framework for web testing and automation that provides a single API to test Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers. It features built-in auto-waiting, cross-browser support, no artificial timeouts, and native tracing/video capture, making end-to-end tests more reliable and efficient.

items.d: A collection of MCP servers.
items.z: Awesome MCP Servers 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器集合，涵盖文件访问、数据库连接、API集成等场景，支持本地与云端服务。项目提供多语言 README 和活跃社区支持，并配有在线目录与测试工具，助力开发者快速集成 AI 能力至各类应用。
items.e: Awesome MCP Servers is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enabling secure AI interactions with local and remote resources. It includes production-ready and experimental servers for file access, databases, APIs, and more, with multilingual documentation, community support, and integrated testing tools via glama.ai.

items.d: mall项目是一套电商系统，包括前台商城系统及后台管理系统，基于Spring Boot+MyBatis实现，采用Docker容器化部署。 前台商城系统包含首页门户、商品推荐、商品搜索、商品展示、购物车、订单流程、会员中心、客户服务、帮助中心等模块。 后台管理系统包含商品管理、订单管理、会员管理、促销管理、运营管理、内容管理、统计报表、财务管理、权限管理、设置等模块。
items.z: mall 是一个完整的电商系统，包含基于 Spring Boot + MyBatis 的前台商城和后台管理系统，支持 Docker 容器化部署。前台涵盖商品展示、搜索、购物车、订单流程等核心电商功能；后台提供商品、订单、会员、促销等全链路管理。集成 Elasticsearch、Redis、RabbitMQ 等主流中间件，适合企业级电商项目开发与学习。
items.e: Mall is a full-featured e-commerce system with front-end portal and back-end management, built on Spring Boot + MyBatis and deployed via Docker. It includes product display, search, cart, checkout, and user management on the frontend, and supports comprehensive backend operations like inventory, orders, promotions, and analytics. Integrated with Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, and other modern technologies, it serves as a robust platform for enterprise-level e-commerce development and learning.

items.d: Free monospaced font with programming ligatures
items.z: Fira Code 是一款专为程序员设计的免费等宽字体，支持编程连字（ligatures），可自动将常见符号组合（如 `->`、`<=`、`:=`）渲染为单一视觉单元，提升代码可读性。字体完全兼容 ASCII，保留源码结构，同时提供丰富的字形变体、样式集和 Unicode 支持，适用于编辑器、终端及数学公式显示。
items.e: Fira Code is a free monospaced font featuring programming ligatures that render multi-character sequences like `->` or `:=` as single glyphs, enhancing code readability. It maintains ASCII compatibility while offering stylistic sets, character variants, and full Unicode support for editors, terminals, and mathematical notation.

items.d: Model Context Protocol Servers
items.z: 该仓库提供 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方参考服务器实现，涵盖文件操作、网络抓取、Git 管理、内存存储等场景，支持多语言 SDK（Python、TypeScript 等），旨在帮助开发者理解 MCP 架构并构建安全的 LLM 工具集成方案。
items.e: This repository offers reference implementations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including file system access, web fetching, Git operations, and memory management. Built with multi-language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, etc.), it serves as an educational resource for developers to build secure LLM-integrated tools using MCP.

items.d: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
items.z: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
items.e: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

items.d: Bring projects, wikis, and teams together with AI. AppFlowy is the AI collaborative workspace where you achieve more without losing control of your data. The leading open source Notion alternative.
items.z: AppFlowy 是一款开源的 AI 协作文档工具，作为 Notion 的替代方案，支持项目、维基与团队协作。基于 Flutter 和 Rust 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端应用，具备数据库、看板、文档及 AI 助手功能，强调数据自主控制与隐私安全。
items.e: AppFlowy is an open-source AI-powered collaborative workspace and Notion alternative, enabling projects, wikis, and team collaboration. Built with Flutter and Rust, it offers cross-platform desktop and mobile apps with databases, kanban boards, docs, and AI assistance, prioritizing data ownership and privacy.

items.d: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
items.z: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
items.e: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

items.d: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.z: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
items.e: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

items.d: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
items.z: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，专注于规格驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development），通过将规格转化为可执行代码，帮助开发者快速构建高质量软件。它提供 CLI 工具、AI 助手集成和项目治理框架，支持从零开始或现有项目初始化，显著提升开发效率并减少‘ vibe coding’。
items.e: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, transforming specifications into executable code to accelerate high-quality software creation. It offers CLI tools, AI agent integration, and project governance via `/speckit.constitution` and `/speckit.specify` commands, enabling rapid project initialization and reducing ad-hoc coding.

items.d: 《动手学深度学习》：面向中文读者、能运行、可讨论。中英文版被70多个国家的500多所大学用于教学。
items.z: 《动手学深度学习》是一本面向中文读者的开源深度学习教材，提供可运行代码与交互式学习体验，覆盖数学原理、算法实现与工程实践。该书被全球500多所大学采用，支持中英双语教学，强调批判性思维与动手能力，助力学习者成为具备实战能力的AI应用科学家。
items.e: Dive into Deep Learning is an open-source textbook designed for Chinese readers, offering executable code and interactive learning. It integrates mathematical theory, algorithmic implementation, and engineering practice, adopted by over 500 universities worldwide. The book emphasizes hands-on learning to cultivate AI application scientists with both theoretical depth and practical skills.

items.d: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
items.z: RAGFlow 是一款领先的开放源代码检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，深度融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为大型语言模型构建卓越的上下文层。它提供简洁高效的 RAG 工作流，适用于各类规模企业，支持多语言文档处理、智能问答、知识库构建及 Agent 驱动任务自动化。
items.e: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that seamlessly integrates advanced RAG with Agent capabilities to build superior context layers for LLMs. It delivers a streamlined, scalable workflow ideal for enterprises, supporting multilingual document processing, intelligent Q&A, knowledge base construction, and agent-driven task automation.

items.d: 🐹 Open-source Mac and PC cleaner. Keep your machine clean, light, and running like new. Fast CLI, plus native Mac and Windows apps.
items.z: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
items.e: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

items.d: 🎉 A curated list of awesome things related to Vue.js
items.z: Vue.js 生态精选资源库，涵盖官方文档、实战教程、UI组件库、企业级应用案例及开发工具，为开发者提供从入门到进阶的完整学习路径与生产级解决方案。
items.e: A meticulously curated collection of Vue.js resources including official docs, tutorials, UI component libraries, enterprise case studies, and development tools, offering a complete learning path from beginner to production-ready solutions.

items.d: The Python programming language
items.z: CPython 3.15.0 alpha 6 是 Python 官方参考实现的源代码仓库，提供完整的构建指南、跨平台编译支持及开发者工具链。项目包含完整的标准库、构建系统（configure/make）、测试套件和性能优化选项（如 PGO 和 LTO），适用于开发、调试及生产环境部署。
items.e: CPython 3.15.0 alpha 6 is the official reference implementation of the Python programming language, containing source code, build instructions, and developer tools. It supports cross-platform compilation, includes the full standard library, test suite, and performance optimizations like PGO and LTO for production-ready builds.

items.d: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
items.z: screenshot-to-code 是一款 AI 驱动的工具，支持将截图、设计稿或 Figma 设计直接转换为高质量的前端代码（HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue），支持 Gemini 3、Claude Opus 4.5 等先进模型，提供实验性视频录制转代码功能，适用于快速原型开发和 UI 自动化生成。
items.e: screenshot-to-code is an AI-powered tool that converts screenshots, mockups, and Figma designs into clean, functional front-end code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). It supports advanced models like Gemini 3 and Claude Opus 4.5, with experimental video-to-code capabilities for rapid prototyping and UI automation.

items.d: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
items.z: OpenAI Codex CLI 是一款轻量级终端编码智能体，支持本地运行代码生成与编辑。通过 npm 或 Homebrew 一键安装，集成 ChatGPT 账户体系，提供 IDE 插件及桌面应用扩展，适用于开发者快速实现自动化编程任务。
items.e: Codex CLI is a lightweight coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. Install via npm or Homebrew, sign in with ChatGPT, and use it in terminal, IDEs like VS Code, or as a desktop app for automated code generation and editing.

items.d: 为GPT/GLM等LLM大语言模型提供实用化交互接口，特别优化论文阅读/润色/写作体验，模块化设计，支持自定义快捷按钮&函数插件，支持Python和C++等项目剖析&自译解功能，PDF/LaTex论文翻译&总结功能，支持并行问询多种LLM模型，支持chatglm3等本地模型。接入通义千问, deepseekcoder, 讯飞星火, 文心一言, llama2, rwkv, claude2, moss等。
items.z: GPT Academic 是为 GPT/GLM 等 LLM 大语言模型设计的实用化交互接口，专注论文阅读、润色与写作优化，支持模块化插件与自定义快捷按钮，集成 Python/C++ 项目剖析、PDF/LaTeX 论文翻译与总结功能，兼容通义千问、DeepSeek、文心一言等主流模型，支持本地部署与多模型并行调用。
items.e: GPT Academic is a practical interface for GPT/GLM and other LLMs, optimized for academic tasks like paper reading, editing, and writing. It features modular plugins, custom shortcuts, code analysis, PDF/LaTeX translation, and supports multiple models including Qwen, DeepSeek, and local deployments like ChatGLM3.

items.d: Apache ECharts is a powerful, interactive charting and data visualization library for browser
items.z: Apache ECharts 是一个强大的开源数据可视化库，基于纯 JavaScript 和 zrender 构建，支持丰富的交互式图表（如折线图、柱状图、热力图等），提供高度可定制的配置选项，适用于商业产品中的数据可视化需求，支持 npm 安装、CDN 引入及多语言文档。
items.e: Apache ECharts is a free, powerful charting and visualization library for browsers, built with pure JavaScript and zrender. It offers intuitive, interactive, and highly customizable charts for commercial products, with support for npm, CDN, and comprehensive documentation.

items.d: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share.
items.z: Memos 是一款开源、自托管的快速笔记工具，专为即时记录设计。原生支持 Markdown，轻量高效，完全由用户掌控数据。提供简洁的时间线界面，无需分类导航，单命令部署，支持 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL，具备完整的 REST/gRPC API，适合个人知识管理和团队协作。
items.e: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking tool designed for instant capture. Native Markdown support, lightweight (~20MB Docker image), and full data ownership with zero telemetry. Features timeline-first UI, single binary deployment, and extensible via REST/gRPC APIs for personal knowledge management and team use.

items.d: ChatGPT 中文调教指南。各种场景使用指南。学习怎么让它听你的话。
items.z: 本项目提供全面的 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，涵盖学术论文、创意写作、商业文案、翻译、数据分析等 20+ 应用场景，帮助用户掌握提示词技巧，让 AI 高效完成各类任务，提升工作效率与内容质量。
items.e: This repository offers a comprehensive guide to prompting ChatGPT in Chinese, covering over 20 use cases including academic writing, creative content, business communication, translation, and data analysis. It empowers users to master prompt engineering and leverage AI for enhanced productivity and content quality.

items.d: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
items.z: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
items.e: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

items.d: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
items.z: Pake 是一个基于 Rust Tauri 框架的网页转桌面应用工具，支持一键将任意网页打包为跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）原生应用。核心优势包括体积小巧（仅约5MB）、启动迅速、零配置快速部署，并提供广告过滤、沉浸式模式、快捷键等丰富功能，极大提升网页应用的使用体验。
items.e: Pake is a lightweight tool that converts any webpage into a desktop app with one command, built on Rust Tauri for cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Linux). It offers ultra-small size (~5MB), fast startup, zero-configuration packaging, and features like ad-blocking, immersive mode, and customizable shortcuts for enhanced web app usability.

items.d: 🚀🤖 Crawl4AI: Open-source LLM Friendly Web Crawler & Scraper. Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN
items.z: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的 LLM 友好型网络爬虫与抓取工具，专为将网页转换为干净、适合大语言模型（LLM）处理的 Markdown 格式而设计，广泛应用于 RAG、智能体和数据流水线场景。其核心亮点包括高吞吐量、可控性强、支持 Docker 部署，并具备崩溃恢复、预抓取加速等高级功能，拥有 5 万+ GitHub 星标社区。
items.e: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It features high throughput, Docker support, crash recovery, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and is battle-tested by a 50k+ star community. Ideal for scalable, cost-effective web extraction.

items.d: A programming framework for agentic AI
items.z: AutoGen 是微软开源的多智能体 AI 编程框架，支持构建自主或人机协作的智能应用。它提供灵活的代理设计、多代理协同机制及与 MCP 等工具的深度集成，适用于复杂任务编排、自动化工作流和交互式 AI 系统开发。
items.e: AutoGen is an open-source framework for building multi-agent AI applications that can operate autonomously or collaborate with humans. It enables flexible agent design, orchestration, and integration with tools like MCP, supporting complex workflows, automation, and interactive AI systems.

items.d: :atom: The hackable text editor
items.z: Atom 是一款基于 Electron 构建的现代化可定制文本编辑器，专为 21 世纪开发者设计。它融合了经典编辑器的优点，支持深度自定义但默认配置友好易用，适用于跨平台开发环境。
items.e: Atom is a hackable, modern text editor built on Electron, designed for deep customization while remaining approachable. It combines the best features of traditional editors with a flexible, open-source architecture for developers.

items.d: Scrapy, a fast high-level web crawling & scraping framework for Python.
items.z: Scrapy 是一个高性能的 Python 网络爬虫框架，专为高效提取结构化数据而设计。支持跨平台运行，基于异步架构实现高并发抓取，提供灵活的中间件扩展机制，广泛用于数据采集、价格监控、内容聚合等场景。
items.e: Scrapy is a high-performance Python web crawling and scraping framework designed for extracting structured data from websites. Built on an asynchronous architecture, it enables high-concurrency data extraction with flexible middleware support, widely used in data collection, price monitoring, and content aggregation.

items.d: The Magic Mask for Android
items.z: Magisk 是一款专为 Android 6.0+ 设备设计的开源定制工具，提供系统级 root 权限、模块化功能扩展及 Zygisk 动态注入能力，支持在不修改系统分区的情况下深度定制设备，广泛用于解锁系统限制、安装模块和高级调试。
items.e: Magisk is an open-source suite for customizing Android devices above Android 6.0, offering root access via MagiskSU, systemless modification through modules, and Zygisk for runtime code injection, enabling deep customization without altering system partitions.

items.d: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
items.z: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
items.e: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

items.d: Autonomous coding agent right in your IDE, capable of creating/editing files, executing commands, using the browser, and more with your permission every step of the way.
items.z: Cline 是一款集成在 IDE 中的自主编码代理，基于 Claude Sonnet 的代理能力，支持文件创建/编辑、终端命令执行、浏览器操作等，全程需用户授权。通过 AST 分析、正则搜索和上下文管理，可处理复杂开发任务，支持 MCP 扩展工具，提供安全的 AI 编程辅助。
items.e: Cline is an autonomous coding agent integrated directly into your IDE, powered by Claude Sonnet's agentic capabilities. It can create/edit files, execute terminal commands, use browsers, and more—with your permission at every step. Designed for complex software development tasks through AST analysis, regex searches, and context-aware workflows, it extends functionality via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while maintaining human oversight for safety.

items.d: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
items.z: CLI-Anything 致力于将任意软件转化为原生 AI 智能体工具，通过统一接口桥接 AI 代理与真实世界软件。支持一键安装社区构建的 CLI 工具，提供 OpenClaw、Cursor 等平台兼容方案，覆盖 16+ 应用并实现 1839 项测试全通过。核心功能包括自动化注册、元技能发现及 JSON/人类可读双输出格式。
items.e: CLI-Anything enables any software to become agent-native, bridging AI agents with real-world tools via standardized interfaces. Features one-command installation from the community-driven CLI-Hub, compatibility with platforms like Cursor and Claude Code, support for 16+ applications, and 100% test pass rate (1,839 tests). Includes automated registry updates, meta-skill discovery, and dual JSON/human-readable output formats.

items.d: :arrow_double_down: Dumb downloader that scrapes the web
items.z: You-Get 是一个轻量级命令行工具，用于从互联网下载视频、音频和图片内容，尤其适用于无官方下载渠道的网站。支持 YouTube、优酷等主流平台，具备流媒体播放、字幕下载及网页图片抓取功能，依赖 Python 和 FFmpeg，是开源的网页内容抓取工具。
items.e: You-Get is a lightweight command-line utility to download media (videos, audios, images) from the web when no official download option exists. It supports platforms like YouTube and Youku, enables streaming playback, subtitle extraction, and image scraping, and relies on Python and FFmpeg as core dependencies.

items.d: The all-in-one AI productivity accelerator. On device and privacy first with no annoying setup or configration.
items.z: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
items.e: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

items.d: Transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.
items.z: MinerU 是一款高效文档解析工具，可将 PDF 等复杂文档自动转换为 LLM 友好的结构化输出（Markdown/JSON），显著提升 Agentic 工作流的文档处理效率与数据可用性。
items.e: MinerU is a high-performance document parsing tool that transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready structured outputs (Markdown/JSON), significantly enhancing document processing efficiency and data accessibility for agentic workflows.

items.d: Get your documents ready for gen AI
items.z: Docling 是一个强大的文档处理工具，支持多种格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX等）的解析与理解，具备高级 PDF 布局分析、表格识别、OCR 及音频转文本功能。它提供统一的 DoclingDocument 输出格式，支持导出为 Markdown、HTML、JSON 等格式，并无缝集成 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等 AI 框架，专为生成式 AI 应用打造。
items.e: Docling is a powerful document processing tool that parses diverse formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, etc.) with advanced PDF layout analysis, table recognition, OCR, and ASR capabilities. It outputs unified DoclingDocument format, supports exports to Markdown, HTML, JSON, and integrates seamlessly with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and other AI frameworks for gen AI applications.

items.d: 1 min voice data can also be used to train a good TTS model! (few shot voice cloning)
items.z: GPT-SoVITS 是一款强大的少样本语音克隆与文本转语音 WebUI 工具，支持零样本和少样本 TTS 训练，仅需 1 分钟语音数据即可微调模型，实现高保真跨语言语音合成，支持中英日韩等多种语言，集成语音分离、ASR 和文本标注等数据集构建工具。
items.e: GPT-SoVITS is a powerful few-shot voice cloning and text-to-speech WebUI that enables zero-shot and few-shot TTS training with just 1 minute of audio data. It supports cross-lingual synthesis in Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and more, featuring integrated tools for voice separation, ASR, and dataset preparation.

items.d: A list of cool features of Git and GitHub.
items.z: 本项目是 GitHub 和 Git 的高级功能速查表，涵盖隐藏特性如忽略空白符、分支对比、行号高亮、任务列表、Emoji 支持、Gist 使用、Hub 工具等，帮助开发者提升工作效率，适用于日常开发协作与代码审查场景。
items.e: This repository provides a comprehensive cheat sheet of advanced Git and GitHub features, including whitespace ignoring, branch comparisons, line highlighting, task lists, emoji support, Gists, Hub CLI, and more—designed to boost developer productivity in collaborative coding and code review workflows.

items.d: Build AI Agents, Visually
items.z: Flowise 是一个可视化 AI 智能体构建平台，支持通过拖拽方式快速搭建 LLM 应用流程。它提供图形化界面集成主流大模型、向量数据库和工具节点，支持本地部署与云端服务，适用于开发者和企业快速原型开发与生产部署。
items.e: Flowise is a visual platform for building AI agents and LLM applications using drag-and-drop workflows. It integrates major LLMs, vector databases, and tools via a no-code interface, supporting both self-hosted and cloud deployment for rapid prototyping and production use.

items.d: CLI platform to experiment with codegen. Precursor to: https://lovable.dev
items.z: gpt-engineer 是一个基于 CLI 的代码生成实验平台，支持通过自然语言描述需求，由 AI 自动生成并执行代码，并可迭代优化。它支持 OpenAI API、本地模型及 Azure 等多种模型，提供项目创建、代码改进和自定义代理基准测试功能，是早期 AI 编程工具的重要探索。
items.e: gpt-engineer is a CLI platform for experimenting with AI-driven code generation. It allows users to specify software in natural language, watch an AI write and execute code, and iteratively improve it. Supports OpenAI, local models, and Azure, with features for project creation, code improvement, and benchmarking custom agents.

items.d: An advanced guide which might benefit you a lot 🎉 . 人生进阶指南 离谱的人生 离谱的英语学习指南/英语学习教程/英语学习/学英语
items.z: 《离谱的英语学习指南》是一份系统化的英语进阶学习指南，结合作者自身高分经验与科学方法，涵盖词汇、听力、阅读、口语、写作及AI辅助等模块，强调语言学习的自然性与趣味性，提供从CEFR等级到实用技巧的完整路径，助力学习者高效突破瓶颈。
items.e: This advanced English learning guide offers a comprehensive, scientifically-informed approach to mastering English through structured modules on vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing, and AI tools. It emphasizes natural language acquisition and personal enjoyment, providing a clear roadmap from CEFR levels to practical strategies for learners aiming to break through plateaus.

items.d: A Vue.js 2.0 UI Toolkit for Web
items.z: Element 是一个基于 Vue.js 2.0 的企业级 UI 组件库，提供丰富的组件和完善的文档支持，适用于中后台管理系统开发。采用模块化设计，支持主题定制，具备完善的国际化方案，并拥有活跃的社区生态。
items.e: Element is a Vue.js 2.0 UI toolkit for web development, offering a comprehensive set of components and documentation for enterprise-level applications. It features modular architecture, theme customization, full internationalization, and an active community ecosystem.

items.d: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
items.z: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力工作室，集成智能聊天、自主代理和300+助手，提供统一接口访问主流大语言模型，支持多语言界面与跨平台部署，适用于个人及企业级智能工作流构建。
items.e: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity studio featuring smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants with unified access to leading LLMs. It supports multi-language interfaces and cross-platform deployment for building intelligent workflows at personal or enterprise level.

items.d: all of the workflows of n8n i could find (also from the site itself)
items.z: 该仓库收集了 n8n 自动化工作流的完整集合，包含 4343+ 个工作流和 365+ 种集成，覆盖网页抓取、AI 智能体、数据同步等场景。核心亮点是集成 AI-BOM 工具，可扫描工作流中的 AI 安全风险，如硬编码密钥、未授权 AI 代理和危险工具组合，提供合规性报告，助力满足 EU AI Act 要求。
items.e: This repository aggregates 4,343+ n8n automation workflows with 365+ integrations, covering web scraping, AI agents, and data synchronization. Its standout feature is the integration of AI-BOM, the first tool to scan n8n workflows for AI security risks—detecting hardcoded keys, unauthenticated agents, and dangerous tool combinations—while generating compliance-ready reports aligned with EU AI Act deadlines.

items.d: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
items.z: Ghost 是一个现代化的开源 Node.js 内容管理系统（CMS），专为独立创作者、会员订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供强大的发布工具、会员管理和订阅功能，支持无头架构，可灵活集成前端框架。核心优势包括简洁的编辑器、SEO 优化、自动化工作流和 Ghost(Pro) 托管服务，适合个人博客、媒体网站及内容变现平台。
items.e: Ghost is a modern, open-source Node.js CMS designed for professional publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editor, SEO tools, and headless architecture for flexible front-end integration. With features like automated workflows and Ghost(Pro) managed hosting, it's ideal for creators and publishers seeking a developer-friendly, scalable platform.

items.d: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
items.z: New API 是一个统一的 AI 模型聚合与分发平台，支持将各类大语言模型转换为 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容格式，提供个人与企业级的中心化模型管理网关。
items.e: New API is a unified AI model hub for aggregation and distribution, supporting cross-conversion of various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It serves as a centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

items.d: Semantic is a UI component framework based around useful principles from natural language.
items.z: Semantic UI 是一个基于自然语言原则的现代化 UI 组件框架，提供 50+ 组件、3000+ CSS 变量和三级变量继承体系，支持 EM 响应式设计和 Flexbox 布局，兼容 React/Angular 等主流框架，助力快速构建美观且可维护的前端界面。
items.e: Semantic UI is a modern UI component framework based on natural language principles, offering 50+ components, 3000+ CSS variables, and a three-level variable inheritance system. It supports responsive design with EM values and Flexbox, integrates seamlessly with React, Angular, and other frameworks, enabling rapid development of beautiful and maintainable web interfaces.

items.d: 🗂️A file list/WebDAV program that supports multiple storages, powered by Gin and Solidjs. / 一个支持多存储的文件列表/WebDAV程序，使用 Gin 和 Solidjs。
items.z: AlistGo/alist 是一个基于 Gin 和 Solidjs 构建的多存储文件列表/WebDAV 程序，支持本地、阿里云盘、OneDrive、Google Drive 等数十种云存储，提供统一访问入口与在线预览功能，具备轻量部署、开箱即用特性。
items.e: AlistGo/alist is a multi-storage file list and WebDAV program built with Gin and SolidJS, supporting over 30 cloud services including local storage, AliYunDrive, OneDrive, and Google Drive. It offers unified access, online preview, and easy deployment out-of-the-box.

items.d: 利用AI大模型，一键生成高清短视频 Generate short videos with one click using AI LLM.
items.z: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一款基于 AI 大模型的智能短视频生成工具，支持一键生成高清横竖屏视频。用户只需输入主题或关键词，即可自动完成文案生成、素材匹配、语音合成、字幕添加及背景音乐配置，全面覆盖视频创作流程，支持多模型接入与批量处理，适用于内容创作者快速产出高质量短视频。
items.e: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an AI-powered short video generation tool that leverages large language models to automatically create high-definition videos with one click. Users input a topic or keyword to generate scripts, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and background music. It supports multiple AI models, batch processing, and both vertical and horizontal formats, ideal for content creators seeking efficient video production.

items.d: aider is AI pair programming in your terminal
items.z: Aider 是一款终端 AI 结对编程工具，支持与主流大模型（如 Claude、GPT-4、DeepSeek）协作开发，具备代码库映射、Git 集成、100+ 语言支持和 IDE 插件能力，实现自然语言驱动的代码修改与项目管理。
items.e: Aider is an AI pair programming tool in the terminal that collaborates with LLMs like Claude and GPT-4 to edit code, manage projects, and integrate with Git. It supports codebase mapping, IDE plugins, and works across 100+ programming languages via natural language commands.

items.d: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
items.z: Cypress 是一款专为浏览器端应用设计的现代化端到端测试框架，提供快速、易用且可靠的测试体验。它支持实时重载、时间旅行调试和自动等待等特性，显著提升前端测试效率与稳定性，适用于现代 Web 应用的全流程自动化测试。
items.e: Cypress is a modern end-to-end testing framework designed for browser-based applications, offering fast, easy, and reliable testing. It features real-time reloads, time-travel debugging, and automatic waiting to enhance frontend test efficiency and stability, ideal for full-stack automation across modern web apps.

items.d: Odoo. Open Source Apps To Grow Your Business.
items.z: Odoo 是一套基于开源技术的企业级业务应用套件，涵盖 CRM、电商、仓储、财务、项目管理等核心模块，支持模块化部署与无缝集成，提供完整的开源 ERP 解决方案。其低代码平台与 Python 技术栈便于二次开发，适用于中小企业数字化转型。
items.e: Odoo is an open-source business application suite featuring integrated modules like CRM, eCommerce, accounting, and inventory management. Built on Python, it offers modular, scalable ERP solutions with seamless integration and extensive customization capabilities for growing businesses.

items.d: OCR software, free and offline. 开源、免费的离线OCR软件。支持截屏/批量导入图片，PDF文档识别，排除水印/页眉页脚，扫描/生成二维码。内置多国语言库。
items.z: Umi-OCR 是一款开源免费的离线OCR软件，支持截图识别、批量图片处理、PDF文档扫描及二维码识别。具备智能排版解析、水印页眉页脚排除功能，内置多国语言识别库，无需联网即可高效运行，适用于Windows和Linux系统。
items.e: Umi-OCR is a free, open-source, offline OCR software supporting screenshot recognition, batch image processing, PDF scanning, and QR code detection. It features intelligent layout parsing, watermark/header/footer removal, and multi-language recognition libraries, running efficiently without internet on Windows and Linux.

items.d: :fireworks:Interactive Online Platform that Visualizes Algorithms from Code
items.z: Algorithm Visualizer 是一个交互式在线平台，通过可视化代码将算法动态呈现，帮助学习者和开发者直观理解算法执行过程。支持多种编程语言，提供丰富的教程与可视化效果，适用于教学与算法研究。
items.e: Algorithm Visualizer is an interactive online platform that brings algorithms to life through code visualization. It supports multiple programming languages and offers engaging educational content, making algorithm learning intuitive and effective for students and professionals.

items.d: 🚀 Awesome list of open source applications for macOS. https://t.me/s/opensourcemacosapps
items.z: 该仓库是 macOS 开源应用精选列表，收录 689 款高质量开源应用，涵盖音频、开发、图形、生产力等 49 个类别。以 Swift 为主力语言，支持跨平台与原生应用，旨在帮助用户发现优质免费工具并鼓励社区贡献。
items.e: This repository curates 689 open source macOS applications across 49 categories, including audio, development, graphics, and productivity. Primarily written in Swift, it features both native and cross-platform apps to help users discover free tools and encourages community contributions.

items.d: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
items.z: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
items.e: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

items.d: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么
items.z: 中国独立开发者项目列表聚合了2026年2月最新上线的创新产品，涵盖AI语音助手、投资理财工具、打字练习平台、音乐生成、简历优化、浏览器插件等多个领域。项目以网站或App形式呈现，强调实用性与用户体验，如智能语音朗读、美股A股基金定投计算、AI音乐创作等，展现了中国独立开发者在AI应用与垂直场景工具上的活跃创新。
items.e: This repo aggregates innovative projects by Chinese indie developers launched in February 2026, including AI voice assistants, investment calculators, typing trainers, music generation tools, resume optimizers, and browser extensions. All projects are web or app-based, emphasizing practicality and user experience, such as intelligent text-to-speech, stock/fund investment analysis, AI-powered songwriting, and productivity tools, showcasing active innovation in AI applications and niche utility apps.

items.d: The open-source CapCut alternative
items.z: OpenCut 是一款免费开源的视频编辑器，支持网页、桌面和移动端，提供时间轴编辑、多轨道支持、实时预览等功能，无水印且无需订阅。注重隐私保护，所有视频处理在本地完成，核心功能对标 CapCut，适合追求简洁高效的用户。
items.e: OpenCut is a free, open-source video editor for web, desktop, and mobile, offering timeline-based editing, multi-track support, and real-time preview. It emphasizes privacy by processing videos locally, avoids watermarks, and targets users seeking CapCut-like simplicity without paywalled features.

items.d: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation
items.z: acme.sh 是一个纯 Unix shell 脚本实现的 ACME 客户端，用于自动化 SSL/TLS 证书申请与续期。支持 ECDSA、通配符和多域名证书，兼容主流操作系统和容器环境，部署简单，仅需3分钟掌握，是运维自动化的理想工具。
items.e: acme.sh is a pure Unix shell script ACME client for automating SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal. It supports ECDSA, wildcard, and SAN certificates, runs on major OS platforms and containers, and is easy to deploy—masterable in just 3 minutes for efficient DevOps automation.

items.d: 小红书笔记 | 评论爬虫、抖音视频 | 评论爬虫、快手视频 | 评论爬虫、B 站视频 ｜ 评论爬虫、微博帖子 ｜ 评论爬虫、百度贴吧帖子 ｜ 百度贴吧评论回复爬虫  | 知乎问答文章｜评论爬虫
items.z: MediaCrawler 是一个基于 Playwright 的多平台自媒体数据采集工具，支持小红书、抖音、B站等7大主流平台的公开内容抓取，具备关键词搜索、评论爬取、登录态缓存、IP代理池及词云图生成等功能，无需复杂逆向即可高效采集数据。
items.e: MediaCrawler is a powerful multi-platform media crawler built with Playwright, supporting data extraction from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, and 7+ platforms. It enables keyword search, comment scraping, login state caching, proxy pools, and comment word cloud generation without requiring complex reverse engineering.

items.d: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
items.z: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、开发工具、数据分析、商业营销等十大领域。通过 Composio 插件，Claude 可连接500+应用执行真实操作（如发邮件、创建工单），实现从文本生成到自动化工作的跨越。
items.e: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of practical workflows for enhancing Claude AI across platforms. It covers document processing, development tools, data analysis, business automation, and more. With the Composio plugin, Claude can connect to 500+ apps to perform real-world actions like sending emails or creating issues, extending beyond text generation.

items.d: 🌐 The Internet Computer! Free, Open-Source, and Self-Hostable.
items.z: Puter 是一个开源的个人互联网操作系统，提供文件管理、应用商店和远程桌面功能，支持自托管与云端部署。它具备隐私优先的云存储能力，可作为 Dropbox 或 Google Drive 的替代方案，同时支持网站、Web 应用和游戏的开发与发布，适用于个人云、服务器管理和学习分布式系统。
items.e: Puter is an open-source personal internet OS offering file management, app store, and remote desktop capabilities. It supports self-hosting and cloud deployment, functioning as a privacy-focused alternative to services like Dropbox or Google Drive, while enabling web app development and distributed system learning.

items.d: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
items.z: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
items.e: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

items.d: TensorFlow Tutorial and Examples for Beginners (support TF v1 & v2)
items.z: 本项目为 TensorFlow 初学者提供全面且结构化的学习路径，涵盖从基础操作到高级模型的完整示例。通过 Jupyter Notebook 和源码结合的方式，清晰展示 TF v1 与 v2 的实现差异，重点突出现代 API 最佳实践（如 layers、estimator、dataset），适合希望快速上手 TensorFlow 并掌握其核心功能的开发者。
items.e: This repository offers a comprehensive, beginner-friendly tutorial for TensorFlow, featuring clear examples in both notebooks and source code for TF v1 and v2. It covers fundamental operations to advanced models, emphasizing modern API practices such as layers, estimator, and dataset. Ideal for developers seeking hands-on experience with TensorFlow's core functionalities.

items.d: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
items.z: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式学习平台，通过 AI 教师和同学实时互动，将任意主题或文档转化为沉浸式课堂体验。支持一键生成课件、测验、白板演示及项目式学习活动，集成 OpenClaw 实现从飞书、Slack 等消息应用直接创建课程。
items.e: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent AI platform that transforms any topic or document into an immersive classroom experience. Powered by AI teachers and peers, it generates slides, quizzes, simulations, and interactive learning activities in real time, with built-in OpenClaw integration for seamless creation from messaging apps like Feishu, Slack, or Telegram.

items.d: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
items.z: Sentry 是一款开发者优先的错误追踪与性能监控平台，提供实时问题检测、错误追踪、性能分析和用户行为回放功能，支持 20+ 编程语言和框架的官方 SDK，助力团队快速定位并修复代码缺陷。
items.e: Sentry is a developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring platform that enables real-time issue detection, error tracing, performance insights, and user session replay. It supports 20+ languages via official SDKs, helping teams debug and resolve problems faster.

items.d: The self-managing agent platform
items.z: Agno 是一个专为构建、运行和管理大规模智能体软件而设计的运行时框架。它支持构建具备记忆、知识库、防护机制和百种集成的智能体，提供 FastAPI 后端服务，实现状态化智能体的生产级部署与监控，并通过 AgentOS UI 提供测试、管理和追踪功能。
items.e: Agno is a runtime framework for building, running, and managing agentic software at scale. It enables creation of stateful agents with memory, knowledge, guardrails, and 100+ integrations, serving them via a stateless FastAPI backend in production, with monitoring and management through the AgentOS UI.

items.d: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长。同时支持飞书、钉钉、企业微信应用、微信公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助手和企业数字员工。
items.z: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
items.e: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

items.d: An AI SKILL that provide design intelligence for building professional UI/UX multiple platforms
items.z: UI UX Pro Max 是一款 AI 技能，专为多平台构建专业 UI/UX 设计而生。其核心功能是通过 AI 驱动的设计系统生成器，快速分析项目需求并输出适配不同框架的完整设计体系，支持 67 种 UI 风格与 100 条推理规则，显著提升跨平台设计效率与一致性。
items.e: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill delivering intelligent design solutions for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. Its flagship Design System Generator uses AI reasoning to instantly analyze project requirements and generate tailored, framework-agnostic design systems, supporting 67 UI styles and 100 reasoning rules for efficient cross-platform design.

items.d: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
items.z: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
items.e: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

items.d: The uncompromising Python code formatter
items.z: Black 是一个无妥协的 Python 代码格式化工具，强制统一代码风格，提升团队协作效率。它基于 AST 分析实现确定性格式化，支持 Python 3.10+ 及 Jupyter Notebook，提供极小 diff 输出以加速代码审查，并内置语法有效性验证确保代码安全。
items.e: Black is the uncompromising Python code formatter that enforces consistent style across projects. It reformats entire files in place using AST analysis, supports Python 3.10+ and Jupyter Notebooks, produces minimal diffs for faster code reviews, and validates syntax safety through built-in AST checks.

items.d: A fast, simple & powerful blog framework, powered by Node.js.
items.z: Hexo 是一个基于 Node.js 的快速、简洁且强大的博客框架，支持 GitHub Flavored Markdown 和 Octopress 插件，提供一键部署到 GitHub Pages 等功能，拥有强大的 API 和丰富的主题插件生态。
items.e: Hexo is a fast, simple & powerful blog framework powered by Node.js, supporting GitHub Flavored Markdown and Octopress plugins, with one-command deployment to platforms like GitHub Pages, a robust API, and extensive themes and plugins.

items.d: Teams-first Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code
items.z: oh-my-claudecode 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的多智能体协同框架，采用零学习曲线理念。通过团队模式（team）实现 staged pipeline 自动化开发流程，支持 tmux CLI 工作器扩展 Codex/Gemini 能力，提供 deep-interview 需求澄清和 /ccg 混合协作技能，显著提升团队协作效率。
items.e: oh-my-claudecode is a zero-learning-curve multi-agent orchestration framework for Claude Code. It enables automated team-based development via staged pipelines, supports tmux CLI workers for Codex/Gemini integration, offers deep-interview for requirement clarification, and provides /ccg skill for mixed AI collaboration to boost team productivity.

items.d: Breakthrough Method for Agile Ai Driven Development
items.z: BMad Method 是一个 AI 驱动的敏捷开发框架，提供结构化工作流程和12+领域专家代理（如PM、架构师、开发者等），支持从小型修复到企业级系统的自适应开发。核心特性包括智能帮助、多代理协作（Party Mode）、完整生命周期管理，并集成官方模块如BMad Builder、Test Architect等，助力高效构建复杂系统。
items.e: BMad Method is an AI-driven agile development framework offering structured workflows and 12+ domain expert agents (e.g., PM, Architect, Developer), with scale-adaptive intelligence for projects from bug fixes to enterprise systems. Key features include AI-guided help, multi-agent collaboration (Party Mode), full lifecycle support, and official modules like BMad Builder and Test Architect for specialized domains.

items.z: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
items.e: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

items.d: 人人都能用英语
items.z: Enjoy 是一款 AI 驱动的外语学习工具，通过智能助教帮助用户高效学习英语。支持网页、浏览器插件（YouTube/Netflix）及桌面端，提供视频跟读、电子书学习、闪卡复习和课程定制等功能，结合‘一千小时’训练体系实现沉浸式语言习得。
items.e: Enjoy is an AI-powered English learning tool that leverages intelligent assistants to help users master English efficiently. It offers web, browser extension (for YouTube/Netflix), and desktop versions, featuring video dubbing, e-book study, flashcards, and personalized courses based on the '1000-hour' immersive training methodology.

items.d: 🎥      Make videos programmatically with React
items.z: Remotion 是一个基于 React 的视频编程框架，允许开发者使用 Web 技术（如 CSS、Canvas、SVG、WebGL）和 React 组件库来创建动态视频。它支持变量、API 调用、算法等编程能力，适用于个性化视频生成、数据可视化动画等场景，如 GitHub Unwrapped 年度报告。
items.e: Remotion is a React-based framework for programmatically creating videos using web technologies like CSS, Canvas, SVG, and WebGL. It enables dynamic video generation through programming logic, reusable components, and real-time preview, ideal for personalized content, data-driven animations, and automated video production.

items.d: Materialize, a CSS Framework based on Material Design
items.z: MaterializeCSS 是基于 Material Design 原则构建的现代化 CSS 框架，提供丰富的预构建组件（如导航栏、卡片、表单）和流畅的动画效果，支持响应式布局与主流浏览器兼容，适用于快速开发美观且用户友好的 Web 应用。
items.e: MaterializeCSS is a modern CSS framework based on Material Design principles, offering a rich set of pre-built components (e.g., navigation, cards, forms) with smooth animations and responsive layouts, compatible with major browsers for rapid development of visually appealing and user-friendly web applications.

items.d: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
items.z: AI网站克隆模板，通过AI编程代理一键逆向工程任意网站为现代化Next.js代码库。支持Claude Code等主流AI工具，自动提取设计元素、生成组件规范并并行构建页面结构，显著提升前端开发效率。
items.e: AI Website Cloner Template enables one-command reverse-engineering of any website into a modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents. It automatically extracts design tokens, generates component specifications, and reconstructs pages through parallel builders, supporting major platforms like Claude Code for rapid frontend development.

items.d: Powerful AI Client
items.z: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
items.e: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

items.d: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。
items.z: 微舆（BettaFish）是一个从0实现的多Agent舆情分析系统，通过AI驱动的全域社媒监控、复合分析引擎、多模态内容解析及Agent协作机制，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌并预测趋势。系统支持公私域数据融合，具备轻量化Python架构与高扩展性，可快速定制至金融等垂直领域。
items.e: BettaFish is a zero-to-one implemented multi-Agent public opinion analysis system that breaks information cocoons and predicts trends through AI-driven social media monitoring, hybrid analysis engines, and agent collaboration. It supports private-public data fusion, offers lightweight Python architecture, and enables rapid customization for vertical domains like finance.

items.d: Build your personal knowledge base with Trilium Notes
items.z: Trilium Notes 是一款免费开源的跨平台笔记应用，支持构建大型个人知识库。其核心功能包括无限层级树状结构、富文本与 Markdown 编辑器、代码高亮、全文搜索、版本控制及多位置克隆笔记，适用于知识管理与结构化信息存储。
items.e: Trilium Notes is a free, open-source, cross-platform note-taking app focused on building large personal knowledge bases. It features hierarchical notes with cloning support, rich WYSIWYG editing (including math and code syntax highlighting), full-text search, versioning, and seamless navigation.

items.d: Query Engine for AI Analytics: Build self-reasoning agents across all your live data
items.z: MindsDB 是一个开源 AI 分析查询引擎，支持构建能直接访问数据库、数据仓库和应用程序的自主推理 AI 代理。它通过 SQL 兼容语言统一 200+ 数据源，无需 ETL，实现自然语言问答和语义搜索，适用于对话式分析、知识库检索等场景。
items.e: MindsDB is an open-source AI analytics query engine that powers self-reasoning agents to answer questions directly from live data sources like databases and data warehouses without ETL. It unifies 200+ data sources via SQL-compatible syntax, enabling conversational analytics and semantic search across structured and unstructured data.

items.d: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
items.z: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 技能蒸馏工具，通过分析公开资料提取顶尖人物的认知框架、决策启发式和表达模式，让用户直接调用乔布斯、马斯克等名人的思维方式解决实际问题。核心功能包括五层心智模型提取（表达DNA、认知框架、决策启发式、反模式、诚实边界），支持一键安装并已在 Claude Code 中验证可用性。
items.e: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent that distills the cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication patterns of top-tier individuals like Jobs, Musk, and Zhang Xuefeng from public data. It enables users to invoke these distilled mental models directly in Claude Code for problem-solving. The system extracts five layers of thinking patterns (expression DNA, cognitive architecture, judgment heuristics, anti-patterns, and honest boundaries) with clear limitations on what cannot be captured.

items.d: A powerful 🚀 Android chart view / graph view library, supporting line- bar- pie- radar- bubble- and candlestick charts as well as scaling, panning and animations.
items.z: MPAndroidChart 是一个功能强大且易于使用的 Android 图表库，支持折线图、柱状图、饼图、雷达图、气泡图和 K 线图等多种图表类型，具备缩放、平移和动画功能，适用于数据可视化场景。
items.e: MPAndroidChart is a powerful and easy-to-use Android chart library supporting line, bar, pie, radar, bubble, and candlestick charts with scaling, panning, and animations for data visualization.

items.d: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
items.z: Vane 是一个隐私优先的 AI 问答引擎，支持本地 LLM（Ollama）和云端大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Groq），结合互联网知识库与 SearxNG 网页搜索，提供带引用来源的精准回答。支持文件上传、多模态搜索、智能建议及本地历史记录，所有数据在本地处理以保障隐私。
items.e: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your hardware, combining internet knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq). It delivers cited answers via SearxNG-powered web search, supports file uploads, multimodal content, smart suggestions, and maintains local search history—all while keeping data private.

items.d: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.
items.z: Khoj 是一款自托管的个人 AI 应用，可作为你的 AI 第二大脑。它支持与本地或在线 LLM（如 Llama3、GPT、Claude、Gemini 等）对话，从互联网或文档中获取答案，并构建自定义智能体、自动化任务及深度研究。具备语义搜索、多格式文档解析、跨平台访问等功能，完全开源且隐私安全。
items.e: Khoj is a self-hostable personal AI app acting as your AI second brain. It enables interaction with any local or online LLM (e.g., Llama3, GPT, Claude), retrieves answers from the web or your documents, builds custom agents, automates research, and supports semantic search across PDFs, Markdown, Notion, Word files, and more. Fully open-source and privacy-focused.

items.d: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
items.z: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
items.e: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

items.d: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
items.z: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
items.e: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

items.d: LLM API 管理 & 分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、字节豆包、ChatGLM、文心一言、讯飞星火、通义千问、360 智脑、腾讯混元等主流模型，统一 API 适配，可用于 key 管理与二次分发。单可执行文件，提供 Docker 镜像，一键部署，开箱即用。LLM API management & key redistribution system, unifying multiple providers under a single API. Single binary, Docker-ready, with an English UI.
items.z: One API 是一个统一的 LLM API 管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、文心一言等数十家主流大模型，通过标准 OpenAI API 格式统一接入，实现密钥管理、负载均衡与二次分发。提供单可执行文件部署、Docker 镜像及英文 Web UI，开箱即用，适用于企业级多模型集成场景。
items.e: One API is a unified LLM API management and distribution system that supports over 20 mainstream models including OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Baidu's Wenxin. It standardizes access via OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling key management, load balancing, and redistribution. Deployable as a single binary or Docker image with an English web interface, it offers out-of-the-box functionality for enterprise multi-model integration.

items.d: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
items.z: DrawDB 是一款免费、简洁且直观的免费在线数据库关系图编辑器，支持可视化设计数据库结构并自动生成 SQL 脚本。用户无需注册即可直接在浏览器中创建、编辑和导出数据库模型，适用于快速原型设计、文档绘制和团队协作。
items.e: DrawDB is a free, simple, and intuitive online database schema editor and SQL generator. It enables users to visually design database structures, generate SQL scripts, and export diagrams directly in the browser—no account required. Ideal for rapid prototyping, documentation, and team collaboration.

items.d: A shadowsocks client for Android
items.z: Shadowsocks Android 是一款基于 Kotlin 开发的开源代理客户端，支持 Android 和 Chrome OS 平台。该应用提供安全、快速的科学上网功能，采用 Shadowsocks 协议加密传输数据，兼容多种服务器配置，具备自动切换、流量统计等实用功能，适用于需要隐私保护和网络访问的场景。
items.e: Shadowsocks Android is an open-source proxy client built with Kotlin for Android and Chrome OS. It enables secure and fast internet access using the Shadowsocks protocol, supporting multiple server configurations, automatic switching, and traffic monitoring for enhanced privacy and network freedom.

items.d: Free ChatGPT&DeepSeek API Key，免费ChatGPT&DeepSeek API。免费接入DeepSeek API和GPT4 API，支持 gpt | deepseek | claude | gemini | grok 等排名靠前的常用大模型。
items.z: ChatAnywhere 提供免费 ChatGPT 和 DeepSeek API 转发服务，支持 gpt-5、gpt-4o、deepseek-r1/v3、claude、gemini、grok 等主流大模型。采用 OpenAI 标准协议，兼容各类应用，支持流式响应，国内直连无需代理，免费额度每日 200 次（按 IP 和 Key 共享），适合个人非商业用途。
items.e: ChatAnywhere offers free ChatGPT and DeepSeek API key forwarding services, supporting top-tier models like gpt-5, gpt-4o, deepseek-r1/v3, claude, gemini, and grok. It uses the official OpenAI-compatible protocol, supports streaming responses, and enables direct access from China without proxies. Free tier allows 200 requests/day per IP+Key combination for personal non-commercial use.

items.d: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
