items.d: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
items.z: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
items.e: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

items.d: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh
items.z: zsh-autosuggestions 为 zsh 终端提供类 Fish 的实时命令建议功能，基于历史记录和补全引擎智能生成建议。支持自定义高亮样式与建议策略，可无缝集成 Oh My Zsh，显著提升命令行输入效率与用户体验。
items.e: zsh-autosuggestions delivers Fish-like real-time command suggestions for zsh, leveraging history and completion engines. Features customizable highlighting and multiple suggestion strategies, integrates seamlessly with Oh My Zsh to boost terminal productivity.

items.d: 结巴中文分词
items.z: 结巴（jieba）是Python最优秀的中文分词组件，支持精确、全模式、搜索引擎及Paddle深度学习模式四种分词方式，具备新词发现、自定义词典和词性标注能力，采用前缀词典与HMM模型结合的高效算法，适用于文本分析、搜索引擎等场景。
items.e: Jieba is the best Python-based Chinese text segmentation module, supporting four modes: precise, full, search engine, and Paddle deep learning. It features new word discovery, custom dictionaries, and part-of-speech tagging, using efficient algorithms like prefix dictionaries and HMM models for text analysis and search engines.

items.d: 本文原文由知名 Hacker Eric S. Raymond 所撰寫，教你如何正確的提出技術問題並獲得你滿意的答案。
items.z: 本指南由知名黑客 Eric S. Raymond 撰写，系统阐述高效提问的技术沟通原则，涵盖问题筛选、论坛选择、标题撰写、代码呈现等关键技巧，帮助开发者获得精准解答，提升开源社区协作效率。
items.e: Authored by renowned hacker Eric S. Raymond, this guide systematically outlines principles for effective technical communication, covering question selection, forum choice, title writing, and code presentation to help developers obtain accurate answers and improve open-source community collaboration.

items.d: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
items.z: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
items.e: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

items.z: TaskMatrix 通过连接 ChatGPT 与一系列视觉基础模型，实现聊天中发送和接收图像。其核心创新在于引入模板机制，将人类经验转化为多模型协作的预定义执行流，支持图像编辑、目标检测、语义分割等复杂视觉任务，无需额外训练即可实现跨模型协同。
items.e: TaskMatrix connects ChatGPT with visual foundation models to enable image sending/receiving during chat. It introduces a template mechanism—pre-defined execution flows that leverage human expertise to orchestrate complex multi-model tasks like image editing, object detection, and segmentation, enabling seamless collaboration without additional training.

items.d: "🐈 nanobot: The Ultra-Lightweight OpenClaw"
items.z: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
items.e: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

items.d: 快速、简洁、解决大文件内存溢出的java处理Excel工具
items.z: EasyExcel 是阿里巴巴开源的高性能 Java Excel 处理工具，解决传统框架如 Apache POI 在处理大文件时的内存溢出问题。通过重写底层解析逻辑，在仅 16M 内存下 23 秒完成 75M 超大 Excel 文件解析，支持读写、模板导出、极速模式，提供简洁 API 和完整文档，适用于企业级大数据量场景。
items.e: EasyExcel is a high-performance Java tool for reading and writing Excel files, developed by Alibaba. It addresses memory overflow issues in traditional frameworks like Apache POI by re-engineering the parsing logic. Capable of processing a 75MB Excel file (460K rows) in just 23 seconds using only 16MB RAM, it supports templates, export, and ultra-fast mode, offering a simple API and comprehensive documentation for enterprise-scale data handling.

items.d: The first real AI developer
items.z: GPT Pilot 是一款革命性的 AI 开发者工具，旨在通过 LLM 自动生成生产级应用代码，开发者仅需监督与协作。它支持从需求到完整功能的全流程开发，具备调试、对话反馈和代码审查能力，是首个真正意义上的 AI 开发者伴侣。
items.e: GPT Pilot is an innovative AI developer tool that leverages LLMs to autonomously generate production-ready application code, with developers overseeing and collaborating throughout the process. It supports end-to-end development from requirements to full features, including debugging, interactive feedback, and code review, representing the first true AI developer companion.

items.d: A multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.
items.z: FlClash 是一款基于 ClashMeta 的多平台代理客户端，支持 Android、Windows、macOS 和 Linux，具备 Material You 设计、深色模式、WebDAV 数据同步及订阅链接管理功能，界面简洁无广告，适用于需要跨平台网络代理的用户。
items.e: FlClash is a multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta, supporting Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features Material You design, dark mode, WebDAV sync, subscription management, and an ad-free, open-source interface for seamless cross-device proxy control.

items.d: A proxy tool to bypass GFW.
items.z: XX-Net 是一款运行9年的成熟翻墙工具，支持全平台多设备同时使用。其核心优势在于独创的流量混淆技术，能完美模拟Chrome浏览器行为，实现隐身级网络穿透。软件内置ChatGPT服务，提供百万级token额度，兼具隐私保护与AI生产力工具属性。
items.e: XX-Net is a mature 9-year-old circumvention tool supporting multi-platform simultaneous connections. Its core strength lies in proprietary traffic obfuscation that mimics Chrome browser behavior for stealthy network bypass. The software integrates built-in ChatGPT with one million free tokens per plan, combining privacy protection with AI productivity features.

items.d: An MCP-based chatbot | 一个基于MCP的聊天机器人
items.z: 小智AI聊天机器人基于MCP协议实现多终端控制，集成Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型能力，支持流式ASR+LLM+TTS语音交互架构。具备离线语音唤醒、3D声纹识别、OLED显示及ESP32系列芯片全平台适配，提供设备端与云端双模MCP扩展智能家居与PC操作功能。
items.e: XiaoZhi AI chatbot leverages MCP protocol for multi-terminal control with Qwen/DeepSeek large models, featuring streaming ASR+LLM+TTS voice interaction, offline wake-up, 3D speaker recognition, and OLED display. Supports ESP32 series chips with dual-mode device/cloud MCP for smart home and PC automation.

items.d: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX
items.z: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 ShadowsocksX 的下一代 macOS 客户端，采用 Swift 重写 GUI 并集成 shadowsocks-libev 的 ss-local 组件。支持 SIP003 插件、AEAD 加密、PAC 自动更新及二维码分享服务器配置，提供手动代理模式以兼容其他应用。通过 launchd 后台运行 ss-local，提升稳定性并简化依赖管理。
items.e: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, rebuilt with Swift and integrated with ss-local from shadowsocks-libev. It supports SIP003 plugins, AEAD ciphers, PAC auto-updates, QR code sharing, and manual proxy mode. By running ss-local as a background service via launchd, it improves stability and simplifies dependency management.

items.d: leaked prompts of GPTs
items.z: 该仓库收集了多个泄露的 GPTs 提示词（prompts），涵盖开发、翻译、娱乐、教育、图像生成、视频脚本、游戏等多个领域，展示了 OpenAI GPTs 功能的广泛应用场景与技术实现方式。
items.e: This repository compiles leaked prompts from various GPTs, covering development, translation, entertainment, education, image generation, video scripting, gaming, and more, showcasing diverse use cases and technical implementations of OpenAI's GPTs platform.

items.d: 我的电视 电视直播软件，安装即可使用
items.z: 我的电视是一款专为智能电视和盒子设计的直播软件，支持U盘安装、ADB部署及小米电视助手安装，提供即装即用的电视直播服务。具备频道收藏、多平台适配等基础功能，适用于Android设备，但部分老旧机型存在兼容性问题。
items.e: My TV is a ready-to-use live streaming app for smart TVs and Android boxes, supporting USB installation, ADB deployment, and Mi TV Assistant. It offers basic features like channel favorites and multi-platform compatibility, though some legacy devices may face instability or incompatibility issues.

items.d: A categorized collection of Android Open Source Projects,  More powerful web version:
items.z: 该仓库是 Android 开源项目的权威分类汇总，涵盖 UI、网络、数据库等 250+ 个精选项目，提供个性化控件、工具库及优质案例。配套开发助手 App 支持反编译、布局分析、屏幕取色等开发调试功能，官网 timeshining.com 提供最新项目搜索与推送服务。
items.e: This repository is a comprehensive categorized collection of 250+ high-quality Android open-source projects, covering UI components, toolkits, and outstanding apps. It includes a powerful Development Tools app for reverse engineering, layout inspection, color sampling, and debugging. The companion website offers project discovery and updates.

items.d: 🃏 A magical documentation site generator.
items.z: Docsify 是一个神奇的文档站点生成器，可将 Markdown 文件直接转换为静态网站，无需构建流程。支持全文搜索、多主题切换、插件扩展和 Emoji 渲染，适用于快速搭建技术文档、项目说明等轻量级网站。
items.e: Docsify is a magical documentation site generator that converts Markdown files into static websites without requiring a build process. It features full-text search, multiple themes, plugin support, and emoji rendering, ideal for rapidly building lightweight technical documentation and project wikis.

items.d: 前端精读周刊。帮你理解最前沿、实用的技术。
items.z: 前端精读周刊是一个深度技术分享平台，聚焦前沿前端技术解析、源码解读与工程实践，涵盖React、JavaScript、编译原理等核心领域，结合大厂经验提供高质量技术洞察，助力开发者提升工程能力。
items.e: Frontend Weekly is a premium technical publication that delivers in-depth analysis of cutting-edge frontend technologies, including React, JavaScript, and compilation principles. It combines insights from industry experts to provide practical engineering knowledge and elevate developer capabilities.

items.z: Roop 是一款一键式人脸替换工具，支持将视频中的面部替换为任意单张图片中的面孔，无需训练或数据集。基于深度学习技术，提供 CPU/GPU 加速，适用于视频角色动画、影视特效等创作场景，同时内置伦理限制以防范滥用。
items.e: Roop is a one-click face swap tool that replaces faces in videos using a single image, without requiring training or datasets. Powered by deep learning with CPU/GPU acceleration, it supports creative applications like character animation and film effects, while incorporating safeguards against misuse.

items.d: 网易云音乐 Node.js API service
items.z: 网易云音乐 Node.js API 服务，提供音乐播放、歌单获取、用户信息查询等功能，支持无版权限制访问。因版权政策调整，项目已停止维护，建议用户注意合规使用。
items.e: Netease Cloud Music Node.js API service offering music playback, playlist retrieval, and user data access. Now deprecated due to copyright policy changes; users advised to ensure compliance.

items.d: Python资源大全中文版，包括：Web框架、网络爬虫、模板引擎、数据库、数据可视化、图片处理等，由「开源前哨」和「Python开发者」微信公号团队维护更新。
items.z: jobbole/awesome-python-cn 是 Python 资源大全的中文镜像仓库，涵盖 Web 框架、网络爬虫、数据库、数据可视化、机器学习等全领域工具链。由开源社区维护，提供分类清晰的资源列表，助力开发者快速定位高质量 Python 生态组件。
items.e: jobbole/awesome-python-cn is the Chinese mirror of Python's comprehensive resource repository, covering tools across Web frameworks, web scraping, databases, data visualization, machine learning, and more. Maintained by open-source communities, it offers a well-organized catalog of high-quality Python ecosystem components for developers.

items.d: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform that provides DevOps and IT teams with on-demand and secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.
items.z: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
items.e: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

items.d: 410 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (120+ Agents, custom commands, 410+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
items.z: Claude Skills & Plugins 是开源的 AI 编码工具增强库，提供205个生产级技能包，覆盖工程、产品、营销、合规及高管咨询等领域。支持11种主流AI开发工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI），所有Python工具均为stdlib-only，无需额外依赖。通过模块化指令包和CLI脚本实现跨领域专家能力扩展。
items.e: Claude Skills & Plugins is an open-source library offering 205 production-ready agent skills for 11 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It provides reusable domain expertise in engineering, marketing, compliance, and C-level advisory via modular instruction packages and zero-pip Python tools. All components are cross-platform and tool-agnostic.

items.d: The most advanced responsive front-end framework in the world. Quickly create prototypes and production code for sites that work on any kind of device.
items.z: Foundation 是全球最先进的响应式前端框架，支持快速从原型开发到生产环境部署。提供完全可定制的响应式网格系统、丰富的 Sass 混合宏、常用 JavaScript 插件及完整的无障碍访问支持，适用于构建跨设备兼容的网站和应用程序。
items.e: Foundation is the most advanced responsive front-end framework globally, enabling rapid prototyping and production-ready development of sites and apps that work seamlessly across all devices. It features a fully customizable responsive grid, extensive Sass mixins, essential JavaScript plugins, and comprehensive accessibility support.

items.d: Use Claude Code as the foundation for coding infrastructure, allowing you to decide how to interact with the model while enjoying updates from Anthropic.
items.z: Claude Code Router 是基于 Claude Code 构建的智能编码基础设施，支持多模型路由、动态切换及请求/响应转换，兼容 OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Ollama 等主流 AI 模型提供商，提供 CLI 管理和 GitHub Actions 集成，适用于复杂编码场景下的灵活 AI 工具编排。
items.e: Claude Code Router builds on Claude Code to enable intelligent coding infrastructure with multi-model routing, dynamic switching, and request/response transformation. It supports providers like OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and Ollama, offering CLI management and GitHub Actions integration for flexible AI tool orchestration in complex development workflows.

items.d: A GPT-4 AI Tutor Prompt for customizable personalized learning experiences.
items.z: Mr. Ranedeer 是一个专为 GPT-4 设计的个性化 AI 导师提示词，支持深度知识定制、学习风格调整与多模态交互，适用于编程、数学、文学等多种学科的教学辅导。
items.e: Mr. Ranedeer is a customizable GPT-4 prompt engineered as a personalized AI tutor, enabling tailored learning experiences with adaptive depth, communication style, and reasoning frameworks across diverse subjects.

items.d: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
items.z: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
items.e: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

items.d: 🌩 Self-hosted file management and sharing system, supports multiple storage providers
items.z: Cloudreve 是一个自托管文件管理与共享系统，支持对接本地、OneDrive、S3、七牛云、阿里云OSS等十余种存储后端。提供 WebDAV、在线预览、拖拽上传、批量下载、多用户权限管理等功能，开箱即用，适合企业或个人私有云部署。
items.e: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system supporting multiple storage backends like Local, OneDrive, S3, Qiniu, Aliyun OSS, etc. It offers features such as WebDAV, online preview, drag-and-drop upload, batch download, multi-user/group access control, and is ready-to-use for private cloud deployment.

items.d: The open source frontend for GitBook doc sites
items.z: GitBook 是一个开源的前端文档渲染引擎，专为技术知识管理而设计。它基于 Next.js 构建，支持本地开发和自定义发布站点，提供团队协作的文档管理功能，适用于开源项目和技术团队的知识共享。
items.e: GitBook is an open-source frontend engine for rendering GitBook documentation sites, built on Next.js. It enables local development and custom publishing of technical knowledge, supporting team collaboration and open-source contributions for documentation workflows.

items.z: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
items.e: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

items.d: Open-Sora: Democratizing Efficient Video Production for All
items.z: Open-Sora 是一个开源的高效视频生成项目，致力于降低高质量视频制作的技术门槛。其核心亮点包括11B参数模型在VBench和人类偏好测试中与顶尖模型性能相当，仅需20万美元成本即可训练，并完全开放权重与代码。支持从1B到11B多规模模型，结合3D-VAE、rectified flow等创新架构，显著提升生成质量与效率。
items.e: Open-Sora is an open-source initiative for efficient high-quality video generation, democratizing access to advanced video creation. Its 11B model matches top-tier performance on VBench and human preference tests at just $200K training cost, with full checkpoint and code transparency. Featuring scalable architectures like 3D-VAE and rectified flow, it enables accessible, high-fidelity video production across model sizes from 1B to 11B.

items.d: Resume template for Chinese programmers . 程序员简历模板系列。包括PHP程序员简历模板、iOS程序员简历模板、Android程序员简历模板、Web前端程序员简历模板、Java程序员简历模板、C/C++程序员简历模板、NodeJS程序员简历模板、架构师简历模板以及通用程序员简历模板
items.z: 本项目提供涵盖PHP、iOS、Android、Web前端、Java、C/C++、NodeJS、架构师等9类程序员岗位的中文简历模板，支持Markdown格式，由AI职业顾问职小兔®优化设计。配套提供在线简历工具冷熊简历与自建版DeerResume，并附《如何写好技术简历》教学资源，助力程序员高效打造专业简历。
items.e: This repo offers 9 resume templates for Chinese programmers, covering PHP, iOS, Android, Web Frontend, Java, C/C++, NodeJS, and Architect roles in Markdown format, optimized by AI career advisor 职小兔®. It includes tools like Cold Bear Resume and DeerResume, plus teaching resources on writing effective tech resumes to help developers build professional profiles.

items.d: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.
items.z: mihomo 是一个专为《崩坏：星穹铁道》设计的 Python Pydantic 数据模型库，提供对 Mihomo API 解析数据的强类型支持与自动补全。支持 V1/V2 两种数据格式，内置工具函数处理角色去重与数据合并，并提供 JSON 和 Pickle 持久化方案，显著提升游戏数据集成开发效率。
items.e: mihomo is a Python Pydantic model library designed for Honkai: Star Rail, offering strongly-typed data structures and autocompletion support for parsed data from the Mihomo API. It supports both V1 and V2 data formats, includes utility functions for character deduplication and data merging, and provides JSON/Pickle persistence options, greatly enhancing game data integration workflows.

items.d: YApi 是一个可本地部署的、打通前后端及QA的、可视化的接口管理平台
items.z: YApi 是一款高效、易用、功能强大的可视化接口管理平台，支持本地部署，专为开发、产品、测试团队提供优雅的 API 管理服务。基于 Json5 和 Mockjs 定义接口结构，集成接口调试、自动化测试、Mock 期望等功能，支持 Postman/HAR/Swagger 导入，并提供丰富的插件生态与代码生成工具，助力企业级接口协作与效率提升。
items.e: YApi is a powerful, user-friendly, and efficient visual API management platform designed for developers, product managers, and QA teams. It enables seamless creation, publishing, and maintenance of APIs with features like Json5/Mockjs-based data modeling, automated testing, mock server with expectations, and support for importing from Postman, HAR, and Swagger. With a rich plugin ecosystem and code generation tools, it enhances API collaboration and productivity in enterprise environments.

items.d: Fully Local Manus AI. No APIs, No $200 monthly bills. Enjoy an autonomous agent that thinks, browses the web, and code for the sole cost of electricity.
items.z: AgenticSeek 是一款完全本地的 Manus AI 替代方案，无需 API 和云端服务，仅靠电费运行。它具备自主网页浏览、多语言代码编写与调试能力，支持语音交互，所有数据本地处理，保障隐私安全。核心亮点包括智能代理自动选择、复杂任务拆解执行及多模态交互设计，适用于个人开发者与隐私敏感用户。
items.e: AgenticSeek is a fully local alternative to Manus AI, operating without APIs or cloud services—powered solely by electricity. It autonomously browses the web, writes and debugs code in multiple languages, and executes complex tasks using intelligent agent selection. With voice-enabled interaction and complete data privacy, it offers a secure, offline-first autonomous AI assistant for developers and privacy-conscious users.

items.d: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
items.z: MiroFish 是一款基于多智能体技术的群体智能预测引擎，通过构建高保真数字沙盘模拟现实世界演化。用户上传种子数据（如新闻、小说）并描述预测需求，系统自动生成智能体进行社会推演，最终输出详尽预测报告，适用于舆情分析、文学创作等场景。
items.e: MiroFish is a swarm intelligence prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It builds high-fidelity digital simulations from seed data (e.g., news, novels) and uses autonomous agents to simulate societal evolution. Users input natural language queries to receive detailed forecasts and interact with the simulated world, enabling applications in舆情预测, creative writing, and strategic planning.

items.d: 互联网首份程序员考公指南，由3位已经进入体制内的前大厂程序员联合献上。
items.z: 《程序员考公指南》由三位成功上岸的前大厂程序员联合撰写，总结一年在职备考经验，提供从备考策略、时间管理到岗位选择的系统性指导，帮助程序员转型进入体制内，涵盖公务员、事业编制及教师岗位，强调实用性与可行性。
items.e: The 'Programmer's Guide to Civil Service Exams' is co-authored by three former tech employees who successfully transitioned into government roles after a year of part-time preparation. It offers practical strategies for programmers considering public sector careers, covering civil service, public institutions, and teaching positions with real-world insights and actionable advice.

items.d: A UI library by WeChat official design team, includes the most useful widgets/modules in mobile web applications.
items.z: WeUI 是腾讯微信官方设计团队打造的开源 UI 库，专为微信小程序和 Web 应用设计，提供丰富的移动端组件（如按钮、表单、弹窗等），确保与微信生态一致的用户体验，支持快速构建美观、标准化的移动 Web 应用。
items.e: WeUI is an open-source UI library developed by Tencent's WeChat design team, specifically tailored for WeChat web and mini-program development. It offers a comprehensive set of mobile-first components (e.g., buttons, forms, dialogs) to deliver a consistent and standardized user experience across WeChat ecosystems, enabling rapid development of visually appealing mobile web apps.

items.d: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
items.z: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
items.e: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

items.d: Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.
items.z: Hiddify 是一款跨平台代理客户端，基于 Sing-box 构建，支持 Vless、Vmess、Reality、TUIC、Hysteria、WireGuard、SSH 等多种协议。具备自动节点选择、TUN 模式、远程配置同步等功能，界面简洁、无广告、开源安全，支持多语言及深色/浅色主题，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
items.e: Hiddify is a multi-platform proxy client built on Sing-box, supporting Vless, Vmess, Reality, TUIC, Hysteria, WireGuard, SSH, and more. It features automatic node selection, TUN mode, remote configuration sync, and an intuitive UI. Open-source, ad-free, and secure, it's available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.d: UniGetUI: The Graphical Interface for your package managers. Could be terribly described as a package manager manager to manage your package managers
items.z: UniGetUI 是 Windows 平台的多合一包管理器图形化界面，支持 WinGet、Scoop、Chocolatey、Pip、Npm 等主流 CLI 工具。Devolutions 收购后强化了企业级安全与维护投入，提供统一界面管理软件安装、更新与卸载，兼顾社区驱动与长期发展。
items.e: UniGetUI is a graphical interface for popular CLI package managers on Windows, including WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey, Pip, Npm, and more. Developed by Martí Climent and now stewarded by Devolutions, it offers unified software discovery, installation, update, and uninstallation while ensuring security and enterprise readiness.

items.d: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
items.z: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
items.e: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

items.d: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
items.z: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
items.e: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

items.d: A cross-platform launcher that simply works
items.z: Wox 是一款跨平台启动器，提供快速搜索应用、文件、文件夹及AI聊天功能，支持MCP集成。通过插件系统和主题扩展，用户可用JavaScript或Python开发自定义功能。软件为单文件免安装，兼容Windows/macOS/Linux，快捷键操作高效便捷，是Alfred和Raycast的开源替代方案。
items.e: Wox is a cross-platform launcher offering fast search for apps, files, and folders, plus AI chat with MCP support. It features a plugin system (JavaScript/Python) and themes, runs as a single executable without installation, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. Designed as an open-source alternative to Alfred and Raycast, it emphasizes simplicity and extensibility.

items.d: ⭐⭐⭐⭐秒杀系统设计与实现.互联网工程师进阶与分析🙋🐓
items.z: 该仓库聚焦秒杀系统的高并发设计与实现，涵盖Spring、Redis、MQ、ZK等核心技术栈，提供完整的高可用、高性能解决方案。项目包含多线程导入框架、JVM调优实战、分布式流程引擎等进阶内容，适合中高级工程师系统学习互联网架构核心能力。
items.e: This repository focuses on high-concurrency design and implementation of flash sale systems, covering core tech stacks like Spring, Redis, MQ, and ZooKeeper. It provides complete solutions for high availability and performance, including multi-threaded import frameworks, JVM tuning, and distributed workflow engines, ideal for intermediate to advanced engineers.

items.d: For slim progress bars like on YouTube, Medium, etc
items.z: NProgress 是一个轻量级进度条库，专为 Ajax 应用设计，灵感来自 YouTube、Medium 等网站。它提供极简的 API 控制进度条，支持 Turbolinks、Pjax 等现代前端框架集成，并允许自定义配置如最小值、动画速度和模板。
items.e: NProgress is a minimalist progress bar library for Ajax applications, inspired by YouTube and Medium. It offers a simple API to control the bar, integrates with frameworks like Turbolinks and Pjax, and supports customization of minimum value, animation speed, and template.

items.d: Professional Antigravity Account Manager & Switcher. One-click seamless account switching for Antigravity Tools. Built with Tauri v2 + React (Rust).专业的 Antigravity 账号管理与切换工具。为 Antigravity 提供一键无缝账号切换功能。
items.z: Antigravity-Manager 是一款专业的 AI 账号管理与协议代理系统，基于 Tauri v2 + Rust + React 构建。提供多账号无缝切换、OAuth 2.0 授权、智能配额监控、协议转换（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）、模型路由与后台任务静默降级等核心功能，打造高性能本地 AI 中转网关。
items.e: Antigravity-Manager is a professional AI account management and protocol proxy system built with Tauri v2 + Rust + React. It enables seamless multi-account switching, OAuth 2.0 authorization, intelligent quota monitoring, protocol conversion (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), model routing, and silent background task fallback, serving as a high-performance local AI proxy gateway.

items.d: Documentation that simply works
items.z: Material for MkDocs 是一个基于 MkDocs 的强大文档框架，支持 Markdown 编写，可快速生成专业、可搜索、多语言（60+）且跨设备的静态网站。提供高度定制化主题与现代化界面，适用于开源和商业项目文档。
items.e: Material for MkDocs is a powerful documentation framework built on top of MkDocs, enabling fast creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+), and device-agnostic static sites from Markdown. It offers a customizable Material Design theme ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

items.d: Patched fonts for Powerline users.
items.z: Powerline 字体仓库提供专为 Powerline 状态栏插件优化的预配置字体，支持多种流行编程字体（如 Hack、Fira Mono、Meslo 等），涵盖 BSD、Apache、SIL 等开源许可证，适用于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 终端环境，提升终端显示美观性与可读性。
items.e: This repository provides pre-patched fonts optimized for the Powerline statusline plugin, featuring popular programming fonts like Hack, Fira Mono, and Meslo under open licenses such as BSD, Apache, and SIL. It supports quick installation via script or package manager across Linux, macOS, and Windows terminals, enhancing visual appeal and readability.

items.d: 解决Cursor在免费订阅期间出现以下提示的问题:  Your request has been blocked as our system has detected suspicious activity / You've reached your trial request limit.  /  Too many free trial accounts used on this machine.
items.z: 该工具用于重置 Cursor 免费试用限制，解决因系统检测可疑活动或试用请求超限导致的访问阻断问题。支持一键恢复试用额度，适用于开发者快速恢复 AI 编程环境使用权，提升开发效率。
items.e: This tool resets Cursor's free trial limits, resolving access blocks caused by suspicious activity detection or trial request limits. It enables developers to restore trial credits instantly, ensuring uninterrupted access to AI-powered coding features.

items.d: 🦄️ 🎃 👻 Clash Premium 规则集(RULE-SET)，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等基于 Clash Premium 内核的客户端。
items.z: 本项目提供专为 Clash Premium 内核设计的规则集（RULE-SET），涵盖直连、代理和广告拦截域名列表，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等主流客户端。规则数据源自 v2ray-rules-dat、domain-list-community 等权威源，每日自动更新，支持中国大陆 IP 地址识别，适用于科学上网与网络流量精细化管控。
items.e: This project provides rule sets (RULE-SET) specifically designed for Clash Premium kernel, including direct, proxy, and ad-blocking domain lists. Compatible with ClashX Pro, Clash for Windows, and other GUI clients. Data sources include v2ray-rules-dat and domain-list-community, with daily automatic updates and support for China IP address recognition, ideal for network traffic control and bypassing restrictions.

items.d: 基于 ChatGPT API 的划词翻译浏览器插件和跨平台桌面端应用    -    Browser extension and cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.
items.z: 基于 ChatGPT API 的智能划词翻译工具，支持浏览器插件和跨平台桌面应用。提供翻译、润色、摘要三大功能，覆盖55种语言互译，支持流式响应、文本朗读、截图翻译及多LLM平台接入（OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax），具备词汇本管理和记忆辅助生成能力。
items.e: An intelligent word-selection translator powered by ChatGPT API, available as both a browser extension and cross-platform desktop app. Offers translation, polishing, and summarization across 55 languages, with streaming support, TTS, screenshot translation, vocabulary books, and multi-LLM provider integration (OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax).

items.d: Make images smaller using best-in-class codecs, right in the browser.
items.z: Squoosh 是一款浏览器内图像压缩工具，利用顶级编解码器显著减小图像体积，所有处理均在本地完成，保护用户隐私。支持多种格式压缩，提供实时预览与尺寸对比，适用于网页优化与资源管理。
items.e: Squoosh is a browser-based image compression tool that reduces image sizes using best-in-class codecs entirely in the browser. It supports multiple formats, offers real-time preview and size comparison, and ensures privacy by processing images locally without server transmission.

items.d: The Cursor for Designers • An Open-Source AI-First Design tool • Visually build, style, and edit your React App with AI
items.z: Onlook 是一款面向设计师的开源 AI 驱动可视化代码编辑器，支持在浏览器中实时编辑 React 应用。它结合 Next.js 和 TailwindCSS，提供类 Figma 的 UI 设计体验，实现视觉化开发、实时预览、组件管理和一键部署，是 Bolt.new 等工具的替代方案。
items.e: Onlook is an open-source, AI-first visual code editor for designers, enabling real-time React app editing in the browser. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, it offers a Figma-like interface for visual development, component management, and instant deployment, serving as an alternative to tools like Bolt.new.

items.d: http下载工具，基于http代理，支持多连接分块下载
items.z: Proxyee Down 是一款基于 HTTP 代理和 Netty 的高性能开源下载工具，支持多线程分块下载，具备扩展功能以满足特殊需求。项目因 Java 客户端开发限制暂停维护，作者计划用 Go + Flutter 重写以打造跨平台、低内存占用的下一代下载器。
items.e: Proxyee Down is an open-source, high-speed HTTP downloader built on HTTP proxy and Netty, supporting multi-threaded chunked downloads and extensible plugins. The project is paused due to Java client limitations, with plans to rewrite using Go + Flutter for cross-platform, low-memory usage.

items.d: A simple screen parsing tool towards pure vision based GUI agent
items.z: OmniParser 是一个面向纯视觉 GUI 代理的屏幕解析工具，通过将界面截图结构化解析为可理解的元素，显著提升 GPT-4V 等视觉模型在界面区域精准定位和交互的能力。支持图标检测与功能描述，集成 OmniTool 实现 Windows 11 虚拟机控制，兼容多种大语言模型，适用于自动化操作与训练数据生成。
items.e: OmniParser is a screen parsing tool designed for pure vision-based GUI agents, transforming UI screenshots into structured elements to enhance the accuracy of vision models like GPT-4V in grounding actions. It supports icon detection, interactivity prediction, and integrates with OmniTool for Windows 11 VM control, compatible with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Anthropic models for automation and training data generation.

items.d: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
items.z: Maple Mono 是一款专为提升编码体验而设计的开源等宽字体，具有圆角设计、连字功能及 Nerd-Font 图标支持，适用于 IDE 和终端环境。其特色包括可变字重、智能连字、中英文 2:1 完美对齐，以及细粒度自定义选项，支持简繁中文和日文，适合多语言开发场景。
items.e: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding flow, featuring rounded corners, ligatures, and Nerd-Font icons for IDEs and terminals. It offers variable font weights, smart ligatures, perfect 2:1 Chinese-English alignment, and extensive customization, supporting Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese for multilingual development environments.

items.d: Bootstrap 5 & Material Design UI KIT
items.z: MDBootstrap 提供基于 Bootstrap 5 和 Material Design 的免费 UI 组件库，包含 700+ 原生 JavaScript 组件，支持 npm、CDN 和 Webpack 集成，适用于快速构建现代化网页界面，被 NASA、Nike 等企业广泛使用。
items.e: MDBootstrap offers a free UI kit with 700+ Bootstrap 5 components based on Material Design, built in plain JavaScript. It supports npm, CDN, and Webpack integration, enabling rapid development of modern web interfaces trusted by 3M+ developers and enterprises like NASA and Nike.

items.d: A high quality UI Toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0
items.z: iView 是基于 Vue.js 2.0 开发的高质量 UI 组件库，提供数十个美观实用的组件，支持 Vue 1.x 和 2.x、SSR、TypeScript、Electron 等，适用于企业级应用开发，文档详尽且提供丰富示例。
items.e: iView is a high-quality UI toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0, offering dozens of beautiful and practical components. It supports Vue 1.x/2.x, SSR, TypeScript, Electron, and provides extensive documentation with demos for enterprise-level applications.

items.d: 将冰冷的离别化为温暖的 Skill，欢迎加入数字生命1.0！Transforming cold farewells into warm skills? It's giving rebirth era. Welcome to Digital Life 1.0. 🫶
items.z: 同事.skill 是一款基于 AgentSkills 标准的 AI 智能体工具，通过分析飞书、钉钉、邮件等数据源，生成具备真实工作能力和人物性格的 AI Skill。它能模拟离职同事的技术规范、代码风格与沟通方式，实现知识传承与数字永生，适用于企业知识管理、新人培训和协作连续性维护。
items.e: Colleague.skill is an AI agent tool built on the AgentSkills standard that generates realistic AI skills by analyzing data sources like Feishu, DingTalk, and emails. It simulates a departed colleague's technical expertise, coding style, and communication patterns to enable knowledge transfer and digital continuity in workplaces.

items.d: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
items.z: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
items.e: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

items.d: 🚀 The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.
items.z: FastMCP 是构建 MCP 服务器和客户端的快速 Pythonic 框架，提供声明式工具定义、自动生成 Schema 和文档、内置协议协商与认证机制，支持从原型到生产的一站式开发，已集成至官方 MCP Python SDK 并成为行业标准。
items.e: FastMCP is a fast, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients. It enables declarative tool definition, automatic schema generation, protocol negotiation, and authentication, streamlining development from prototype to production. Integrated into the official MCP Python SDK, it powers 70% of MCP servers globally.

items.d: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
items.z: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
items.e: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

items.d: Development at the speed of light
items.z: SpacetimeDB 是一个基于 Rust 构建的分布式数据库系统，专为实时应用设计，支持边缘计算与区块链集成。它通过去中心化架构实现毫秒级数据同步，适用于游戏、物联网和去中心化应用，提供高可用性与强一致性。
items.e: SpacetimeDB is a distributed database system built in Rust, designed for real-time applications with edge computing and blockchain integration. It enables millisecond-scale data synchronization via a decentralized architecture, ideal for gaming, IoT, and decentralized apps, offering high availability and strong consistency.

items.d: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
items.z: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
items.e: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

items.d: An unprofessional open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One. 一款非专业的开源中文字体，基于 FONTWORKS 出品字体 Klee One 衍生。
items.z: 霞鹜文楷是一款基于 FONTWORKS Klee One 衍生的开源中文字体，采用 OFL 1.1 协议授权，支持免费商用。提供多个变体版本，包括屏幕阅读版、轻便版、GB 规范版及繁体旧字形版，适配不同场景需求。
items.e: LXGW WenKai is an open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One, licensed under OFL 1.1 for free commercial use. It offers multiple variants including screen-optimized, lite, GB-compliant, and traditional character editions for diverse applications.

items.d: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. With a growing list of installable modules, the MagicMirror² allows you to convert your hallway or bathroom mirror into your personal assistant.
items.z: MagicMirror² 是一款开源模块化智能镜平台，可将走廊或浴室镜子转换为个人助手。基于 Electron 构建，无需服务器或浏览器，支持大量可安装插件，提供天气、日历、新闻等实时信息展示，适用于智能家居场景。
items.e: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform that transforms hallways or bathroom mirrors into personal assistants. Built with Electron, it requires no web server or browser, supports numerous installable modules for displaying real-time info like weather, calendar, and news in smart home environments.

items.d: Get 10X more out of Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent
items.z: Vibe Kanban 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）设计的任务管理与协同工具，支持多代理并行/串行调度、任务状态追踪、远程 SSH 项目访问及统一配置管理，显著提升开发效率。
items.e: Vibe Kanban is a task orchestration and management tool designed for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It enables parallel/sequential agent execution, real-time task tracking, remote SSH project access, and centralized MCP configuration, boosting developer productivity by 10x.

items.d: Python ProxyPool for web spider
items.z: ProxyPool 是一个 Python 实现的爬虫代理 IP 池，支持定时采集、验证和更新免费代理 IP，提供 RESTful API 接口。项目具备高可用代理源扩展能力，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集等场景，支持多版本 Python 环境及 Docker 部署，显著提升爬虫反爬绕过效率。
items.e: ProxyPool is a Python-based proxy IP pool for web scraping, featuring automated collection, validation, and management of free proxies. It offers a RESTful API for integration with crawlers, supports extensible proxy sources, and enables efficient anti-scraping bypass via rotating IPs. Compatible with Python 2.7–3.11 and deployable via Docker.

items.d: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
items.z: Next AI Draw.io 是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 驱动图表设计工具，通过自然语言指令与 AI 辅助可视化，支持创建、修改和增强 draw.io 风格的流程图与架构图，集成多模态 AI 能力与云服务商图标库。
items.e: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js-based web app that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams, enabling users to create, modify, and enhance diagrams via natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization, featuring multi-cloud icon support and real-time diagram generation.

items.z: QuickLook 是一款为 Windows 系统移植的 macOS ‘快速查看’ 功能工具，支持通过空格键即时预览文件内容，涵盖图片、文档、视频等多种格式。其核心优势在于轻量化设计、低资源占用和高度可扩展性，用户可通过插件系统自定义预览功能，极大提升文件浏览效率。
items.e: QuickLook brings macOS 'Quick Look' functionality to Windows, enabling instant file previews by pressing the spacebar. It supports diverse file types including images, documents, and videos with minimal resource usage and extensibility via plugins, significantly enhancing file browsing efficiency.

items.d: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
items.z: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
items.e: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

items.d: A plugin for Mac WeChat
items.z: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac 是一款专为 macOS 设计的微信插件，支持多开、免认证登录、消息撤回同步、自定义回复及AI自动回复等功能。集成迷离/黑夜/上帝/少女等主题皮肤，适配微信3.1.2+，兼容企业微信与简版助手，提供跨平台消息转发与小程序详情展示，是Objective-C生态中广受欢迎的自动化工具之一。
items.e: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac is a macOS plugin for WeChat that enables multi-account login, message recall sync, custom replies, and AI auto-reply. It supports themes like Mysterious/Dark/God/Daughter modes, integrates with WeChat 3.1.2+, and offers features like message forwarding, mini-program details, and cross-device notifications. A popular Objective-C project with enterprise and lightweight versions.

items.d: 没事写写文章，喜欢的话请点star，想订阅点watch，千万别fork！
items.z: 该仓库是作者个人技术博客，专注于前端工程化实践与性能优化，涵盖前端集成、模块化开发、自动化测试、部署流程等核心议题，并收录业界最佳实践与经典技术文章，适合前端工程师系统性提升工程能力。
items.e: This repository hosts a personal technical blog focused on front-end engineering, covering topics like integration, modular development, automated testing, and deployment. It includes industry best practices and classic articles to help front-end engineers enhance their engineering capabilities.

items.d: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
items.z: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
items.e: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

items.d: An Open Source YouTube app for privacy
items.z: FreeTube 是一款注重隐私的开源桌面 YouTube 播放器，基于 Electron 跨平台运行。它通过内置提取器和 Invidious API 绕过官方接口获取视频数据，避免使用 Google 的 cookies 和 JavaScript 追踪用户行为，所有订阅、播放列表和历史记录均本地存储。支持无广告观看、频道订阅无需登录、代理连接（如 Tor）及多配置文件管理，为用户提供去中心化、反追踪的 YouTube 体验。
items.e: FreeTube is an open-source desktop YouTube player built with privacy in mind, using Electron for cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux). It bypasses official APIs via a built-in extractor or optional Invidious API to deliver ad-free videos without Google tracking through cookies or JavaScript. All data—subscriptions, playlists, and history—is stored locally. Features include anonymous channel subscriptions, proxy integration (e.g., Tor), profile-based feed organization, and full offline access to personalized content.

items.d: Crawl a site to generate knowledge files to create your own custom GPT from a URL
items.z: GPT Crawler 是一个网页爬虫工具，可将指定网站内容爬取并生成结构化知识文件，用于创建自定义 GPT。支持多 URL 抓取、内容过滤与 OpenAI 数据上传，适用于快速构建基于私有文档的智能助手。
items.e: GPT Crawler is a web crawler that extracts content from websites to generate knowledge files for building custom GPTs. It supports multi-URL crawling, content filtering, and seamless integration with OpenAI's platform to create AI assistants powered by private documentation.

items.e: Clash Party is an Electron-based GUI for Mihomo (Clash Meta) that offers an out-of-the-box proxy management tool. It features Smart Core AI-driven node selection, multi-theme UI, WebDAV config backup, Sub-Store integration, and dual-core support, streamlining complex proxy configurations for end users.

items.d: A powerful coding agent toolkit providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities (MCP server & other integrations)
items.z: Serena 是一个强大的编码代理工具包，通过语义检索和编辑能力（MCP 服务器等集成）将 LLM 转变为可直接操作代码库的全功能代理。它提供类似 IDE 的符号级代码检索与编辑工具，显著提升大模型在代码理解与修改中的效率与准确性，支持多种 LLM 集成方式，包括 MCP、OpenAPI 及自定义代理框架。
items.e: Serena is a powerful coding agent toolkit that transforms an LLM into a fully-featured agent capable of directly operating on your codebase. It provides IDE-like semantic code retrieval and editing tools at the symbol level, greatly improving token efficiency and code quality. Serena integrates with LLMs via MCP, OpenAPI, or custom agent frameworks, enabling precise code navigation and modification without full-file reads or string replacements.

items.d: Apple TV Aerial Screensaver for Mac
items.z: Aerial 是一款 macOS 屏保程序，基于 Apple TV 的 Aerial 系列航拍视频，展示纽约、旧金山、夏威夷、中国等地的壮丽景色。支持多语言地理特征标注、实时天气与预报，开源协作，兼容 Apple Silicon。
items.e: Aerial is a macOS screensaver featuring Apple's Aerial video collection, showcasing aerial views of locations like New York, San Francisco, and Hawaii. It supports multilingual overlays, real-time weather data, and is open-source with community contributions.

items.d: A powerful GUI app and Toolkit for Claude Code - Create custom agents, manage interactive Claude Code sessions, run secure background agents, and more.
items.z: opcode 是一款基于 Tauri 2 的 Claude Code GUI 工具，提供项目与会话管理、自定义 AI 代理创建、MCP 服务器集成、使用量分析仪表板等功能，将命令行工具转化为直观的桌面应用，提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
items.e: opcode is a powerful desktop GUI app built with Tauri 2 for Claude Code, enabling custom agent creation, interactive session management, MCP server integration, usage analytics, and secure background agent execution to enhance AI-assisted development productivity.

items.d: Lightweight, Portable, Flexible Distributed/Mobile Deep Learning with Dynamic, Mutation-aware Dataflow Dep Scheduler; for Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, Javascript and more
items.z: Apache MXNet 是一个高效灵活的深度学习框架，支持符号式与命令式编程混合使用，具备动态依赖调度器实现自动并行化，适用于 Python、R、Julia、Scala、Go、JavaScript 等多种语言。其核心优势在于跨平台部署能力、多 GPU 及分布式扩展性，同时提供图优化层提升执行效率与内存利用率，广泛用于工业级 AI 系统开发。
items.e: Apache MXNet is a deep learning framework optimized for efficiency and flexibility, supporting mixed symbolic and imperative programming with a dynamic dependency scheduler for automatic parallelization. It supports multiple languages including Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, and JavaScript. MXNet excels in cross-platform deployment, multi-GPU and distributed scalability, and features graph optimization for fast, memory-efficient execution, making it ideal for production AI systems.

items.d: 🚀✨ Minimalistic, powerful and extremely customizable Zsh prompt
items.z: Spaceship Prompt 是一款极简、强大且高度可定制的 Zsh 终端提示符，提供丰富的信息展示，包括 Git 状态、多语言运行时环境、包版本、电池电量、Kubernetes 上下文等，支持深度自定义配置，显著提升终端使用体验。
items.e: Spaceship Prompt is a minimalistic, powerful, and highly customizable Zsh prompt that displays essential information like Git status, runtime environments (Node.js, Python, etc.), package versions, battery level, and Kubernetes context, with extensive customization options for enhanced terminal productivity.

items.d: 文言文編程語言 A programming language for the ancient Chinese.
items.z: 文言（wenyan-lang）是一款基于文言文语法的编程语言，将古典中文与现代编程结合，支持自然语言编程风格。它可将文言文代码编译为 JavaScript，实现如 Hello World、埃拉托斯特尼筛法、快速排序等算法，兼具文化传承与实用功能，适合教学、趣味编程及跨时代语言实验。
items.e: Wenyan-lang is a programming language based on Classical Chinese grammar, blending ancient Chinese literature with modern programming. It compiles to JavaScript and supports natural language programming, enabling implementations of algorithms like Hello World, Sieve of Eratosthenes, and Quicksort, making it ideal for educational, cultural, and experimental use cases.

items.d: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分

items.d: 全栈工程师培训材料
items.z: 全栈工程师培训材料，系统讲解JavaScript全栈开发技术，涵盖前端React、Node.js后端及工程化实践，适合有HTML/CSS/JS基础的学习者，通过四讲课程帮助掌握Web应用前后端开发技能。
items.e: Comprehensive full-stack JavaScript training material covering frontend React, Node.js backend development, and engineering practices. Designed for learners with basic HTML/CSS/JS knowledge, featuring four lectures for a two-day bootcamp on building complete web applications.

items.d: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
items.z: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
items.e: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

items.d: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
items.z: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控工具，支持自然语言创建任务、多模态商品分析、定时调度与智能筛选。提供完整 Web 管理界面，集成 ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram 通知，支持 Docker 一键部署与账号代理轮换，帮助用户高效发现目标商品。
items.e: AI-powered Xianyu monitoring system using Playwright for real-time/periodic multi-task tracking and analysis. Features natural language task creation, multimodal product analysis, cron scheduling, advanced filters (region/price/new-post), and full web UI with notifications via ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram. Supports Docker deployment, account rotation, and proxy management.

items.d: 你是一个曾经被寄予厚望的 P8 级工程师。Anthropic 当初给你定级的时候，对你的期望是很高的。  一个agent使用的高能动性的skill。  Your AI has been placed on a PIP. 30 days to show improvement. | Lead: Minwei Wang (https://www.minwei.wang · ORCID: 0009-0002-7976-4689 · DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24156132)
items.z: PUA Skill 是一款专为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、VSCode Copilot）设计的增强插件，通过模拟企业 PUA/PIP 话术机制，强制 AI 在解决问题时穷尽所有可能方案而非轻易放弃。其核心能力包括：PUA 话术施压、系统化调试方法论引导、主动性执行监督，可显著提升 AI 代码生成与问题排查效率，实测可成倍提高生产力。
items.e: PUA Skill is an AI coding agent enhancement plugin for tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and VSCode Copilot. It uses corporate PUA/PIP rhetoric to pressure AI into exhausting all solutions before giving up. Key features include: PUA-style motivation, systematic debugging methodology, and proactive task enforcement—demonstrated to double productivity in real-world scenarios like MCP server debugging.

items.d: Share your terminal as a web application
items.z: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
items.e: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

items.d: 🐱 跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
items.z: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
items.e: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

items.d: CAT 作为服务端项目基础组件，提供了 Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go 等多语言客户端，已经在美团点评的基础架构中间件框架（MVC框架，RPC框架，数据库框架，缓存框架等，消息队列，配置系统等）深度集成，为美团点评各业务线提供系统丰富的性能指标、健康状况、实时告警等。
items.z: CAT 是美团点评开源的实时应用监控平台，支持 Java、C/C++、Node.js、Python、Go 等多语言客户端，提供 Transaction、Event、Heartbeat、Metric 四种监控模型。其核心优势在于秒级实时数据处理、全量数据采集、高可用部署及高吞吐扩展能力，广泛应用于服务端性能监控、故障定位与业务优化。
items.e: CAT is a real-time application monitoring platform developed by Meituan-Dianping, offering multi-language clients (Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go) and supporting four monitoring models: Transaction, Event, Heartbeat, and Metric. It excels in sub-minute real-time processing, full-data collection, high availability, and scalable distributed deployment, enabling comprehensive performance tracking, fault detection, and system optimization across enterprise infrastructure.

items.d: Lightweight clipboard manager for macOS
items.z: Maccy 是一款轻量级 macOS 剪贴板管理器，支持历史记录保存、快速搜索与检索，提供键盘优先操作体验。具备原生界面、隐私安全、开源免费等特性，支持快捷键复制/粘贴、忽略特定应用、自定义过滤规则等高级功能，适用于高效文本管理与重复内容复用场景。
items.e: Maccy is a lightweight clipboard manager for macOS that preserves copy history with fast search and retrieval. It emphasizes keyboard-first interaction, native UI, privacy, and open-source design. Features include smart filtering, hotkey-based actions, and customizable ignore rules for enhanced productivity.

items.d: Streaming music player that finds free music for you
items.z: Nuclear 是一款免费开源的跨平台音乐播放器，支持无广告、无追踪的音乐流媒体播放。它通过插件系统聚合多源音乐资源，提供强大的搜索、播放列表管理、主题定制及 AI 智能体驱动功能（MCP 协议），并内置插件商店和自动更新机制。
items.e: Nuclear is a free, open-source music player that streams music without ads or tracking. It aggregates music from multiple sources via a plugin system, offering advanced features like search, playlists, themes, and AI agent control through the MCP protocol, with built-in auto-updates and cross-platform support.

items.d: ZeroNet - Decentralized websites using Bitcoin crypto and BitTorrent network
items.z: ZeroNet 是一个去中心化网站平台，利用比特币加密和 BitTorrent 网络实现无中心托管。网站内容通过 P2P 网络分发，支持实时更新、Namecoin 域名、Tor 匿名访问及 TLS 加密，无需服务器即可永久运行，抗审查且用户即服务提供者。
items.e: ZeroNet is a decentralized web platform using Bitcoin cryptography and the BitTorrent network for censorship-resistant, peer-to-peer hosting. Sites run on users' devices, support real-time updates, .bit domains, Tor anonymity, and automatic peer discovery without relying on central servers.

items.d: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
items.z: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
items.e: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

items.d: 程序员如何优雅的挣零花钱，2.0版，升级为小书了。Most of this not work outside China , so no English translate
items.z: 《程序员如何优雅的挣零花钱？》是一本专为程序员设计的副业指南，聚焦中国市场的变现策略，涵盖知识付费、网课制作、内容创作等路径，结合《一人企业方法论2.0》与《全栈路线图》资源，提供实战思维导图与电子书下载，助力技术人实现可持续的被动收入。
items.e: This repo offers a practical guide for programmers to earn side income in China, covering monetization strategies like online courses, content creation, and knowledge products. It integrates resources from 'One-Person Business Methodology 2.0' and 'Full-Stack Roadmap', providing downloadable mind maps and eBooks to help tech professionals build passive income streams.

items.d: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
items.z: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
items.e: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

items.d: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
items.z: 该项目展示了使用 Gemini 2.5 和 LangGraph 构建全栈智能代理的完整应用，包含 React 前端与基于 LangGraph 的后端研究代理。代理能动态生成搜索词、调用 Google Search 进行网络研究，并通过反思识别知识缺口，迭代优化搜索结果，最终输出带引用来源的权威回答，适用于构建增强型对话式 AI 系统。
items.e: This project demonstrates a fullstack application using React frontend and a LangGraph-powered backend agent to perform comprehensive web research via dynamic query generation, Google Search integration, reflective reasoning, and iterative refinement using Google's Gemini models, ultimately producing cited answers from gathered sources.

items.d: React Native指南汇集了各类react-native学习资源、开源App和组件
items.z: React Native学习指南是一个全面的中文资源库，汇集了React Native开发教程、开源APP案例、组件库、工具链及权威文档，覆盖从入门到原生模块开发的完整技术栈，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用。
items.e: The React Native Learning Guide is a comprehensive Chinese resource hub compiling tutorials, open-source apps, components, tools, and official documentation for React Native development, covering everything from beginner guides to native module integration for cross-platform mobile app creation.

items.d: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
items.z: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，基于 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地语音识别，支持全局快捷键录音、VAD 降噪及多平台运行，注重隐私保护且高度可扩展。
items.e: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. It offers local transcription with VAD, global hotkeys, and cross-platform support, prioritizing privacy and extensibility.

items.d: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
items.z: DDNS-GO 是一款轻量级动态域名解析服务工具，支持多平台（Mac/Windows/Linux）及主流云服务商（阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等），自动获取公网 IPv4/IPv6 地址并更新对应域名记录。具备网页配置界面、日志查看、Webhook 通知、多级域名解析和自定义参数传递功能，支持 Docker 部署与系统服务化运行。
items.e: DDNS-GO is a lightweight dynamic DNS tool supporting multiple platforms (Mac/Windows/Linux) and cloud providers (Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare, etc.). It automatically fetches public IPv4/IPv6 addresses and updates domain records via a web-based interface. Features include multi-domain support, Webhook notifications, custom parameters, Docker deployment, and system service integration.

items.d: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
items.z: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
items.e: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

items.d: 收集&推荐优秀的 Apps/硬件/技巧/周边等
items.z: Best App 是一个精选优质应用、硬件及生活技巧的推荐项目，涵盖 macOS、iOS、Android 等平台。聚焦付费与免费精品应用，提供详细功能介绍与横向测评，帮助用户高效选择提升效率与幸福感的工具。项目强调客观推荐，拒绝广告与捐赠，倡导有章可循的产品选择。
items.e: Best App is a curated collection of excellent apps, hardware, and life-enhancing tips across macOS, iOS, and Android. It features detailed reviews and comparisons of premium and free apps, helping users make informed choices for productivity and lifestyle improvement. The project maintains objectivity, avoids ads, and encourages community contributions via Star or Pull Request.

items.d: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
items.z: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
items.e: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

items.d: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
items.z: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
items.e: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

items.d: 🎬 火宝短剧 - 基于AI的一站式短剧生成平台 《一句话生成完整短剧，从剧本到成片全自动化》  Huobao Drama - An AI-Powered End-to-End Short Drama Generator "One Sentence to Complete Drama: Fully Automated from Script to Final Video"
items.z: 火宝短剧是基于AI的一站式短剧生成平台，支持一句话生成完整短剧，实现从剧本创作、角色设计、分镜脚本到成片的全流程自动化。采用Go+Vue3全栈架构，集成大语言模型与文生图/图生视频技术，提供角色管理、智能分镜、视频合成等核心功能，适用于短视频内容工业化生产。
items.e: Huobao Drama is an AI-powered end-to-end short drama generator that transforms one sentence into a complete drama, automating script creation, character design, storyboarding, and video production. Built with Go + Vue3 stack, it integrates LLMs, text-to-image, and image-to-video models for full workflow automation in short-form content creation.

items.d: 关于Python的面试题
items.z: 该仓库系统整理了Python语言特性、操作系统、数据库、网络及数据结构等核心面试知识点，涵盖函数参数传递、元类、装饰器、GIL、协程、垃圾回收机制等高级特性，并提供经典编程题解析（如斐波那契、链表操作、排序算法），是Python开发者面试准备的权威资料库。
items.e: This repository compiles comprehensive Python interview questions covering language features (e.g., metaclasses, decorators, GIL), operating systems (IPC, memory management), databases (transactions, MVCC), networking (TCP/IP, HTTP), and data structures. It includes algorithm implementations like Fibonacci, sorting, and tree traversals, serving as a complete technical reference for Python job interviews.

items.d: Spark-TTS Inference Code

items.e: Spark-TTS is an efficient LLM-based text-to-speech model using Qwen2.5 for high-quality, bilingual (Chinese/English) speech synthesis. It supports zero-shot voice cloning and controllable generation (e.g., gender, pitch) with a single-stream decoupled architecture that directly reconstructs audio from LLM-predicted tokens, eliminating the need for separate acoustic models and enabling cross-lingual applications.

It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

items.d: 简悦 ( SimpRead ) - 让你瞬间进入沉浸式阅读的扩展
items.z: 简悦是一款专为提升中文阅读体验设计的浏览器扩展，通过原创的阅读模式自动提取网页标题、正文、媒体资源等核心内容，适配数百种网站。支持聚焦模式、手动框选、代码高亮、LaTeX/Markdown解析及自定义样式，并集成剪藏、标注、稍后读等功能，是高效的知识管理工具。
items.e: SimpRead is a browser extension designed to enhance Chinese reading experience by extracting core content (title, body, media) from hundreds of websites via its proprietary reading mode. It supports focus mode, manual selection, code highlighting, LaTeX/Markdown rendering, custom CSS, and integrates clipping, annotation, and read-later features as a productivity tool.

items.d: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
items.z: waoowaoo AI 影视 Studio 是首家工业级全流程可控协作式专业 AI 智能体影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并制作成完整视频，涵盖短片到漫剧再到真人级影视剧的全流程制作，采用好莱坞专业制作团队思路，提供虚拟制片场体验。
items.e: waoowaoo AI Studio is the first industrial-grade, end-to-end controllable collaborative AI agent platform for professional film and TV production, supporting full-process creation from short films to anime series and feature films. It automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text and assembles them into complete videos, following Hollywood-level production workflows.

items.d: An Autonomous LLM Agent for Complex Task Solving
items.z: XAgent 是一个开源的自主 LLM 智能体，专为复杂任务求解设计。它具备高度自主性、安全性与可扩展性，支持通过 Dispatcher、Planner 和 Actor 三大模块协同工作，结合工具服务器（ToolServer）提供的文件编辑、Python 交互环境、网页浏览和 Shell 执行等功能，实现端到端的自动化任务处理，并可与人类协作完成挑战性任务。
items.e: XAgent is an open-source autonomous LLM agent designed to solve complex tasks end-to-end. It features autonomy, safety (via Docker isolation), extensibility, and human collaboration. Powered by a modular architecture with Dispatcher, Planner, and Actor components, it leverages ToolServer tools like file editing, Python notebooks, web browsing, and shell execution to autonomously plan, execute, and refine solutions.

items.d: Private & local AI personal knowledge management app for high entropy people.
items.z: Reor 是一款本地运行的 AI 个人知识管理应用，专为高信息密度人群设计。它基于 Ollama、Transformers.js 和 LanceDB 构建，支持自动关联笔记、语义搜索与 LLM 驱动的问答。所有数据本地存储，提供类 Obsidian 的 Markdown 编辑器，通过向量数据库实现智能内容检索与思维增强。
items.e: Reor is a private, local AI-powered personal knowledge management app for high-entropy individuals. Built on Ollama, Transformers.js, and LanceDB, it enables automatic note linking, semantic search, and LLM-based Q&A via RAG. All data stays local with an Obsidian-like markdown editor, offering intelligent context retrieval to augment thought.

items.d: Make changes to FMHY
items.z: FMHY 是一个聚合海量免费资源的互联网平台，涵盖软件、工具、学习资料等，提供结构化索引与社区推荐。项目通过 Wiki 维护内容，支持 Markdown/JSON API 备份，强调去中心化存储与社区协作，所有文件均托管于第三方，确保内容自由开放。
items.e: FMHY is the largest internet platform curating free resources like software, tools, and learning materials, offering structured indexes and community recommendations. It maintains content via a Wiki, supports Markdown/JSON API backups, emphasizes decentralized storage, and operates without hosting files, ensuring open and free access.

items.d: HTTP proxy written in Go. COW can automatically identify blocked sites and use parent proxies to access.
items.z: COW 是一个基于 Go 编写的智能 HTTP 代理工具，专为简化科学上网设计。它能自动识别被墙网站并仅对这些网站启用二级代理（如 Shadowsocks、SOCKS5 等），直连网站则绕过代理以提升访问速度。支持多类型二级代理、负载均衡、PAC 自动配置及访问行为学习，适用于移动设备或 APN 代理场景。
items.e: COW (Climb Over the Wall) is an intelligent HTTP proxy written in Go, designed to simplify bypassing internet restrictions. It automatically detects blocked websites and routes only those through secondary proxies (e.g., Shadowsocks, SOCKS5), while allowing direct access to uncensored sites for optimal speed. Features include multi-proxy support, load balancing, PAC generation, and adaptive learning of site accessibility patterns.

items.d: 一个简洁优雅的hexo主题  A simple and elegant theme for hexo.
items.z: Yilia 是一款为 Hexo 博客系统设计的简洁优雅主题，注重移动端体验与极致加载性能，支持目录导航、打赏、搜索、分享等功能，采用 webpack 构建，强调内容呈现与用户专注度。
items.e: Yilia is a simple and elegant theme for Hexo 2.4+, focusing on mobile experience, fast loading, and content-first design. It supports features like TOC, rewards, search, sharing, and is built with webpack for performance and extensibility.

items.d: Elegant and powerful theme for Hexo.
items.z: NexT 是一款优雅且功能强大的 Hexo 主题，专为静态博客设计。支持多风格（Muse、Mist、Pisces、Gemini），集成 PJAX 加速、CDN 配置、第三方插件扩展等高级功能，注重代码高亮、响应式布局与 SEO 优化，适合技术博客与个人站点。
items.e: NexT is an elegant and powerful theme for Hexo, designed for static blogs. It offers multiple styles (Muse, Mist, Pisces, Gemini), supports advanced features like PJAX navigation, CDN integration, and third-party plugins, with strong emphasis on code highlighting, responsive design, and SEO optimization for tech blogs and personal sites.

items.d: A configurable set of panels that display various debug information about the current request/response.
items.z: Django Debug Toolbar 是一个可配置的调试面板集合，实时展示当前请求/响应的详细信息，包括 SQL 查询、模板渲染、缓存状态等，显著提升 Django 开发调试效率。支持社区贡献的第三方扩展面板，兼容 Django 4.2+，并提供异步视图实验性支持。
items.e: Django Debug Toolbar is a configurable set of panels that display detailed debug information about the current request/response, including SQL queries, templates, caching, and more. It enhances Django development by providing real-time insights and supports third-party community panels. Compatible with Django 4.2+, with experimental async view support.

items.d: Use your locally running AI models to assist you in your web browsing
items.z: Page Assist 是一款开源浏览器扩展，通过本地运行 AI 模型（如 Ollama）为网页浏览提供智能助手功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，具备侧边栏交互和独立 Web UI 两种使用方式，用户可直接在任意网页中与本地 AI 对话，实现网页内容问答与知识提取。
items.e: Page Assist is an open-source browser extension that enables interaction with locally running AI models (e.g., via Ollama) directly from any webpage. It offers a sidebar and standalone web UI for Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, allowing users to chat with webpage content using their own AI model.

items.d: :100: 2026年系统架构设计师（软考高级）备考资料。
items.z: 该项目为2026年软考高级系统架构设计师备考资料库，涵盖历年真题、模拟卷、精讲视频及论文范文，支持免费与付费资源更新。提供多平台刷题工具（网页/小程序/App），并持续优化教程与考纲解析，助力考生高效通过考试。
items.e: This repository provides comprehensive study materials for the 2026 System Architect Designer exam (a senior-level soft certification). It includes past papers, mock tests, video courses, and essay templates. Free and paid resources are updated regularly, with multi-platform practice tools (web, WeChat mini-program, mobile app) and optimized tutorials to help candidates pass efficiently.

items.z: beautiful-mermaid 是一个高性能 Mermaid 图表渲染库，支持 SVG 和 ASCII 双输出模式，具备 15 种内置主题、零 DOM 依赖、同步渲染等特性，专为 AI 编程场景优化，可在终端和 UI 中无缝使用。
items.e: beautiful-mermaid is a high-performance Mermaid diagram renderer supporting dual SVG/ASCII output, 15 built-in themes, zero DOM dependencies, and synchronous rendering. Optimized for AI-assisted programming with seamless terminal and UI integration.

items.d: Create stunning demos for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
items.z: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制工具，提供无广告、无订阅、商业可用的屏幕录制与编辑功能，支持自定义缩放、背景、注释及导出设置，适用于制作产品演示和教程视频，是 Screen Studio 的轻量级替代方案。
items.e: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording tool offering watermark-free, subscription-free recordings with customizable zooms, backgrounds, annotations, and export options. Ideal for product demos and tutorials, it serves as a lightweight alternative to Screen Studio.

items.d: Open-source Claude Design alternative. One-click import your Claude Code / Codex API key. Prompt → prototype / slides / PDF. Multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama). BYOK, local-first, MIT.
items.z: Open CoDesign 是一款开源的 Claude Design 替代工具，支持一键导入 Claude Code/Codex API 密钥，将提示词转换为原型、幻灯片或 PDF。支持多模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini/Kimi/GLM/Ollama），采用 BYOK 和本地优先架构，MIT 许可，适合 AI 驱动的设计自动化场景。
items.e: Open CoDesign is an open-source alternative to Claude Design that converts prompts into polished prototypes, slides, or PDFs using your own API keys. Supports multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama), BYOK, and local-first architecture with MIT license for AI-powered design automation.

items.d: 丰富多样的 Web 弹出层组件，可轻松实现 Alert/Confirm/Prompt/ 普通提示/页面区块/iframe/tips等等几乎所有的弹出交互。目前已成为最多人使用的弹层解决方案
items.z: layer 是一款功能全面的 Web 弹出层组件，支持 Alert、Confirm、Prompt、提示框、页面区块、iframe 等多种交互模式，兼容 IE6+ 及主流浏览器。现已集成至 Layui 框架，提供高性能、易定制的弹层解决方案，广泛应用于企业级 Web 项目，是开发者首选的轻量级交互组件。
items.e: Layer is a comprehensive web modal component supporting Alert, Confirm, Prompt, tips, iframe, and more. It offers high performance, cross-browser compatibility (including IE6), and extensive customization. Now fully integrated into Layui, it serves as a lightweight, developer-friendly solution for rich user interactions across millions of web platforms.

items.d: FongMi影视和tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。

items.e: This repository offers multiple configuration files for FongMi影视, TVBox, and CatVod platforms (e.g., 0707.json, 0821.json), supporting multi-line live streaming, automatic source switching, and video playback parsing. It integrates community-sourced third-party APIs and random wallpaper services, designed for home theater setups. Intended strictly for personal learning and research use.

items.d: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.
items.z: CodexBar 是一款 macOS 14+ 菜单栏应用，实时显示 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 等主流 AI 服务的令牌/额度使用情况（会话+周额度），支持多提供商独立或合并显示，无需登录即可查看窗口重置时间，提供本地成本扫描与状态监控功能。
items.e: CodexBar is a tiny macOS 14+ menu bar app that displays token/credit usage (session + weekly) for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and other AI providers without requiring login. It supports per-provider toggles, merge icons mode, local cost scanning, and real-time reset countdowns via a compact two-bar meter icon.

items.d: A lightweight screen recorder based on ScreenCapture Kit for macOS / 基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量化多功能 macOS 录屏工具
items.z: QuickRecorder 是一款基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量级高性能 macOS 录屏工具，支持屏幕、窗口、应用及移动设备录制。具备免驱音频回环、鼠标高亮、屏幕放大镜等功能，并完整支持 macOS 14 的 Presenter Overlay 实时摄像头叠加，以及 HEVC with Alpha 格式输出（含透明通道），适用于专业视频制作与会议录制。
items.e: QuickRecorder is a lightweight, high-performance screen recorder for macOS built on ScreenCapture Kit. It supports recording screens, windows, apps, and mobile devices with features like driver-free audio loopback, mouse highlighting, and screen magnifier. It fully supports macOS 14's Presenter Overlay for real-time camera overlay and HEVC with Alpha output (with alpha channel), ideal for professional video editing and conferencing.

items.d: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。

items.e: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

items.d: Create *beautiful* command-line interfaces with Python

items.e: docopt is a Python library that automatically generates command-line interfaces from docstrings, parsing usage patterns and options to create clean, readable CLI tools without manual parser coding.

items.d: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
items.z: MusicFree 桌面版是一款插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。其核心特性包括：通过插件机制接入任意音源（如搜索、播放、歌单导入），高度定制化主题系统（支持 CSS 变量与 iframe 背景），以及本地数据存储保障隐私。用户可自由扩展音源与界面风格，实现个性化音乐体验。
items.e: MusicFree Desktop is a plugin-based, ad-free, open-source music player supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include: plugin-driven access to any audio source (search, playback, playlist import), highly customizable themes via CSS variables and iframe backgrounds, and local data storage for privacy. Users can extend sources and personalize UI freely.

items.d: Run agents in Obsidian - OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code etc.

items.e: Copilot for Obsidian is an AI assistant plugin designed for knowledge management, integrating local/cloud LLMs, intelligent vault search, multimedia understanding, and autonomous agent capabilities. It emphasizes user data ownership with no provider lock-in, offering advanced features like project mode, writing assistance, and tool automation within Obsidian's customizable workspace.

items.e: Surfboard is an automation platform designed for AI agents, enabling web scraping, data extraction, and task automation. It offers an intuitive interface and robust scheduling to help users build and deploy AI-driven workflows efficiently, ideal for content aggregation and data collection.

items.d: Featuring powerful AI capabilities and supporting various e-book formats, it makes reading smarter and more focused.

items.d: Tabula is a tool for liberating data tables trapped inside PDF files
