Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

items.d: Bananas🍌, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
items.z: Bananas 是一款跨平台屏幕共享工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，采用点对点连接技术，无需注册或服务器中转（仅需 STUN/TURN 和信令服务器完成初始连接）。主打隐私安全、简单易用，适合快速分享屏幕。
items.e: Bananas is a cross-platform screen sharing tool for Mac, Windows, and Linux, using peer-to-peer connections without requiring accounts or central servers (except for STUN/TURN and signaling servers). It emphasizes privacy, simplicity, and instant sharing.

items.d: VSCode插件：自动生成，自动更新VSCode文件头部注释, 自动生成函数注释并支持提取函数参数，支持所有主流语言，文档齐全，使用简单，配置灵活方便，持续维护多年。
items.z: koroFileHeader 是一款 VSCode 插件，专注于自动生成文件头部注释、自动更新编辑信息，并支持函数注释与参数提取。支持所有主流编程语言，配置灵活，文档详尽，自2018年持续维护，拥有超39.7万用户，日均安装量达200-500次，助力开发者规范代码风格与提升编码效率。
items.e: koroFileHeader is a VSCode plugin that automates file header comment generation, updates last editor and timestamp, and supports function documentation with automatic parameter extraction. It works across all major programming languages, offers flexible configuration, comprehensive documentation, and has been actively maintained since 2018 with over 397K users and daily installs of 200–500.

items.d: 消息推送平台🔥 推送下发【邮件】【短信】【微信服务号】【微信小程序】【企业微信】【钉钉】等消息类型。
items.z: Austin 是一个企业级统一消息推送平台，支持邮件、短信、微信、钉钉、企业微信等10+渠道的消息下发，具备全链路追踪、资源隔离、定时任务等能力，采用 SpringBoot + Kafka + Redis + Xxl-Job 等技术栈，适用于业务通知、营销触达等场景。
items.e: Austin is an enterprise-grade unified messaging push platform supporting 10+ channels including email, SMS, WeChat, DingTalk, and enterprise WeChat. It features full-lifecycle tracking, channel isolation, and scheduled delivery via cron. Built with SpringBoot, Kafka, Redis, and Xxl-Job, it serves business notifications and marketing campaigns.

items.d: 定投改变命运 —— 让时间陪你慢慢变富 https://onregularinvesting.com
items.z: 《定投改变命运》系统阐述普通人通过定期投资实现财富积累与阶层跃迁的路径，强调定投作为唯一可操作、可坚持的长期投资策略，结合证券市场奇迹属性与人性弱点分析，提供可落地的投资哲学与实践指南。
items.e: This book systematically explains how ordinary people can break through class barriers through regular investing, emphasizing that dollar-cost averaging is the only feasible and sustainable investment strategy. It combines market insights with human psychology to offer a practical philosophy and actionable guidance for long-term wealth building.

items.d: Multi-channel AI proxy with intelligent key rotation. 智能密钥轮询的多渠道 AI 代理。
items.z: GPT-Load 是一个高性能企业级 AI API 透明代理服务，专为需要集成多 AI 服务的开发者和企业设计。基于 Go 构建，具备智能密钥轮询、负载均衡、故障自动恢复、动态配置热重载等特性，支持 OpenAI、Google Gemini、Anthropic Claude 等多种 AI 服务格式，提供完整的监控和管理界面。
items.e: GPT-Load is a high-performance, enterprise-grade transparent proxy service for AI APIs, designed for developers and enterprises integrating multiple AI services. Built with Go, it features intelligent key rotation, load balancing, automatic failure recovery, hot-reload configuration, and comprehensive monitoring. Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude APIs with a Vue 3 management interface.

items.d: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
items.z: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
items.e: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

items.d: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行
items.z: CCG 是多模型协作开发系统，由 Claude 编排、Codex 处理后端、Gemini 负责前端，提供 28 个命令覆盖完整开发流程，支持零配置一键安装，通过 OPSX 实现规格驱动开发，确保安全性和自动化。
items.e: CCG is a multi-model collaboration development system where Claude orchestrates Codex (backend) and Gemini (frontend), offering 28 slash commands for full-stack development, zero-config setup, and spec-driven workflows via OPSX for secure, automated coding.

items.d: A Flutter UI Kit（一个 Flutter UI组件库），包含 ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, WaterMark, GradientCircularProgressIndicator...
items.z: Flukit 是一个功能丰富的 Flutter UI 组件库，提供 ScaleView、Swiper、PullRefresh、WaterMark 等实用 Widget，涵盖手势交互、动画效果、进度指示器等场景，支持自定义渐变按钮、弹性滚动头部等高级功能，显著提升 Flutter 开发效率。
items.e: Flukit is a comprehensive Flutter UI kit offering essential widgets like ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, and WaterMark. It supports advanced features such as gesture interactions, gradient animations, elastic headers, and progress indicators, significantly enhancing Flutter app development efficiency.

items.d: Python client for Apache Kafka
items.z: kafka-python 是一个功能完整的 Python 客户端库，用于与 Apache Kafka 分布式流处理系统交互。它高度模拟官方 Java 客户端的行为，支持高吞吐量的消息生产与消费，提供消费者组、偏移量提交、事务消息、消息头、反序列化等高级功能，适用于构建实时数据管道和流处理应用。
items.e: kafka-python is a fully-featured Python client for Apache Kafka, designed to closely mimic the official Java client. It supports high-level asynchronous message production and consumption, consumer groups, offset commits, transactional messages, message headers, and deserialization, making it ideal for building real-time data pipelines and streaming applications.

items.d: TVBox 网络接口，更新速度快，接口访问速度快且稳定！
items.z: TVBox 提供高速稳定的网络接口，支持多加速访问源，但官方已推荐迁移至功能更丰富的 OK影视。该项目主要用于构建电视直播与点播应用，强调接口响应速度与稳定性，适用于各类智能电视及移动端播放平台。
items.e: TVBox offers a fast and stable network interface with multiple CDN acceleration sources. Although it no longer supports TVBox, the project recommends migrating to OK影视 for enhanced features and mobile support. It is designed for building IPTV and video-on-demand applications with high performance.

items.d: Collection of material design libs and res.
items.z: Awesome-MaterialDesign 是一个精选的 Android Material Design 资源与库集合，涵盖官方文档、Google 示例项目、设计资源及第三方开源库，为开发者提供从设计规范到 UI 组件实现的完整解决方案，助力快速构建符合 Material Design 标准的 Android 应用。
items.e: Awesome-MaterialDesign is a curated collection of Android Material Design resources and libraries, including official docs, Google sample projects, design assets, and third-party open-source libraries, providing a complete solution for developers to build Material Design-compliant Android apps efficiently.

items.d: Gemini polling proxy service （gemini轮询代理服务）
items.z: Gemini Balance 是一个基于 FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理与负载均衡服务，支持多密钥轮询、OpenAI 格式兼容、图像文本对话、网页搜索及实时状态监控，提供灵活的配置管理和详细的日志追踪。
items.e: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI-based proxy and load balancer for Google's Gemini API, enabling multi-key polling, OpenAI API compatibility, image-text chat, web search, and real-time key status monitoring with dynamic configuration and detailed logging.

items.d: lanproxy是一个将局域网个人电脑、服务器代理到公网的内网穿透工具，支持tcp流量转发，可支持任何tcp上层协议（访问内网网站、本地支付接口调试、ssh访问、远程桌面、http代理、https代理、socks5代理...）。技术交流QQ群 736294209
items.z: lanproxy 是一款高性能内网穿透工具，支持 TCP 流量转发，可代理访问内网网站、SSH、远程桌面等任何 TCP 上层协议。提供 Java 客户端和跨平台 Go 客户端，支持 SSL 加密、多用户管理、自定义域名绑定及 HTTPS 证书自动申请，解决公网访问内网服务的安全与便捷问题。
items.e: Lanproxy is a high-performance intranet penetration tool that supports TCP traffic forwarding for any TCP-based protocol (e.g., web access, SSH, remote desktop). It offers Java and cross-platform Go clients, with SSL encryption, multi-user support, custom domain binding, and automatic HTTPS certificate issuance, enabling secure and easy public access to private networks.

items.d: One Remote Access Manager to Rule Them All
items.z: 1Remote 是一款现代化的个人远程会话管理与启动工具，支持 RDP、SSH、VNC、Telnet、(S)FTP 等多种协议，提供多屏幕 HiDPI 连接、标签化界面、自定义运行器及 mRemoteNG 导入功能，支持便携运行与多语言主题定制。
items.e: 1Remote is a modern personal remote session manager and launcher supporting RDP, SSH, VNC, Telnet, (S)FTP, RemoteApp, NoMachine and more. It offers multi-screen HiDPI RDP support, customizable runners, mRemoteNG import, portable deployment, and a tabbed, multi-language interface.

items.d: AIGCPanel 是一个简单易用的一站式AI数字人系统，支持视频合成、声音合成、声音克隆，简化本地模型管理、一键导入和使用AI模型。
items.z: AIGCPanel 是一款集成视频合成、语音合成与克隆的一体化AI数字人系统，支持多模态模型一键导入与管理。基于Electron+Vue3+TypeScript构建，提供跨平台桌面应用，内置CosyVoice、MuseTalk等主流模型，简化本地AI创作流程，适合非技术用户快速生成逼真数字人内容。
items.e: AIGCPanel is an all-in-one AI digital human system featuring video synthesis, voice synthesis, and cloning. It supports one-click model import/management of mainstream models like CosyVoice and MuseTalk. Built with Electron+Vue3+TypeScript for cross-platform desktop deployment, it simplifies local AI content creation for non-technical users.

items.d: an elegant efficient express mvvm framework
items.z: Avalon2 是一个高效优雅的 MVVM 前端框架，支持双向数据绑定与组件化开发，具备优异的渲染性能与后端渲染能力。它兼容 IE6+，提供丰富的指令系统（如 ms-duplex、ms-if）和组件开发支持，适用于构建高性能单页应用（SPA）。
items.e: Avalon2 is an elegant and efficient MVVM framework for frontend development, featuring two-way data binding, componentization, and high-performance rendering. It supports server-side rendering, IE6+ compatibility, and provides a rich directive system (e.g., ms-duplex, ms-if) for building scalable single-page applications (SPAs).

items.d: A ready-to-go translation ocr tool developed with WPF/WPF 开发的一款即用即走的翻译、OCR工具
items.z: STranslate 是一款基于 WPF 开发的即用即走翻译与 OCR 工具，支持多语言实时翻译与屏幕文字识别，具备轻量化、跨平台特性，提供简洁高效的用户界面，适用于办公、学习等场景的文本快速处理需求。
items.e: STranslate is a ready-to-use translation and OCR tool built with WPF, offering real-time multilingual translation and screen text recognition. It features a lightweight, cross-platform design with an intuitive interface, ideal for quick text processing in work and study environments.

items.d: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 插件与皮肤生态：一切皆插件。任务看板、移动端远程与 SSH 运维构筑开发工作台；皮肤经 WebGL 深度优化，更支持 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸；皮肤、宠物、插件由 DSH 大市场一键安装，正迈向 DSH 创意工坊。A pluggable plugin-skin ecosystem for the DSH Web GUI - Task board, remote mobile UI, SSH ops, WebGL-optimized skins with Wallpaper Engine wallpapers - becoming a DSH creative workshop.

items.d: 💬 Unofficial WeChat client built with React, MobX and Electron.
items.z: weweChat 是基于 React、MobX 和 Electron 开发的非官方微信客户端，支持桌面端多平台运行，具备消息防撤回、桌面通知、键盘快捷键、拖拽发送文件、批量消息发送等实用功能，界面现代化且兼容 macOS 窗口毛玻璃效果。
items.e: weweChat is an unofficial WeChat desktop client built with React, MobX, and Electron. It supports desktop notifications, message recall blocking, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop file sending, and batch messaging, offering a modern interface with macOS vibrancy effects.

items.d: A jQuery UI theme based on Twitter Bootstrap
items.z: jQuery UI Bootstrap 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 设计的 jQuery UI 主题，旨在让 jQuery UI 组件与 Bootstrap 风格无缝融合。它支持与 Bootstrap 共存，并提供现代化外观，同时兼容 jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3 及现代浏览器。项目处于活跃开发中，目标是实现 Bootstrap 3.x 兼容性，欢迎社区贡献。
items.e: jQuery UI Bootstrap is a theme for jQuery UI widgets inspired by Twitter Bootstrap's design, enabling visual consistency between Bootstrap and jQuery UI components. It supports coexistence with Bootstrap CSS and targets jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3. The project is actively developed with goals to achieve Bootstrap 3.x compatibility and welcomes contributors.

items.d: Zero-Config Code Flow for Claude code & Codex
items.z: ZCF 是一款零配置 Claude Code & Codex 代码流工具，提供一键安装、双语界面、智能代理系统和个性化 AI 助手。支持多种 API 提供商（如 302.AI、GLM、PackyCode 等），内置工作流、MCP 集成，并持续更新维护，适合开发者快速部署 AI 编程环境。
items.e: ZCF (Zero-Config Code Flow) is a zero-configuration tool for Claude Code & Codex, enabling one-click setup with bilingual support, intelligent agent system, and personalized AI assistants. It supports multiple API providers (e.g., 302.AI, GLM, PackyCode), includes workflows and MCP integration, and is actively maintained for seamless AI coding experience.

items.d: 一个基于 React Native TVOS 和 Expo 构建的播放器，旨在提供流畅的视频观看体验。
items.z: OrionTV 是基于 React Native TVOS 和 Expo 构建的跨平台电视播放器，专为 Apple TV 和 Android TV 设计。采用 TypeScript + Expo Router 实现现代化前端架构，集成 TV 优化 UI 与视频流服务，提供流畅的影视内容观看体验，依赖 MoonTV 作为后端数据源。
items.e: OrionTV is a cross-platform TV player built with React Native TVOS and Expo, supporting Apple TV and Android TV. It features a modern frontend using TypeScript, Expo Router, and TV-optimized UI for seamless video playback, powered by MoonTV as its backend content provider.

items.d: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
items.z: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型和 RAG 技术的智能问数系统，支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），实现自然语言转 SQL 查询并生成可视化图表。具备开箱即用、安全可控、易于集成等优势，可嵌入 DataEase、Dify 等应用，支持细粒度权限管理与持续优化，越问越准。
items.e: SQLBot is an intelligent data querying system powered by LLMs and RAG, enabling conversational analytics (ChatBI) with natural language-to-SQL conversion and visualization. It offers plug-and-play deployment, secure workspace isolation, fine-grained permissions, and seamless integration into platforms like DataEase and Dify, continuously improving accuracy through user interactions.

items.d: Django app for handling the server headers required for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)
items.z: django-cors-headers 是一个 Django 应用，用于自动为响应添加跨域资源共享（CORS）头，支持灵活配置允许的源、方法和头部，适用于前后端分离架构中安全地允许跨域请求。
items.e: django-cors-headers is a Django app that automatically adds Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers to responses, enabling secure cross-origin requests from browsers with configurable origins, methods, and headers.

items.d: 输入SQL，输出索引优化建议
items.z: SQLAdvisor 是美团点评 DBA 团队开发的 SQL 索引优化工具，基于 MySQL 词法解析分析 WHERE、JOIN 等条件，智能生成索引优化建议。已在内部广泛应用，支持开源协作与持续迭代，提供完整文档与社区支持。
items.e: SQLAdvisor is an index optimization tool developed by Meituan-Dianping's DBA team, analyzing SQL queries via MySQL's native lexer to generate intelligent index suggestions based on WHERE, JOIN, and aggregation conditions. Widely used internally, it supports open-source collaboration with comprehensive documentation and community feedback channels.

items.d: Redis-based components for Scrapy.
items.z: Scrapy-Redis 是基于 Redis 的分布式爬虫组件，支持多实例共享任务队列与去重，实现高效分布式网页抓取与后处理。提供 Scrapy 即插即用调度器、去重过滤器、Item Pipeline 及基础 Spider，增强爬虫扩展性与并发能力。
items.e: Scrapy-Redis provides Redis-based distributed components for Scrapy, enabling shared task queues and deduplication across multiple spider instances. It supports distributed crawling, post-processing, and plug-and-play architecture with scheduler, filter, and pipeline components for scalable web scraping.

items.d: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
items.z: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
items.e: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

items.d: One Worker, All Subscriptions
items.z: Sublink Worker 是一个轻量级订阅转换与管理工具，支持 ShadowSocks、VLESS、Hysteria2 等主流代理协议，兼容 Sing-Box、Clash 等客户端。通过 Cloudflare Workers、Vercel 或 Docker 一键部署，提供 KV 存储的短链生成、多语言界面及自动化 API，适用于个人或团队统一管理多源代理订阅。
items.e: Sublink Worker is a lightweight subscription converter and manager supporting proxy protocols like ShadowSocks, VLESS, and Hysteria2. Deployable on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or Docker, it offers short-link generation via KV storage, multi-language UI, and automation APIs for unified management of proxy subscriptions across clients such as Sing-Box and Clash.

items.d: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
items.z: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
items.e: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

items.d: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
items.z: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
items.e: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

items.d: ⭐️ A cross-platform CLI All-in-One assistant tool for Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI.
items.z: CC-Switch CLI 是一款跨平台命令行工具，专为 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等 AI 开发助手设计，提供统一的配置管理与切换功能。基于 Rust 构建，支持多工作区管理、MCP服务器配置、提示词管理及环境检查，集成 WebDAV 同步能力，显著提升 AI 开发工具链的运维效率。
items.e: CC-Switch CLI is a cross-platform command-line tool for unified management of AI development assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. Built with Rust, it supports provider switching, workspace configuration, MCP servers, prompts, local proxy routes, and environment checks, with WebDAV sync capabilities to streamline AI toolchain operations.

items.d: Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
items.z: Lunar 是一款专为 macOS 设计的显示器控制应用，支持通过 DDC/CI 协议直接调节外接显示器亮度、音量、输入源及屏幕方向。其核心亮点包括传感器/同步/位置自适应亮度调节、XDR/HDR 高亮度支持、低于 0% 的暗光模式、App 预设配置及 BlackOut 功能（关闭屏幕同时保留充电、音频等功能），完美兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片。
items.e: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors via DDC/CI, enabling hardware-level brightness, volume, input switching, and orientation adjustments. Key features include sensor/sync/location-based adaptive brightness, support for 1000–1600 nits XDR/HDR displays, sub-zero dimming, app-specific presets, and BlackOut mode—preserving charging, audio, and input while turning off screens. Fully compatible with both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.

items.d: Python package for doing RPA
items.z: RPA for Python 是一个强大的自动化工具包，提供简洁的 API 实现网页、桌面应用及 OCR 流程的自动化，支持跨平台运行，适用于重复性任务的高效处理，显著提升工作效率。
items.e: RPA for Python is a powerful automation toolkit offering a simple API to automate web, desktop, and OCR workflows across platforms, enabling efficient handling of repetitive tasks with minimal code.

items.d: Simulates Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, and Kiro client requests, compatible with the OpenAI API. It supports thousands of Gemini model requests per day and offers free use of the built-in Claude model in Kiro. Easily connect to any client via the API, making AI development more efficient!
items.z: AIClient-2-API 是一个强大的 API 代理服务，能够将原本仅限客户端使用的大模型（如 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Qwen Code、Kiro 等）的请求统一转换为兼容 OpenAI 协议的标准接口。支持每日数千次 Gemini 模型请求，内置 Claude 免费调用功能，提供高可用性的模块化架构，包含账户池管理、智能轮询、自动故障转移和健康检查机制，显著提升 AI 开发效率。
items.e: AIClient-2-API is a powerful proxy service that unifies requests from client-restricted large models (e.g., Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, Kiro) into a standard OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini model requests, offers free built-in Claude access, and features a modular architecture with account pooling, intelligent polling, automatic failover, and health checks for 99.9% uptime, greatly enhancing AI development efficiency.

items.d: CSS library for Instagram filters
items.z: CSSgram 是一个基于 Sass 和 CSS 的 Instagram 滤镜库，通过 CSS 伪元素和混合模式为网页图片添加 Instagram 风格滤镜效果，支持 24 种经典滤镜（如 Aden、1977、Brooklyn 等），无需图像处理工具即可实现丰富的视觉风格，适用于现代浏览器（Chrome 43+、Firefox 38+ 等）。
items.e: CSSgram is a Sass and CSS library that applies Instagram-like filters to images using CSS filters and blend modes via pseudo-elements. It offers 24 presets (e.g., Aden, 1977, Brooklyn) for web-based image styling without manual editing, compatible with modern browsers (Chrome 43+, Firefox 38+, etc.).

items.d: Open-source, accurate and easy-to-use video speech recognition & clipping tool, LLM based AI clipping intergrated.
items.z: FunClip 是一款开源、精准且易用的视频语音识别与剪辑工具，集成阿里巴巴通义语音实验室开源的 FunASR Paraformer 系列模型，支持中文及英文语音识别，具备热词定制、说话人分离、多段自由剪辑等功能，并引入 LLM 智能剪辑能力，用户可通过 Gradio 界面快速生成精准视频片段与字幕。
items.e: FunClip is an open-source, accurate, and user-friendly video speech recognition and clipping tool. It leverages Alibaba's FunASR Paraformer models for ASR, supports Chinese and English, enables hotword customization, speaker separation, multi-segment clipping, and integrates LLM-based AI clipping via Qwen/GPT series models with customizable prompts for intelligent video editing.

items.d: 中国5级行政区域mysql库
items.z: 该仓库提供中国5级行政区域MySQL数据库，涵盖省、市、县、镇、村完整行政层级，包含大陆地区邮政编码及经纬度信息。数据源自国家统计局官网，2023年版本在2020年基础上优化，共758,049条记录，支持高效导入与查询。
items.e: This repository provides a MySQL database of China's 5-level administrative divisions, including provinces, cities, counties, towns, and villages, with postal codes and coordinates for mainland China. Data sourced from the National Bureau of Statistics, the 2023 version refines the 2020 dataset, totaling 758,049 records, optimized for fast import and querying.

items.d: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
items.z: BiliNote 是一款开源 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持哔哩哔哩、YouTube、抖音等平台视频链接自动提取内容，结合 GPT 或通义千问等模型生成结构化 Markdown 笔记，支持插入截图、跳转链接及多版本记录，提供本地部署与在线体验。
items.e: BiliNote is an open-source AI video note generator that automatically extracts content from Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin, and other platforms to create structured Markdown notes using GPT, DeepSeek, or Qwen models. It supports screenshots, jump links, multiple versions, and local deployment with optional CUDA acceleration.

items.d: Python PDF Parser (Not actively maintained). Check out pdfminer.six.
items.z: PDFMiner 是一个用于从 PDF 文档中提取文本和布局信息的纯 Python 工具，支持 PDF-1.7 格式及多种字体类型，具备自动排版分析、加密文档处理、CJK 语言支持等功能，可将 PDF 转换为文本、HTML、XML 等格式，并提供命令行工具与调试接口。
items.e: PDFMiner is a pure Python tool for extracting text and layout information from PDF documents, supporting PDF-1.7, various fonts, encryption, and CJK languages. It enables conversion to text, HTML, XML, and provides detailed layout analysis via command-line tools. Note: This project is no longer actively maintained.

items.d: "Sigma File Manager" is a free, open-source, quickly evolving, modern file manager (explorer / browser) app for Windows and Linux.
items.z: Sigma File Manager 是一款免费开源的现代文件管理器，专为 Windows 和 Linux 设计，支持快速文件浏览与操作。项目已进入 v2 稳定测试阶段，提供直观界面与高效功能，适用于日常文件管理需求。
items.e: Sigma File Manager is a free, open-source, modern file manager for Windows and Linux, offering fast file browsing and operations. Now in v2 beta, it features an intuitive interface and efficient tools for streamlined file management.

items.d: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
items.z: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
items.e: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

items.d: Chrome扩展：支持GPT（Codex） / kiro / Grok自动注册、上传
items.z: FlowPilot 是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为批量自动化 ChatGPT OAuth 注册与登录流程设计。支持多邮箱服务（如 QQ、163、DuckDuckGo、Cloudflare 等）获取验证码，具备自动填写表单、密码生成、失败重试、自定义邮箱池及号池管理等功能，适用于 CPA/SUB2API 账号批量运营场景。
items.e: FlowPilot is a Chrome extension designed for batch automation of ChatGPT OAuth registration and login. It supports multiple email services (e.g., QQ, 163, DuckDuckGo, Cloudflare) to retrieve verification codes, with features like auto-form filling, password generation, retry on failure, custom email pools, and account management—ideal for scaling CPA/SUB2API operations.

items.d: 微信公共平台消息接口服务中间件
items.z: Node.js 微信公众平台消息接口中间件，支持文本、图片、语音、视频、音乐、图文等多种自动回复，提供会话管理和多客服转发功能，适用于公众号开发快速集成消息处理逻辑。
items.e: A Node.js middleware for WeChat Official Platform message interface, supporting automatic replies (text, image, voice, video, music, news), session management, and customer service transfer, enabling rapid integration of message handling logic for official accounts.

items.d: 【编程随想】收藏的开源项目清单
items.z: 编程随想维护的开源项目收藏清单，涵盖C/C++和Python两大语言的技术库与示例代码，聚焦程序员实用工具与学习资源，便于快速检索与参考。
items.e: A curated collection of open-source projects by Programthink, featuring code libraries and examples in C/C++ and Python, designed for developers to quickly access practical tools and learning resources.

items.d: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
items.z: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
items.e: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

items.d: Wrappers for JavaScript alert(), confirm() and other flexible dialogs using Twitter's bootstrap framework
items.z: Bootbox 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 框架的 JavaScript 对话框封装库，提供简洁易用的 alert()、confirm() 等弹窗接口，支持高度定制化与响应式设计，适用于现代 Web 应用的用户交互场景。
items.e: Bootbox is a JavaScript library that wraps native alert(), confirm(), and other dialog functions using Twitter's Bootstrap framework, offering customizable, responsive modal dialogs for modern web applications.

items.d: Learn python3 in one picture.
items.z: 本项目通过一张图片全面展示 Python3 核心语法与特性，涵盖数据类型、流程控制、函数、类、模块等关键内容，辅以 IPython Notebook 交互版本，适合快速入门与参考。
items.e: This project presents a comprehensive one-page visual guide to Python 3 syntax and features, including data types, control flow, functions, classes, and modules, with an interactive IPython Notebook version for easy learning and reference.

items.d: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."
items.z: 红墨是基于🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌的一站式小红书图文生成器，支持一句话生成完整图文内容，包含智能大纲、封面页和内容页批量生成。采用Python Flask后端与Vue 3前端，支持Docker一键部署，集成Gemini 3文案与图片生成能力，提供可视化配置界面。
items.e: RedInk is a one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator powered by 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, enabling instant creation of complete posts from a single sentence. It features AI-driven outline generation, cover page design, and batch content creation. Built with Python Flask backend and Vue 3 frontend, it supports Docker deployment and integrates Gemini 3 for text and image generation with a user-friendly web interface.

items.d: ReactiveX for Python
items.z: RxPY 是一个基于 Python 的 ReactiveX 实现，支持响应式编程范式，提供超过 120 个操作符和 1300+ 单元测试，支持异步事件流处理、可观察序列操作及调度器管理，兼容 Python 3.9+，适用于构建高并发、事件驱动型应用。
items.e: RxPY is a ReactiveX implementation for Python, enabling reactive programming with over 120 operators and 1300+ unit tests. It supports asynchronous event streams, observable sequences, and schedulers, designed for building concurrent, event-driven applications in Python 3.9+.

items.d: Repo for BenTsao [original name: HuaTuo (华驼)], Instruction-tuning Large Language Models with Chinese Medical Knowledge. 本草（原名：华驼）模型仓库，基于中文医学知识的大语言模型指令微调
items.z: 本草（原名华驼）开源基于中文医学知识指令微调的LLaMA、Alpaca-Chinese、Bloom、活字等模型，采用LoRA方法在医学知识库与文献数据上训练，显著提升医疗问答效果，支持多基模型适配与推理部署。
items.e: BenTsao (formerly HuaTuo) is an open-source collection of instruction-tuned large language models including LLaMA, Alpaca-Chinese, Bloom, and Huozi, fine-tuned on Chinese medical knowledge using LoRA. It enhances medical Q&A performance across multiple base models with support for inference deployment.

items.d: 微信视频号下载器
items.z: 微信视频号下载器是一款轻量级跨平台工具，支持 Windows 和 macOS 系统，通过注入浏览器扩展实现一键下载视频号视频。无需登录或复杂配置，自动安装证书并启动代理服务，在微信 PC 端界面直接添加下载按钮，支持多画质选择，下载完成后自动展示文件信息，体积小巧且操作简便。
items.e: WeChat Channels Video Downloader is a lightweight cross-platform tool for Windows and macOS that enables one-click downloading of videos from WeChat Channels. It automatically installs certificates, starts a proxy service, and injects download buttons into the WeChat PC client interface. Users can select video quality (e.g., xWT111, xWT98) and download files with metadata displayed post-download, offering a simple and efficient experience.

items.d: Codelabs management & hosting tools
items.z: Google Codelabs 工具集提供强大的交互式教程创作与托管能力，支持通过 Google Docs 或 Markdown 进行灵活的内容编写，自动生成响应式网页教程。核心工具 claat 可将文档转换为 HTML、Markdown 等格式，支持实时预览、用户进度追踪及多平台适配，适用于教育、技术分享和开发者活动场景。
items.e: The Google Codelabs tools enable powerful creation and hosting of interactive instructional tutorials via Google Docs or Markdown. The core claat tool transforms documents into responsive web-based codelabs, supporting real-time preview, user progress tracking, and multi-format output (HTML/Markdown), ideal for education and developer events.

items.d: Self-hosted webscraper.
items.z: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
items.e: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

items.d: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS
items.z: ClashMac 是一款专为 macOS 打造的本地代理客户端，采用 SwiftUI 原生开发，深度集成系统。提供航线地图、连接拓扑和流量统计三大核心可视化功能，支持系统代理与 TUN 增强模式，具备菜单栏常驻、隐私模式、实时切换和自动重连等特性，带来直观高效的代理管理体验。
items.e: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client built with SwiftUI, offering route map visualization, connection topology, and real-time traffic statistics. It supports system proxy and TUN modes, features menu bar integration, privacy mode, instant node switching, and auto-reconnection for an intuitive proxy management experience.

items.d: Python QR Code image generator
items.z: 纯 Python 编写的 QR 码生成库，支持生成 PNG、SVG 等格式图像，提供命令行工具和 Python API。可自定义尺寸、颜色、纠错等级等参数，适用于快速生成二维码并集成到自动化流程中。
items.e: A pure Python library for generating QR codes, supporting PNG, SVG, and console output. Offers command-line interface and Python API with customizable parameters like size, colors, and error correction levels, ideal for automation and integration.

items.d: AI 影视生产级工具 | 支持 Seedance 2.0 | 剧本到成片全流程批量化 | AI-powered film production tool with Seedance 2.0 support
items.z: 魔因漫创是一款AI影视生产级工具，支持Seedance 2.0多模态生成，实现从剧本解析、角色场景生成到分镜制作与成片输出的全流程自动化。具备角色一致性管理、批量化生产队列、多供应商AI调度等核心能力，专为短剧、动漫番剧等中高频内容创作场景设计。
items.e: Moyin Creator is an AI-powered film production tool supporting Seedance 2.0 for end-to-end automation from script parsing to final video generation. It features character consistency, batch processing, and multi-provider AI scheduling, optimized for short-form dramas and anime series.

items.d: Yet Another Clash Dashboard
items.z: yacd 是一个现代化的 Clash 代理控制面板，提供简洁直观的 Web 界面用于管理代理规则、流量监控和配置。支持通过 URL 参数动态连接不同 Clash 后端实例，具备深色/浅色主题切换功能，可通过 Docker 快速部署，适用于个人或企业网络代理管理场景。
items.e: Yet Another Clash Dashboard (yacd) is a modern, clean web interface for managing Clash proxy configurations. It enables real-time traffic monitoring, rule management, and dynamic backend connection via URL parameters. Features include dark/light theme support and easy deployment via Docker, ideal for personal or enterprise proxy administration.

items.d: 查看被删的微信好友
items.z: 该项目通过微信网页版接口检测被删除好友，原理为新建群组测试好友是否可添加。因接口存在人数限制及微信策略变更，已无法正常使用。推荐替代方案包括网页版微信API及Electron桌面客户端，支持Python、Go、Node.js等多语言实现。
items.e: This project detects WeChat users who deleted you by creating group tests via the web interface. It is now unusable due to API rate limits and policy changes. Alternatives include web-based WeChat APIs and Electron desktop clients, with implementations in Python, Go, and Node.js.

items.d: Making AJAX as easy as anchor tags
items.z: Intercooler 是一个轻量级（6.74KB gzipped）的 AJAX 增强库，通过 HTML 属性即可实现类似锚标签的异步交互。它支持事件触发、进度指示、RESTful 依赖、AJAX 历史记录等功能，无需编写 JavaScript 即可构建现代 Web 应用，适用于渐进式增强现有项目。
items.e: Intercooler is a lightweight (6.74KB gzipped) library that enables AJAX functionality using HTML attributes, similar to anchor tags. It supports event triggers, progress indicators, RESTful dependencies, AJAX history, and more, allowing developers to build modern web apps with minimal JavaScript, ideal for incremental enhancement of existing applications.

items.d: 🚀 KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API【特长：长文本解读整理】，支持高速流式输出、智能体对话、联网搜索、探索版、K1思考模型、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
items.z: KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索、智能体对话、长文档解读及图像解析，零配置部署，兼容ChatGPT接口，支持多路token轮询与自动会话清理，仅供测试用途。
items.e: KIMI AI long-text LLM reverse API supporting high-speed streaming, multi-turn dialogue, web search, agent conversations, document interpretation, and image parsing. Zero-config deployment, ChatGPT-compatible interface, multi-token support, and automatic session cleanup. For testing only.

items.d: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
items.z: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
items.e: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

items.d: cursor IDE enjoy VIP
items.z: cursor-vip 是一个通过共享方式解锁 Cursor IDE 付费 VIP 功能的工具，支持多语言配置与代理模式。它提供稳定的 Claude 模型访问，通过脚本或二进制文件快速部署，适用于开发者绕过区域限制使用高级 AI 编程功能，但稳定性不及官方版本。
items.e: cursor-vip is a tool that unlocks Cursor IDE's paid VIP features via shared access, supporting multi-language configuration and proxy modes. It offers stable Claude model access, easy deployment via scripts or binaries, and enables developers to use advanced AI coding features despite regional payment restrictions, though with lower stability than the official version.

items.d: Go/React开发的端到端webrtc的文件传输/文字传输/桌面共享，安全，隐私，数据不经过服务器。
items.z: 基于Go/React和WebRTC的端到端P2P文件传输工具，支持文件、文字传输及桌面共享，数据直连不经过服务器，具备端到端加密、响应式设计和Docker一键部署能力。
items.e: A secure, privacy-focused P2P file transfer tool built with Go/React and WebRTC, enabling direct file, text, and desktop sharing without server relay, featuring end-to-end encryption, responsive design, and Docker deployment.

items.d: 收集一些Loon、Surge、QuantumultX、ShadowRocket、Egern的配置与去广告规则。
items.z: 本仓库提供 Loon、Surge、Quantumult X 等代理工具的配置与去广告规则，涵盖抖音、微博等主流 App 的广告过滤与 IP 修改功能，支持 MITM 响应体解析，适用于净化网络环境，提升使用体验。
items.e: This repository offers configuration files and ad-blocking rules for Loon, Surge, Quantumult X, and other proxy tools, including ad removal for apps like Douyin and Weibo, with MITM-based response parsing to enhance browsing experience.

items.d: DeepSeek-Compatible Middleware Interface: A technical exploration project in Go, focusing on high-concurrency protocol adaptation. It serves as a reference implementation for converting diverse web protocols into standardized formats.
items.z: DS2API 是一个高性能 DeepSeek Web 对话能力转换 API，支持 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容接口。采用 Go 全量实现后端，React 构建管理后台，具备多账号轮询、PoW 验证、Tool Calling 防泄漏处理等核心功能，支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，并提供完整的后台管理系统。
items.e: DS2API is a high-performance API that converts DeepSeek Web chat capabilities into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini compatible interfaces. Built with full Go backend implementation and React admin UI, it features multi-account polling, PoW verification, Tool Calling protection, and supports deployment via Docker/Vercel. Includes complete management system with account testing and configuration sync.

items.d: Bootstrap components built with Vue.js
items.z: VueStrap 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Bootstrap 3 构建的原生组件库，提供无需 jQuery 依赖的轻量级 UI 解决方案。现已停止维护，推荐使用功能更完善的替代方案 BootstrapVue 或 uiv。
items.e: VueStrap is a native Vue.js component library built on Bootstrap 3, offering jQuery-free UI components. It is no longer maintained; users are advised to migrate to BootstrapVue or uiv for enhanced features and accessibility.

items.d: A generic system for filtering Django QuerySets based on user selections
items.z: Django-filter 是一个用于在 Django 中基于用户选择动态过滤 QuerySet 的通用应用，支持通过 URL 参数生成类似 admin 的筛选界面，提供类似 ModelForms 的声明式 API，并深度集成 Django REST Framework，适用于构建灵活的数据筛选接口。
items.e: Django-filter is a reusable Django application that enables declarative dynamic QuerySet filtering via URL parameters, offering an API similar to ModelForms. It supports admin-like filtering interfaces and integrates seamlessly with Django REST Framework for building flexible data filtering endpoints.

items.d: WeRoBot 是一个微信公众号开发框架
items.z: WeRoBot 是一个基于 Python 的微信公众号开发框架，采用 MIT 协议开源。它提供简洁的装饰器语法处理消息事件，支持文本、图片、事件等交互类型，内置消息解析、签名校验和自动回复功能，极大简化微信公众号后端开发流程。
items.e: WeRoBot is a Python-based WeChat Official Account development framework licensed under MIT. It offers a clean decorator syntax for handling message events like text, images, and events, with built-in message parsing, signature verification, and auto-reply capabilities, streamlining backend development for WeChat Official Accounts.

items.d: 专注批量推送的小而美的工具，目前支持：模板消息-公众号、模板消息-小程序、微信客服消息、微信企业号/企业微信消息、阿里云短信、阿里大于模板短信 、腾讯云短信、云片网短信、E-Mail、HTTP请求、钉钉、华为云短信、百度云短信、又拍云短信、七牛云短信
items.z: WePush 是一款专注于批量消息推送的轻量级工具，支持微信公众号、小程序、企业微信、短信平台（阿里云、腾讯云等）及邮件等多种渠道。具备变量消息、定时推送、用户导入、多账号管理等功能，提供可视化界面与推送历史管理，适用于营销通知、系统告警等场景。
items.e: WePush is a lightweight tool for bulk message pushing, supporting WeChat official accounts, mini-programs, enterprise accounts, SMS platforms (e.g., Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud), and email. It offers variable messaging, scheduled delivery, user import, multi-account management, and a user-friendly GUI, ideal for marketing alerts and system notifications.

items.d: 🦋 An Infographic Generation and Rendering Framework, bring words to life with AI!
items.z: AntV Infographic 是蚂蚁集团 AntV 团队推出的下一代声明式信息图可视化引擎，提供约200个内置模板和组件，支持AI友好语法配置，可快速生成高质量SVG信息图，具备主题系统、内置编辑器和数据叙事能力，适用于数据可视化与内容创作场景。
items.e: AntV Infographic is AntV's next-generation declarative infographic visualization engine, offering ~200 built-in templates and components. It supports AI-friendly syntax for rapid generation of high-quality SVG infographics, featuring a theme system, built-in editor, and data storytelling capabilities for visualization and content creation.

items.d: Apple's Liquid Glass effect for React
items.z: Liquid Glass React 是一款为 React 应用打造的 Apple 液态玻璃特效组件库，完美复现 macOS 和 iOS 中的毛玻璃视觉效果。支持多模式折射、弹性交互、鼠标追踪位移、色差调节等高级特性，适用于现代 UI 设计中的卡片、按钮等组件，显著提升视觉质感与交互体验。
items.e: Liquid Glass React is a React component library that replicates Apple's Liquid Glass effect, delivering authentic frosted glass visuals with displacement, refraction, and elastic interactions. It supports multiple refraction modes, mouse tracking, chromatic aberration, and customizable blur/saturation, ideal for modern UI elements like cards and buttons.

items.d: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。
items.z: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等场景，并解析《刑法》《网络安全法》等法律条文，为从业者提供合规指引，避免触碰数据安全与个人信息保护的法律红线。
items.e: This project compiles Chinese web crawler violation cases involving illegal data collection, commercial infringement, and unauthorized access. It analyzes relevant laws including the Criminal Law and Cybersecurity Law to guide practitioners in avoiding legal risks related to data compliance and personal information protection.

items.z: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等五大禁区，并附相关法律法规解读与律师观点，旨在警示从业者遵守数据合规要求，规避法律风险。
