It includes legal regulations and expert opinions to help practitioners comply with data compliance and avoid legal risks.

items.d: Kode Agent — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
items.z: Kode 是一个终端中的强大 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并自动化完整工作流程。它兼容 Claude 的 .claude 格式，提供 YOLO 模式（默认）和安全的权限检查模式，支持 20+ AI 模型，具备原生二进制分发能力，注重隐私且无默认遥测。
items.e: Kode is a powerful AI coding assistant in your terminal that understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and automates workflows. It supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with .claude formats, offers YOLO and safe modes, works with 20+ AI models, and features native binary distribution with privacy-first design and no telemetry by default.

items.d: 中文网页重设与排版：一致化浏览器排版效果，构建最适合中文阅读的网页排版
items.z: typo.css 是一个专为中文网页设计的样式重置与排版工具，旨在统一浏览器渲染差异，优化中文阅读体验。它提供完整的 reset 样式、阅读内容排版类 `.typo` 及专名号、着重号等中文排版增强功能，支持桌面与移动端，适用于文章、文档等长文本场景。
items.e: typo.css is a CSS framework designed for Chinese web typography, aiming to standardize browser rendering and optimize readability. It offers a complete reset, a `.typo` class for article layouts, and enhancements like underlines for proper nouns and emphasis marks, supporting both desktop and mobile platforms.

items.z: ShadowsocksR for Windows 是一款基于 ShadowsocksR 协议的跨平台代理工具，专为绕过网络审查设计。支持多服务器配置、系统级代理、PAC自动更新及UDP流量转发，提供完整的隐私保护和网络访问解决方案。
items.e: ShadowsocksR for Windows is a cross-platform proxy tool based on the ShadowsocksR protocol, designed to bypass internet censorship. It supports multiple server configurations, system-wide proxy, automatic PAC updates, and UDP forwarding, offering comprehensive privacy protection and network access.

items.d: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
items.z: Deep Research 是一个基于 AI 的极速深度研究工具，支持多 LLM 模型（如 Gemini、OpenAI、Anthropic 等）和主流搜索引擎，可在约 2 分钟内生成高质量研究报告。采用 Thinking 与 Task 模型协同工作，支持本地知识库构建、知识图谱可视化、内容编辑与历史记录管理，所有数据均本地处理，保障隐私安全。
items.e: Deep Research is an AI-powered tool for lightning-fast in-depth research, supporting multiple LLMs (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and search engines. It generates comprehensive reports in ~2 minutes using Thinking and Task models, with local knowledge base, knowledge graph, content editing, and full privacy via on-device processing.

items.d: A light and plugable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
items.z: maptalks-gl 是一个基于 WebGL 和 WebGPU 驱动的全新地图引擎，专为高性能 2D/3D 地图可视化而设计。支持矢量切片、3DTiles 和 GLTF 格式，提供丰富的 3D 分析功能与交通模拟动画，兼容旧版 maptalks API，便于迁移。
items.e: maptalks-gl is a WebGL and WebGPU-driven map engine for high-performance 2D/3D mapping. It supports vector tiles, 3DTiles, and GLTF formats, offering advanced 3D analysis and traffic simulation. With backward-compatible APIs, it enables seamless migration from legacy maptalks.

items.d: Lightweight CSS framework
items.z: MUI 是一个轻量级 CSS 框架，严格遵循 Google 的 Material Design 设计规范，提供响应式网格系统、无依赖组件和邮件样式支持，核心优势在于极小的体积（CSS 6.6KB，JS 5.4KB）和高度可定制性，适合快速构建现代化网页界面。
items.e: MUI is a lightweight CSS framework adhering to Google's Material Design guidelines, offering a responsive grid, zero dependencies, customizable styling, and email support. Key strengths include minimal footprint (6.6KB CSS, 5.4KB JS gzipped) and async JS loading for fast, modern web development.

items.d: A lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features.
items.z: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
items.e: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

items.d: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
items.z: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
items.e: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

items.d: Quick and easy product tours with Twitter Bootstrap Popovers
items.z: Bootstrap Tour 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap Popovers 的快速易用的产品引导工具，专为构建交互式用户引导流程设计。支持 Bootstrap 2.3.0+ 版本，提供灵活的 API 和丰富的配置选项，适用于提升用户体验和引导新用户。
items.e: Bootstrap Tour is a quick and easy product tour library built on Twitter Bootstrap Popovers, designed to create interactive onboarding experiences. Compatible with Bootstrap >= 2.3.0, it offers a flexible API and extensive configuration options for guiding users through applications.

items.d: A JavaScript library for rendering music notation and guitar tablature.
items.z: VexFlow 是一个开源的 JavaScript 音乐符号渲染库，支持在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中生成乐谱与吉他谱。基于 TypeScript 开发，输出 HTML Canvas 和 SVG 格式，提供易用的 EasyScore 高级 API 以及灵活的底层 Native API，适用于网页、命令行工具及 PDF 导出等场景。
items.e: VexFlow is an open-source JavaScript library for rendering music notation and guitar tablature. Written in TypeScript and compiled to ES6, it outputs scores to HTML Canvas and SVG, supporting both browsers and Node.js environments (e.g., CLI tools for PDF generation). It offers a high-level EasyScore API and a flexible low-level Native API.

items.d: 这是一个Android系统TTS应用，内置微软演示接口，可自定义HTTP请求，可导入其他本地TTS引擎，以及根据中文双引号的简单旁白/对话识别朗读 ，还有自动重试，备用配置，文本替换等更多功能。
items.z: TTS Server 是一款专为 Android 设计的文本转语音应用，集成微软演示接口，支持自定义 HTTP 请求、本地 TTS 引擎导入及基于中文双引号的智能旁白识别朗读，具备自动重试、备用配置和文本替换等高级功能，适用于多场景语音合成需求。
items.e: TTS Server is an Android-based text-to-speech application featuring Microsoft demo interface integration, customizable HTTP requests, local TTS engine support, and smart narration recognition via Chinese quotation marks. It includes advanced features like auto-retry, fallback configurations, and text replacement for versatile speech synthesis.

items.d: IPProxyPool代理池项目，提供代理ip
items.z: IPProxyPool是一个开源代理IP池项目，支持Python 2/3，提供高匿、匿名和透明代理IP抓取与验证服务。通过多线程爬虫自动采集代理源，结合评分机制筛选可用IP，支持HTTP/HTTPS协议及国内外地域过滤。项目采用SQLite默认数据库，可扩展至MySQL、MongoDB等，并提供RESTful API供外部调用，适用于爬虫、数据采集等场景。
items.e: IPProxyPool is an open-source proxy IP pool project supporting Python 2/3, offering automated collection and validation of anonymous, high-anonymity, and transparent proxy IPs. It uses multi-threaded crawlers to gather proxies from multiple sources, filters them via a scoring system, and supports HTTP/HTTPS protocols with geographic filtering. Built on SQLAlchemy ORM, it defaults to SQLite but can be extended to MySQL or MongoDB. A RESTful API enables external access for use in web scraping and data collection applications.

items.d: WeChat SDK for Python
items.z: WeChatpy 是一个功能完整的微信公众平台第三方 Python SDK，支持普通公众平台被动响应、企业微信、微信支付、第三方平台代调用及小程序云开发等核心 API 集成，提供简洁易用的接口封装，适用于快速构建微信生态应用。
items.e: WeChatpy is a comprehensive third-party Python SDK for the WeChat public platform, supporting core APIs such as passive response, enterprise WeChat, WeChat Pay, third-party proxy calls, and mini-program cloud development, offering a clean interface for rapid integration into WeChat ecosystem applications.

items.d: ShadowsocksR update rss, SSR organization https://github.com/shadowsocksr
items.z: ShadowsocksR C# 版本4.8.0 是一个全能代理工具，支持Socks4/4a/5、HTTP协议，具备节点统计、连接管理、UDP-over-TCP、多重代理及自定义协议插件功能。支持服务器订阅与自动更新，提供GPG签名校验确保安全性，适用于绕过网络限制与隐私保护。
items.e: ShadowsocksR C# v4.8.0 is a comprehensive proxy tool supporting Socks4/4a/5, HTTP, with features like node statistics, connection management, UDP-over-TCP, multi-hop proxying, and custom protocol plugins. It supports server subscription with GPG signature verification for security, ideal for bypassing censorship and enhancing privacy.

items.d: A Python implementation of John Gruber’s Markdown with Extension support.
items.z: Python-Markdown 是 Python 实现的 John Gruber 官方 Markdown 语法解析器，高度兼容参考实现，支持扩展机制，提供简洁的 API 将 Markdown 文本转换为标准 HTML，广泛用于文档生成、静态站点构建和内容管理系统。
items.e: Python-Markdown is a Python implementation of John Gruber's Markdown, nearly fully compliant with the reference implementation. It supports extensible syntax via plugins, offering a clean API to convert Markdown text into HTML, widely used in documentation, static site generation, and content management systems.

items.d: Your Friendly Open-Source Gen-AI Platform
items.z: Pollinations.ai 是一个开源生成式 AI 平台，提供免费的文本到图像、音频、视频和文本生成 API，支持多种模型如 Stable Diffusion 和 Llama。开发者可通过简单 API 调用快速集成 AI 能力，适用于创意项目、应用开发和自动化内容生成，社区活跃且持续扩展应用场景。
items.e: Pollinations.ai is an open-source generative AI platform offering free APIs for text-to-image, audio, video, and text generation using models like Stable Diffusion and Llama. It enables developers to integrate AI capabilities via simple API calls, supporting creative projects, app development, and automated content creation with an active community and growing ecosystem.

items.d: An open-source implementation of uTools, a high-performance, scalable application launcher and plugin platform | Supports macOS and Windows, 一个高性能、可扩展的应用启动器和插件平台  uTools 的开源实现 | 支持 macOS 和 Windows
items.z: ZTools 是 uTools 的开源实现，一个高性能跨平台应用启动器与插件平台，支持 macOS 和 Windows。采用 Electron + LMDB 数据库架构，具备拼音搜索、正则匹配、剪贴板管理等核心功能，内置插件市场支持在线安装与热更新，提供主题定制与完整 TypeScript API，适用于快速启动应用与自动化工作流。
items.e: ZTools is an open-source implementation of uTools, a high-performance cross-platform application launcher and plugin platform for macOS and Windows. Built with Electron + LMDB database architecture, it features pinyin search, regex matching, clipboard management, and an integrated plugin market with online installation and auto-updates. Offers theme customization, full TypeScript API support, and seamless app launching/automation workflows.

items.d: Material Design theme for hexo.
items.z: Material Theme 是一款专为 Hexo 博客框架设计的纯净 Material Design 风格主题，支持响应式布局和现代化 UI 交互。提供多版本下载（稳定版/开发版/历史版），集成 BrowserStack 浏览器兼容测试与 jsDelivr CDN 加速服务，具备完善的文档与社区支持。
items.e: Material Theme is a pure Material Design theme for Hexo, featuring responsive layouts and modern UI interactions. It offers multiple download versions (stable/canary/historical), integrates BrowserStack for cross-browser testing, and uses jsDelivr CDN for fast asset delivery, backed by comprehensive documentation and community support.

items.d: 🍒 This is the mobile version of Cherry Studio.
items.z: Cherry Studio App 是 Cherry Studio 的官方移动端应用，专为 iOS 和 Android 设计，提供多 LLM 提供商支持（OpenAI、Gemini 等）、AI 助手对话、深色/浅色主题适配及本地数据管理功能，采用 Expo React Native + Redux Toolkit 架构。
items.e: Cherry Studio App is the official mobile version of Cherry Studio, optimized for iOS and Android. It supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini), AI assistant conversations, dark/light themes, and local data management, built with Expo React Native and Redux Toolkit.

items.d: A lightweight Vue.js UI library with a simple API, inspired by Google's Material Design.
items.z: Keen UI 是一个轻量级 Vue.js 3 UI 组件库，采用简洁 API 设计，灵感来自 Google Material Design。它专注于交互式 JavaScript 组件，不依赖 CSS 框架，支持自定义主题与尺寸，并提供独立组件打包方案以优化体积。
items.e: Keen UI is a lightweight Vue.js 3 UI library featuring a simple API inspired by Google's Material Design. It focuses on interactive JavaScript-driven components without bundling CSS frameworks, supports theme and sizing customization, and offers standalone component builds for bundle optimization.

items.d: React Native入门指南
items.z: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
items.e: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

items.d: A cross-platform and extendable version manager with support for Java, Node.js, Golang, Python, Flutter, .NET & more
items.z: vfox 是一款跨平台、可扩展的版本管理器，支持 Java、Node.js、Go、Python、Flutter、.NET 等多种运行时环境。它通过插件系统统一管理多语言开发环境，支持项目级版本隔离、自动切换和主流 shell 集成，简化了多项目环境下的依赖配置复杂度。
items.e: vfox is a cross-platform, extensible version manager (similar to nvm, asdf-vm) supporting Java, Node.js, Go, Python, Flutter, .NET and more. It enables unified management of multiple runtime versions across projects via plugins, with automatic environment switching, project-level isolation, and seamless shell integration for simplified development workflows.

items.d: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
items.z: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
items.e: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

items.d: A desktop GUI for Claude Code — chat, code, and manage projects visually. Built with Electron + Next.js.
items.z: CodePilot 是一个基于 Electron + Next.js 构建的 Claude Code 桌面 GUI 客户端，提供多模型提供商支持、MCP 扩展、自定义技能、跨平台通信及项目感知型智能助手工作区，实现可视化聊天、编码与项目管理一体化体验。
items.e: CodePilot is a desktop GUI client for Claude Code built with Electron and Next.js, offering multi-provider support, MCP extensions, custom skills, cross-platform bridging, and an AI assistant workspace that understands your projects through persistent memory and onboarding flows.

items.d: Per object permissions for Django
items.z: django-guardian 是 Django 的细粒度对象权限管理库，通过扩展 Django 的授权后端实现基于对象的权限控制。支持为单个模型实例分配权限，适用于需要复杂权限模型的应用场景，如多租户系统或内容协作平台。
items.e: django-guardian is a Django library implementing per-object permissions by extending Django's authorization backend. It enables fine-grained access control at the object level, allowing assignment of permissions to individual model instances—ideal for multi-tenant or collaborative applications requiring complex permission models.

items.d: An unofficial bilibili client for mac
items.z: Bilibili Mac Client 是一款非官方哔哩哔哩桌面客户端，基于 mpv 实现硬解播放与 libass 弹幕渲染，支持多视频网站解析、分段视频拼接、弹幕发送与屏蔽、本地视频播放及自定义配置，显著降低 CPU 占用并优化能效表现。
items.e: An unofficial Bilibili desktop client for macOS, built on mpv with hardware decoding and libass-based danmaku rendering. It supports multi-site video parsing, segmented video stitching, danmaku interaction, local playback, and extensive customization via mpv config, offering superior performance and energy efficiency compared to HTML5 players.

items.d: Multi-agent AI orchestration platform for automation, workflows, and developer tools. Golutra transforms Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw into a unified agent system with parallel execution, task orchestration, long-running workflows, and AI productivity workspace.
items.z: golutra 是一款下一代多智能体协作工作台，将现有 CLI 工具转化为统一的 AI 协作枢纽。支持无限并行执行、自动化编排和实时结果跟踪，无需迁移项目或重学命令。基于 Vue 3 + Rust 的 Tauri 桌面应用，兼容 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等主流 AI 工具，实现‘一人+AI团队’的高效开发模式，适用于软件开发、内容创作等多种场景。
items.e: golutra is a next-generation multi-agent workspace that transforms existing CLI tools into a unified AI collaboration hub. It supports unlimited parallel execution, automated orchestration, and real-time tracking without project migration or command relearning. Built with Vue 3 + Rust as a Tauri desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Gemini CLI to enable efficient 'one person + an AI squad' workflows across software development and content creation.

items.d: 👻 A simple & beautiful GUI application for scrcpy.
items.z: Scrcpy GUI 是一个简洁美观的图形界面应用，用于便捷控制 Android 设备屏幕。它基于 scrcpy 实现，支持 USB 和无线连接、实时屏幕镜像、键盘鼠标控制、多设备管理、剪贴板共享等功能，无需 Root，跨平台运行，提升手机操作效率。
items.e: Scrcpy GUI is a simple and beautiful graphical application for controlling Android devices via scrcpy. It supports USB and wireless connections, real-time screen mirroring, keyboard/mouse input, multi-device management, clipboard sharing, and more—without requiring root access. It enhances mobile productivity across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.d: Intelligent Skill routing and workflow orchestration for AI agents — +21.12 pp reward, −29.6% tokens on SkillsBench with DeepSeekV4Flash-VE.
items.z: VibeSkills 是一个集成340+ AI技能的操作系统级工具，覆盖编码、研究、自动化与创意工作。通过智能路由、记忆系统和治理验证，实现技能高效协同，显著降低使用门槛，让非技术用户也能轻松调用先进AI能力，提升生产力。
items.e: VibeSkills is an AI operating system integrating 340+ governed skills across coding, research, automation, and creative work. It enables efficient skill orchestration via intelligent routing, memory systems, and governance verification, dramatically lowering the barrier to advanced AI tool usage for both technical and non-technical users.

items.d: 基于大模型的智能对话客服工具，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、哔哩哔哩、抖音企业号、抖音、抖店、微博聊天、小红书专业号运营、小红书、知乎等平台接入，可选择 GPT3.5/GPT4.0/ 懒人百宝箱 （后续会支持更多平台），能处理文本、语音和图片，通过插件访问操作系统和互联网等外部资源，支持基于自有知识库定制企业 AI 应用。
items.z: 金销数据云智能客服是基于大语言模型的专业电商SaaS解决方案，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、抖音、小红书等10+主流平台接入，具备文本/语音/图片处理能力，支持自有知识库定制与插件扩展，提供多维度数据分析与意图识别功能。
items.e: JinXiao Data Cloud AI Customer Service is a professional e-commerce SaaS solution powered by large language models, supporting integration with 10+ mainstream platforms including WeChat, Pinduoduo, Qianniu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, with capabilities for text/voice/image processing, custom knowledge base configuration, plugin ecosystem, and multi-dimensional data analytics including intent recognition.

items.d: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
items.z: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
items.e: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

items.d: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprises form builder and analytics platform that allows users to create questionnaires, exams, polls, quizzes, and analyze data online.
items.z: XIAOJUSURVEY 是一套企业级表单构建与数据分析平台，支持问卷、考试、投票等多样化调研场景。基于 Vue3 + NestJS 技术栈，提供 40+ 题型、100+ 模板，具备智能逻辑编排、AI 生成问卷、分题统计与交叉分析能力，支持品牌化定制与多端嵌入，适用于市场调研、客户满意度测评等复杂业务场景。
items.e: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprise-grade form builder and analytics platform enabling creation of questionnaires, exams, polls, and quizzes with online data analysis. Built on Vue3 + NestJS, it offers 40+ question types, 100+ templates, AI-powered survey generation, logic rules, cross-analysis, and brand customization for market research, customer feedback, and educational assessments.

items.d: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian: generate Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text with Claude Code
items.z: Obsidian视觉技能包通过Claude Code将文本转换为Canvas、Excalidraw和Mermaid图表，支持流程图、思维导图等多种类型，提供手绘风格与动画输出，适用于知识管理与可视化呈现。
items.e: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian generates Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text using Claude Code. It supports flowcharts, mind maps, and hierarchical structures with hand-drawn aesthetics, animation modes, and full Chinese text compatibility for knowledge visualization.

items.d: 表白代码收藏馆~谁说程序猿不懂浪漫❤️
items.z: Awesome Love Code 是一个创意表白代码集合项目，汇集多种网页表白特效，涵盖动画、交互、音乐等元素，为开发者提供浪漫表白的技术实现方案，展现程序员表达爱意的独特方式。
items.e: Awesome Love Code is a curated collection of romantic coding projects featuring web-based confession effects with animations, interactions, and music. It showcases how programmers express love through creative technical implementations.

items.z: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动化注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Cursor、Kiro、Grok 等平台的批量注册。基于 FastAPI + React 构建，具备插件化扩展能力，集成临时邮箱服务、代理池管理、验证码破解（Turnstile/Captcha）及并发控制功能，提供 Web UI 实时日志监控。
items.e: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account automation registration and management system supporting batch registration for platforms like Trae.ai, Cursor, Kiro, and Grok. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin-based extensibility, temporary email integration, proxy pool management, captcha solving (Turnstile/Captcha), concurrent execution control, and real-time SSE logging via web UI.

items.d: Visible multi-agent CLI workspace for mixing Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents
items.z: CCB（Claude Codex Bridge）是一个多AI智能体协作平台，支持Claude、Codex和Gemini等模型的实时协同工作。通过项目级团队管理、命名代理通信和持久化上下文，实现零拷贝的任务委派与广播同步，适用于复杂开发流程的自动化协作场景。
items.e: CCB (Claude Codex Bridge) is a real-time multi-AI collaboration platform enabling seamless coordination between Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context, minimal token overhead, named agent communication, and project-level team management for efficient AI-driven development workflows.

items.d: Chrome扩展：支持OpenAI OAuth注册(自动开通plus账号)、验证码获取、CPA/sub/cpdex2api回调验证与自动恢复
items.z: 该Chrome扩展专为批量自动化ChatGPT OAuth注册与登录流程设计，支持CPA面板授权获取、邮箱自动生成（DuckDuckGo/Cloudflare/Gmail/2925）、多类型验证码接收（QQ/163/Hotmail/Inbucket）及回调验证。具备单步执行、自动运行、日志追踪和配置保存功能，适用于大规模账号管理场景。
items.e: This Chrome extension automates bulk ChatGPT OAuth registration/login via CPA panel integration, supporting dynamic email generation (DuckDuckGo/Cloudflare/Gmail/2925), multi-source verification code retrieval (QQ/163/Hotmail/Inbucket), and callback validation. Features step-by-step control, auto-execution, logging, and config persistence for scalable account management.

items.d: A modern static site generator by the Material for MkDocs team
items.z: Zensical 是由 Material for MkDocs 团队打造的新一代现代化静态站点生成器，支持 Markdown 编写，具备搜索、多语言（60+）、响应式布局等特性，专为开源和商业项目提供快速构建专业文档站点的解决方案。
items.e: Zensical is a modern static site generator crafted by the creators of Material for MkDocs, enabling rapid creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+ languages), and responsive documentation sites from Markdown – ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

items.d: Enable Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China with SIP enabled, tested on MacOS 15.4.1+ and 26+
items.z: 本工具通过修改系统缓存文件及注入eligibiltyd进程，绕过Apple对Apple Intelligence在中国销售Mac上的区域限制，支持macOS 15.4+及26.1+，无需常驻后台服务。提供方法1（lldb注入+文件锁定）和方法2（直接修改plist）两种方案，新增强制修改地区为美国功能以解锁ChatGPT整合等高级特性，适用于M1及以上芯片设备。
items.e: This tool enables Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China by bypassing regional restrictions via system cache modification and eligibilityd process injection, tested on macOS 15.4+ and 26.1+. It requires no persistent background services and offers two methods: Method 1 (lldb injection + file locking) and Method 2 (direct plist editing), with an added option to force region change to US for advanced features like ChatGPT integration, compatible with M1+ chips.

items.d: ⚙️ Convert HTML to Markdown. Even works with entire websites and can be extended through rules.
items.z: html-to-markdown 是一款强大的 HTML 到 Markdown 转换工具，支持完整网页转换、复杂格式处理、自定义选项和插件扩展。提供 Golang 库、CLI 工具和在线 API 三种使用方式，具备智能转义、表格支持、嵌套列表等高级功能，适用于内容提取、文档转换等场景。
items.e: html-to-markdown is a robust HTML-to-Markdown converter that transforms entire websites into clean, readable Markdown with support for complex formatting, customizable options, and extensible plugins. It offers a Golang library, CLI tool, and hosted REST API, featuring smart escaping, table conversion, nested lists, and relative-to-absolute link resolution.

items.z: Professor Synapse 是一个智能 AI 引导系统，通过创建和协调专家代理来协助用户达成目标。它支持通用提示词（兼容任意 LLM）和 Claude 技能两种模式，具备自学习、多代理辩论、知识库维护等高级功能，适用于复杂任务的专业化指导与自动化处理。
items.e: Professor Synapse is an intelligent AI guide that creates and orchestrates specialized expert agents to help users achieve their goals. It supports both universal prompts (compatible with any LLM) and a self-building Claude Skill, featuring pattern learning, multi-agent debates, and persistent knowledge management for targeted expertise.

items.d: MarkDown在线简历工具，可在线预览、编辑和生成PDF。[此项目已不再维护，建议使用 cv.ftqq.com 替代 ]
items.z: DeerResume 是一款功能强大的 Markdown 在线简历工具，支持实时编辑、预览、密码保护和一键生成 PDF。用户可自主部署，自由定制样式，适用于技术岗位简历制作，尤其适合开发者使用。
items.e: DeerResume is a powerful Markdown-based online resume tool that supports real-time editing, preview, password protection, and PDF generation. It allows self-hosting with customizable styles, making it ideal for developers creating professional tech resumes.

items.d: Super tiny size multi-touch gestures library for the web. 　　　You can touch this →
items.z: AlloyFinger 是一个超轻量级的多点触控手势库，专为网页设计，支持触摸、滑动、缩放、旋转等手势识别。采用模块化设计，体积小巧，API 简洁易用，兼容主流框架（如 Omi），适用于移动端和桌面端交互场景。
items.e: AlloyFinger is a super lightweight multi-touch gesture library for the web, supporting gestures like touch, swipe, pinch, and rotate. It features a modular design, small size, simple API, and compatibility with frameworks like Omi, ideal for mobile and desktop interactive applications.

items.d: ⭐This is a lightweight kit for generating astrolabes for Zi Wei Dou Shu (The Purple Star Astrology), an ancient Chinese astrology. It allows you to obtain your horoscope and personality analysis. 支持多语言轻量级获取紫微斗数排盘信息的javascript开源库。
items.z: iztro 是一个轻量级紫微斗数排盘 JavaScript 库，支持多语言输入输出，可生成星盘数据、生肖星座、四柱运限及四化分析，提供链式调用和插件扩展，适用于个人命理分析、文化应用开发及学术研究。
items.e: iztro is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating Zi Wei Dou Shu astrolabes, supporting multi-language input/output, star charts, zodiac signs, four pillars, luck cycles, and four transformations. It offers chainable APIs, plugin extensibility, and is ideal for astrology apps, cultural tools, and research.

items.d: 签到
items.z: qiandao 是一个基于 HAR 编辑器的自动化签到框架，支持多平台自动签到任务管理。核心功能包括通过 HAR 文件录制与编辑浏览器操作，结合 Python 脚本实现定时自动签到，支持邮件通知与数据库存储。提供 Web 管理界面与 Docker 部署方案，适用于各类周期性签到场景，如论坛、学习平台等。
items.e: Qiandao is an automated check-in framework based on HAR editor, enabling scheduled check-ins across multiple platforms. It records and edits browser actions via HAR files, executes tasks using Python scripts, and supports email notifications and database storage. Features include a web admin interface and Docker deployment, ideal for recurring check-in scenarios such as forums and learning platforms.

items.d: Trying to complete over 100 projects in various categories in golang.
items.z: 《Go实战开发》是一本通过100+实战项目系统学习Go语言的书籍，涵盖Web开发、网络编程、数据库操作等全场景。作者astaxie结合PHP开发经验，以项目驱动方式帮助开发者掌握Go核心特性与工程实践，配套开源代码与社区支持，适合中高级开发者进阶。
items.e: 《Go实战开发》 is a project-driven book teaching Go through 100+ practical projects across categories like web development and networking. Authored by astaxie, it leverages PHP experience to guide developers in mastering Go's core features and engineering practices, with open-source code and community support for advanced learning.

items.d: Auto-register & manage accounts for ChatGPT, Cursor, Kiro, Grok, Windsurf, Trae & 13+ AI platforms · Protocol/browser dual-mode · Plugin-based · One-click Mac/Windows desktop app
items.z: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动化注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Cursor、ChatGPT 等主流 AI 平台。采用 FastAPI + React 技术栈，具备插件化架构、邮箱服务集成（MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail）、验证码自动识别及代理池管理功能，提供 Web UI 实时管控并发注册任务。
items.e: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account automation registration and management system supporting AI platforms like Trae.ai, Cursor, and ChatGPT. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin architecture, integrated mailbox services (MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail), captcha solving, proxy pool management, and real-time SSE logging via web UI for concurrent task control.

items.d: Simple tagging for django
items.z: django-taggit 是一个为 Django 框架提供的简洁高效的标签管理库，支持通过 TaggableManager 轻松为模型添加标签功能，兼容 Django 3.2+，提供 API 操作、表单集成和后台管理支持，适用于内容分类与检索场景。
items.e: django-taggit is a simple and efficient tagging library for Django, enabling easy tag management via TaggableManager. It supports Django 3.2+, offers API-driven tag operations, form integration, and admin support, ideal for content categorization and retrieval.

items.z: 该项目曾用于将微信读书的划线和笔记自动同步至Notion，通过GitHub Action定时执行实现数据迁移。现已因接口限制失效，官方推荐使用Chrome插件替代。项目提供微信群、QQ群支持及捐赠渠道，作者持续维护多个类似自动化工具。
items.e: This project previously automated syncing WeChat Read highlights and notes to Notion via GitHub Actions. It is now deprecated due to API limitations, with a Chrome extension recommended as the current solution. The author maintains related automation tools and offers community support through WeChat/QQ groups.

items.d: Python 黑魔法手册
items.z: 《Python 黑魔法手册》是一本深入解析 Python 语言隐藏特性与进阶技巧的电子书，涵盖冷门语法、Shell 高级用法、代码炫技及底层机制解读，旨在帮助开发者突破常规认知，掌握高效、优雅的 Python 编程范式。
items.e: The 'Magic Python' handbook is an eBook exploring advanced and lesser-known Python features, including obscure syntax, shell tricks, code hacks, and deep technical insights, designed to help developers master elegant and efficient Python programming beyond basic tutorials.

items.d: Multi-Platform Live Stream Automatic Recording Tool | 多平台直播流自动录制客户端 · 基于FFmpeg · 支持监控/定时/转码
items.z: StreamCap 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的多平台直播流自动录制工具，支持 40+ 国内外主流直播平台（如抖音、B站、Twitch、TikTok），具备循环监控、定时录制、批量任务管理和自动转码功能，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/Web 全平台支持，适用于内容存档与直播数据分析。
items.e: StreamCap is a multi-platform live stream recording tool powered by FFmpeg and StreamGet, supporting 40+ global platforms (e.g., Douyin, Bilibili, Twitch, TikTok). It features real-time monitoring, scheduled recording, batch processing, and automatic transcoding, with full support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and web deployment for content archiving and live data analysis.

items.d: 发现导航，好用强大轻量级导航网站 Discover navigation, easy to use, powerful lightweight navigation website
items.z: 发现导航是一个纯静态、支持SEO的轻量级导航网站，内置800+优质网站资源。它无需数据库和服务器，支持在线编辑、AI翻译、书签导入导出、暗黑模式、多主题切换及响应式设计，提供后台管理及自动化部署功能，适用于个人或企业内网统一链接管理。
items.e: Discover Navigation is a pure static, SEO-friendly lightweight navigation website featuring over 800 curated sites. Built without databases or servers, it supports online editing, AI translation, bookmark import/export, dark mode, multi-theme switching, responsive design, admin panel, and automated deployment—ideal for personal or enterprise internal link management.

items.d: 一个基于✨HOOK机制的微信机器人，支持🌱安全新闻定时推送【FreeBuf，先知，安全客，奇安信攻防社区】，👯Kfc文案，⚡漏洞查询，⚡手机号归属地查询，⚡知识库查询，🎉星座查询，⚡天气查询，🌱摸鱼日历，⚡微步威胁情报查询， 🐛视频，⚡图片，👯帮助菜单。📫 支持积分功能，⚡支持自动拉人，，🌱自动群发，👯Ai回复（国内主流AI模型，扣子，FastGpt，Dify全面支持！），⚡视频号解析，😄自定义程度丰富，小白也可轻松上手！
items.z: NGCBot 是一款基于 HOOK 机制的微信机器人，集成安全资讯推送、AI 智能回复、漏洞查询、天气日历等丰富功能，支持主流 AI 平台，具备自动拉群、群发、视频解析等自动化能力，自定义程度高，适合安全从业者与社群运营。
items.e: NGCBot is a HOOK-based WeChat robot supporting security news push, AI replies, vulnerability queries, weather, calendar, and more. It integrates with major AI platforms, offers automation features like auto-invite and group messaging, and is highly customizable for non-technical users.

items.d: 翻译自Miguel Grinberg的blog https://blog.miguelgrinberg.com 的2017年新版The Flask Mega-Tutorial教程
items.z: 本仓库是 Miguel Grinberg 《The Flask Mega-Tutorial》2017年版的完整中文翻译，涵盖从基础到部署的全栈开发实践。通过23章系统讲解 Flask 框架核心功能，包括模板、表单、数据库、用户认证、Ajax、全文搜索、国际化及多平台部署（Linux/Heroku/Docker），适合中高级开发者构建复杂 Web 应用。
items.e: This repository contains the complete Chinese translation of Miguel Grinberg's 2017 'The Flask Mega-Tutorial', covering full-stack web development with Flask from basics to deployment. Spanning 23 chapters, it systematically teaches core Flask features including templating, forms, databases, authentication, Ajax, full-text search, internationalization, and multi-platform deployment (Linux/Heroku/Docker), ideal for intermediate to advanced developers building complex web applications.

items.d: 基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B等系列LLM的针对本地知识库的自动问答
items.z: 本项目基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B系列大模型，构建了一个针对本地知识库的自动问答Web应用。支持上传PDF、TXT、DOCX、MD等格式文档，结合多种Embedding模型实现语义检索，提供本地部署和云端体验，适用于私有知识问答、文档理解等场景。
items.e: This project builds a web-based QA system using LangChain and ChatGLM-6B series LLMs for local knowledge base queries. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

items.d: Django application and library for importing and exporting data with admin integration.
items.z: django-import-export 是一个专为 Django 应用设计的强大数据导入导出库，支持 CSV、Excel、JSON 等多种格式，提供 Admin 后台集成和编程接口。核心功能包括数据预览、批量导入、CRUD 操作控制、外键与多对多关系处理、数据验证及自定义转换，适用于需要高效处理大规模数据迁移或批量操作的 Web 应用。
items.e: django-import-export is a robust Django library for importing and exporting data across multiple formats (CSV, Excel, JSON, etc.). It offers seamless Admin UI integration and programmatic access, featuring data preview, bulk import, CRUD control, foreign key/many-to-many relation handling, validation, and custom transformations—ideal for data migration and batch operations in Django applications.

items.d: Free anti fingerprint browser, 指纹浏览器, 隐私浏览器, 防识别浏览器, 反识别浏览器, 防关联浏览器, 免费的web3空投专用指纹浏览器 https://virtualbrowser.cc/?src=github
items.z: VirtualBrowser 是一款基于 Chromium 的免费反指纹浏览器，支持多环境隔离与指纹定制，可修改操作系统、代理、语言、时区等数十项指纹特征，适用于 Web3 空投防关联场景。提供自动化接口，支持 Playwright 集成，具备跨平台扩展潜力。
items.e: VirtualBrowser is a free anti-fingerprint browser based on Chromium, enabling multi-environment isolation and customizable fingerprinting. It allows modification of OS, proxy, language, timezone, and over 15+ fingerprint attributes for Web3 airdrop protection. Supports automation via Playwright and offers cross-platform expansion plans.

items.d: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
items.z: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
items.e: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

items.d: 发现导航 , 好用强大轻量级导航网站 Discover navigation, easy to use, powerful lightweight navigation website
items.z: 发现导航是一个纯静态、支持SEO的轻量级导航网站，内置800+优质链接，具备AI翻译、书签导入导出、多主题切换、暗黑模式、响应式设计等强大功能，支持无服务器部署和在线管理，适用于个人或企业内网导航。
items.e: Discover Navigation is a pure static, SEO-friendly lightweight navigation site with 800+ curated links. It features AI translation, bookmark import/export, multi-theme support, dark mode, responsive design, and no-server deployment, suitable for personal or enterprise internal navigation.

items.d: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension that allows you to specify, plan, and implement software features.
items.z: Conductor 是 Gemini CLI 的扩展工具，通过上下文驱动开发（Context-Driven Development）实现软件功能的规范化生命周期管理。它支持在编码前制定详细规格与执行计划，确保代码质量与团队一致性，适用于新项目和现有项目的智能开发流程管控。
items.e: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

items.z: 该仓库原为 MusicFree 插件生态的集中管理平台，现已被清空。原功能可能涉及音乐流媒体平台的插件集成、扩展支持及开发者工具分发，服务于跨平台音乐播放场景。
items.e: This repository was originally a centralized hub for MusicFree plugins, now cleared. It likely managed plugin integration and distribution for music streaming platforms, supporting cross-platform playback extensions.

items.d: AList proxy server for TvBox, support playlist and search.
items.z: AList-TvBox 是一个专为 TvBox 设计的 AList 代理服务器，支持播放列表生成与内容搜索功能。通过集成 AList 的文件管理能力，为电视盒子提供结构化视频资源访问接口，适用于家庭媒体中心场景。
items.e: AList-TvBox is an AList proxy server tailored for TvBox, enabling playlist generation and content search. It leverages AList's file management to deliver structured video resources to TV boxes, ideal for home media center setups.

items.d: JSON Web Token Authentication support for Django REST Framework
items.z: 该项目为 Django REST Framework 提供 JSON Web Token (JWT) 身份验证支持，实现无状态用户认证。适用于需要安全、可扩展 API 的场景，如前后端分离应用。现已停止维护，建议使用官方或活跃替代方案。
items.e: This package adds JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication support for Django REST Framework, enabling stateless API security. Ideal for modern web applications requiring secure, scalable authentication. Note: Project is unmaintained; alternatives recommended.

items.d: gfw_whitelist
items.z: 该项目提供基于白名单的PAC代理配置方案，通过维护国内常用域名白名单，实现国内网站直连、境外网站走代理的科学上网模式。支持自动生成whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac三种格式的代理配置文件，兼容Chrome、Firefox等主流浏览器，支持SOCKS5/HTTPS等多种代理协议，并提供在线PAC生成服务。
items.e: This project provides a PAC proxy configuration solution based on whitelisting, allowing direct connection for domestic websites and proxy for international sites. It supports generating three types of proxy config files (whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac), compatible with major browsers, supporting multiple proxy protocols like SOCKS5/HTTPS, and offers online PAC generation service.

items.d: LiYing is an automated photo processing program designed for automating the post-processing workflow of ID photos in general photo studios. | LiYing 是一套适用于自动化 完成一般照相馆后期证件照处理流程的照片自动处理的程序。
items.z: LiYing 是一款专为照相馆设计的证件照自动化处理程序，支持人体与面部智能识别、角度自动校正、背景色更换、多尺寸裁切及排版。完全离线运行，所有图像处理均在本地完成，适用于单人标准肖像照的批量高效处理。
items.e: LiYing is an automated photo processing program tailored for photo studios, enabling intelligent human and face detection, automatic angle correction, background replacement, multi-size cropping, and layout. It runs entirely offline with all image processing performed locally, ideal for batch processing standard single-person ID photos.

items.d: 🌸Publish faster with an edge-native blog powered by Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2
items.z: Rin是一个基于Cloudflare全栈无服务器架构的现代博客平台，集成Pages、Workers、D1和R2服务。支持GitHub OAuth登录、富文本编辑、实时自动保存、私有文章控制、图片拖拽上传、自定义URL别名、友链检测、评论系统及Webhook通知等功能，实现零运维部署的个人博客解决方案。
items.e: Rin is a modern serverless blog platform built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform, integrating Pages, Workers, D1, and R2. It features GitHub OAuth authentication, rich text editing, real-time autosave, privacy controls, image management, custom slugs, unlisted posts, blogroll with link validation, comment system, and webhook notifications for a fully managed blogging experience.

items.d: Chrome extension to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
items.z: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
items.e: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

items.d: ✨ AsrTools: Smart Voice-to-Text Tool | Efficient Batch Processing | User-Friendly Interface | No GPU Required | Supports SRT/TXT Output | Turn your audio into accurate text in an instant!
items.z: AsrTools 是一款智能语音转文字工具，支持批量音频/视频文件处理，提供 SRT/TXT/字幕文件输出，具备高颜值 PyQt5 界面与多线程并发能力，无需 GPU 即可快速生成准确文本，适用于字幕制作与语音内容提取。
items.e: AsrTools is an intelligent voice-to-text tool that supports batch processing of audio and video files, generating SRT/TXT/subtitle outputs with a user-friendly PyQt5 interface. It uses multi-threading for fast conversion, requires no GPU, and enables instant text extraction from media files.

items.d: Experimental
items.z: Box 是一个实验性项目，核心功能为通过修改 App.java 配置文件调整应用默认设置，包括播放类型、解码方式、历史记录数量等参数。
items.e: Box is an experimental project focused on configuring default app settings via App.java, including playback type, decoding mode, DNS, and UI preferences.

items.d: Legacy code of V2EX running on Google App Engine
items.z: Project Babel 2 是基于 Python 和 Google App Engine 的开源社区建站系统，专为构建类似 V2EX 的分享与发现型社区设计。支持节点分类、多主题管理、响应式主题、WebDAV 头像托管、Atom 订阅、HTML5 兼容、MapReduce 数据优化及 Twitter OAuth 集成，具备高性能扩展能力，支持百万级日访问量。
items.e: Project Babel 2 is an open-source community platform built with Python on Google App Engine, designed for sharing and discovery communities like V2EX. It features node-based organization, responsive themes, WebDAV avatars, Atom feeds, HTML5 support, MapReduce data optimization, and Twitter OAuth integration, capable of scaling to millions of daily pageviews with proper configuration.

items.d: 中华人民共和国行政区划数据【省、市、区县、乡镇街道】中国省市区镇三级四级联动地址数据（GB/T 2260）
items.z: 提供中华人民共和国省、市、区县、乡镇街道四级完整行政区划数据，严格遵循GB/T 2260国家标准，数据权威且实时更新。支持三级联动选择、身份证号识别等实用功能，适用于地址选择、表单验证、地理信息系统等场景。
items.e: Comprehensive Chinese administrative division data covering provinces, cities, districts, counties, towns, and streets, adhering to the national standard GB/T 2260. Includes authoritative and regularly updated data from official sources, supporting three-level cascading selection, ID card validation, and integration with web components or jQuery plugins for address selection and geographic applications.

items.d: Material Design 中文协同翻译 - design.1sters.com
items.z: Material Design 中文协同翻译项目致力于将 Google 官方 Material Design 规范完整翻译为中文，覆盖动画、样式、布局等核心模块，采用 GitHub 协作模式，支持多人参与翻译与校对，最终生成网页和 PDF 文档，助力国内设计师与开发者掌握统一设计语言。
items.e: This project translates Google's Material Design specification into Chinese collaboratively, covering animation, style, layout, and more. It uses GitHub for open collaboration, enabling translators and reviewers to contribute, with final outputs published as web pages and PDFs to support designers and developers in adopting a unified design language.

items.d: Full featured redis cache backend for Django.
items.z: django-redis 是一个功能完整的 Redis 缓存和会话后端，专为 Django 设计。它支持原生 redis-py URL 连接字符串、可插拔客户端/解析器/序列化器，提供主从支持、无限超时、Unix 套接字连接及原始 Redis 客户端访问，适用于高并发生产环境。
items.e: django-redis is a full-featured, BSD-licensed Redis cache and session backend for Django. It supports native redis-py URL connections, pluggable clients/parsers/serializers, primary/secondary setups, infinite timeouts, Unix sockets, and raw Redis client access, making it ideal for production-scale Django applications.

items.d: A lightweight Python tool to clean AI refusal responses from Codex CLI session files
items.z: Codex Session Patcher 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，专用于清理 AI 编码工具（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、OpenCode）会话文件中的拒绝回复。它支持智能检测拒绝内容、AI 改写替换文本、批量清理及 CTF/渗透测试场景下的提示词注入，提供 Web UI 和 CLI 双模式操作，适用于安全测试与自动化开发场景。
items.e: Codex Session Patcher is a lightweight Python tool designed to clean refusal responses from AI coding tools like Codex CLI, Claude Code, and OpenCode. It features intelligent detection, AI-powered rewriting of rejections, batch processing, and CTF/pentest prompt injection via profiles or workspaces, with both CLI and Web UI support for secure testing workflows.

items.d: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
items.z: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
items.e: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

items.d: A smart, powerful, and beautiful excalidraw drawing tool.Draw Professional Charts with Natural Language
items.z: Smart Excalidraw 是一款基于自然语言的专业图表生成工具，集成 AI 大模型与 Excalidraw 画布，支持 20+ 种图表类型（如流程图、架构图、ER 图等），通过独创连接算法优化布局，用户仅需描述需求即可自动生成可编辑的专业级图表，支持本地部署与服务器端 LLM 配置，兼顾易用性与隐私安全。
items.e: Smart Excalidraw is an AI-powered diagramming tool that generates professional charts from natural language descriptions. It integrates with Excalidraw canvas, supports 20+ chart types (e.g., flowcharts, architecture diagrams, ER diagrams), uses an innovative connection algorithm for optimal layout, and allows users to edit AI-generated diagrams in real-time. Supports local deployment and server-side LLM configuration for enterprise use.

items.d: 浸入式学语言助手 (Immersive Language Learning Assistant)
items.z: 浸入式语言学习助手是一款基于‘可理解输入’理论的浏览器插件，通过智能翻译网页词汇并集成发音功能，实现自然语言习得。支持自动语言检测、AI选词、双语音频朗读及交互式提示，将整个互联网转化为个性化学习材料。
items.e: An immersive language learning browser extension based on 'comprehensible input' theory, intelligently translating selected words with pronunciation support. Features automatic language detection, AI-driven vocabulary selection, dual TTS, and interactive tooltips to turn the web into personalized learning content.

items.d: 做最好的接口管理平台
items.z: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
items.e: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

items.d: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
items.z: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
items.e: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

items.d: Some Chinese Android Developers Information, 微信公众号:codekk, 网站:
items.z: 该仓库整理了中国知名 Android 开发者信息，包含 GitHub 账号、博客链接及个人简介，涵盖源码分析、性能优化、动画开发、开源项目等多个方向，是中文 Android 开发者社区的重要资源集合。
items.e: This repository compiles information about prominent Chinese Android developers, including GitHub profiles, blog links, and professional introductions, covering areas such as source code analysis, performance optimization, animation development, and open-source projects, serving as a key resource for the Chinese Android developer community.

items.d: An unofficial 12306 Client for Mac
items.z: 12306ForMac 是一款非官方的 Mac 版 12306 火车票订票助手，支持自动捡票与下单功能。基于 Swift 开发，依赖 Carthage 管理 CocoaPods 依赖，兼容 OS X 10.11 及以上系统。项目采用 Alamofire、PromiseKit 等主流框架，提供图形化界面替代官方网页购票，适用于 macOS 用户便捷购票。
items.e: 12306ForMac is an unofficial macOS client for 12306 railway ticket booking, supporting auto-search and purchasing. Built with Swift 3.2 and Xcode 9.0, it uses Carthage for dependency management and integrates Alamofire, PromiseKit, and FMDB. Designed for OS X 10.11+, it offers a native GUI alternative to the official web interface for convenient ticket booking.

items.d: README file generator, powered by AI.
items.z: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
items.e: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

items.z: 基于 Auto.js 6 的蚂蚁森林能量自动收取脚本，支持自动收集好友能量、能量雨识别与点击、排行榜策略配置等功能，提供模块化扩展与配置工具，适用于 Android 设备自动化操作，显著提升蚂蚁森林能量获取效率。
items.e: An Auto.js 6-based script for automating energy collection in Ant Forest, featuring auto-collection of friend energy, rain energy detection, ranking strategies, and modular configuration tools to enhance efficiency on Android devices.

items.d: weui for react
items.z: React-WeUI 是基于 React 框架封装的 WeUI 组件库，提供与微信原生 UI 风格一致的移动端界面组件，支持 npm 安装与 CDN 引用，具备完善的文档与示例，适用于快速构建移动端 Web 应用。

It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

items.z: RAG Web UI 是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的智能对话系统，支持多格式文档管理与向量化处理，提供精准知识问答服务。系统具备前后端分离架构、分布式文件存储及高性能向量数据库（如 ChromaDB、Qdrant），支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek 及本地 Ollama 模型部署，适用于私有化部署与 API 集成场景。

It supports multi-format document ingestion, asynchronous processing, vectorization, and flexible LLM deployment (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), with a scalable backend architecture and OpenAPI for external access.

items.z: 本项目提供 DeepSeek-V3 和 R1 大模型的逆向 API 接口，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索及深度思考功能，兼容 ChatGPT 接口标准，支持零配置部署与多账号 token 负载均衡，仅限个人测试使用，商用请转官方平台。
items.e: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for DeepSeek-V3 and R1 models, featuring high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversations, web search, and deep reasoning. items.d: Social auth made simple

items.e: Python Social Auth is a simple social authentication/registration library supporting multiple frameworks and auth providers. Built on django-social-auth, it offers a unified interface to define third-party authentication providers and extend support for additional frameworks and ORMs. Deprecated since Dec 3, 2016, with code migrated to the python-social-auth organization.

items.d: markdown2: A fast and complete implementation of Markdown in Python
items.z: markdown2 是一个高性能、完整的 Python Markdown 解析器，严格遵循原始 Perl 实现的行为。支持丰富的扩展语法（如代码高亮、表格、脚注等），兼容 Python 3.5+，提供模块和命令行两种使用方式，适合快速将 Markdown 转换为结构化的 HTML。
items.e: markdown2 is a fast, complete Python implementation of Markdown that closely matches the original Perl version. It supports numerous extras like syntax highlighting, tables, and footnotes, works with Python 3.5+, and offers both module and CLI usage for converting Markdown to HTML.

items.e: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

items.e: Octopus is a personal LLM API aggregation service that unifies multiple provider channels with intelligent load balancing and protocol conversion. It supports multi-key management, automatic model/pricing sync, comprehensive analytics, and elegant UI, with multi-database support (SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL) for stable and efficient AI interface management.

items.d: Pic Smaller – Compress JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, SVG and GIF images intelligently
items.z: Pic Smaller 是一款智能在线图像压缩工具，支持 JPEG、PNG、WEBP、AVIF、SVG 和 GIF 格式。采用纯前端技术实现，无需服务器处理，确保数据安全。提供格式转换、色彩优化、压缩对比等高级功能，界面简洁，兼容桌面与移动端，适合快速压缩与编辑图像。
items.e: Pic Smaller is an intelligent online image compression tool supporting JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, SVG, and GIF formats. Built with pure frontend technologies like WebAssembly and Web Worker, it ensures complete privacy by processing images locally. Offers advanced features such as format conversion, color optimization, and side-by-side compression comparison, with a responsive UI for desktop and mobile.

items.d: Django social authentication made simple

items.e: Django Social Auth is a deprecated library enabling social login via OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID for Django projects. It supports 40+ providers including Google, Facebook, and Twitter, offering user registration, multi-account association, custom user models, and extensible authentication pipelines. Now superseded by python-social-auth.

items.e: brew-cask-upgrade is a CLI tool to upgrade outdated macOS GUI apps installed via Homebrew Cask. It offers interactive prompts, granular control, auto-update detection, batch upgrades, and features like cleanup and quarantine bypass, enhancing the efficiency of managing Homebrew Cask applications.

items.e: Django Material brings Google's Material Design 3 to Django with full-featured CRUD and admin interfaces. Built on TailwindCSS and django-cotton, it offers zero-build, responsive, accessible components powered by Unpoly.js for seamless navigation. Designed for AI-assisted development, it enables rapid, modern frontend development in Django without React, Vue, or Angular.

items.e: CallMe is a minimal plugin for Claude Code that enables phone calls to alert users when tasks are done, stuck, or require decisions. It supports multi-turn voice conversations via OpenAI's TTS/STT, works across smartphones and smartwatches, and uses ngrok for secure webhook tunneling.

items.d: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead

It provides persistent context, minimal token overhead, visible concurrency, and project-scoped runtime with built-in agent communication and delegation.

items.d: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
items.z: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
items.e: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

items.d: Pipelines: Versatile, UI-Agnostic OpenAI-Compatible Plugin Framework
items.z: Pipelines 是 Open WebUI 推出的开源插件框架，支持在任意兼容 OpenAI API 的 UI 客户端中运行自定义 Python 工作流。它允许开发者通过轻量代码扩展功能，如实现 RAG、消息监控、翻译过滤等复杂逻辑，适用于需要高性能计算或定制化 AI 流程的场景。
items.e: Pipelines is an open-source plugin framework by Open WebUI that enables modular, customizable workflows for any UI client supporting OpenAI API specs. It allows developers to extend functionality with custom Python logic—such as RAG, message monitoring, or translation filters—ideal for offloading heavy computations from main instances.

items.d: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.

items.e: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

items.d: Clamps an HTML element by adding ellipsis to it if the content inside is too long.
items.z: Clamp.js 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，用于在 HTML 元素内容过长时自动截断并添加省略号。支持单行、多行及基于高度的自适应截断，提供灵活的字符分割策略和原生 WebKit 支持，适用于响应式文本展示场景。
items.e: Clamp.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that truncates HTML element content with ellipsis when text overflows. It supports single/multi-line clamping, auto-sizing based on height, customizable truncation characters, and optional native WebKit -webkit-line-clamp support, ideal for responsive text display.

items.d: Magic auto brightness based on screen contents 💡
items.z: Lumen 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，能根据屏幕内容自动调节亮度。用户只需使用亮度键即可控制，系统会自动学习偏好。当屏幕显示深色内容（如终端）时自动调亮，显示浅色内容（如网页）时自动调暗，显著提升夜间使用舒适度，尤其适合长时间编程或阅读。
items.e: Lumen is a macOS menu bar app that automatically adjusts screen brightness based on displayed content. It learns user preferences via brightness keys, brightening the screen for dark content (e.g., terminal) and dimming it for light content (e.g., web pages), offering a more comfortable viewing experience, especially at night.

items.d: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead

items.e: Claude Code Bridge (ccb) enables real-time multi-AI collaboration via a split-pane terminal, supporting models like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context per AI instance, minimal token usage through lightweight prompts, and seamless integration with WezTerm or tmux. Every interaction is visible and controllable, eliminating single-model bias and context limits.

items.d: Django friendly finite state machine support

items.e: viewflow.fsm is a Django-friendly finite state machine library enabling declarative workflow modeling. It uses Python enums and Django enumeration types to define states and transitions, enforcing strict state control and database independence for building persistent business processes and automated workflows.

items.d: Cross domain local storage, with permissions

items.e: Cross-storage enables secure cross-domain localStorage sharing via a permission-controlled Hub-Client architecture. items.d: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
items.z: 本指南专为高权限自主AI代理OpenClaw设计，采用‘代理式零信任架构’范式，从传统静态防御转向动态防护。通过三层防御矩阵（事前行为黑名单、事中权限限制、事后夜间审计）有效应对提示注入、供应链投毒等AI特有风险，支持强推理模型自动部署，显著降低用户配置成本。
items.e: This guide is tailored for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional static defense to 'Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture'. It implements a battle-tested 3-Tier Defense Matrix—pre-action blacklists, in-action permission controls, and post-action nightly audits—to mitigate LLM-specific threats like prompt injection and supply chain poisoning. Designed for seamless integration with strong reasoning models to minimize manual security setup.

items.d: Awesome Django authorization, without the database

items.e: django-rules is a lightweight yet powerful Django authorization library enabling object-level permissions without requiring a database. Built on a rule-based system, it supports complex predicate logic, dynamic permissions, and seamless integration with Django views, templates, and Admin for efficient access control.
