items.d: One-Stop Retail Inventory Solution
items.z: IOE是一款基于Django开发的综合性零售库存管理系统，提供商品管理、库存跟踪、销售记录、会员管理和数据分析等全流程解决方案。系统支持实时库存预警、多支付方式收银、会员积分体系及可视化报表，具备Docker部署能力，适用于小型零售店和仓库场景。
items.e: IOE is a comprehensive retail inventory management system built with Django, offering full-cycle solutions for product management, stock tracking, sales recording, member management, and data analytics. It supports real-time inventory alerts, multi-payment checkout, member points system, and visual reports, with Docker deployment support for small retail stores and warehouses.

items.d: MCP server that provides tools and resources for interacting with n8n API
items.z: 该仓库提供了一个基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的服务器，使 AI 助手能够通过自然语言与 n8n 工作流自动化平台进行交互。核心功能包括通过 API 管理 n8n 工作流、触发执行、获取状态等，支持 Docker 部署和 npm 安装，适用于 AI 驱动的流程自动化场景。
items.e: This repository provides an MCP server enabling AI assistants to interact with n8n workflows via natural language. It allows programmatic management of n8n workflows and executions through its API, supporting deployment via npm or Docker. Key use cases include AI-driven workflow automation and integration.

items.d: AI 写作伙伴，点亮你的创作灵感
items.z: Arboris-Novel 是一款面向创作者的 AI 写作辅助工具，通过角色管理、大纲生成和智能续写功能帮助解决创作卡顿问题。支持多版本内容对比与个性化风格适配，旨在打造能理解角色、记忆世界设定的智能写作伙伴，提供 Docker 快速部署方案。
items.e: Arboris-Novel is an AI-powered writing assistant for creators, featuring character management, outline generation, and intelligent content continuation. It supports multi-version comparison and personalized style adaptation to create a smart writing companion that remembers your world and understands characters, with Docker-based deployment.

items.d: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme
items.z: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme 是一款基于 Flat-UI 设计风格的移动端主题，提供现代化扁平化界面，支持 jQuery Mobile 1.3.0 至 1.4 版本，通过 Stylus 和 Grunt 实现自定义配色与样式扩展，适用于快速构建美观的移动端 Web 应用。
items.e: jQuery Mobile Flat UI Theme is a modern, flat design theme for jQuery Mobile inspired by Flat-UI. It supports versions 1.3.0 to 1.4, allows custom swatches via Stylus and Grunt, and enables rapid development of visually appealing mobile web applications.

items.d: PuTTY 中文版，原 http://code.google.com/p/puttycn 项目。
items.z: PuTTY 是一款自由开源的跨平台 Telnet/SSH 客户端，支持 Win32 和 Unix 系统下的 xterm 终端模拟。中文版由 larryli 维护，提供本地化支持与文档翻译，适用于远程服务器管理与安全连接场景。
items.e: PuTTY is a free, open-source cross-platform Telnet/SSH client that emulates an xterm terminal on both Win32 and Unix systems. The Chinese version, maintained by larryli, offers localized documentation and support for remote server management and secure connections.

items.d: 搜索真实文献并生成引用对应文献的AI论文
items.z: paper-ai 是一个基于 AI 的论文写作工具，支持通过真实文献自动生成引用，集成 Semantic Scholar、arXiv 和 PubMed 进行文献检索，结合大模型生成高质量学术内容，显著提升论文撰写效率与引用准确性。
items.e: Paper-ai is an AI-powered academic writing tool that generates papers with real citations by searching Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and PubMed. It combines large language models with academic databases to streamline research and writing workflows.

items.d: Google Assistant for macOS!
items.z: MacAssistant 是一款将 Google Assistant 集成到 macOS 的 Swift 应用，支持语音交互与系统控制。通过 Google Assistant SDK 实现自然语言处理，支持天气查询、日程管理等常见指令，需用户自行配置 OAuth 凭证。项目采用 Swift 4.2 开发，基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers，提供跨平台语音助手解决方案。
items.e: MacAssistant is a Swift-based macOS app integrating Google Assistant via the Google Assistant SDK, enabling voice interaction and system control. It supports natural language queries like weather and agenda, requiring user-provided OAuth credentials. Built with Swift 4.2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers, it offers a cross-platform voice assistant solution for macOS.

items.d: Deploy your private Gemini application for free with one click, supporting Gemini 1.5, Gemini 2.0 models.
items.z: Gemini Next Chat 是一个开源的 Gemini AI 聊天框架，支持一键免费部署私有应用，兼容 Gemini 1.5/2.0 系列模型。基于 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 构建，提供 Web、桌面多端支持，具备函数调用扩展能力，适用于企业级私有化部署场景。
items.e: Gemini Next Chat is an open-source, extensible chatbot framework for Gemini AI models (1.5/2.0). Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it enables one-click free deployment of private web applications across Web, MacOS, Windows, and Linux platforms with function calling support.

items.d: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)
items.z: 基于 Golang 开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，支持 Docker 一键部署（镜像仅 2MB），提供每日 10 万次推送额度，支持原生弹窗与声音提醒，具备多用户管理、自定义跳转页面及无限换肤功能，适用于个人及小型项目消息通知场景。
items.e: A minimalist and free WeChat message push service built with Golang, supporting one-click Docker deployment (2MB image), 100K daily push quota, native pop-up and sound alerts, multi-user support, customizable redirect pages, and unlimited skin switching, ideal for personal and small-scale notification systems.

items.d: 🐒一些修改自网络的油猴脚本 Some Tampermonkey scripts modified from the internet
items.z: 该仓库提供一系列基于油猴脚本（Tampermonkey）的自动化工具，多数脚本改编自网络资源，涵盖网页功能增强、界面优化及实用小工具。所有脚本均托管于GreasyFork平台，支持多语言版本，具备高安装量和良好用户评价，适用于提升日常浏览与操作效率。
items.e: This repository hosts a collection of Tampermonkey user scripts, mostly modified from online sources, designed to enhance web functionality, optimize interfaces, and provide utility tools. Hosted on GreasyFork with multi-language support, these scripts boast high installation counts and positive user ratings, ideal for improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

items.d: A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. It doesn't need any kind of modification on your side, just add it to the installed apps.
items.z: django-admin-bootstrapped 是一个为 Django 管理后台提供 Twitter Bootstrap 主题的插件，无需修改现有代码即可集成。它支持 Bootstrap 3 样式渲染、可拖拽排序内联表单、自定义 HTML 注入及 XHTML 兼容，显著提升管理界面的视觉体验与交互性。
items.e: django-admin-bootstrapped is a Django admin theme powered by Twitter Bootstrap, requiring no code changes—just add it to INSTALLED_APPS. It offers Bootstrap 3 styling, drag-and-drop sortable inlines, custom HTML injection, XHTML compatibility, and enhanced message alerts for a modern admin interface.

items.d: Modern mouse gestures for Windows. (C#)
items.z: WGestures 是一款现代化的 Windows 全局鼠标手势工具，支持 Win7/8/10，提供直观的手势操作以提升效率。采用 C# 开发，集成数字签名与安装程序，适用于快速执行系统命令或应用操作。
items.e: WGestures is a modern global mouse gesture tool for Windows (Win7/8/10), enabling efficient navigation via intuitive gestures. Built in C# with digital signing and MSI installer support, it streamlines workflow automation through customizable gesture actions.

items.d: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
items.z: 该仓库是一个多服务注册与API密钥管理工具，专注于自动化注册并验证Tavily、Firecrawl和Exa的API密钥。通过真实浏览器模拟注册流程、集成Turnstile验证码破解、自动收取邮箱验证码，并对获取的密钥进行实际调用验证，确保可用性。支持跨平台运行，可选将密钥上传至统一代理池，专为MySearch-Proxy等聚合搜索网关提供稳定可靠的密钥上游来源。
items.e: This repository provides a multi-service toolkit for automating registration and validation of API keys from Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It simulates real browser signups, integrates Turnstile solver, auto-collects email verification codes, and validates keys via live API calls to ensure functionality. Cross-platform compatible, with optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for aggregation search gateways like MySearch-Proxy.

items.d: Responsive Image Maps jQuery Plugin
items.z: jQuery RWD Image Maps 是一个响应式图像地图插件，通过动态重计算坐标，使 HTML 图像映射在窗口缩放或图像尺寸变化时保持精准定位，适用于响应式网页设计中的交互式图像区域。
items.e: jQuery RWD Image Maps is a responsive image maps plugin that recalculates area coordinates dynamically to maintain accurate clickable regions when images resize, ideal for interactive responsive web designs using HTML image maps.

items.d: Flarum - 优雅自由的 PHP 轻社区
items.z: Flarum 是一款基于 PHP 和 Mithril 框架的自由开源轻量级论坛软件，以简洁、响应式设计和高度可扩展性为核心特色。它提供完整的 API 支持与模块化扩展机制，适合快速搭建现代化社区平台，采用 MIT 许可证确保完全开放。
items.e: Flarum is a free, open-source forum software built with PHP and the Mithril JavaScript framework, emphasizing simplicity, responsiveness, and extensibility. It offers a modular architecture with comprehensive APIs for customization, ideal for building modern online communities under MIT license.

items.d: TVBox自用接口
items.z: TVBox自用接口集合，提供多地域GitHub RAW加速服务与EPG电子节目指南源，支持直播源搜索及短链生成工具，适用于个人电视盒子流媒体播放场景，强调隐私与自用属性。
items.e: A personal-use TVBox interface repository offering multi-region GitHub RAW acceleration, EPG sources for electronic program guides, live stream search tools, and URL shortening services, designed for private streaming on media boxes without public promotion.

items.d: Old Celery integration project for Django
items.z: django-celery 是 Celery 与 Django 的集成项目，专为 Celery v3.x 至 v4.x 设计，提供基于 Django ORM 和缓存的结果存储、任务模块自动发现及后台管理功能。现已停止维护，推荐使用新版 Celery 教程替代。
items.e: django-celery is a legacy integration project for Celery with Django, supporting Celery v3.x to v4.x only. It enables Django ORM-based result storage, automatic task discovery, and admin integration. The project is no longer actively maintained; users are advised to follow the updated Celery Django tutorial.

items.d: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework
items.z: DRF-extensions 是 Django REST Framework 的扩展集合，提供 DetailSerializerMixin、缓存、条件请求、嵌套路由和批量操作等核心功能，支持多版本 Django 和 DRF，文档完善，适合企业级 API 开发。
items.e: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework, offering features like DetailSerializerMixin, caching, conditional requests, nested routes, and bulk operations. It supports multiple Django and DRF versions with comprehensive documentation, ideal for enterprise-grade API development.

items.d: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
items.z: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
items.e: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

items.d: 中华人民共和国国家标准 GB/T 2260 行政区划代码
items.z: GB/T 2260 是中国行政区划代码国家标准，提供县及县级以上行政区划的完整编码数据，支持多语言实现（Python、JavaScript、Ruby、Java、PHP、Go、Elixir、Swift、C#），可用于构建地理信息系统、地址解析、数据统计等应用，数据权威且持续更新。
items.e: GB/T 2260 is the Chinese national standard for administrative division codes, providing complete coding data for counties and above-level administrative regions. It supports multi-language implementations (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Java, PHP, Go, Elixir, Swift, C#) and is ideal for GIS, address parsing, and data analysis applications with authoritative and regularly updated sources.

items.d: Obsidian Plugin to execute code in a note.
items.z: Obsidian Execute Code 插件支持在笔记中直接运行代码块，提供一键执行、交互式输入和结果展示功能。目前已支持 Python、R、Octave 等 30+ 种编程语言，并支持魔法命令、全局代码注入及持久化输出（实验性）。适用于数据科学、教学演示和自动化脚本场景。
items.e: The Obsidian Execute Code plugin enables direct execution of code blocks within notes, featuring one-click run buttons, interactive input prompts, and real-time output display. It supports over 30 languages including Python, R, and Octave, with magic commands, global code injections, and experimental persistent output for PDF export. Ideal for data science, teaching, and scripting workflows.

items.d: 这是一个基于Claude Skill的**AI人像Prompt生成系统**，能够从特征库中智能组合生成高质量的人像描述Prompt，并具备自动学习和库扩展能力。 核心能力: Prompt生成、特征提取、自动学习、智能审核、版本控制
items.z: 基于Claude Skills的AI人像Prompt生成系统，集成12个专业领域Skills与1246+元素库，支持Portrait/Cross-Domain/Design三种智能生成模式。具备语义理解、跨域组合、变量采样等核心能力，提供自动学习、智能审核和版本控制功能，实现从特征提取到高质量提示词生成的全流程自动化。
items.e: An AI-powered prompt generation system based on Claude Skills, integrating 12 domain-specific skills with a 1,246+ element library. Supports three intelligent modes: Portrait, Cross-Domain, and Design. Features semantic understanding, cross-domain composition, variable sampling, automatic learning, intelligent review, and version control for end-to-end automated prompt generation.

items.d: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
items.z: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。它支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），并提供字幕导航、多播放模式（快进/跳过无字幕片段）、自动暂停等功能，帮助用户高效创建多媒体闪卡并优化语言学习体验。
items.e: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled content. It enables loading selectable subtitles from streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports subtitle navigation, playback modes (e.g., condensed/fast-forward), and integrates with tools like Yomitan for word styling and annotation to enhance vocabulary acquisition.

items.d: A Python library that provides an easy way to identify devices like mobile phones, tablets and their capabilities by parsing (browser) user agent strings.
items.z: user_agents 是一个 Python 库，用于解析浏览器 User-Agent 字符串，精准识别设备类型（手机、平板、PC）及其功能特性（如触屏能力），支持主流移动平台与爬虫检测，依赖 ua-parser 实现高效解析。
items.e: user_agents is a Python library that parses browser User-Agent strings to accurately identify device types (mobile, tablet, PC) and capabilities (e.g., touch support), supporting major platforms and bot detection via the ua-parser engine.

items.d: A beautiful component library based on vue3
items.z: Lew UI 是一个基于 Vue3 的美观组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和开箱即用的样式。它集成了 Tippy.js、Lucide 图标、VueUse 等优质开源库，支持虚拟列表、表单验证等高级功能，文档完善，易于集成，适合快速构建现代化 Web 应用。
items.e: Lew UI is a beautiful Vue3-based component library offering a rich set of UI components with out-of-the-box styling. It integrates high-quality open-source libraries like Tippy.js, Lucide icons, and VueUse, supporting advanced features such as virtual lists and form validation. With comprehensive documentation and easy integration, it's ideal for rapidly building modern web applications.

items.d: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
items.z: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
items.e: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

items.d: [IJCAI 2024] Generate different roles for GPTs to form a collaborative entity for complex tasks.
items.z: 生成失败
items.e: Generation failed

items.d: [IJCAI 2024] Generate different roles for GPTs to form a collaborative entity for complex tasks.
items.z: AutoAgents 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动智能体生成框架，支持为复杂任务自动生成多角色协作的智能体团队。该框架包含规划器、观察者、工具调用和专家智能体等模块，通过反思机制优化执行流程，已成功应用于谣言验证、贪吃蛇游戏等场景，相关论文已被 IJCAI 2024 接收。
items.e: AutoAgents is an open-source framework for automatically generating collaborative multi-agent systems based on LLMs to tackle complex tasks. It features a planner, observers, tools, and dynamically generated expert agents with reflection mechanisms. Applications include rumor verification and game automation. The associated paper was accepted at IJCAI 2024.

items.d: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
items.z: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
items.e: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

items.d: Snip Anything Solve Everything​
items.z: Snippai 是一款基于先进 AI 算法的智能截图工具，支持公式识别（转 LaTeX）、文本提取、表格转 Markdown、图像分析、代码理解、颜色检测和多语言翻译等功能，显著提升截图处理效率与智能化水平。
items.e: Snippai is an AI-powered intelligent snipping tool that leverages advanced algorithms to recognize formulas (LaTeX conversion), extract text, convert tables to Markdown, analyze images, understand code, detect colors, and translate text in any language—enhancing productivity through smart screenshot processing.

items.d: quick-cocos2d-x is a quick framework, based on cocos2d-x. Make mobile games in Lua.
items.z: quick-cocos2d-x 是触控科技基于 cocos2d-x 开发的 Lua 脚本扩展框架，专为移动端游戏快速开发设计。它提供完整的 Lua 脚本支持、高级 UI 库、代码加密与自动更新功能，显著降低开发成本并提升效率，适用于高品质手游产品的敏捷开发。
items.e: Quick-Cocos2d-x is a Lua-based extension framework built on cocos2d-x by Touch Technology, designed for rapid mobile game development. It offers full Lua scripting support, advanced UI libraries, code encryption, and auto-update features, significantly reducing development costs and accelerating time-to-market for high-quality mobile games.

items.d: 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。  ⬇️⬇️ WebRPA技术交流群 ⬇️⬇️
items.z: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
items.e: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

items.d: DCloud开源项目集锦
items.z: DCloud开源项目合集，涵盖uni-app、uni-app x、uniCloud、UTS等全栈开发框架的示例工程，提供uni-ai x全平台AI聊天套件及uVue语法测试项目，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用与云端一体化解决方案。
items.e: DCloud's open-source project collection featuring example projects for uni-app, uni-app x, uniCloud, UTS, and more, including the open-source cross-platform AI chat suite uni-ai-x and uVue syntax test project, enabling rapid development of mobile and cloud-integrated applications.

items.d: Django-ERP是一款基于Django开发的ERP管理软件，包含常用的销售管理、采购管理、库存管理、组织管理等，支持按项目归集费用，支持工作流审批，支持采购单、报价单的批量导入。
items.z: Django-ERP是基于Django框架开发的开源企业资源管理系统，涵盖销售、采购、库存及组织管理模块，支持项目费用归集、工作流审批及单据批量导入，适用于中小企业内部管理需求。
items.e: Django-ERP is an open-source ERP management system built on Django, featuring modules for sales, procurement, inventory, and organizational management. It supports project-based cost allocation, workflow approvals, and bulk import of purchase orders and quotations, ideal for SMEs seeking streamlined internal operations.

items.d: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
items.z: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作辅助系统，通过双 Agent 架构和六维审查机制解决 AI 写作中的遗忘与幻觉问题，支持 200 万字级连载创作，集成 RAG 检索、创意约束系统和追读力机制，确保叙事连贯性与读者粘性。
items.e: A long-form webnovel writing assistant built on Claude Code, utilizing dual-agent architecture and six-dimensional review mechanisms to address AI writing issues like forgetting and hallucination, supporting serialized creation up to 2 million words with RAG retrieval, creative constraint systems, and reader engagement mechanics.

items.d: :books: 一起写Python文章，一起看Python文章 - 利用readthedocs的Python技术文章的收集和翻译。
items.z: PyZh 是一个基于 ReadTheDocs 的 Python 技术文章翻译与收集项目，致力于汇聚优质英文技术文档并提供中文翻译。项目采用 RST 格式编写，支持多语言协作，提供 RSS 订阅和在线浏览功能，鼓励社区共同参与内容创作与翻译。
items.e: PyZh is a Python technology article translation and collection project built on ReadTheDocs, aiming to aggregate high-quality English technical articles with Chinese translations. It uses RST format, supports collaborative writing, offers RSS subscription and online reading, and encourages community contributions.

items.d: Browser action engine for AI agents. 10× faster, resilient by design.
items.z: Actionbook 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的浏览器操作引擎，提供实时更新的网页操作手册和 DOM 结构信息，使智能体能快速、精准地执行网页交互任务。相比传统方法，其性能提升 10 倍，显著降低 LLM 的 token 消耗，并通过语义化 JSON 定义实现高容错性和跨框架兼容性。
items.e: Actionbook is a browser action engine designed for AI agents, delivering up-to-date action manuals and DOM structure so agents can instantly operate any website without guessing. It enables 10x faster execution, 100x token savings, resilient automation via versioned manuals, and universal compatibility with any LLM or agent framework.

items.d: 🚀 一键部署个人的 ChatGPT 镜像站
items.z: ChatGPT Mirror 是一个个人 ChatGPT 镜像站，支持多账号共享管理，提供与官网一致的完整功能体验。通过录入 ChatGPT Token 实现团队协作访问，内置 API 接口（/v1/chat/completions）兼容主流客户端，无需翻墙即可使用。支持 Docker 一键部署，含管理后台和临时聊天模式，现已停止维护并推荐迁移至 Grok Mirror。
items.e: ChatGPT Mirror is a personal ChatGPT mirror site enabling multi-account sharing and management for team collaboration. It delivers full-featured access identical to the official site, with built-in API (/v1/chat/completions) compatible with clients like ChatGPT-Next-Web. No VPN required; supports Docker one-click deployment, admin panel, and ephemeral chat modes. Discontinued; users advised to migrate to Grok Mirror.

items.d: Agent-native AI assistant — chat, write, whiteboard, learning, all in one.
items.z: YOLO 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的智能 AI 助手插件，支持 Agent 模式、多窗口对话和知识库问答。通过工具调用与自定义技能实现自动化操作，结合 RAG 技术将整个知识库作为上下文，提供多语言、多模型支持的流畅写作与任务处理体验。
items.e: YOLO is an intelligent, multilingual AI assistant plugin for Obsidian, featuring Agent mode with tool calling and custom skills, multi-window chat, RAG-powered knowledge base Q&A, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other mainstream LLMs.

items.d: :books:Java核心知识点整理（包括Java基础、JVM、数据库、计算机网络、算法、操作系统、设计模式、系统设计、框架原理）
items.z: 本仓库系统整理 Java 核心技术知识体系，涵盖 Java 基础、JVM、并发编程、容器类、数据库（MySQL、Redis）、计算机网络、算法（数据结构、LeetCode、海量数据处理）、操作系统（Linux）、设计模式及主流框架原理（Spring、MyBatis、Dubbo、Netty、Kafka、Zookeeper、Nginx、Tomcat）。内容结构清晰，适合 Java 开发者系统学习与面试准备。
items.e: This repository systematically organizes core Java knowledge, covering Java fundamentals, JVM, concurrency, collections, databases (MySQL, Redis), computer networks, algorithms (data structures, LeetCode, big data), operating systems (Linux), design patterns, and framework principles (Spring, MyBatis, Dubbo, Netty, Kafka, Zookeeper, Nginx, Tomcat). It provides structured learning materials ideal for Java developers and interview preparation.

items.d: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap.
items.z: Bootstrap Colorpicker 是一个专为 Bootstrap 4 设计的模块化颜色选择插件，支持 jQuery 和 Bootstrap CSS/JS。它提供灵活的颜色选择功能，兼容 v2.x（Bootstrap 3/4）和 v3.x（Bootstrap 4 或无 Bootstrap）版本，适用于网页颜色输入场景。
items.e: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap 4, built with jQuery and optional Bootstrap CSS/JS. It supports v2.x (Bootstrap 3/4) and v3.x (Bootstrap 4 or standalone), offering flexible color selection for web applications. Available via npm, yarn, or direct download.

items.d: 📕 小红书创作者MCP工具包 - 支持与AI客户端集成的内容创作和发布工具
items.z: 小红书创作者MCP工具包是一个专为AI客户端（如Claude Desktop）设计的自动化内容创作与发布工具，支持图文/视频笔记自动发布、定时数据采集及创作者数据分析，提供Cookie管理、远程浏览器连接和CSV本地存储功能，实现LLM驱动的小红书运营全流程自动化。
items.e: The Xiaohongshu Creator MCP Toolkit is an AI-integrated automation tool for content creation and publishing, supporting image/video note posting, scheduled data collection, and creator analytics. It features cookie management, remote browser connectivity, and CSV storage, enabling full LLM-driven Xiaohongshu operations via MCP protocol integration.

items.d: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
items.z: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
items.e: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

items.d: Obfuscate all your TCP connections into HTTP protocol.
items.z: FakeHTTP 是一款基于 Netfilter Queue 的 TCP 连接混淆工具，可将任意 TCP 流量伪装成 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，有效绕过网络审查与深度包检测。支持自定义接口、目标主机、TTL 跳数及防火墙规则配置，适用于高级网络隐蔽通信场景。
items.e: FakeHTTP is a TCP connection obfuscation tool that disguises all TCP traffic as HTTP/HTTPS protocols using Netfilter Queue. It enables stealthy network communication by bypassing deep packet inspection and censorship, with support for custom interfaces, hostnames, TTL manipulation, and firewall rule integration.

items.d: A Django app that keeps a log of changes made to an object.
items.z: django-auditlog 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于自动记录模型对象的所有变更，包括操作用户、变更摘要及详细 JSON 数据，支持灵活查询与审计追踪，适用于需要完整操作日志的场景。
items.e: django-auditlog is a lightweight Django app that automatically logs all changes to model objects, capturing the actor, change summary, and detailed JSON data for flexible auditing and traceability.

items.d: 微信公众平台 Python 开发包 [DEPRECATED]
items.z: wechat-python-sdk 是一个已停止维护的微信公众平台 Python 开发包，支持订阅号和服务号官方接口，提供消息处理、加解密、模板消息等功能。该 SDK 设计为轻量级，便于集成到各类 Web 框架中，不处理 HTTP 请求响应，仅封装微信 API 操作并返回合规响应数据。
items.e: wechat-python-sdk was a deprecated Python SDK for WeChat Official Accounts (subscription/service accounts), offering message handling, encryption/decryption, template messages, and menu management. It focused on simplifying WeChat API integration by returning compliant response data without handling HTTP layers, designed for easy integration into web frameworks.

items.d: 如果有人让你推荐 Python 技术书，请让他看这个列表
items.z: 本项目为 Python 开发者精心整理的权威技术书籍推荐列表，涵盖入门到进阶全阶段，包含《Head First Python》《集体智慧编程》《利用 Python 进行数据分析》等经典著作，结合社区投票与豆瓣评分，提供高质量学习资源导航。
items.e: This repo curates a comprehensive list of authoritative Python technical books from beginner to advanced levels, featuring classics like 'Head First Python', 'Programming Collective Intelligence', and 'Python for Data Analysis', backed by community votes and Douban ratings for reliable learning guidance.

items.d: Three.js 系列教程，学习和探索 Three.js 世界。
items.z: Three.js 系列教程，系统讲解 WebGL 3D 图形开发技术，涵盖场景构建、坐标系（左手/右手）、球极坐标、BufferGeometry 等核心概念。作者结合官方文档与实战经验，提供学习路径，并分享向 Three.js 官方提交 PR 的贡献经历，强调持续跟进版本更新重要性。
items.e: A comprehensive Three.js tutorial series covering core concepts like 3D scene creation, coordinate systems (left/right-handed), spherical coordinates, and BufferGeometry. The author shares learning insights, official documentation usage tips, and contributions to the Three.js GitHub repo, emphasizing staying updated with version changes.

items.d: Desktop Agent for Any Task
items.z: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
items.e: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

items.d: A JQuery validation framework for bootstrap forms.
items.z: jqBootstrapValidation 是一个专为 Bootstrap 表单设计的 jQuery 验证框架，支持实时输入验证并在 help-block 元素中显示错误提示，提升表单交互体验。
items.e: jqBootstrapValidation is a jQuery validation framework designed for Bootstrap forms, providing real-time input validation and displaying error messages in help-block elements to enhance form user experience.

items.d: OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini Business with multi-account load balancing and multimodal capabilities (image/video generation, file parsing) | 将 Gemini Business 转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡及多模态能力（图像生成、视频生成、解析文件）
items.z: Gemini Business2API 将 Gemini Business 转换为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡、自动化注册登录、多模态文件解析（100+格式）、图像/视频生成及流式输出。提供 Docker 部署、管理面板和 PostgreSQL/SQLite 存储，适用于个人技术研究与非商业场景。
items.e: Gemini Business2API converts Gemini Business into an OpenAI-compatible API with multi-account load balancing, automated account management, multimodal file parsing (100+ formats), image/video generation, and streaming responses. Features Docker deployment, admin panel, and PostgreSQL/SQLite persistence for non-commercial research use.

items.d: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
items.z: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
items.e: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

items.d: Tiny JS library using bootstrap's popovers to help guide your users around your website
items.z: Bootstro.js 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，利用 Bootstrap 的弹出框（popover）功能，为网站提供用户引导功能。支持 Bootstrap 2 和 3，无需修改代码即可适配，仅需一行变更即可从 Bootstrap 2 升级。支持通过 JS 变量或 AJAX 动态加载引导数据，避免污染 HTML，提升可维护性。
items.e: Bootstro.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that leverages Bootstrap's popover functionality to guide users through a website. It supports both Bootstrap 2 and 3 with minimal code changes. It enables dynamic slideshow creation via JavaScript variables or AJAX, avoiding HTML pollution and improving maintainability.

items.d: 自部署的摄影作品网站，支持多种功能特性。PicImpact，分享你和世界！
items.z: PicImpact 是一个基于 Next.js + Hono.js 的自部署摄影作品展示网站，支持瀑布流相册、WebGL 高性能图片查看器（含实况照片与分块加载）、地图标记、EXIF 信息展示、双因素认证、Passkey 无密码登录及多存储后端兼容。具备响应式设计、暗黑模式、RSS 订阅与自动化上传功能，适合个人或团队搭建专业图库平台。
items.e: PicImpact is a self-deployable photography portfolio built with Next.js and Hono.js, featuring a masonry gallery, WebGL-powered image viewer (with Live Photos support), EXIF-based geotagging, TOTP/Passkey authentication, multi-storage backend compatibility, RSS feeds, and responsive design. Ideal for creators to showcase high-resolution images with performance optimization.

items.d: Power Keys - 解放 Windows 和 macOS 使用效率
items.z: Power Keys 是一款专为 Windows 和 macOS 设计的效率工具，通过精心设计的无冲突快捷键组合，显著提升系统操作效率。其核心价值在于统一跨平台快捷键逻辑，降低学习成本，适用于日常办公、开发及多任务处理场景。
items.e: Power Keys is an efficiency tool for Windows and macOS that boosts productivity through well-designed, non-conflicting keyboard shortcuts. It unifies cross-platform shortcut logic, reducing learning curves for developers and power users in daily workflows and multitasking.

items.d: WebSockets for Django
items.z: django-socketio 是一个 BSD 许可的 Django 应用，通过集成 gevent-socketio 实现 WebSocket 支持，提供频道订阅、事件广播和信号式事件系统，支持实时通信与自动重载服务器，适用于需要实时交互的 Django 项目。
items.e: django-socketio is a BSD-licensed Django application that enables WebSocket support via gevent-socketio, offering channel-based subscriptions, event broadcasting, and a signals-like event system for real-time communication in Django projects.

items.d: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
items.z: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
items.e: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

items.d: Simple prebuilt applications.
items.z: Django Basic Apps 是一组预构建的 Django 应用集合，提供博客、媒体内嵌等基础功能模块。支持通过模板标记语法 `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` 实现内容内嵌，需依赖 Django Comments、Tagging、Markdown 等第三方库。
items.e: Django Basic Apps is a collection of prebuilt Django applications offering core features like blogging and content inlining. It supports embedding objects via template markup `<inline type="app.model" id="1"/>` and requires dependencies such as Django Comments, Tagging, and Markdown libraries.

items.z: LunaTV Enhanced Edition 是基于 MoonTV 深度二次开发的全功能影视聚合播放平台，集成 YouTube、网盘搜索、AI推荐、短剧、IPTV直播、Bangumi动漫等60+重大功能增强。采用 Next.js + React + TypeScript 技术栈，支持 Docker 部署，具备弹幕系统、播放统计、Emby私有库集成、超宽显示器适配等特性，提供极致在线观影体验。
items.e: LunaTV Enhanced Edition is a comprehensive media aggregation platform based on MoonTV with 60+ major feature enhancements including YouTube integration, cloud drive search, AI recommendations, short dramas, IPTV streaming, and Bangumi anime. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, featuring Docker deployment, danmaku system, playback statistics, Emby private library integration, and ultra-wide display support for an ultimate online viewing experience.

items.d: A news-reading App (MVP+Dagger2+RxJava+Retrofit2+Material Design)
items.z: ColorfulNews 是一款基于 MVP 架构的新闻阅读应用，采用 Material Design 风格，集成 Dagger2、RxJava 和 Retrofit2 实现高效的数据绑定与网络请求。支持多频道浏览、图片新闻展示及流畅交互体验，适用于 Android 平台学习与实践。
items.e: ColorfulNews is a news-reading app built with MVP architecture and Material Design, utilizing Dagger2, RxJava, and Retrofit2 for robust dependency injection, reactive programming, and network communication. It supports multi-channel browsing, image news display, and smooth user interactions, ideal for Android development learning.

items.d: V2EX 撕逼大战
items.z: 该仓库专门收集 V2EX 社区及类似平台上的公开争议事件，涵盖技术争论、价值观冲突、商业纠纷等多元议题，通过存档原始帖子与补充背景资料，系统记录中国互联网技术圈内的公共舆论交锋与社区生态变迁。
items.e: This repository archives public disputes from V2EX and related platforms, covering technical debates, value conflicts, and business controversies. It systematically documents public discourse and community evolution in China's tech ecosystem through original posts and contextual materials.

items.d: elasticsearch 权威指南
items.z: 《Elasticsearch 权威指南》中文版项目，由译者 Gavin Foo 翻译自 Clinton Gormley 和 Zachary Tong 的原作，涵盖 Elasticsearch 的核心概念、全文搜索、结构化查询、数据分析、地理定位、自动补全等高级功能，并提供生产环境配置与监控实践，适合开发者与数据工程师系统学习 Elasticsearch。
items.e: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide' by Gavin Foo, based on the original work by Clinton Gormley and Zachary Tong. This project covers core concepts, full-text search, structured queries, analytics, geolocation, autocomplete, and production deployment of Elasticsearch, serving as a comprehensive resource for developers and data engineers.

items.d: ❤️‍🔥 A chrome extension as an alternative to Notion AI that goes beyond Notion AI. | 一个替代 Notion AI 的浏览器插件，不止于 Notion AI
items.z: Writely 是一款基于 OpenAI GPT 模型的浏览器插件，旨在替代 Notion AI。它支持在任意网页编辑器中提供智能写作辅助、邮件撰写、文章创作及社交媒体互动等功能，显著提升用户的内容创作效率与质量，实现跨平台的智能文本处理体验。
items.e: Writely is a browser extension powered by OpenAI's GPT model, designed as an alternative to Notion AI. It enables intelligent writing assistance across any webpage editor, supporting email composition, article drafting, and social media interactions, thereby enhancing content creation efficiency and quality with cross-platform accessibility.

items.d: Diycode每日文章精选
items.z: Diycode每日精选是一个技术文章聚合项目，专注于每日精选高质量技术文章并附带点评，覆盖Android开发、React Native、性能优化、架构设计等领域，内容由社区维护并归档，旨在为开发者提供有价值的知识分享与学习资源。
items.e: Diycode Daily Selection is a curated tech article aggregation project that collects and reviews high-quality technical articles daily, covering Android development, React Native, performance optimization, and architecture. Maintained by the community, it archives content for developers to access valuable knowledge and learning resources.

items.d: pip install python-office 自动化办公专用库
items.z: python-office 是一个专为自动化办公设计的 Python 第三方库，支持一键安装所有功能模块。用户仅需一行代码即可实现微信机器人、PDF处理、邮件发送、Excel/Word/PowerPoint 操作、OCR 识别、AI 工具调用等办公场景需求，无需掌握 Python 编程即可快速上手，显著提升办公效率。
items.e: python-office is a Python third-party library designed for office automation, enabling one-line code solutions for tasks like WeChat bots, PDF processing, email sending, Excel/Word/PowerPoint operations, OCR, and AI tools. It requires no Python knowledge, supports modular imports, and significantly boosts productivity with zero learning curve.

items.d: Hexo theme, Blog theme, Clean, Responsive theme
items.z: Hexo主题diaspora是一款简洁清新的响应式博客主题，支持Ajax加载、音乐播放、分类标签页和本地搜索功能，适合摄影、影评、乐评等文艺类博客，提供丰富的自定义配置选项。
items.e: Hexo-theme-diaspora is a clean, responsive blog theme featuring Ajax loading, music playback, category/tag pages, and local search. Ideal for photography, film, and music reviews, it offers extensive customization via configuration options.

items.d: 把灵感、写作、出图、改稿、沉淀放进同一个工作台，让创作从“想到”直接走到“可发布”
items.z: ProxyCast 是一个面向创作者的 AI Agent 平台，整合灵感发散、内容生成、素材制作与版本沉淀全流程，支持社媒、短视频、小说、海报等九大创作主题，实现从想法到可发布内容的一站式高效创作。
items.e: ProxyCast is an AI Agent platform for creators, integrating ideation, content generation, asset creation, and versioning into a unified workspace. It supports nine major creative domains—from social media to novels—enabling seamless workflows from concept to publishable output.

items.d: ChatGPT Team 账号自动轮转管理 - Codex 额度监控、自动换号、邮箱注册、CPA/Sub2API 认证同步
items.z: AutoTeam 是一款 ChatGPT Team 账号自动化管理工具，支持自动注册、Codex OAuth 认证、额度监控与智能轮转。通过 Playwright 实现浏览器自动化，集成 FastAPI 提供 HTTP 接口和 Vue 3 管理面板，可同步 CPA 认证文件并定时巡检，确保团队账号高效稳定运行。
items.e: AutoTeam is an automated management tool for ChatGPT Team accounts, featuring auto-registration, Codex OAuth authentication, quota monitoring, and intelligent rotation. Built with Playwright for browser automation, it provides a FastAPI backend and Vue 3 dashboard, syncing CPA auth files and enabling scheduled health checks to maintain optimal account performance.

items.d: A drop-in replacement for Django's runserver.
items.z: django-devserver 是 Django runserver 的即用型替代方案，提供实时 SQL 日志、Werkzeug 调试器集成、多进程/线程支持及内存分析等功能，显著提升开发调试效率。
items.e: django-devserver is a drop-in replacement for Django's runserver, offering real-time SQL logging, Werkzeug debugger integration, multi-process/threaded modes, and memory profiling to enhance development debugging.

items.d: Bringing together outstanding artificial intelligence (AI) open source projects from around the world.
items.z: AI Resource Central 是一个汇聚全球优秀人工智能开源项目的综合性平台，涵盖智能体、模型训练、多模态处理等核心领域。项目分类清晰，包含 AutoGPT、MetaGPT、CrewAI 等主流框架，支持开发者快速获取前沿技术资源，推动 AI 应用落地与技术创新。
items.e: AI Resource Central is a comprehensive platform aggregating top-tier global AI open-source projects, covering key domains like agents, model training, and multimodal processing. It features curated frameworks such as AutoGPT, MetaGPT, and CrewAI, enabling developers to rapidly access cutting-edge resources and accelerate AI innovation.

items.d: Accounts for Django made beautifully simple
items.z: Django Userena 是一个为 Django 项目提供完整账户管理的开源应用，涵盖用户注册、激活、消息通知等功能，采用 BSD 许可可免费商用。其核心优势在于高度可定制性与开箱即用的用户体验，显著简化 Django 用户认证系统的开发流程。
items.e: Django Userena is an open-source Django application that provides complete account management including signup, activation, and messaging. It features full customization, BSD licensing for free commercial use, and streamlines user authentication development with a polished, production-ready interface.

items.d: 腾讯会议摸鱼工具
items.z: TMSpeech 是一款 Windows 平台的实时语音转文字工具，基于 sherpa-onnx 框架实现中文会议语音识别，支持 WASAPI 内录、实时字幕显示与历史记录保存。具备低 CPU 占用（<5%）、无边框可拖动界面、自定义外部识别器集成等功能，适用于会议转录、走神备忘等场景。
items.e: TMSpeech is a Windows-based real-time speech-to-text tool using the sherpa-onnx framework for Chinese meeting transcription. It captures system audio via WASAPI, displays live subtitles like lyrics, and saves recognition history. Features include low CPU usage (<5%), draggable UI, and support for custom external recognizers, ideal for meetings and note-taking.

items.z: Awesome AI GPTs 是一个精选的 OpenAI GPTs 资源库，涵盖提示词工程、内容创作、编程辅助、数据分析等场景。项目提供热门 GPTs 推荐、插件安装指南、知识库构建工具及安全防护方案，助力用户高效利用 AI 能力。
items.e: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

items.d: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
items.z: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），提供可导航的字幕列表、多种播放模式（如跳过无字幕片段、自动暂停）以及高质量多媒体闪卡生成功能，显著提升语言学习效率。
items.e: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled videos. It enables loading selectable subtitles onto streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports navigable subtitle lists, condensed playback modes, and multimedia flashcard creation to optimize vocabulary acquisition.

items.d: [NeurIPS 2024] DreamClear: High-Capacity Real-World Image Restoration with Privacy-Safe Dataset Curation
items.z: DreamClear 是 NeurIPS 2024 论文提出的高容量真实世界图像修复系统，通过隐私安全的语料库构建技术，实现高质量图像恢复。其核心创新在于结合 PixArt-α 生成模型与多模态对齐能力，支持文本引导修复，并在 RealLQ250 基准测试中表现优异，适用于摄影、遥感等真实场景。
items.e: DreamClear, presented at NeurIPS 2024, is a high-capacity real-world image restoration framework featuring privacy-safe dataset curation. It leverages the PixArt-α generative model with multimodal alignment for text-guided restoration, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the RealLQ250 benchmark across diverse real-world scenarios including photography and remote sensing.

items.d: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
items.z: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
items.e: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

items.d: Material Design 中文版 ( 2015 年 8 月更新)
items.z: Material Design 中文版是 Google 官方设计规范的首个完整中文翻译项目，由 1sters 团队联合极客学院于 2015 年 8 月完成全面更新。该项目系统性地将 Material Design 核心理念、组件规范与交互原则转化为高质量中文文档，覆盖 60+ 章节，极大推动了中国开发者对现代移动 UI 设计的理解与实践。
items.e: Material Design 中文版 is the first complete Chinese translation of Google's official design specification, collaboratively completed by the 1sters team and Geekbang Academy in August 2015. This project systematically translates core concepts, component specifications, and interaction principles of Material Design into high-quality documentation, covering over 60 chapters, significantly advancing the understanding and practice of modern mobile UI design among Chinese developers.

items.d: 基于官方OpenWebUI，汉化界面提高中文使用体验，增加了模型计费和用量统计
items.z: HaloWebUI 是基于 Open WebUI 深度定制的中文 AI 自托管平台，集成 Claude/Gemini/xAI 等多模型路由与知识检索增强功能。提供原生中文界面、模型计费统计及 HaloClaw 消息网关，支持 Docker 一键部署与全链路可控的对话管理。
items.e: HaloWebUI is a Chinese-localized self-hosted AI platform built on Open WebUI, featuring multi-model routing (Claude/Gemini/xAI), knowledge retrieval enhancement, and cost tracking. It includes native Chinese UI, HaloClaw message gateway, and Docker deployment support for full conversational control.

items.d: 一款白噪音应用送给你，祝您牛掰，有的是钱
items.z: XMSLEEP 是一款专注于白噪音播放的 Android 应用，提供雨声、篝火、雷声等多种自然声音，支持音量调节、倒计时、预设播放区域及收藏功能。采用 Material Design 3 和 Jetpack Compose 构建，具备深色模式、动态主题色、无缝循环播放及蓝牙耳机支持，界面简洁流畅，适用于放松、专注和助眠场景。
items.e: XMSLEEP is an Android app focused on white noise playback, offering natural sounds like rain, fire, thunder, and bird chirps. It supports volume control, countdown timer, preset playlists, favorites, and seamless looping. Built with Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3, it features dark mode, dynamic theming, Coil image loading, and Bluetooth headset support for immersive relaxation, focus, and sleep aid.

items.d: Cache-based rate-limiting for Django
items.z: Django Ratelimit 是一个基于缓存的 Django 速率限制中间件，通过装饰器为视图提供灵活的限流功能，支持基于 IP 地址或请求参数（GET/POST）进行访问控制，适用于防止滥用和保障 API 安全。
items.e: Django Ratelimit is a cache-based rate-limiting library for Django that uses decorators to limit view access, configurable by IP address or request parameters (GET/POST), ideal for preventing abuse and securing APIs.

items.d: vue2.0-tutorial
items.z: 本仓库是一个基于 Vue 2.0 的单页应用教程，使用 vue-cli、vue-router、vuex 和 vue-resource 构建完整前端架构，结合 webpack 实现热加载与组件化开发，并集成 Bootstrap UI 框架，适合学习现代 Vue.js 项目工程化实践。
items.e: This repository is a Vue 2.0 tutorial for building a single-page application using vue-cli, vue-router, vuex, and vue-resource. It demonstrates project scaffolding, component-based development, hot-reload via webpack, and integration with Bootstrap, serving as a practical guide for modern Vue.js engineering practices.

items.d: Gemini Nexus 是一款面向浏览器场景的 AI 助手扩展，集成 Gemini Web、Gemini API 与 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持网页上下文、图像处理、工具调用和 MCP 浏览器控制。
items.z: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理及浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，实现网页交互的智能化增强。支持多驱动 API（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容）、上下文管理、历史消息编辑及基于 DevTools Protocol 的自动化操作，为浏览器内 AI 工作流提供原生级体验。
items.e: Gemini Nexus is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini, featuring an injected floating toolbar, image AI processing, and browser control via MCP. It supports multiple API drivers (Web Client/Official/OpenAI Compatible), context management, message history editing, and automation through Chrome DevTools Protocol for native AI-enhanced browsing workflows.

items.d: css files created from pygment's built-in styles
items.z: 该项目提供由 Pygments 内置样式生成的预编译 CSS 文件，用于代码高亮显示，避免用户手动生成。支持一键重新生成所有样式文件，简化了代码语法高亮在网页中的集成流程。
items.e: This repository provides pre-generated CSS files from Pygments' built-in styles for code syntax highlighting, eliminating the need for manual generation. It allows easy regeneration of all styles using the current Pygments version via a simple make command.

items.d: 一款基于 AI 技术的 Web 应用程序，可将文本内容智能转换为 Mermaid 格式的代码，并将其渲染成可视化图表。
items.z: Smart Mermaid 是一款基于 AI 的 Web 应用，可将自然语言文本智能转换为 Mermaid 图表代码并实时渲染。支持流程图、序列图等多种图表类型，提供标准 SVG 与手绘风格双渲染器，具备 AI 代码修复、优化及文件导入功能，适合快速生成可视化图表。
items.e: Smart Mermaid is an AI-powered web app that converts natural language text into Mermaid diagram code and renders it visually. It supports multiple chart types, dual rendering modes (SVG and hand-drawn), AI-assisted code fixing/optimization, and file import, enabling efficient text-to-diagram conversion for technical documentation and planning.

items.d: Claude Code 中文开发套件 - 为中国开发者定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境。一键安装完整中文化体验，集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描，支持免翻墙访问。让 AI 编程更简单。
items.z: Claude Code 中文开发套件是为中国开发者量身定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境，提供一键安装的全中文化体验。集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描等核心功能，支持免翻墙访问。最新版本融合 Anthropic 黑客松冠军配置，包含 9 个专用智能体、7+ 技能模块、10 个快捷指令和完整规则体系，实现从需求分析到代码审查的全流程 AI 驱动开发。
items.e: Claude Code Chinese Development Kit is a zero-threshold AI programming environment tailored for Chinese developers, offering one-click installation with full Chinese localization. It integrates MCP servers, intelligent context management, security scanning, and supports direct access without VPN. The latest version incorporates the Anthropic Hackathon-winning configuration, featuring 9 specialized agents, 7+ skill modules, 10 slash commands, and a complete rule system for end-to-end AI-driven development workflows.

items.d: Surge模块 脚本 module sgmodule 面板 规则 分流 破解 解锁
items.z: 该仓库提供 Surge 模块脚本集合，涵盖去广告、应用解锁、会员功能激活等实用功能，支持哔哩哔哩高清、彩云天气 SVIP、扫描全能王会员等多种主流 App，适用于 iOS 平台网络流量管理与自动化增强。
items.e: This repository offers a collection of Surge modules for ad removal, app unlocking, and premium feature activation, supporting popular apps like Bilibili HD, Caiyun Weather SVIP, and CamScanner. Designed for iOS network traffic management and automation enhancement.

items.d: Convert HTML to a multi-thousand-page vector PDF with a single line of frontend code
items.z: dompdf.js 是一个前端库，可将 HTML 转换为多页矢量 PDF，支持分页和数千页文档生成。基于 html2canvas 和 jspdf 改造，直接在浏览器中生成可编辑、非图像式的 PDF，具备高质量输出、小文件体积、无需服务端渲染等优势，适用于网页内容导出和打印场景。
items.e: dompdf.js is a frontend library that converts HTML into multi-thousand-page vector PDFs with a single line of code. Built on html2canvas and jspdf, it generates editable, non-image PDFs directly in the browser, offering high quality, small file size, and no server-side rendering. Ideal for web content export and printing.

items.d: A simple android app to enable Google Location Report, Google Now and related functions in China mainland or somewhere like.
items.z: LocationReportEnabler 是一款专为中国大陆用户设计的 Android 应用，通过修改系统参数启用 Google 位置报告、Google Now 及相关功能。支持 ROOT 和 Xposed 框架两种模式，后者更稳定。核心功能包括设置运营商代码和 ISO 国家代码，以绕过地理限制，恢复 Google 服务的时间线功能。
items.e: LocationReportEnabler is a simple Android app designed to enable Google Location Report, Google Now, and related features in mainland China. It works by setting system properties like gsm.sim.operator.numeric and iso-country to bypass regional restrictions. Available in ROOT and Xposed variants, with the latter recommended for better stability and clarity.

It supports configuration via environment variables (APP ID, API Key, URL), offers Docker deployment, multi-language support, and customizable prompts, enabling rapid development of enterprise-grade AI chat interfaces.

items.d: :no_entry: currently unmaintained :no_entry: A minimal JS library for showing & hiding things

items.e: Wallop is a minimal 4kb JavaScript library for showing and hiding elements, designed with mobile-first, progressive enhancement, and CSS-based animations. It dynamically adds classes to control visibility, supports multiple animation modifiers (e.g., slide, fade), and offers a flexible API with custom events for use in sliders, tabs, and more.

items.e: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

items.e: Personal technical blog covering core computer science topics including algorithms, data structures, distributed systems (MIT 6.824 course notes), Go/PHP programming, Pulsar MQ, and custom library design docs, serving as a comprehensive knowledge repository.

items.d: A JavaScript library to display Photo Sphere panoramas.
items.z: Photo Sphere Viewer 是一个基于 Three.js 的 JavaScript 库，用于在网页上展示 360×180 度全景图。支持 equirectangular 投影格式，兼容 Android 4.2+ 拍摄的照片球，提供丰富的交互控制与自定义选项，适用于虚拟旅游、房地产展示等场景。
items.e: Photo Sphere Viewer is a JavaScript library built on Three.js for displaying 360×180 degree panoramas on web pages. It supports equirectangular projection, integrates with Android Photo Sphere, and offers extensive customization and interaction features for immersive experiences.

items.d: 非付费会员，fofa数据采集工具
items.z: Fofa-hack 是一个面向非付费用户的 FOFA 数据采集工具，用于绕过平台对爬虫的严格限制。项目已停止更新，但可作为开发 FOFA 爬虫工具的参考案例，支持通过第三方打码库和内置代理池等技术手段实现数据抓取，适合安全研究人员进行资产测绘与信息收集。
items.e: Fofa-hack is a data collection tool for non-paying FOFA users, designed to bypass increasingly strict anti-crawling restrictions. The project is no longer maintained but serves as a reference for developing FOFA crawlers, utilizing third-party CAPTCHA-solving libraries and built-in proxy pools to extract network asset information, primarily used by security researchers for reconnaissance.

items.d: 一个基于Python和Flask的Web应用，整合了多维度股票分析能力和人工智能辅助决策功能。系统通过AKShare获取股票数据，结合技术分析、基本面分析和资金面分析，为投资者提供全方位的投资决策支持。
items.z: 基于Python/Flask和LangGraph的智能股票分析系统，整合AKShare多源数据与13个专业AI Agent（技术、基本面、资金流、情绪等），提供100分制综合评分及情景预测。支持联网搜索问答、Human-in-the-Loop风险审批、MCP工具接口，具备财经门户式可视化界面与实时全球市场监控。
items.e: An AI-powered stock analysis web application built with Python/Flask and LangGraph, integrating multi-source data via AKShare and 13 specialized AI agents (technical, fundamental, capital flow, sentiment). Features 100-point scoring, scenario forecasting, web-searchable Q&A, human-in-the-loop risk approval, MCP tool server, and real-time global market monitoring with a financial portal-style interface.

items.d: tvbox 影视tv 宝盒 接口
items.z: 该仓库提供多个TVBox影视接口配置，包括自用、Panda Groove、多线路及香雅情等源，支持阿里Token推送功能，适用于电视盒子应用。所有接口均通过镜像加速访问，内容涵盖主流影视资源聚合，便于用户快速部署个性化影视播放平台。
items.e: This repository offers multiple TVBox streaming interfaces, including self-hosted, Panda Groove, multi-line, and Xiangyaqing sources, with support for Aliyun Token push. It is designed for TV box applications, providing mirrored access to mainstream video aggregation services for quick deployment of custom streaming platforms.

items.d: 自动视频生成器，给定主题，自动生成解说视频。用户输入主题文字，系统调用大语言模型生成故事或解说的文字，然后进一步调用语音合成接口生成解说的语音，调用文生图接口生成契合文字内容的配图，最后融合语音和配图生成解说视频。
items.z: 自动视频生成器通过大语言模型生成解说文本，调用语音合成与文生图接口生成音视频素材，最终合成主题解说视频。支持PPT/PDF输入、免费资源校对、千帆ERNIE模型及百度千帆平台集成，提供Gradio交互界面与完整工作流。
items.e: Auto Video Generator creates explanatory videos by generating text via LLMs, synthesizing speech, producing images via text-to-image models, and combining them into final videos. It supports PPT/PDF input, free resource checking, integrates with Baidu Qianfan's ERNIE models, and offers a Gradio-based interactive interface with full workflow automation.

items.d: 小视频宝：AI 驱动的视频生成工具，一键生成高质量营销视频 AI-powered video generation tool for creating high-quality marketing videos with one click.
items.z: ClipTurbo 是一款 AI 驱动的短视频生成工具，专为营销视频创作设计。利用 AI 处理文案、翻译、图标匹配及 TTS 语音合成，结合 manim 渲染引擎输出高质量视频，有效规避平台限流风险。支持多分辨率、自定义字体与背景音乐，提供 Windows 客户端及即将上线的 Web 版本，助力用户快速变现短视频内容。
items.e: ClipTurbo is an AI-powered video generation tool focused on creating high-quality marketing videos. It leverages AI for script processing, translation, icon matching, and TTS synthesis, rendering videos via manim to avoid platform restrictions. Features include customizable resolution, fonts, and background music, with a Windows client and upcoming web version, enabling rapid monetization of short-form video content.

items.d: 此项目已停止维护，建议迁移到  https://github.com/museui/muse-ui/
items.z: vue-carbon 是基于 Vue.js 1.0 开发的 Material Design 风格移动端 Web UI 库，提供丰富的组件如 Refresh Control、HeaderBar 等，支持 npm 安装与 webpack 集成，现已停止维护，推荐迁移至 Muse UI。
items.e: Vue-carbon is a Material Design style mobile web UI library built with Vue.js 1.0, featuring components like Refresh Control and HeaderBar. It supports npm installation and webpack integration but is no longer maintained; migration to Muse UI is recommended.

items.d: A jQuery tag/token input plugin for Twitter's Bootstrap, by the guys from Sliptree
items.z: Bootstrap Tokenfield 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签输入插件，支持键盘操作、复制粘贴、自动补全集成等功能。虽然项目已停止维护，但仍可用于需要轻量级标签输入的场景，尤其适合与 Bootstrap 3+ 和 jQuery 1.9+ 配合使用。
items.e: Bootstrap Tokenfield is a jQuery plugin for tag/token input built on Twitter Bootstrap, supporting keyboard navigation, copy-paste, and integration with autocomplete/typeahead. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for lightweight tagging in Bootstrap 3+ environments with jQuery 1.9+.

items.d: Free claude-sonnet-4.6  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 不支持 tools / function calling / MCP
items.z: Cursor2API 是一个将 Cursor Web 转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API 的高性能服务，支持 Claude Sonnet 4.6 模型，提供完全兼容 OpenAI API 格式的接口，具备低延迟响应、安全认证、流式/非流式输出及完善的错误处理机制，可通过 Docker、系统服务或本地编译部署。
items.e: Cursor2API is a high-performance service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI-compatible API, supporting Claude Sonnet 4.6. It offers full OpenAI API compatibility with low-latency responses, secure authentication, streaming/non-streaming support, and robust error handling, deployable via Docker, systemd, or local compilation.

items.d: 一个基于AI的学生错题本
items.z: 智能错题本系统基于AI技术，支持多科目错题管理、自动解析与知识点标签生成，集成Google Gemini/OpenAI/Azure OpenAI等主流大模型，提供筛选、导出、相似题练习及学习数据可视化功能，支持PWA原生应用体验与Docker一键部署。
items.e: A comprehensive AI-powered wrong-answer notebook system that supports multi-subject error management, automatic problem analysis, and knowledge tagging. Integrates Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Azure OpenAI APIs for intelligent features like filtering, export, similar question generation, and learning analytics. Offers PWA support and Docker deployment.

items.d: dead simple crontab powered job scheduling for django.
items.z: django-crontab 是一个为 Django 项目提供极简 Cron 任务调度的工具，支持通过 Python 方法或 Django 管理命令定义定时任务，自动同步到系统 crontab，并提供添加、查看和移除任务的管理命令，适用于 1.8-2.0 版本的 Django 项目。
items.e: django-crontab is a dead-simple tool for Django that enables cron-powered job scheduling via Python methods or management commands. It automatically syncs CRONJOBS to the system crontab and provides commands to add, show, and remove tasks, supporting Django 1.8-2.0.

items.d: 让 QwenLM 物尽其用
items.z: Qwen-Proxy 是一个将通义千问官方平台（chat.qwen.ai、Qwen Code/CLI）转换为 OpenAI API 兼容接口的代理服务，支持多账户轮询、流式响应、多模态及256K长上下文。通过统一API格式，用户可无缝对接各类OpenAI客户端调用通义千问模型，并提供Web管理界面与代理池集成方案应对高并发限速问题。
items.e: Qwen-Proxy is a proxy service that converts QwenLM's official platforms (chat.qwen.ai, Qwen Code/CLI) into OpenAI-compatible APIs. It supports multi-account polling, streaming responses, multimodal capabilities, and 256K context via CLI endpoints. Seamlessly integrates with OpenAI clients while offering a web admin interface and proxy pool integration for high-concurrency scenarios.

items.d: Create beautiful SVG guitar chord charts
items.z: SVGuitar 是一个基于 JavaScript/TypeScript 的 SVG 吉他和弦图生成库，支持在浏览器中直接渲染美观的和弦图表。它提供高度可定制的配置选项，包括手指位置、横按标记、标题样式等，适用于音乐教育、乐谱制作等场景，并可通过 npm 安装集成到项目中。
items.e: SVGuitar is a JavaScript/TypeScript library that generates beautiful SVG guitar chord charts directly in the browser. It offers highly customizable configurations for finger positions, barre chords, titles, and more, making it ideal for music education and sheet music creation. It can be installed via npm or used as a UMD script.

items.d: 支持 AnyRouter、AgentRouter 的多平台多账号签到，理论兼容所有基于 NewAPI、OneAPI 的平台。
items.z: AnyRouter 多账号自动签到工具，支持 AnyRouter 和 AgentRouter 平台，兼容 NewAPI/OneAPI 架构。通过 GitHub Actions 实现定时自动签到，支持多账号并行处理、WAF 绕过及机器人通知，配置灵活且维护良好。
items.e: A multi-account auto check-in tool for AnyRouter and AgentRouter platforms, compatible with NewAPI/OneAPI architectures. Uses GitHub Actions for scheduled automation, supports parallel account processing, WAF bypass, and notification alerts with flexible configuration.

items.d: Bootstrap alert system made better, builds off of bootstrap-alert.js
items.z: bootstrap-notify 是对 Bootstrap 原生警告系统的增强扩展，基于 bootstrap-alert.js 构建，提供更丰富的通知样式与交互能力，适用于现代 Web 应用中的用户提示与消息展示。
items.e: Bootstrap Notify enhances the native Bootstrap alert system by building on bootstrap-alert.js, offering improved notification styles and interactions for modern web applications.

items.d: Useful GPT Prompts
items.z: 该仓库收集并整理了实用的 GPT 提示词，涵盖 Midjourney 等 AI 工具的生成模板，旨在提升用户与 AI 交互的效率和创意表达，适用于内容创作、设计辅助等场景。
items.e: This repository curates useful GPT prompts, starting with a Midjourney Prompt Generator, designed to enhance AI interaction efficiency and creative output for content creation and design assistance.

items.d: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
items.z: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
items.e: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

items.d: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
items.z: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
items.e: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

items.d: 基于chatgpt-next-web，增加了midjourney绘画功能，支持mj-plus的ai换脸和局部重绘，接入了stable-diffusion，支持oss，支持接入fastgpt知识库，支持suno，支持luma。支持dall-e-3、gpt-4-vision-preview、whisper、tts等多模态模型，支持gpt-4-all，支持GPTs商店。新增加了支持后台管理的版本，包括登录注册，平台模型apikey管理，套餐管理，消息保存等。
items.z: ChatGPT-Next-Web-Pro 是基于 ChatGPT-Next-Web 的深度增强版本，集成多模态 AI 能力，支持 MidJourney 绘画、Stable Diffusion、DALL-E-3、Suno 音乐生成、Luma 视频创作及 GPTs 商店，同时提供无后台轻量版与带用户管理、API 密钥管控、套餐订阅的有后台企业版，覆盖绘图、语音、文件解析等全场景 AI 应用。
items.e: ChatGPT-Next-Web-Pro is an enhanced fork of ChatGPT-Next-Web, integrating multimodal AI capabilities including MidJourney painting, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E-3, Suno music generation, Luma video creation, and GPTs Store. It offers both a lightweight 'no-backend' version and a full-featured 'with-backend' enterprise edition with user management, API key control, subscription plans, and support for file parsing, OCR, TTS, and cloud storage.

items.d: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-iOS
items.z: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 Shadowsocks 的下一代 macOS 客户端，提供高性能代理功能，支持 SSR 协议，适用于科学上网与隐私保护。项目因监管要求已停止维护，原代码存档于 shadowsocksr-backup 仓库。
items.e: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, offering high-performance proxy capabilities with SSR protocol support for secure browsing and privacy protection. The project has been discontinued due to regulatory reasons, with archived code in the shadowsocksr-backup repository.

items.d: 强大的ai小说创作网站
items.z: Ai-Novel 是一个功能强大的 AI 小说创作平台，支持多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），提供流式写作、知识库管理、RAG 检索、图谱分析等核心能力。采用 React + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker Compose 一键部署，具备项目管理、角色设定、大纲生成、批量任务及导出等功能，适用于专业作家与内容创作者。
items.e: Ai-Novel is a powerful AI-powered novel writing platform supporting multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) with features like streaming generation, knowledge base management, RAG retrieval, and graph analysis. Built on React + FastAPI, it offers project management, character development, outline generation, batch tasks, and export capabilities via Docker Compose deployment.

items.d: 专为tmailor调教，古法永动机版本！（支持duck/33mail/tmailor）
items.z: Infinitoai 是一款基于 Chrome Side Panel 的自动化扩展，专为 OpenAI OAuth 注册/登录流程设计。支持 Duck、33mail、TMailor 多邮箱源及 QQ/163/Inbucket 等验证码收件通道，具备完整工作流编排、自动重试、失败统计与人工接管能力，适用于批量验证与自动化测试场景。
items.e: Infinitoai is a Chrome Side Panel extension automating OpenAI OAuth registration/login workflows. It supports multiple email sources (Duck, 33mail, TMailor) and verification channels (QQ/163/Inbucket), featuring full workflow orchestration, auto-retry, failure tracking, and manual intervention capabilities for batch validation and testing.

items.d: Team IDE 集成MySql、Oracle、金仓、达梦、神通等数据库、SSH、FTP、Redis、Zookeeper、Kafka、Elasticsearch、Mongodb、小工具等管理工具
items.z: Team IDE 是一款集成多种数据库（MySQL、Oracle、金仓等）、中间件（Redis、Kafka、Elasticsearch等）及开发工具的跨平台IDE。支持SSH终端、数据库可视化操作、SQL执行、Thrift服务测试、JSON/YAML转换等，提供终端透传、SSH隧道、节点管理等高级功能，支持单机和服务器部署。
items.e: Team IDE is a cross-platform integrated development environment featuring support for multiple databases (MySQL, Oracle, Kingbase, etc.), middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch), and development tools. It offers SSH terminal, database visualization, SQL execution, Thrift service testing, and JSON/YAML conversion, with advanced features like terminal passthrough, SSH tunneling, and node management. Supports both standalone and server deployment modes.

items.d: A diffusion model to colorize black and white images
items.z: 该项目利用扩散模型对黑白图像进行自动着色，采用LAB颜色空间分离亮度与色彩通道，仅对色彩通道添加噪声并预测去噪结果。模型基于UNet架构，结合灰度图像特征进行条件控制，实现端到端的图像着色。项目展示了从噪声生成彩色图像的过程，适用于历史影像修复、老照片上色等场景。
items.e: This project implements a diffusion model for automatic colorization of black-and-white images using the LAB color space, where only the color channels are noised and predicted. The UNet-based model conditions on grayscale features and predicts denoised color channels, enabling end-to-end image colorization. It's suitable for restoring historical photos and enhancing old images.

items.d: A webServer convert web and x5 movie sites to cms api data
items.z: dr_py 是一个将主流影视网站（含x5内核站点）转换为 CMS API 数据源的 Python 服务器，专为 TV Box 和 Pluto 等应用设计。它基于 dr 模板重构，提供标准化接口，支持多平台部署与自动嗅探，适用于无需编程知识的内容聚合场景。
items.e: dr_py is a Python-based web server that converts web and x5 movie sites into CMS-compatible API data, tailored for TV Box and Pluto apps. It reimplements the dr template with standardized interfaces, supports cross-platform deployment, and enables automatic content sniffing without requiring Java knowledge.

The platform integrates intelligent optimization algorithms, deep reasoning analysis, visualization debugging tools, and community sharing features, providing compre
items.z: AI Prompt Optimization Platform 是一个专业的提示词工程工具，集成智能优化算法与深度推理分析，提供可视化调试、模板管理与社区共享功能，显著提升 AI 交互效果与响应准确性。
items.e: AI Prompt Optimization Platform is a professional prompt engineering tool that integrates intelligent optimization algorithms, deep reasoning analysis, visualization debugging, and community sharing features to enhance AI interaction effectiveness and response accuracy.

items.d: 🖌 docsify cli tool - A magical documentation generator.
items.z: docsify-cli 是一个强大的文档生成工具，提供快速初始化、本地服务器和实时重载功能，支持自定义主题与插件，适用于快速搭建现代化文档站点。
items.e: docsify-cli is a powerful documentation generator that offers quick initialization, local server with live reload, and support for custom themes and plugins, ideal for rapidly building modern documentation sites.

items.d: 🦄 The world's largest Midjourney drawing API, generating over 1 million drawings daily, supporting Discord Youchuan Midjourney 🐂！
items.z: Midjourney API 是全球最大的 Midjourney 绘图 API 代理项目，日生成图像超百万张，完全免费开源。支持 Discord 绘图、悠船绘图及官网接入，提供 Imagine、Vary、Remix 等全套指令，集成账号池管理、多数据库支持、负载均衡、CloudFlare 验证绕过、图片/视频一键换脸等功能，适用于企业级绘图服务部署。
items.e: Midjourney API is the world's largest free and open-source proxy for Midjourney's Discord channel, generating over 1 million images daily. It supports full-featured drawing via Discord, YouChuan, and official Midjourney, with comprehensive commands like Imagine, Vary, Remix, account pooling, load balancing, CloudFlare bypass, image/video face swap, and enterprise-grade deployment features.

items.d: a library for adding declarative ajax functionality to your website
items.z: eldarion-ajax 是一个用于为网站添加声明式 AJAX 功能的 JavaScript 库，通过 jQuery 实现。它简化了重复的 AJAX 代码编写，支持通过服务器返回的 JSON 中 `html` 字段渲染 HTML 片段，无需前端模板引擎。支持 `<a>` 点击、表单提交等常见交互，适用于现代 Web 应用的无刷新操作场景。
items.e: eldarion-ajax is a JavaScript library that enables declarative AJAX functionality on websites using jQuery. It eliminates repetitive $.ajax code by leveraging server-rendered HTML fragments returned in JSON. Designed for seamless integration with server-side templates, it supports common actions like link clicks and form submissions without full page reloads.

items.d: berserkJS 是新形态的前端测试自动化工具 + 页面性能分析工具 ，同时也是个使用 JS 语法控制的命令行浏览器。可用 JS 编写前端自动测试用例 + 页面性能分析用例。 想了解更多？看看连接中的文档吧~~
items.z: berserkJS 是一款基于 Qt 的前端自动化测试与页面性能分析工具，支持无头浏览器模式运行主流测试框架，提供 DOM 操作、网络监控、屏幕捕获及性能指标采集功能，API 简洁且符合 W3C 标准，已在微博、Cisco、腾讯等企业落地应用。
items.e: berserkJS is a Qt-based frontend automation and performance analysis tool that supports headless browser testing with mainstream frameworks, offering DOM manipulation, network monitoring, screenshot capture, and performance metrics collection. Its W3C-compliant APIs are simple and production-proven in enterprises like Sina Weibo, Cisco, and Tencent.

items.d: 爬取微信公众号文章
items.z: 该仓库通过搜狗微信接口爬取微信公众号文章，支持获取账号信息、文章列表及全文内容，集成反爬虫机制与动态渲染技术，适用于内容聚合与数据分析场景。
items.e: This repository scrapes WeChat Official Account articles via Sogou's WeChat search platform, supporting account info retrieval, article list parsing, and full content extraction. It includes anti-scraping measures and dynamic rendering support for content aggregation and data analysis.

items.d: We don't need a lot of libraries. We just need the best ones. | Unofficial recommended first choice.
items.z: one-python 精选 Python 生态中最优质的库，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、网络爬虫、数据分析等核心领域，推荐 scikit-learn、TensorFlow、pandas、requests、Scrapy 等高效工具，助力开发者以最少依赖实现强大功能。
items.e: one-python curates the best Python libraries across key domains like machine learning, deep learning, NLP, web crawling, and data analysis. It recommends top tools such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, pandas, requests, and Scrapy, enabling developers to build powerful applications with minimal dependencies.

items.d: 这是一个基于AI的自动化交易程序，专为数字货币市场（BNB/USDT）设计。该程序旨在实现全自动化交易，通过AI算法帮助用户在数字货币市场中做出更智能的交易决策。
items.z: GridBNB 是一个基于 Python 的企业级自动化交易程序，专为币安交易所设计，支持多币种并发网格交易。通过动态波动率分析、EWMA 混合算法和多层风险管理，实现稳定捕捉市场波动收益。提供 Docker 容器化部署、Nginx 反向代理、实时监控 Web 界面及理财功能集成，适合专业交易者进行自动化数字货币交易。
items.e: GridBNB is a Python-based enterprise-grade automated trading program designed for Binance exchange, supporting concurrent grid trading across multiple cryptocurrency pairs. It leverages dynamic volatility analysis, EWMA hybrid algorithms, and multi-layer risk management to capture market fluctuations profitably. Features include Docker deployment, Nginx proxy, real-time monitoring web UI, and integrated savings functionality for professional crypto trading automation.

items.d: Downloads : https://brahma-dev.github.io/synergy-stable-builds/
items.z: Synergy 是一款开源的跨平台输入共享工具，允许用户通过一套键鼠无缝控制多台计算机。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，提供简洁的配置与编译流程，适用于多设备办公场景，强调自由使用与二次开发。
items.e: Synergy is an open-source, cross-platform tool that enables sharing a single mouse and keyboard across multiple computers. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with straightforward configuration and build processes, ideal for multi-device productivity environments.

items.d: A SSL-enabled development server for Django
items.z: django-sslserver 是一个为 Django 框架提供 SSL 支持的本地开发服务器，支持自签名证书和自定义 CA 证书，适用于开发环境 HTTPS 调试，但不建议用于生产部署。
items.e: Django SSL Server is a development-only SSL-enabled server for Django, supporting self-signed and CA-trusted certificates, ideal for local HTTPS testing during development, though not recommended for production use.

items.d: Visual design tool for building Terminal User Interfaces
items.z: TUIStudio 是一款类 Figma 的终端用户界面可视化设计工具，支持拖拽式组件编排、实时 ANSI 预览、多框架代码导出（Ink/BubbleTea/Textual 等），内置 20+ TUI 组件与丰富主题系统，提供绝对/弹性/网格布局引擎及完整撤销重做功能。
items.e: TUIStudio is a Figma-like visual editor for designing Terminal UIs, featuring drag-and-drop components, live ANSI preview, multi-framework export (Ink/BubbleTea/Textual), 20+ built-in TUI elements, layout engines (absolute/flex/grid), and real-time theme switching with gradient support.

items.d: RN 开源之初，写几个Mini-App
items.z: 该项目是React Native早期实战项目集合，包含通讯录、LBS附近服务、豆瓣API搜索等Mini-App。涵盖文件系统Node.js服务端、通讯录管理、公告系统、地图定位及Webview集成，提供完整移动端开发范例，适合RN初学者学习全栈移动应用开发。
items.e: This repository contains early React Native practical projects including address book, LBS nearby services, and Douban API search apps. It covers Node.js file-based backend, contact management, announcements, map positioning, and Webview integration, serving as a comprehensive full-stack mobile development tutorial for RN beginners.

items.d: AI generate code
items.z: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
items.e: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

items.z: Shadowsocks 是一个高性能的 TCP/UDP 隧道代理工具，支持用户管理 API、TCP Fast Open 和 IP 黑名单，用于绕过网络防火墙，提供跨平台服务端与客户端支持，适用于 Linux、Windows、Android 及 OpenWRT 等环境。
items.e: Shadowsocks is a high-performance TCP/UDP tunnel proxy with features like user management API, TCP Fast Open, and IP blacklisting, designed to bypass firewalls. It supports cross-platform deployment on Linux, Windows, Android, and OpenWRT, offering both server and client implementations.

items.d: AI 时代的 Vibe Coding 实践：使用 Claude Code 从零开发 AI 漫剧生成平台的完整记录，涵盖技术选型、AI 驱动开发、UI 优化与功能迭代全流程。
items.z: 本项目记录使用 Claude Code 实践 AI 时代 Vibe Coding 的完整过程，涵盖从零开发 AI 漫剧生成平台的技术选型、AI 驱动开发、UI 优化与功能迭代。通过自然语言描述需求驱动代码生成，结合超级技能框架实现 TDD 开发流程，并采用 SPEC 规范确保接口标准化，展现以文档为核心的新型编程范式。
items.e: This project documents the complete practice of Vibe Coding in the AI era using Claude Code, covering technology selection, AI-driven development, UI optimization and feature iteration for an AI comic generation platform. It demonstrates a new programming paradigm where natural language requirements drive code generation, combined with super-skill frameworks for TDD workflows and SPEC specifications for standardized interfaces.

items.d: TTSFM mirrors OpenAI's TTS service, providing a compatible interface for text-to-speech conversion with multiple voice options for free.
items.z: TTSFM 是一个免费的 OpenAI 兼容文本转语音 API 服务，基于 OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS 提供多语音选项、6种音频格式支持、速度调节和实时流式生成，包含 Python SDK、Web 交互界面及 Docker 部署方案，适用于教育与研究场景。
items.e: TTSFM is a free, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API service based on OpenAI's GPT-4o mini TTS, offering 11 voice options, 6 audio formats, speed control (0.25x–4.0x), real-time streaming, Python SDK, web playground, and Docker deployment for educational and research use.

items.d: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
items.z: Grok2API 是基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理服务，支持 Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV 一键部署，提供流/非流式对话、图像生成、深度思考等功能。具备号池并发、自动负载均衡、Token/API Key 管理、后台面板等核心能力，三端部署行为一致，适配移动端并增强筛选与状态判定逻辑。
items.e: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based proxy for Grok AI, supporting one-click deployment on Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV with streaming/non-streaming chat, image generation, deep thinking, concurrent token pools, and auto load balancing. It features unified management panels, mobile adaptation, enhanced token filtering, and consistent behavior across local/FastAPI/Docker/Workers deployments.

items.d: 基于 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建、由 mihomo 驱动的原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，专注轻量、稳定与可观测。
items.z: ClashBar 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，基于 mihomo Core，采用 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建。主打轻量化设计（37.5MB），支持配置管理、节点切换、流量策略控制、实时连接监控与系统代理集成，提供中英文双语界面，专注提升代理工具在 macOS 上的易用性与稳定性。
items.e: ClashBar is a native macOS menu bar proxy client built with SwiftUI + AppKit, powered by mihomo Core. It emphasizes lightweight design (37.5MB), offering configuration management, node switching, traffic policy control, real-time connection monitoring, and system proxy integration. With bilingual support (zh/en), it enhances usability and stability for proxy tools on macOS.

items.d: [UNMAINTAINED] Online reStructuredText editor
items.z: rsted 是一个基于 Flask 的在线 reStructuredText 编辑器，提供实时预览功能，支持通过 Docker 快速部署。虽然项目已停止维护，但可作为轻量级 RST 文档编辑工具使用，适合快速编写和预览技术文档。
items.e: rsted is a simple online reStructuredText editor built with Flask, offering real-time preview. Though unmaintained, it provides a lightweight solution for editing and previewing RST documents, deployable via Docker or local server on port 5000.

items.d: 参考Spec-kit 实现小说撰写工具
items.z: Novel Writer 是基于规格驱动开发（SDD）的 AI 智能中文小说创作工具，支持在 Claude、Cursor、Gemini 等 13 个 AI 助手中通过斜杠命令系统化创作。提供七步创作方法论、情节追踪、角色一致性验证等核心功能，专为中文小说写作优化，支持跨平台使用与插件扩展。
items.e: Novel Writer is an AI-driven Chinese novel writing tool based on Specification-Driven Development (SDD), enabling systematic creation through slash commands in 13 AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Gemini. It offers a 7-step methodology, plot tracking, character consistency checks, and Chinese-optimized features, with cross-platform support and extensible plugin architecture.

items.e: An open-source live wallpaper app for macOS 14+, supporting MP4/MOV video playback with multi-display rendering and high performance. Install via Homebrew or compile from source using Xcode and CMake. Requires Gatekeeper bypass for unsigned apps. UI modernization to SwiftUI is planned while maintaining the daemon component.

items.d: 移动端响应式插件
items.z: 移动端响应式插件通过transform:scale实现页面缩放适配，支持contain/cover/auto三种模式，兼容iOS4+与Android2.3+等老旧系统。采用视觉稿px单位直接适配，无需rem或媒体查询，零依赖仅1KB，适合单屏滑屏H5页面开发。
items.e: A lightweight mobile responsive plugin using transform:scale for device adaptation. Supports contain/cover/auto modes with excellent legacy browser support (iOS4+/Android2.3+). Uses visual design px units directly without rem or media queries, ideal for single-screen H5 apps.

items.d: A customizable plug-in photo gallery management application for the Django web framework.
items.z: Django-photologue 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的强大图片管理与画廊应用，支持上传照片、创建画廊、添加水印等效果，提供灵活的插件化架构，适用于构建定制化图片展示网站。
items.e: Django-photologue is a powerful image management and gallery application for Django, enabling photo uploads, gallery organization, watermarking, and flexible customization for web-based photo displays.

items.d: django-request is a statistics module for django. It stores requests in a database for admins to see, it can also be used to get statistics on who is online etc.
items.z: django-request 是一个为 Django 框架设计的网站统计模块，自动记录用户请求至数据库，支持管理员查看访问数据、在线用户统计及流量分析。通过中间件集成和模板标签，可轻松实现用户活跃度监控与访问趋势可视化，适用于需要精细化运营分析的网站项目。
items.e: django-request is a Django statistics module that logs HTTP requests to a database for admins to analyze. It enables real-time tracking of online users, visitor statistics, and traffic insights via built-in middleware and template tags, ideal for monitoring user engagement and site performance in Django applications.
