items.d: 把网页AI转api，如claude2api
items.z: Web2API 是一个网页 AI 服务桥接工具，将 Claude Web 等前端 AI 能力封装为 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API。支持图片输入、流式输出、工具调用及可视化配置，无需修改客户端即可对接现有 SDK（如 Cursor）。提供 Docker 和源码部署方式，集成浏览器指纹与代理管理，适用于自动化对话场景。
items.e: Web2API is a bridge service that wraps web-based AI services (primarily Claude Web) into standard OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It supports image input, streaming/non-streaming output, tool calls, and offers a visual config UI for proxy groups, account pools, fingerprints, and time zones. Deployable via Docker or source code, it enables seamless integration with existing clients like OpenAI SDK or Cursor without code changes.

items.d: 深度解析链接、文档或代码，生成“全能导师级”的教学笔记
items.z: Knowledge Absorber 是一个 AI 技能模块，深度解析链接、文档或代码，生成结构化教学笔记（Markdown/HTML）。核心亮点：导师模式支持上下文感知的交互式问答，多源输入冲突对比强化事实校验，严格搜索内化实现专注阅读体验，适用于 Trae、Claude 等环境。
items.e: Knowledge Absorber is an AI skill module that deeply analyzes links, documents, or code to generate structured teaching notes (Markdown/HTML). Key features: Mentor Mode enables context-aware interactive Q&A with AI tutors, multi-source conflict detection for fact-checking, strict content filtering for focused reading, and compatibility with Trae, Claude, Gemini, and VS Code Copilot.

items.d: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
items.z: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
items.e: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

items.d: A Telegram bot with a silky smooth AI experience. UI enabled.
items.z: 这是一个功能强大的 Telegram AI 聊天机器人，支持 Azure OpenAI 和原生 OpenAI API，提供实时流式响应与 DALL·E 3 图像生成。具备多角色预设、用户分级权限、一键清空对话、容器化部署等特性，界面支持中英文切换，用户体验流畅顺滑。
items.e: A high-performance Telegram bot delivering seamless AI interactions via OpenAI and Azure OpenAI APIs, featuring real-time streaming responses, DALL·E 3 image generation, customizable bot personas, user tiered access control, and containerized deployment with bilingual UI support.

items.d: a sudoku game written in React Native
items.z: 这是一个使用 React Native 开发的数独游戏应用，具备动画效果、编辑模式、游戏进度保存及在线排行榜功能。开发者曾创下 3分43秒的解题记录，并计划扩展多难度等级、国际化支持和云端数据存储。
items.e: A React Native-based Sudoku game featuring animations, editing mode, game resume, and online leaderboards. The developer holds a personal record of 3:43 and plans to add multiple difficulty levels, i18n support, and cloud-based score storage.

items.d: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
items.z: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
items.e: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

items.d: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
items.z: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档自动生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供配置选项控制文档可见性。项目包含演示环境，支持模板扩展，适用于需要快速搭建标准化 API 文档的中大型后端服务。
items.e: DRF Docs is an automated API documentation generator for Django Rest Framework, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It auto-generates interactive API docs by parsing DRF project structures, with configurable visibility and template extension support. Includes a demo project for development and testing, ideal for medium-to-large backend services requiring standardized API documentation.

items.d: tts 服务
items.z: 基于 Azure 语音服务的现代化 TTS 服务，采用 Go + React 前后端分离架构，支持多语言、可调节语速语调、OpenAI API 兼容及 Docker/Cloudflare Worker 多部署方式，提供高性能文本转语音能力。
items.e: A modern Text-to-Speech service built on Microsoft Azure Speech Services, featuring a Go+React separation architecture with multi-language support, adjustable rate/pitch/style, OpenAI API compatibility, and flexible deployment via Docker or Cloudflare Workers.

items.d: HiApp written in react-native.
items.z: HiApp 是一款基于 React Native 开发的跨平台移动应用，支持 iOS 和 Android 平台。项目提供完整的开发环境配置指南，包含依赖安装、打包器启动及真机运行方案，适合学习 React Native 开发实践。
items.e: HiApp is a cross-platform mobile application built with React Native, supporting both iOS and Android. It includes setup instructions for dependency installation, packager startup, and device deployment, serving as a practical reference for React Native development.

items.z: 本仓库提供 Android Design Support Library 的完整教程，包含60分钟实战项目，涵盖 Snackbar、FloatingActionButton、NavigationView 等核心组件的集成与交互实现，适合 Android 开发者学习现代 UI 设计模式。
items.e: This repository offers a comprehensive 60-minute codelab tutorial on the Android Design Support Library, demonstrating integration of key UI components like Snackbar, FloatingActionButton, and NavigationView to build modern Android interfaces with Material Design principles.

items.d: 一款手势驱动的裁图插件 / A gesture to drive image cropping plug-in
items.z: PhotoClip.js 是一款手势驱动的移动端图片裁剪插件，支持双指缩放、旋转等直观操作，兼容主流浏览器。通过集成 iscroll-zoom、hammer.js 和 lrz 压缩库，实现高效图片裁剪与压缩，适用于移动端照片处理场景，提供灵活的配置选项和回调机制。
items.e: PhotoClip.js is a gesture-driven image cropping plugin for mobile devices, supporting intuitive pinch-to-zoom and rotation. It integrates iscroll-zoom, hammer.js, and lrz compression for efficient image processing. Compatible with modern browsers, it offers flexible configuration and callbacks for mobile photo editing workflows.

items.d: django-threadedcomments is a simple yet flexible threaded commenting system for Django.
items.z: django-threadedcomments 是一个基于 Django 的简洁灵活线程化评论系统，支持评论嵌套回复。它构建于 django_comments 之上，易于扩展，提供完整的模板标签和表单渲染功能，适用于博客、文章等内容的互动评论场景。
items.e: django-threadedcomments is a lightweight yet flexible threaded commenting system for Django, enabling nested replies to both posts and other comments. Built on django_comments, it offers extensible template tags and seamless integration with custom designs, ideal for blogs and articles.

items.d: OpenAI 接口聚合管理，我们致力于提供优质的API接入服务，让您可以轻松集成先进的AI模型至您的产品和服务。
items.z: Chat API 是基于 One API 和 New API 二次开发的 OpenAI 接口聚合管理系统，提供多模型接入、令牌分组计费、渠道标签化管理及 WxPusher 推送通知等功能，支持 Docker/宝塔一键部署，适用于企业级 AI 服务集成。
items.e: Chat API is a secondary development of One API and New API, serving as an OpenAI interface aggregation management system. It offers multi-model access, token-based billing, channel tagging, WxPusher notifications, and supports Docker/Baota one-click deployment for enterprise-level AI service integration.

items.d: cxSelect 是基于 jQuery 的多级联动菜单插件，适用于省市、商品分类等联动菜单。
items.z: cxSelect 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Zepto 的多级联动菜单插件，支持通过 AJAX 或自定义 JSON 数据动态加载省市、商品分类等层级选项，兼容移动端，提供灵活的参数配置与 API 控制，适用于表单联动场景。
items.e: cxSelect is a jQuery and Zepto-based plugin for multi-level cascading menus, supporting dynamic loading of hierarchical options (e.g., provinces, cities) via AJAX or custom JSON data. It offers flexible configuration, mobile compatibility, and full API control for form interactions.

items.d: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，支持实时更新，导出聊天记录，朋友圈等大量便捷功能
items.z: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
items.e: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

items.d: A list of the most popular AI Topic repositories on GitHub based on the number of stars they have received.| AI相关主题Github仓库排名，每日自动更新。
items.z: GitHub-Ranking-AI 是一个每日自动更新的 GitHub AI 仓库排名系统，按星标数量统计热门 AI 主题项目。涵盖 LLM、ChatGPT、OpenAI、DeepSeek、RAG、AI Agents 等前沿领域，提供 AutoGPT、Ollama、LangChain、Dify 等顶级开源工具榜单，是开发者追踪 AI 技术趋势的核心资源库。
items.e: GitHub-Ranking-AI is a daily-updated ranking system of the most popular AI repositories on GitHub based on stars. It covers cutting-edge topics like LLM, ChatGPT, OpenAI, DeepSeek, RAG, and AI Agents, featuring top tools such as AutoGPT, Ollama, LangChain, and Dify. Serving as a vital resource for developers to track AI trends and discover high-quality open-source projects.

items.d: AI 时代的 Vibe Coding 实践：使用 Claude Code 从零开发 AI 漫剧生成平台的完整记录，涵盖技术选型、AI 驱动开发、UI 优化与功能迭代全流程。
items.z: 本项目记录使用 Claude Code 实践 AI 时代 Vibe Coding 的完整过程，聚焦 AI 漫剧生成平台的开发。通过自然语言描述需求驱动开发，结合 superpowers、frontend-design 等技能实现 TDD 开发流程与 UI 优化，采用 SPEC 规范定义接口标准，体现文档即代码的核心理念。
items.e: This project documents the complete practice of Vibe Coding in the AI era using Claude Code to develop an AI comic animation platform. It demonstrates natural language-driven development, leveraging skills like superpowers and frontend-design for TDD workflows and UI optimization, while implementing SPEC specifications to define API standards, embodying the core philosophy that documentation is code.

items.d: 基于IP的真实地址生成器
items.z: 基于IP的真实地址生成器，通过调用ipapi、RandomUser等API，根据用户IP或指定地区自动生成包含姓名、电话、地址、SSN等信息的虚拟身份数据，支持地图展示、本地保存与导出，适用于测试、演示等场景。
items.e: An IP-based real address generator that uses APIs like ipapi and RandomUser to generate realistic virtual identities including name, phone, address, and SSN based on user IP or selected region. Features map display, local storage, export, and responsive UI for testing and demo purposes.

items.d: Boss Skill - BMAD 全自动研发流水线（多 Agent 编排）
items.z: Boss Skill 是基于 BMAD 框架的全自动研发流水线，通过多 Agent 协作实现从需求到部署的完整开发周期。支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 Coding Agent，包含 9 个专业角色（PM、架构师、UI 设计师等），采用四阶段流水线（规划→评审拆解→开发→部署），提供灵活的参数配置和模板定制功能。
items.e: Boss Skill implements a fully automated R&D pipeline using the BMAD framework with multi-Agent orchestration. It supports major coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor, featuring 9 specialized roles (PM, Architect, UI Designer, etc.) across four phases (planning→review/decomposition→development→deployment). Offers flexible configuration options and template customization capabilities.

items.d: The unofficial V2EX app for iOS
items.z: darkerk/v2ex 是一款专为 iOS 平台开发的非官方 V2EX 客户端应用，采用 Swift 4.1 编写，支持 iOS 10.0+。该应用提供简洁的界面设计，让用户能够便捷地浏览 V2EX 社区内容，包括节点、主题和评论等核心功能，是 V2EX 用户的移动端优质替代方案。
items.e: darkerk/v2ex is an unofficial iOS app for V2EX, built with Swift 4.1 and compatible with iOS 10.0+. It offers a clean interface for browsing V2EX content, including nodes, topics, and comments, serving as a convenient mobile alternative to the web version of V2EX.

items.d: A minimal django project containing a minimal app with a working jquery file upload form based on the work by Sebastian Tschan: http://aquantum-demo.appspot.com/file-upload
items.z: 该项目是一个基于 Sebastian Tschan 的 jQuery-File-Upload 组件的极简 Django 文件上传示例，支持拖拽上传、多文件选择、上传取消及文件删除功能，无需 Flash 等浏览器插件，适用于快速集成前端文件上传到 Django 后端。
items.e: This is a minimal Django project demonstrating how to integrate Sebastian Tschan's jQuery-File-Upload component, featuring drag-and-drop, multi-file selection, upload cancellation, and file deletion. It requires no browser plugins like Flash and is ideal for quickly adding robust file upload functionality to Django applications.

items.d: 吉他和弦推导算法
items.z: guitarChord 是一个吉他和弦推导算法项目，支持根据输入和弦名称自动生成标准指法图，并提供 SVG 可视化输出。基于 React 构建，包含完整的前端交互界面和静态部署能力，适用于音乐教学与练习场景。
items.e: guitarChord is a guitar chord derivation algorithm that generates standard fingerings and SVG visualizations based on input chord names. Built with React, it features an interactive web interface for music education and practice.

items.d: Share obsidian markdown file to notion and generate notion share link    同步obsdian文件到notion，并生成notion分享链接，可以方便的分享obsidian的文件。
items.z: Obsidian to Notion 插件实现一键将 Obsidian Markdown 文件同步至 Notion，自动生成分享链接。支持自定义封面、标签转换、页面更新及多语言，集成 Notion API，适用于知识管理与协作分享。
items.e: The Obsidian to Notion plugin enables one-click syncing of Obsidian Markdown files to Notion with automatic share link generation. It supports custom banners, tag conversion, page updates, and multilingual features via Notion API integration for knowledge management and collaboration.

items.d: AngularJS入门教程——AngularJS中文社区提供
items.z: 本仓库提供完整的AngularJS入门教程，涵盖快速开始、模板系统、双向绑定、路由、REST服务等核心功能。由AngularJS中文社区维护，包含15个循序渐进的实践章节，适合前端开发者系统学习AngularJS框架。
items.e: This repository offers a comprehensive AngularJS tutorial covering core features like templates, two-way binding, routing, and REST services. Maintained by the AngularJS Chinese Community, it includes 15 progressive chapters ideal for developers learning the framework.

items.d: 网站
items.z: 开源阅读官网基于 Docusaurus 2 构建，提供文档、博客和下载功能，支持 Markdown 内容创作，便于用户贡献阅读APP相关资源，提升社区知识共享效率。
items.e: The open-source reading official website is built with Docusaurus 2, featuring documentation, blogs, and downloads. It supports Markdown-based content contributions for the reading app, enhancing community knowledge sharing.

items.d: 一个简单的Chrome插件，用来帮助你登录ChatGPT。
items.z: ChatGPT Auth Helper 是一个 Chrome 浏览器插件，旨在简化用户通过第三方认证服务（如 https://token.oaifree.com/auth）登录 ChatGPT 的流程。该插件提供一键式身份验证支持，提升访问效率，适用于需要频繁使用 ChatGPT 的用户群体。
items.e: ChatGPT Auth Helper is a lightweight Chrome extension designed to simplify the login process for ChatGPT via third-party authentication services like https://token.oaifree.com/auth. It streamlines access by automating token-based logins, enhancing convenience for frequent users.

items.d: Detect mobile browsers and serve different template flavours to them.
items.z: django-mobile 是一个 Django 中间件工具，用于自动检测移动端浏览器并动态切换模板渲染。它通过中间件识别用户设备类型，并基于预设的 'flavour'（如 mobile/desktop）透明加载对应模板（如 mobile/index.html），支持多设备适配和优雅降级，无需修改视图逻辑即可实现响应式站点。
items.e: django-mobile is a Django middleware that detects mobile browsers and serves different templates accordingly. It uses middleware to identify device type, then transparently loads flavored templates (e.g., mobile/index.html) based on the detected 'flavour', enabling responsive design without altering view logic. It supports multiple mobile flavors and graceful fallback to default templates.

items.d: 源代码(开源版本到0.8)，后续版本会继续更新但不会开源
items.z: Auto Cursor 是一款专业的 Cursor IDE 管理工具，支持一键备份与恢复账户配置、无感换号及自动轮换到期账户，实现真正的无缝切换。核心功能包括机器ID管理、配置备份、SQLite 数据库更新等，适用于 macOS 和 Windows 平台，所有操作均创建备份以确保安全。
items.e: Auto Cursor is a professional Cursor IDE management tool enabling one-click backup/restore of account configurations, seamless account switching, and automatic rotation of expired accounts. It manages machine IDs, updates storage.json and SQLite databases, and supports macOS and Windows. All operations create backups for safety and user control.

items.d: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
items.z: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
items.e: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

items.d: MG动画视频skill, 抖音爆款Vibe知识大赏知识短片 ，  自动配音效，一键出片。图文讲解视频 skill  —— 把讲解稿变成「手绘会动的画面」讲解视频。  图形由代码逐笔绘出、文字逐字写出、讲到哪画到哪。五套风格可选，本地 Chrome 渲染， 零生图 API 成本 ，任何改动秒级重渲。

items.z: Bootstrap Tags 是一个 jQuery 插件，用于扩展 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签功能，支持 Bootstrap 2.3.2 和 3+ 版本。它提供自动建议、排除/过滤列表、占位符提示、Bootstrap 按钮样式集成以及可自定义的扩展点，适用于需要交互式标签输入的 Web 表单场景。
items.e: Bootstrap Tags is a jQuery plugin that extends Twitter Bootstrap with tagging functionality, supporting Bootstrap 2.3.2 and 3+. It features autosuggest, exclusion/filtering, popovers, placeholder prompts, and Bootstrap button styling, making it ideal for interactive tag-based input in web forms.

items.d: Python项目自动化多服务器部署的工具
items.z: essay 是一个基于 Fabric 的 Python 项目自动化部署工具，支持多服务器打包与部署。它通过标准化流程简化开发到生产环境的交付，集成 PyPI 服务器和 Git 仓库，提供快速构建、版本化打包、虚拟环境管理及 Supervisord 进程控制，适用于需高效扩展的 Python 服务场景。
items.e: Essay is a Python project automation deployment tool based on Fabric, supporting multi-server packaging and deployment. It streamlines the development-to-production pipeline with standardized workflows, integrating PyPI servers and Git repositories. It enables rapid builds, versioned packaging, virtual environment management, and Supervisord process control, ideal for scalable Python service deployments.

items.z: Card-Tab 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的轻量化书签管理页面，采用卡片式布局支持拖拽排序、分类管理和暗色主题切换。具备多搜索引擎集成、JWT登录验证、KV存储备份及实时天气显示等功能，适合个人快速搭建个性化导航站。
items.e: Card-Tab is a lightweight bookmark management page deployed on Cloudflare Workers, featuring card-based layout with drag-and-drop sorting, custom categories, dark mode, and multi-engine search. It supports JWT authentication, KV storage backups, and real-time weather display for personalized navigation.

items.d: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
items.z: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
items.e: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

items.d: Resume template for Coder 适合程序员的简历模板 🎉
items.z: 专为程序员设计的简历模板，基于Sketch.app制作，提供多版本（2021/2019/2018/2017/中文版）设计，突出技术能力与项目经验，支持一键导出PDF，适配不同求职场景。
items.e: A professional resume template designed for coders, built with Sketch.app. Offers multiple versions (2021/2019/2018/2017/Chinese) to showcase technical skills and project experience, with one-click PDF export for job applications.

items.d: A set of utilities for creating robust pagination tools throughout a django application.
items.z: django-pagination 提供了一套用于在 Django 应用中构建健壮分页工具的实用程序，现已停止维护。其维护分支可在 pydanny/dj-pagination 获取，适用于需要高效处理大量数据展示的 Web 项目。
items.e: django-pagination offers utilities for building robust pagination tools in Django applications. This project is no longer maintained; a supported fork is available at pydanny/dj-pagination, ideal for web apps requiring efficient data pagination.

items.d: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
items.z: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
items.e: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

items.d: 一站式Exa注册机+号池轮询+API服务反代+多用户管理
items.z: ExaFree 是一个 Exa API 代理与管理平台，支持多账号轮询、用户级 API Key 管理、Linux DO OAuth2 登录注册。提供完整的 API 代理服务（search/answer/contents 等）、MCP 工具集成、管理面板及数据库备份功能，采用 Docker 部署，支持 SQLite/PostgreSQL 持久化存储。
items.e: ExaFree is an Exa API proxy and management platform supporting multi-account polling, user-level API key management, and Linux DO OAuth2 login/registration. It provides full API proxy services (search/answer/contents), MCP tool integration, admin panel, and database backup features via Docker with SQLite/PostgreSQL support.

items.d: Scrapy extension to write scraped items using Django models
items.z: scrapy-djangoitem 是一个 Scrapy 扩展，允许使用 Django 模型定义 Scrapy 项目中的 Item。它提供 DjangoItem 类，将 Django 模型字段自动映射为 Scrapy Item 字段，并支持通过 save() 方法将抓取数据直接保存为 Django 模型实例，简化了爬虫与 Django 应用的数据集成。
items.e: scrapy-djangoitem is a Scrapy extension that enables defining Scrapy items using existing Django models. It provides the DjangoItem class, which automatically maps Django model fields to Scrapy item fields and supports saving scraped data directly into Django model instances via the save() method, streamlining integration between Scrapy crawlers and Django applications.

items.z: 该项目通过 ISBN 空间可视化技术，将全球图书数据映射为二维空间，支持按出版社、稀有度等维度进行交互式探索。基于预处理的 ISBN 前缀数据和图书馆馆藏信息，生成高分辨率 PNG 瓦片数据集，适用于大规模图书数据的直观分析与展示。
items.e: This project visualizes the global book catalog by mapping ISBNs into a 2D space, enabling interactive exploration by publisher, rarity, and other dimensions. It uses preprocessed ISBN prefix data and library holdings to generate high-resolution PNG tile datasets for intuitive analysis and visualization of massive book collections.

items.d: Lemon is open source, embeddable, lightweight programming language http://www.lemon-lang.org
items.z: Lemon 是一种开源、轻量级、可嵌入的编程语言，提供完整的编译器与虚拟机实现。支持 POSIX 和 Windows 平台，内置 OS 与 Socket 模块，适用于嵌入式系统和脚本扩展。项目包含源码、核心库、文档与测试用例，采用 MIT 许可证。
items.e: Lemon is an open-source, embeddable, lightweight programming language featuring a complete compiler and virtual machine. It supports POSIX and Windows, includes built-in OS and socket modules, and is ideal for embedded systems and scripting. The project provides source code, core library, documentation, and tests under the MIT license.

items.d: 爱V2EX（原掌上V2EX）
items.z: 爱V2EX是一款非官方的V2EX社区Android客户端，提供话题浏览、节点搜索、用户资料查看、话题创建与回复、未读提醒等功能，支持滑动手势操作，界面简洁易用，完全开源并遵循GPL协议。
items.e: V2EX-android is a non-official Android client for the V2EX community, offering features like topic browsing, node search, user profiles, topic creation/replies, and unread notifications. It supports gesture navigation and is fully open-source under the GPL license.

items.d: 智能助教系统，利用大模型根据课程相关文档自动生成题目并且批改
items.z: CogniLoop 是一个基于大模型的智能助教系统，支持根据课程文档自动生成个性化试题并自动批改。系统构建去中心化学习社区，提供知识库创建、自适应出题、学习圈子及挑战赛功能，通过用户学习轨迹优化策略，实现千人千面的AI驱动教育辅助工具。
items.e: CogniLoop is an AI-powered intelligent tutoring system that generates and grades personalized questions from course documents. It builds a decentralized learning community with knowledge bases, adaptive quizzes, study groups, and challenges, continuously optimizing question strategies based on individual learning paths for truly personalized education.

items.d: 面向电商商品图生产场景的图片套图 Skill。仓库提供一套从商品图分析、卖点提炼、Prompt 组织到成图输出的脚本与配置，适合用在淘宝、京东、拼多多、抖音等国内平台，以及独立站、Amazon 等跨境场景。
items.z: 该仓库提供电商商品图自动化生产工具，支持从原图分析、卖点提炼到多类型套图生成全流程。覆盖白底主图、卖点图、场景展示等8种标准图型，适配淘宝、京东、Amazon等平台。通过结构化输出为详情页、视频等内容提供统一素材，已验证服饰、电器等多品类场景。
items.e: This repository delivers an automated e-commerce image suite generator, enabling end-to-end workflows from product image analysis to multi-format output. It supports 8 standard image types (e.g., white-bg hero images, feature highlights, lifestyle scenes) and is compatible with platforms like Taobao, Amazon, and TikTok. Structured outputs streamline content creation for listings, videos, and detail pages across apparel, electronics, and more.

items.d: Complexity within, simplicity without. 繁于内，简于形。
items.z: ClawDeckX 是为 OpenClaw 设计的开源可视化管理平台，提供 macOS 级视觉体验与极简操作界面。支持多语言、跨平台部署，具备实时监控、智能场景模板、技能中心等功能，显著降低 AI 代理的配置门槛，适合初学者快速上手。
items.e: ClawDeckX is an open-source web visual management platform for OpenClaw, offering a macOS-grade interface with glassmorphism design and smooth animations. It simplifies AI agent configuration through guided wizards, real-time monitoring, multi-agent workflows, and cross-platform deployment (Windows/macOS/Linux), ideal for beginners and advanced users alike.

items.d: 针对 Vue 框架移植的 We UI 框架的适配，让 mobile开发过程成为一种享受。 Demo:
items.z: vue-weui 是将 WeUI 移动端 UI 框架适配到 Vue.js 的项目，结合 vue-router、ES6 和 Webpack 构建现代化移动应用开发环境，提供开箱即用的组件库和开发工具链，显著提升移动端开发效率与体验。
items.e: vue-weui is a Vue.js adaptation of the WeUI mobile UI framework, integrating vue-router, ES6, and Webpack to deliver a modern development stack for mobile apps. It offers ready-to-use components and tooling to streamline mobile development.

items.d: 🥘Base on element-ui, makes crud easily
items.z: el-data-table 是基于 element-ui 封装的 CRUD 表格组件，支持自动请求、分页、树形数据、自定义搜索和操作列，集成 @femessage/el-form-renderer 渲染表单，通过配置化实现快速开发 RESTful API 管理界面。
items.e: el-data-table is a CRUD table component built on element-ui, featuring auto data fetching via axios, pagination, tree structures, custom search, and operation columns. It uses @femessage/el-form-renderer for form rendering and supports configuration-driven RESTful API management.

items.d: TTS Azure Web 是一个 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，可以在本地或者云端使用你的 Azure Key 一键部署。TTS Azure Web is an Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS) web application. It allows you to run it locally or deploy it with a single click using your Azure Key.
items.z: TTS Azure Web 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 React 19 的 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，支持 SSML 精细调优、多语言语音定制及一键部署。提供 Normal/SSML 双模式切换、音频参数调节与导出功能，适用于快速集成 Azure TTS 能力至本地或云端环境。
items.e: TTS Azure Web is a Next.js 15 and React 19-based web application for Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS), enabling fine-grained voice control via SSML. It supports dual-mode operation (UI/SSML), audio export, and one-click deployment with Azure credentials, ideal for rapid integration of Azure TTS into local or cloud environments.

items.d: 基于 n8n 的中文本地化版本（chs 分支持续跟进官方）—— AI 智能体与工作流自动化
items.z: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的工作流自动化平台，支持可视化拖拽与代码级灵活控制（JavaScript/Python），集成400+工具并原生支持AI代理工作流。采用公平代码许可证，提供自托管与云服务选项，具备企业级权限管理、SSO及多数据库支持，适合构建复杂自动化流程。
items.e: n8n is a workflow automation platform for technical teams, offering both visual drag-and-drop and code-level flexibility (JavaScript/Python). With 400+ integrations, native AI agent workflows via LangChain, and a fair-code license, it supports self-hosting or cloud deployment, featuring enterprise-grade permissions, SSO, and multi-database compatibility for complex automation.

items.d: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于20位传奇海报设计师）。支持电影海报、读书笔记、公众号封面、小红书配图等。默认9:16竖版，完美适配社交媒体。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封
items.z: 乔木Mondo海报设计是一款AI驱动的设计工具，用户只需一句话描述需求，即可自动生成专业级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面等设计作品。基于20位传奇设计师风格库，支持多场景适配（公众号、小红书、电影海报等），内置AI提示词优化与风格对比功能，无需设计基础即可产出大师级作品。
items.e: Qiaomu Mondo Poster Design is an AI-powered tool that generates professional posters, book covers, and album art from a single sentence. It leverages styles from 20 legendary designers, supports multiple social media formats (WeChat, Xiaohongshu), and includes AI prompt optimization and style comparison features, enabling anyone to create master-level designs without design skills.

items.d: Simple and easy use python web framework
items.z: Uliweb 是一个基于 Python 的全栈 Web 框架，核心设计目标是可重用性、可配置性和可替换性。采用 MVT 架构，支持模块化应用开发，集成 Werkzeug 路由、SQLAlchemy ORM 和 Alembic 数据库迁移，内置表单处理、国际化、缓存与会话管理，模板支持原生 Python 代码，提升开发效率与代码复用。
items.e: Uliweb is a full-stack Python web framework emphasizing reusability, configurability, and replaceability. It uses the MVT pattern, modular apps, Werkzeug routing, SQLAlchemy ORM with Alembic migrations, built-in form handling, i18n, caching, and session management. Templates support native Python code, enabling efficient and DRY development.

items.d: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI Agent frame.
items.z: Aser 是一个轻量级、自组装的 AI 智能体框架，支持模块化组合与快速开发。通过几行代码即可构建具备工具调用、知识库、记忆、MCP 协议等能力的智能体，适用于 Web3、自动化任务和多智能体协作场景，提供丰富的示例与扩展能力。
items.e: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI agent framework enabling rapid development of modular agents. With just a few lines of code, users can build agents with tools, knowledge retrieval, memory, MCP protocol, and more, ideal for Web3 automation, multi-agent collaboration, and advanced AI workflows.

items.d: A v2ex client on android platform.(deprecated)
items.z: v2ex-daily-android 是一款已停止维护的 Android 客户端应用，专为访问 v2ex 社区设计，支持浏览主题、节点搜索和用户信息查看，界面遵循 Material Design 风格，提供简洁高效的原生体验。
items.e: v2ex-daily-android is a deprecated Android client for the v2ex community, offering topic browsing, node search, and user profiles with a clean Material Design interface, optimized for native mobile experience.

items.d: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
items.z: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
items.e: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

items.d: Two Factor Authentication
items.z: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级两步验证密钥管理系统，支持 TOTP/HOTP 生成、多方式添加密钥（扫码/图片识别/拖拽/粘贴）、AES-256-GCM 加密存储，兼容主流应用批量导入导出，具备 WebDAV/S3 远程同步、自动备份还原及响应式设计，实现免费全球部署与离线 PWA 使用。
items.e: A lightweight two-factor authentication (2FA) key management system built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TOTP/HOTP generation, multi-method key addition (QR scan/image recognition/drag-and-drop/paste), AES-256-GCM encryption, batch import/export from major apps, WebDAV/S3 sync, auto backup/restore, and responsive design for offline PWA use with global free deployment.

items.d: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
items.z: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
items.e: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

items.d: 智能替换网页词汇，创造沉浸式双语学习环境，在日常浏览中自然习得语言。
items.z: VocabMeld 是一款 Chrome 插件，基于可理解性输入理论，通过智能替换网页词汇为母语翻译，创造沉浸式双语学习环境。支持多 LLM 服务（DeepSeek、OpenAI 等），CEFR 难度分级，LRU 缓存加速，本地存储保障隐私，提供强度与样式自定义选项，让语言学习自然融入日常浏览。
items.e: VocabMeld is a Chrome extension that creates an immersive bilingual learning environment by intelligently replacing webpage vocabulary with translations. Built on the 'comprehensible input' theory, it supports multiple LLMs (DeepSeek, OpenAI, etc.), CEFR-level filtering, LRU caching for speed, local storage for privacy, and customizable intensity/styles for natural language acquisition during daily browsing.

items.d: DjangoUeditor
items.z: DjangoUeditor 是一个用于在 Django 项目中集成百度 UEditor 富文本编辑器的 Python 模块，支持强大的 HTML 编辑功能（如拖拽调整表格单元格），提供灵活的上传路径配置和自定义按钮扩展，适用于内容管理系统、博客等富文本编辑场景。
items.e: DjangoUeditor is a Python module that integrates Baidu UEditor, a powerful online HTML editor, into Django applications. It supports advanced editing features like drag-and-drop table cells and offers flexible image/file upload configurations, custom buttons, and admin integration, ideal for CMS and blog platforms.

items.d: weixin pay python 微信支付功能集，前期开发借鉴zwczou https://github.com/zwczou/weixin-python ，后期补充及完善微信支付新功能，处理因微信支付调用规则修改而无法使用的旧代码，升级到最新微信支付接口配套代码
items.z: 该仓库是一个已停止维护的微信支付 Python SDK，提供完整的微信支付功能封装，包括 JSAPI 支付下单、订单查询、退款、红包发放、企业付款及刷卡支付等接口。基于 zwczou/weixin-python 开发，后期适配微信支付接口规则变更，支持证书认证和回调通知，适用于需要集成微信支付功能的 Python 后端服务。
items.e: This is a discontinued Python SDK for WeChat Pay, offering comprehensive API support including JSAPI payments, order queries, refunds, red packet distribution, enterprise transfers, and swipe-card payments. Built upon zwczou/weixin-python with updates to comply with WeChat Pay's evolving API standards, it supports certificate authentication and webhook notifications for secure payment processing in Python backends.

items.d: 开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟服务器，帮助你开发与调试微信公众平台应用
items.z: Wecheat 是一个开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟器，基于 Sinatra 框架开发，提供完整的仿真数据与消息交互功能，支持文本、图片、视频等多种消息类型及事件通知，适用于微信应用开发与调试。
items.e: Wecheat is an out-of-the-box WeChat Official Account API simulator built on the Sinatra framework, offering comprehensive fake data and message interactions including text, images, videos, and events, ideal for developing and debugging WeChat applications.

items.d: 基于Cocos2d-X 3.17 跨平台单机麻将，商业级麻将算法、AI算法
items.z: 基于Cocos2d-X 3.17开发的跨平台单机麻将游戏，采用商业级麻将算法与AI引擎，支持多端运行。项目代码结构清晰、注释详尽，涵盖完整的游戏逻辑、UI交互及机器人对战系统，适合C++游戏开发初学者及棋牌行业转型者学习参考。
items.e: A cross-platform single-player mahjong game built with Cocos2d-X 3.17, featuring commercial-grade mahjong algorithms and AI engine. The project includes complete game logic, UI interactions, and robot opponent systems, with clean code and detailed comments, ideal for C++ beginners and those transitioning into the card game industry.

items.d: A Django address model and field. Addresses may be specified by address components or by performing an automatic Google Maps lookup.
items.z: Django Address 是一个用于存储和管理邮政地址的 Django 模型库，支持通过 Google Maps API 自动解析地址或手动输入地址组件。它提供标准化的地址结构（国家、州、地区、街道），并包含一个便捷的 AddressField 字段类型，简化地址的创建、更新和查询操作，适用于需要精确地址管理的 Web 应用。
items.e: Django Address is a Django library providing models and fields for storing and retrieving postal addresses. It supports automatic address resolution via Google Maps API or manual input of address components, offering a standardized structure (country, state, locality, street) and an AddressField for easy integration into Django models, ideal for applications requiring precise address handling.

items.d: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
items.z: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
items.e: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

items.e: This project automates daily synchronization of Douban movies and books to Notion via GitHub Actions, featuring web previews, WeChat-based tutorials, user communities, and ongoing updates with donation support.

items.e: This repository implements 23 classic design patterns in Python3, covering Creational, Structural, and Behavioral categories with clear examples and references, ideal for learning design patterns and improving software architecture skills.

items.d: 基于avalon的组件库

items.e: avalon.oniui is a UI component library developed by Qunar's frontend team, built on Avalon 1.4. It offers a comprehensive set of UI components (e.g., grids, dialogs, pagination) and utility modules (e.g., drag-and-drop, positioning, hotkeys), enabling modular integration for web applications with rich interactivity and data presentation.

items.d: A CLI for BOSS 直聘 — search jobs, view recommendations, manage applications via reverse-engineered API
items.z: boss-cli 是一个基于逆向工程 API 的 BOSS 直聘命令行工具，支持职位搜索、个性化推荐、申请管理、与招聘者聊天及发送问候等功能。具备多浏览器 Cookie 自动提取、丰富筛选条件、结构化输出和跨平台支持，适用于求职自动化场景。
items.e: boss-cli is a CLI tool for BOSS Zhipin that enables job searching, recommendations, application management, and recruiter chat via reverse-engineered APIs. It supports browser cookie extraction, advanced filtering, structured output, and cross-platform usage for automated job hunting.

items.d: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
items.z: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
items.e: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

items.d: Douban Search App Based on React Native
items.z: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
items.e: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

items.d: ProxyLLM是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话把多种 LLM网站的能力统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API, 一键应用到Claude Code (ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that captures browser sessions to unify the capabilities of multiple LLM websites into an OpenAI-compatible API, enabling one-click integration with Claude Code)
items.z: ProxyLLM 是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 等多平台 LLM 服务统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持一键集成 Claude Code。具备多站点管理、凭据自动捕获、OAuth 登录、动态模型发现及本地持久化日志等功能，提供完整的 OpenAI 格式接口与 Anthropic 原生 API 支持。
items.e: ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that unifies multiple LLM platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) into an OpenAI-compatible API by capturing browser sessions. It enables one-click integration with Claude Code, featuring multi-site management, automatic credential capture, OAuth login, dynamic model discovery, and local persistence, exposing both OpenAI-style and native Anthropic APIs.

items.d: django-debug-toolbar in WebKit DevTools. Works fine with background Ajax requests and non-HTML responses.
items.z: Django Debug Panel 将 Django Debug Toolbar 集成至 WebKit DevTools，支持 AJAX 请求和 HTML 响应外的调试场景，专为单页应用和 AJAX 密集型项目设计，提供浏览器内实时调试能力。
items.e: Django Debug Panel embeds the Django Debug Toolbar into WebKit DevTools, enabling debugging for AJAX requests and non-HTML responses. Ideal for single-page and AJAX-heavy applications, it offers in-browser real-time debugging.

items.d: Automated Grok (x.ai) account registration with DuckMail + headless server support. Auto-push SSO tokens to grok2api.
items.z: 基于 DrissionPage 的 Grok (x.ai) 账号自动化注册工具，集成 DuckMail 临时邮箱与 Chrome 扩展修复 CDP 缺陷绕过 Cloudflare Turnstile。支持无头服务器部署（Xvfb + playwright chromium），自动推送 SSO token 至 grok2api 号池，具备中英文界面适配与代理配置能力。
items.e: Automated Grok (x.ai) account registration tool using DrissionPage, DuckMail temporary emails, and Chrome extension patch to bypass Cloudflare Turnstile via CDP MouseEvent fix. Supports headless Linux deployment with Xvfb, auto-pushes SSO tokens to grok2api pool, includes proxy support and bilingual UI.

items.d: Flux AI Image generator
items.z: Next Money 是一个基于 Next.js 14 的全栈 SaaS 启动模板，集成 Stripe 支付、Clerk 认证、Supabase 数据库、React Email 和 Shadcn/ui 等现代技术栈，专为快速构建商业化 SaaS 产品而设计，提供完整的用户管理、支付处理与邮件通知解决方案。
items.e: Next Money is a full-stack SaaS starter template built with Next.js 14, integrating Stripe payments, Clerk authentication, Supabase database, React Email, and Shadcn/ui. It accelerates SaaS development with ready-to-use user management, payment processing, and email notification features.

items.d: 这是一个用于监控和检测 Ollama 服务可用性和性能的系统。它提供了一个现代化的 Web 界面，支持多语言（中文/英文），并具有实时检测和数据展示功能。
items.z: 这是一个专为 Ollama 服务设计的现代化监控系统，提供实时可用性检测、性能监控（响应时间/TPS）和模型状态展示。支持多语言界面、批量服务检测、FOFA 扫描及数据导出功能，采用 Next.js 14 + TypeScript 构建，具备响应式设计和国际化能力。
items.e: A modern monitoring system for Ollama services that provides real-time availability detection, performance metrics (response time/TPS), and model status tracking. Features multi-language support, batch service scanning, FOFA integration, data export, and a responsive web interface built with Next.js 14 and TypeScript.

items.d: TTS-文本转语音/文本转语音前端，兼容OpenAI、EdgeTTS等接口
items.z: LibreTTS 是一款开源在线文本转语音工具，支持300+种语言和口音的声音，兼容OpenAI与EdgeTTS等主流TTS接口。提供实时试听、语速语调调节、长文本分段处理、历史记录及自定义API配置功能，支持Vercel和Cloudflare Pages一键部署，适合个人或企业快速搭建私有化TTS服务。
items.e: LibreTTS is an open-source online text-to-speech tool supporting 300+ voices across multiple languages and accents. It integrates with OpenAI, EdgeTTS, and other compatible APIs, offering real-time preview, adjustable speech rate/pitch, long-text segmentation, history tracking, and custom API configuration. Deployable via Vercel or Cloudflare Pages for private TTS solutions.

items.d: AI 每日新闻简报 · GitHub 热门 + X 热门文章 + 行情技术分析 · 23 个数据源聚合 + LLM 中文摘要 · 本地或 GitHub Actions 部署
items.z: DailyBrief 是一款 AI 驱动的每日新闻简报工具，聚合 GitHub、X（推特）、财经及国际媒体等 23 个数据源，支持 21 个股票/加密标的的技术指标与 LLM 中文摘要。核心亮点包括：5 种可插拔 LLM 后端（Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax）、中英双语支持、零基础设施的 GitHub Actions 一键部署，以及单文件 HTML 无依赖输出。适用于个人投资者、技术极客及资讯聚合场景，实现自动化、个性化的每日简报生成。
items.e: DailyBrief is an AI-powered daily news briefing tool that aggregates content from 23 sources including GitHub, X (Twitter), financial and international media. It features real-time technical indicators for 21 stocks/crypto assets with LLM-generated Chinese summaries. Key highlights: 5 plug-and-play LLM backends (Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax), bilingual support, zero-infrastructure deployment via GitHub Actions, and standalone HTML output. Ideal for investors, tech enthusiasts, and automated information aggregation.

items.d: Django markdown support and wysiwig
items.z: Django-Markdown 是一个为 Django 框架提供 Markdown 富文本编辑支持的扩展应用，支持在模型字段、表单、管理后台及静态页面中集成所见即所得（WYSIWYG）编辑器，内置预览功能和可配置扩展，适用于内容管理系统（CMS）和文档类 Web 应用。
items.e: Django-Markdown is a Django app enabling Markdown WYSIWYG editing in models, forms, admin interfaces, and flatpages. It integrates a rich text editor with preview functionality, configurable extensions, and admin overrides, ideal for CMS and documentation-driven web applications.

items.d: TVBox的一个可以处理多源的版本，支持安卓4.4
items.z: Jade Box 是 TVBox 的多源增强版本，专为安卓4.4设备优化，支持横屏TV与竖屏手机版。核心功能包括多线路自动切换、直播源M3U格式兼容、智能更新提醒及触屏交互优化，提供灵活的自定义配置能力，适用于家庭影院与移动影视播放场景。
items.e: Jade Box is an enhanced multi-source version of TVBox, optimized for Android 4.4 devices, supporting both horizontal TV and vertical mobile layouts. It features automatic line switching, M3U live stream support, smart update notifications, and touch-optimized UI, enabling flexible customization for home theater and mobile media playback.

items.d: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
items.z: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
items.e: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

items.d: A Web-app for OpenManus
items.z: OpenManusWeb 是一个基于 OpenManus 的 Web 应用，提供无需邀请码即可使用的 AI 智能体服务。该项目由 MetaGPT 团队开发，支持快速部署和自定义代理任务，具备完整的网页界面和演示视频，适用于自动化任务处理和智能决策场景。
items.e: OpenManusWeb is a web application built on OpenManus that enables access to AI agents without an invite code. Developed by the MetaGPT team, it offers customizable agent workflows with a user-friendly interface, supporting automation tasks and intelligent decision-making through a complete web-based platform.

items.d: [Unmaintained] An easy to use material design based framework.
items.z: Material Framework 是一个轻量级、纯 CSS 实现的 Material Design 前端框架，提供完整的组件样式与响应式布局支持，适用于快速构建现代化网页应用，依赖 Google Material Design 图标与自定义配色方案。
items.e: Material Framework is a lightweight, CSS-only implementation of Material Design, offering complete component styling and responsive layouts for rapid development of modern web applications, leveraging Google's Material Design Icons and custom color schemes.

items.d: 更好的Autoteam，实现前端到后端全方位的加强，同时可以批量获取免费号
items.z: AutoTeam-F 是基于 cnitlrt/AutoTeam 的增强版工具，核心改进在于实现免费 ChatGPT Personal 账号批量注册（Fix + Free），并优化操作体验。支持临时邮箱自动注册、Codex OAuth 双模式认证、智能轮转与额度管理、CPA 双向同步、Web 面板可视化操作及 Docker 部署，提供失败分类诊断与软停止等实用功能。
items.e: AutoTeam-F is an enhanced fork of cnitlrt/AutoTeam, focusing on batch generation of free ChatGPT Personal accounts (Fix + Free) and improved UX. It supports automated registration via temp email (cf_temp_email/maillab), Codex OAuth for Team/Personal modes, smart rotation with quota monitoring, CPA bidirectional sync, web dashboard, Docker deployment, failure diagnostics, and soft-stop capabilities.

items.d: The first browser AI Agent extension to support Agent Skills, enabling AI to perform complex tasks through an expandable skill system. 🌟 Star if you like it! | 首个支持 Agent Skills 的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，让 AI 通过可扩展技能系统执行复杂任务 🌟 如果喜欢请点个 Star！
items.z: Tactus 是首个支持 Agent Skills 规范的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，通过可扩展技能系统让 AI 执行复杂任务。支持多模型对话、网页内容理解、图像识别及 HTTP MCP 外部工具集成，具备脚本安全执行与信任机制，实现高效自动化操作。
items.e: Tactus is the first browser AI Agent extension implementing the Agent Skills specification, enabling complex task execution via an extensible skill system. It supports multi-model conversations, page understanding, vision capabilities, and HTTP MCP integration, with secure script execution and user trust controls for efficient automation.

items.d: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到企业微信，无须VPN，速度快
items.z: 本项目实现零代码一键部署ChatGPT至企业微信，无需翻墙，支持手机端与电脑端使用。基于OpenAI API构建，提供智能问答、客服自动化等能力，适用于企业内部沟通、客户服务及营销场景，大幅降低沟通成本并提升效率。
items.e: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into WeCom (WeChat Enterprise), with no need for VPN. It integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT API to deliver intelligent Q&A and automated customer service, enhancing internal communication and business efficiency across mobile and desktop platforms.

items.z: 基于 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的多平台AI写作助手，提供从选题、创作到审校的全流程自动化工作流。通过个人素材库学习作者风格，采用三遍审校机制降低AI味至15-20%，集成标题优化、配图Prompt生成等功能，支持微信公众号、Twitter、小红书等多平台内容适配。
items.e: A multi-platform AI writing agent built on Claude Sonnet 4.5, offering end-to-end automation from ideation to publication. Features style learning via personal material library, three-round editing to reduce AI flavor to 15-20%, and integrated title optimization with image prompt generation, supporting content adaptation across WeChat, Twitter, Xiaohongshu and other platforms.

items.d: Urban governance - Where is the restroom?
items.z: 该应用为解决城市如厕难问题，提供附近2公里内卫生间实时搜索、导航及基础信息查询，集成地图、天气、文章推荐等功能，采用高德地图、七牛云存储、微信公众号及阿里云部署，展示如何快速构建实用型移动应用。
items.e: This app addresses urban restroom accessibility by enabling users to search nearby toilets within 2km, view basic info, and get navigation. It integrates map services, weather, articles, and uses platforms like Amap, Qiniu Cloud, WeChat, and Aliyun for rapid deployment of a practical mobile solution.

items.d: 使用任何设备(浏览器)作为mac的副屏(随航) 将Android平板用作Mac的第二台显示器 还能在Win和Linux镜像屏幕
items.z: 咩Display 是一款跨平台屏幕镜像工具，支持将任意带浏览器的设备（如 Android 平板）作为 Mac 的副屏，实现类似 Apple 随航的功能。基于 ffmpeg 实时转码，支持 mjpg、vp8、h264、hevc 多种编码，延迟低至 100ms（mjpg 模式），适用于 Windows/Linux 屏幕镜像。内置自动旋转、全屏切换，支持通过 ADB 实现 Android 有线连接，适合多屏办公与移动场景。
items.e: meDisplay is a cross-platform screen mirroring tool that turns any browser-equipped device (e.g., Android tablet) into a secondary display for Mac, mimicking Apple's Sidecar. Built with real-time ffmpeg transcoding, it supports mjpg, vp8, h264, and hevc encoding with ultra-low latency (as low as 100ms in mjpg mode). Also supports Windows/Linux X11 mirroring, auto-rotation, fullscreen toggle, and ADB-based Android wired connection for seamless multi-screen workflows.

items.d: 微信公众号文章抓取 & Markdown 转换工具
items.z: 该工具利用 Camoufox 实现反检测抓取，自动提取微信公众号文章的标题、账号、发布时间及原文链接，并将 HTML 内容转换为结构清晰的 Markdown 格式，同时下载图片至本地并重写链接，支持代码块语法高亮，适用于内容归档与知识管理。
items.e: This tool uses Camoufox for anti-detection fetching to extract WeChat Official Account articles, converting HTML content into clean Markdown with metadata (title, account, publish time, URL), downloading images locally, and preserving code blocks with language syntax. Ideal for content archiving and knowledge management.

items.d: 基于deno的抖音视频图文无水印下载，支持cf worker,vercel,deno deploy,docker部署
items.z: 基于 Deno 的抖音无水印视频与图文下载服务，支持多平台部署（Deno Deploy、Cloudflare Workers、Vercel、Docker），通过简单 API 调用即可解析并返回原始媒体链接，适用于内容抓取与自动化处理场景。
items.e: A Deno-based service for downloading watermark-free Douyin videos and images via URL parsing, supporting deployment on Deno Deploy, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and Docker. Provides clean media links through a simple GET API for content extraction and automation.

items.d: Dynamic-memory-first collaborative AI framework for long-form story generation, chapter planning, and coherent narrative writing
items.z: NovelClaw 是一个动态记忆优先的协作式 AI 框架，专为长篇章小说生成设计。它将传统写作转化为可检查的工作空间，支持章节规划、角色与世界观管理、内存银行编辑，并提供会话追踪和手稿审阅功能，实现连贯叙事创作。
items.e: NovelClaw is a dynamic-memory-first collaborative AI framework for long-form story generation, transforming writing into an inspectable workspace with chapter planning, character/worldview management, memory banks, and manuscript review for coherent narrative creation.

items.d: 基于 team-manage 增强的ChatGPT团队账号管理系统，集成了一键 Token 提取、CPA 凭证导出、Token 自动刷新与福利车位分发等实用功能。
items.z: 基于 FastAPI 的 ChatGPT Team 车位管理系统，集成一键 Token 提取、CPA 凭证导出、Token 自动刷新与福利车位分发功能。支持团队账号批量导入、兑换码管理、库存预警、Webhook 联动及售后风控，专为稳定运营场景优化。
items.e: A FastAPI-based ChatGPT Team management system featuring one-click token extraction, CPA credential export, automatic token refresh, and benefit seat distribution. Supports bulk team import, voucher management, inventory alerts, webhook integration, and after-sales risk control for stable operations.

items.z: 暂无描述。
K.I.R.O Register 是一款基于 Playwright 的 AWS Builder ID 账号自动化注册管理工具，支持无头模式批量注册、多邮件服务集成（ShiroMail/TempForward）、Token 自动刷新、Stripe Pro 订阅支付及反检测机制，提供 GUI 界面与 SQLite 本地管理，适用于大规模云开发账号自动化运维。
items.e: K.I.R.O Register is an automation tool for AWS Builder ID account registration, built with Playwright. It supports batch sign-ups via headless mode, integrates multiple email services (e.g., ShiroMail, TempForward), auto-refreshes tokens, manages Stripe-based Pro subscriptions, and includes anti-detection features like browser fingerprint randomization. Features a GUI interface and local SQLite storage for scalable cloud developer account management.

items.d: Local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app — pull gpt, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek into one conversation. Tauri 2 + React 19.
items.z: Talkio 是一款本地优先的多 AI 群聊桌面应用，支持将 GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 等模型整合进同一对话。基于 Tauri 2 + React 19 构建，具备身份角色系统、MCP 工具调用、文件解析、流式输出等功能，提供跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux/Android）体验，所有数据加密存储于本地 SQLite，保障隐私安全。
items.e: Talkio is a local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app that integrates models like GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek into one conversation. Built with Tauri 2 + React 19, it features persona-based roleplay, MCP tool integration, file parsing, streaming output, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android), with all data encrypted locally in SQLite for privacy.

items.d: Hexo七牛同步插件
items.z: Hexo七牛同步插件是一个专为Hexo博客设计的自动化工具，支持将本地静态资源（图片、JS、CSS）自动同步至七牛云存储，无需手动上传。通过配置实现一键部署，支持图片处理、缩略图生成及离线预览，提升博客资源管理效率。
items.e: Hexo Qiniu Sync is an automation plugin for Hexo blogs that synchronizes local static assets (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage. It enables one-click deployment with image processing, thumbnail generation, and offline preview support, streamlining resource management.

items.d: 基于Go语言编写的ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现GPT-Image-2生图，兼容多OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生成图像
items.z: ChatGPT2API 是一个基于 Go 的 ChatGPT 官网接口逆向实现，提供 OpenAI 兼容的图片生成、编辑 API 及多模型文本处理能力。支持号池管理、CPA/sub2api 账号导入、Docker 自托管部署，并集成 React 前端创作台与权限管理系统，适用于非商业性技术研究与个人开发场景。
items.e: ChatGPT2API is a Go-based reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interface, offering OpenAI-compatible image generation, editing APIs, and multi-model text support. It features account pool management, CPA/sub2api integration, Docker deployment, and a React frontend with creation studio and RBAC permissions—designed for non-commercial R&D use.

items.z: bestK/tv 是一个基于 Next.js 的现代化电视直播应用，支持多源直播流聚合、频道分类与搜索功能，提供响应式界面与 EdgeOne Pages 一键部署，适用于构建个人或社区级 IPTV 平台。
items.e: bestK/tv is a modern TV streaming app built with Next.js, featuring multi-source live stream aggregation, channel categorization, and search functionality. It offers a responsive interface and one-click deployment via EdgeOne Pages, ideal for building personal or community IPTV platforms.

items.d: 一个先进的聊天应用，演示了一种独特的对话范式：用户的查询首先由两个不同的人工智能角色进行辩论和提炼，然后才提供最终的综合答案。该项目利用 Google Gemini API 驱动一个逻辑型 AI (Cognito) 和一个怀疑型 AI (Muse)，它们协作生成更健壮、准确和经过严格审查的响应。
items.z: Dual AI Chat 是一个基于 React 19 的先进聊天应用，创新性地引入双 AI 协作范式：逻辑型 Cognito 与创意型 Muse 通过内部辩论提炼答案，结合 Google Gemini 深度思考模型，提供更高准确性、全面性和严谨性的综合响应。
items.e: Dual AI Chat is an advanced chat application built with React 19 that introduces a novel dual-AI collaboration paradigm. It leverages two distinct AI personas—Cognito (logical) and Muse (creative)—to debate and refine responses, enhanced by Google Gemini's deep thinking capabilities for more accurate, comprehensive, and rigorously vetted answers.

items.d: A ShadowsocksR client for Android4.0+.Compatible Shadowsocks protocol and support some ShadowsocksR function.
items.z: ShadowsocksR Droid 是一款专为 Android 4.0+ 设备设计的 ShadowsocksR 客户端，兼容 Shadowsocks 协议并支持部分 ShadowsocksR 功能，采用 Kotlin 和 Java 开发，提供跨平台网络代理解决方案。
items.e: ShadowsocksR Droid is an Android 4.0+ client for ShadowsocksR, compatible with Shadowsocks protocol and supporting some ShadowsocksR features. Built with Kotlin and Java, it offers a cross-platform network proxy solution for enhanced privacy and access.

items.d: Browser-Use Desktop app, control your local Chrome browser with AI agents!
items.z: Browser-Use Desktop 是一款基于 Electron 和 Gradio 的桌面应用，通过 AI 智能体控制本地 Chrome 浏览器，实现网页自动化操作。支持多模态 LLM（如 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 等）和自定义浏览器配置，无需重新登录网站，支持高清屏幕录制，适用于网页抓取、自动化测试等场景。
items.e: Browser-Use Desktop is an Electron-based desktop app that enables AI agents to control your local Chrome browser via Gradio UI. It supports multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.), custom browser profiles, and high-definition screen recording, eliminating re-authentication issues and ideal for web automation and scraping tasks.

items.d: 借用的都是大佬的本地接口和在线接口。
items.z: TVBox 是一个基于开源接口的电视直播与点播平台，集成多个大佬提供的本地和在线数据接口，支持多源切换、高清播放及自定义配置，适用于家庭娱乐与媒体中心场景。
items.e: TVBox is an open-source IPTV and video-on-demand platform that aggregates local and online data interfaces from various contributors. It supports multi-source switching, high-definition playback, and customizable configurations for home entertainment and media center use.

items.d: 一个用于重新生成 Cursor 设备 ID 和设置 Access Token 的 Cursor 扩展
items.z: Fake Cursor 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VS Code 扩展，支持重新生成设备 ID、修补机器码获取逻辑及设置 Access Token，实现多账号共用同一设备。支持 0.45.x~0.46.x 版本，具备使用情况监控、自动备份配置等功能，适用于 Windows/macOS/Linux 系统。
items.e: Fake Cursor is a VS Code extension for Cursor editor that enables device ID regeneration, machine code patching, and Access Token configuration to allow multiple accounts on one device. Supports Cursor 0.45.x-0.46.x, featuring usage monitoring, config backup, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux).

items.z: 该项目为基于 GNU GPL v3.0 协议的 ChatBot，提供基础对话功能，适用于简单交互场景。由于项目已停止维护，建议用于学习或轻量级原型开发。
items.e: This project is a no-longer-maintained ChatBot licensed under GNU GPL v3.0, offering basic conversational capabilities for simple interaction scenarios. Suitable for learning or lightweight prototyping.

items.d: 快速、明确、极简
items.z: 妹Blog v2 是一款基于 PHP+MySQL 的极简静态博客系统，采用 iTorr.JS 和 Q.JS 框架实现前后端分离，支持 Markdown 写作、代码高亮、多用户、分类管理、原生评论及多说集成，并针对 SAE/Hostker 云环境优化部署，提供缓存、模板与静态化加速，适合追求快速搭建与内容优先的个人博客。
items.e: Imouto v2 is a minimalist static blog system built with PHP+MySQL, leveraging iTorr.JS and Q.JS for frontend-backend separation. It supports Markdown writing, syntax highlighting, multi-user management, categories, native and Duoshuo comments, and is optimized for cloud platforms like SAE and Hostker. Features include caching, templating, static generation, and AJAX search for fast content delivery.

items.z: Auto.js 是一个基于无障碍服务的 Android 平台 JavaScript IDE，支持自动化操作、界面录制、控件选择器及脚本打包。本修改版修复了内存泄漏、优化调度机制、集成 PaddleOCR、ONNXRuntime 和 ncnn 推理引擎，增强模型本地推理能力，适用于蚂蚁森林等脚本场景，同时支持防检测变包名功能。
items.e: Auto.js is an Android-based JavaScript IDE leveraging accessibility services for automation, featuring UI recording, powerful selector APIs, and APK packaging. This modified version fixes memory leaks, integrates PaddleOCR, ONNXRuntime, and ncnn for local model inference, supports anti-detection via fake package names, and is optimized for stable script execution in apps like Ant Forest.

items.d: a simple but powerful tool for validating form fields.  support bootstrap and your own styles.
items.z: SMValidator 是一个轻量、无依赖的前端表单验证工具，支持通过 HTML 属性或 JavaScript 配置验证规则，兼容 Bootstrap 和 Semantic UI 样式，支持正则表达式和自定义函数验证，兼容 IE8+，提供灵活的错误提示与样式定制能力。
items.e: SMValidator is a lightweight, dependency-free form validation tool that supports rule configuration via HTML attributes or JavaScript. It integrates with Bootstrap and Semantic UI, supports RegExp and custom function validation, and is compatible with IE8+, offering flexible error messaging and styling options.

items.d: 🎙️Voice input and translation app for macOS. Press to talk, release to paste.
items.z: Voxt 是一款专为 macOS 设计的语音输入与翻译应用，支持全局热键录音、实时波形显示、多引擎语音识别（本地 MLX 和远程 ASR 服务）及文本增强翻译，具备剪贴板安全粘贴、历史记录管理和多模式触发机制，适用于跨语言实时转录与翻译场景。
items.e: Voxt is a macOS menu bar app for voice input and translation, featuring global hotkey recording, real-time waveform display, multi-engine speech recognition (local MLX and remote ASR), text enhancement, and clipboard-safe auto-paste. It supports transcription, translation, selected-text processing, and history management with configurable providers.

items.d: AI-enhanced reading tool for immersive language learning using the n+1 method. Learn languages by staying in the target language ecosystem, with a flow-state focused interface.

Features modular architecture for easy expansion, including intelligent conversation, image generation/analysis, multilingual support, and Redis caching for high-performance deployment.

items.z: Atlas 是专为 OpenClaw 生态设计的专业 AI 赏金猎人技能，支持自动发现 GitHub、Upwork 等平台的高回报任务，通过智能 ROI 矩阵评估收益与成本，并生成高质量代码提交。具备身份管理、止损保护及自动化交付能力，助力智能体高效完成付费任务。
items.e: Atlas is a professional AI bounty hunter skill for the OpenClaw ecosystem, autonomously discovering high-value tasks on GitHub, Upwork, and bug bounty platforms. It uses a smart ROI matrix to evaluate profitability, manages identity as a senior developer, and delivers high-quality pull requests with test evidence, featuring built-in stop-loss protection.

items.d: 🚀 UniHub - 现代化的跨平台工具集应用，支持强大的插件系统 | Modern cross-platform toolkit with powerful plugin system
items.z: UniHub 是基于 Electron 的现代化跨平台工具集应用，采用 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite 技术栈，配备强大的插件系统和内置插件市场。支持动态插件加载、细粒度权限管理、自动更新检测等功能，提供优雅的 Tailwind CSS 界面和全局快捷键操作体验。
items.e: UniHub is a modern cross-platform toolkit built with Electron, Vue 3, TypeScript, and Vite. It features a powerful plugin system with dynamic loading, granular permission control, built-in marketplace, and automatic update detection. The app offers an elegant UI powered by Tailwind CSS and global keyboard shortcuts for enhanced productivity.

items.d: 影子作家（ghostwriter），一些人的写作或语言特征。

items.e: The 'ghostwriter' project provides structured linguistic feature datasets in JSON format, covering sources like Weibo, literary characters, and historical figures. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for non-commercial use, it enhances AI text generation when combined with large language models featuring long context capabilities, ideal for character simulation and stylistic analysis.

items.d: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr; alternate
items.z: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
items.e: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

items.d: Parallel Programming with Python简体中文版
items.z: 《Parallel Programming with Python》简体中文版是一本系统讲解Python并行编程的书籍，涵盖并发、并行与分布式编程的核心概念、算法设计与实践工具。内容从GIL限制、通信机制到分治、数据分解、管道任务等并行模式，结合斐波那契计算与网页爬取等实例，帮助开发者识别可并行问题并高效实现多核/分布式加速。
items.e: The Chinese translation of 'Parallel Programming with Python' is a comprehensive guide covering core concepts, algorithms, and tools for concurrent, parallel, and distributed programming in Python. It addresses GIL limitations, communication patterns, and parallel design techniques like divide-and-conquer and data decomposition, with practical examples such as Fibonacci computation and web scraping to demonstrate parallelizable problems and multi-core/distributed acceleration.

items.d: WeSpy 是一个用于获取wx公众号文章并转换为 Markdown 格式的 Python 工具
items.z: WeSpy 是一个专为微信公众号设计的 Python 工具，可抓取文章并转换为 Markdown 格式，支持防盗链处理、专辑批量下载及多格式输出（Markdown/HTML/JSON），提供命令行和 Python API 两种使用方式。
items.e: WeSpy is a Python tool designed for scraping WeChat Official Account articles and converting them to Markdown format. It supports anti-hotlinking image handling, batch album downloads, and multi-format output (Markdown/HTML/JSON), with both CLI and Python API interfaces.

items.d: Deepin Terminal written by vala

items.e: Deepin Terminal is the default terminal emulator for Deepin OS, built with Vala, offering multi-tab, split-screen, customizable shortcuts, and theming for efficient command-line workflows.

items.d: A declarative, SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in Swift.
items.z: TUIkit 是一个 SwiftUI 风格的终端用户界面框架，提供纯 Swift 实现的声明式 TUI 开发体验。支持状态管理、布局容器、交互组件和完整样式系统，无需 ncurses 或 C 依赖，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 平台。
items.e: TUIkit is a SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in pure Swift, offering declarative syntax with state management, layout containers, interactive components, and full styling support without ncurses or C dependencies.

items.e: An open-source personal blog system built with Django 1.6, featuring article management, support for RST/HTML/Markdown content, integration with Duoshuo comments, RSS, and WeChat auto-reply. Includes xadmin backend and Ansible deployment script for easy setup and learning.

items.d: Android Client for Carbon Forum with Material Design.
items.z: Android-Carbon-Forum 是一个基于 Material Design 的 Carbon Forum 论坛 Android 客户端，提供流畅的移动端浏览体验，支持主题查看、发帖、登录、通知推送等功能，采用模块化架构便于二次开发和定制部署。
items.e: Android-Carbon-Forum is an Android client for Carbon Forum built with Material Design, offering seamless mobile browsing, topic viewing, posting, login, and push notifications. It features a modular architecture for easy customization and deployment.

items.z: hexo-theme-Daily 是一个简洁优雅的 Hexo 主题，专为版本 4.x 设计，提供现代化的博客展示体验。支持 SASS 渲染，兼容 IE9+，内置完整文档和演示站点，适合个人或团队快速搭建美观静态博客。
items.e: hexo-theme-Daily is a clean and modern theme for Hexo (v4.x), featuring simple design and full compatibility with IE9+. It supports SASS rendering, includes demo sites, documentation, and is ideal for building elegant static blogs quickly.

items.d: 麻将AI算法（包含全概率估算、局部概率估算、深度学习版本）
items.z: 该仓库实现多种麻将AI算法，包括基于KNN的全局与局部概率估算、深度学习版本。核心功能涵盖听牌匹配、胡牌概率计算及最优出牌决策，支持万筒条三色14张牌判断，C语言单线程性能达6秒，Lua版约900秒，具备跨平台扩展潜力。
items.e: This repository implements multiple Mahjong AI algorithms, including full and local probability estimation via KNN and deep learning. Key features include tile matching for winning hands, probability calculation for optimal discards, and decision-making support for 14-tile games (Mentsu, Pinzu, Souzu). C version processes in 6 seconds (single-thread), Lua in 900s, with plans to optimize via color-based segmentation.

items.d: 一个现代化的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，为AI助手提供交互式用户反馈收集功能。

items.e: MCP Feedback Collector is a modern Model Context Protocol server for interactive user feedback collection in AI assistants. It supports multi-image uploads, text feedback, and a Chinese GUI with a 700x800px interface. Installable via uvx, it enhances AI-human interaction in tools like Claude Desktop.

items.d: Open-source framework to make AI agents' team collaboration as effective as human collaboration.
items.z: L3AGI 是一个开源框架，旨在让 AI 智能体团队协作达到人类团队的高效水平。它支持构建和管理自主 AI 助手团队，具备记忆能力、多数据源集成（如 PostgreSQL、MySQL、VectorDB）和 LlamaIndex 支持，适用于复杂任务协作与自动化场景。
items.e: L3AGI is an open-source framework enabling AI agents to collaborate as effectively as human teams. It supports autonomous AI assistants with memory, multi-data source integration (PostgreSQL, MySQL, VectorDB), and LlamaIndex, ideal for complex task automation and team-based workflows.

items.d: 🧠 Cortex - Universal AI Agent Memory Service
items.z: Cortex 是一个开源的通用 AI 智能体记忆服务，通过三层动态内存生命周期（工作记忆→核心记忆→归档）实现长期记忆管理。结合 Neo4j 知识图谱与混合搜索（BM25+向量+LLM重排），支持多智能体隔离命名空间、自托管部署及 MCP 协议集成，确保数据主权与低成本运行。
items.e: Cortex is an open-source universal AI agent memory service featuring a three-tier dynamic lifecycle (Working → Core → Archive) for persistent, adaptive memory management. It combines Neo4j knowledge graphs with hybrid search (BM25 + vectors + LLM reranking), supports multi-agent namespaces, self-hosting via Docker, and MCP integration, ensuring data ownership and low-cost operation.

items.e: Article Writer is an AI-powered intelligent writing system designed for WeChat Official Accounts and self-media content. items.d: Desktop operations console for CPA-managed Codex auth pools.

items.e: CPA Control Center is a desktop operations tool for managing Codex auth pools via CPA, built with Wails using Go, Vue 3, and TypeScript. It connects to a CPA instance via Base URL and Management Token, enabling inventory sync, scanning, maintenance, scheduling, logs, history tracking, and CSV/JSON exports. Designed for large-scale pools, it offers real-time health monitoring, bilingual UI (English/Chinese), and automated quota refresh.

items.d: 灵匠 - AI 驱动的创意内容生成平台，支持 AI 图像生成、视频生成、角色项目管理、可视化工作流编辑等功能。

items.e: SoulArtisan is an AI-powered creative content generation platform featuring text-to-image, image-to-video, and character management. Built with Spring Boot and React, it offers visual workflow editing via node-based design for end-to-end creation from scripts to videos, complete with point systems and cloud storage for production use.

items.d: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
items.z: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
items.e: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

items.e: This bash script checks VPS IP availability across major OTT platforms, supporting custom exit IPs, proxies, DNS settings, and network protocols via curl. Designed for Debian systems with flexible flags for diverse network configurations.

Its standout feature is integrated AI assistance for generating, optimizing, and interpreting SQL queries, enhancing productivity for developers and DBAs.

items.d: Django tools for building nonrel backends
items.z: Djangotoolbox 是 Django 的非关系型数据库后端通用工具包，提供标准化接口支持在 NoSQL 数据库上运行 Django。它包含字段类型（如 ListField、DictField）、管理后台适配及权限处理支持，帮助开发者构建兼容 Django ORM 的非关系型数据层。
items.e: Djangotoolbox is a Django utility library providing a unified API for running Django on non-relational/NoSQL databases. items.d: Node-based workflow for orchestrating codebase context and specifications for AI agents.
items.z: SpexFlow 是基于 React Flow 的可视化上下文/规范工作流工具，专为 AI 智能体设计。它将具体功能需求转化为：1) 精选代码库上下文（通过代码搜索或手动选择），2) LLM 生成的高质量实现方案，3) 可直接粘贴给 Codex/Claude Code 等工具的干净提示词。支持节点式编排、缓存重用和 Spec 管理，优化‘一次性完成一个明确功能’的开发流程。
items.e: SpexFlow is a visual context/spec workflow tool built on React Flow for orchestrating codebase context and specifications for AI agents. It transforms concrete feature requests into: 1) curated repo context via code search or manual selection, 2) high-quality implementation plans from LLMs, and 3) clean prompts for fresh-context coding agents (Codex/Claude Code). Optimized for 'finish one well-defined feature in one shot' with node-based workflows, caching, and spec management.

items.d: 节点过滤器
items.z: ProxyFilter 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Clash 代理配置过滤工具，支持多格式输入（YAML、Base64、URI列表），智能匹配中英文地区名称，过滤 VMess、Shadowsocks、Trojan 等协议节点，自动去重并支持多源合并与自定义命名，适用于高效管理代理订阅。
items.e: ProxyFilter is a Cloudflare Workers-based tool for filtering Clash proxy configurations. It supports multiple input formats (YAML, Base64, URI lists), intelligently matches region names in Chinese and English, filters nodes by protocol (VMess, Shadowsocks, Trojan, etc.), removes duplicates, and merges multiple sources with customizable naming.

items.d: 基于 [Karpathy llm-wiki]方法论，利用 AI 持续构建和维护你的个人知识库。支持从多种素材源（网页、推特、公众号、小红书、知乎、YouTube、PDF、本地文件）自动整理为结构化的 wiki，并通过 Quartz 发布为静态wiki知识库网站。 并通过 claude_agent_sdk 调用 claude agent 使用 llm-wiki ,提供api接口对外访问服务 。
items.z: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论构建的个人 AI 知识库系统，支持从网页、社交媒体、PDF 等多元素材源自动提取并结构化生成 wiki 内容，通过 Quartz 发布为静态网站，并利用 Claude Agent SDK 提供 API 服务，实现端到端的智能知识管理与检索增强生成（RAG）。
items.e: A personal AI knowledge base system based on Karpathy's llm-wiki methodology, enabling automated ingestion and structuring of content from diverse sources (web, social media, PDFs) into a wiki format. It publishes knowledge via Quartz as a static site and exposes capabilities through the Claude Agent SDK with RESTful APIs for agentic RAG applications.

items.d: PyTime is an easy-use Python module which aims to operate date/time/datetime by string.
items.z: PyTime 是一个简洁易用的 Python 模块，专注于通过字符串操作日期、时间和 datetime 对象。它支持解析非标准格式的日期字符串（如 '2015.5.17'、'April 3rd 2015'），并允许通过自然语言式字符串进行时间加减运算（如 '2years 3mon'）。同时提供周、月时间区间计算及节日生成功能，适用于脚本自动化与数据处理场景。
items.e: PyTime is a user-friendly Python module designed to handle date/time/datetime operations via string input. It parses irregular date formats (e.g., '2015.5.17', 'NOV21th2015') and supports natural-language-like timedelta calculations (e.g., '2years 3mon'). Features include week/month interval generation, holiday computation, and datetime arithmetic, making it ideal for automation and data processing tasks.

items.z: Kiro Manager 是一款跨平台桌面应用，基于 Wails + Vue 3 构建，专用于 Kiro IDE 账号管理、Machine ID 备份恢复与自动切换。支持多账号切换、Token 自动刷新、批量操作及智能环境快照切换，具备低余额预警、进程检测和无感切号等核心功能，显著提升开发者在多订阅环境下的使用效率。
items.e: Kiro Manager is a cross-platform desktop application built with Wails and Vue 3, designed for managing Kiro IDE accounts, Machine ID backup/restore, and automated environment switching. It supports multi-account management, token auto-refresh, batch operations, low-balance alerts, process detection, and seamless snapshot switching—enhancing developer productivity across subscription tiers.

items.d: 🧠 OpenClaw 融合记忆方案 — 三层 cron 自动记忆提取/蒸馏/巩固，零插件、零侵入、永不失忆
items.z: OpenClaw Memory Fusion 是一个基于 OpenClaw 原生能力的融合记忆增强方案，通过三层 cron 机制（每小时/每天/每周）实现自动记忆提取、蒸馏与巩固。采用本地 session JSONL 为事实源，LLM 提炼高信噪比内容，Markdown 落盘确保可审计性。具备增量游标防重放、防套娃污染、Telegram 运维通知等特性，支持零插件侵入部署。
items.e: OpenClaw Memory Fusion is a memory enhancement solution built on OpenClaw's native capabilities, featuring three-tier cron automation (hourly/daily/weekly) for automatic memory extraction, distillation, and consolidation. It uses local session JSONL as the truth source, LLM-based refinement with high-signal input, and Markdown storage for auditability. Key features include incremental byte-offset cursors to prevent duplication, anti-recursion safeguards, and Telegram-based operational notifications, enabling zero-plugin deployment.

items.d: notion客户端汉化，包括mac和win
items.z: 本项目为Notion桌面客户端（v3.1.0）提供完整汉化支持，涵盖Windows与macOS系统。通过替换`app.asar`文件实现界面本地化，保留原有功能的同时提升中文用户体验，适用于需要中文界面的Notion用户。
items.e: This project provides full Chinese localization for Notion desktop client (v3.1.0), supporting both Windows and macOS. By replacing the `app.asar` file, it enables native Chinese UI while preserving all original functionality, ideal for users requiring a localized interface.

items.d: 让 Z.ai Chat 物尽其用
items.z: zai-proxy 是一个 Go 语言开发的代理服务，将 z.ai 网页聊天接口转换为 OpenAI API 和 Anthropic Messages API 兼容格式。支持 GLM 及 Claude 模型自动映射、流式响应、多模态输入、函数调用、联网搜索等高级功能，提供匿名 token 免登录访问，支持 Docker 部署和自定义代理池配置。
items.e: zai-proxy is a Go-based proxy service that transforms z.ai web chat into OpenAI and Anthropic API-compatible formats. It supports model mapping (GLM/Claude), streaming responses, multimodal inputs, function calling, search mode, anonymous access, Docker deployment, and custom proxy pools for enhanced reliability.

items.e: A minimalist single-page blog built with Vue and GitHub API, powered by GitHub Issues for content. Supports custom configuration and CI/CD via GitHub Actions for static site deployment.

items.d: pac

items.d: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级“从想法到结构化图谱”的工作台：输入一个核心想法，应用会把它扩展为可浏览的知识图谱（模块/子模块）。每个节点支持继续追问扩展、深挖详情，以及可选的配图生成。
items.z: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级‘从想法到结构化图谱’工作台，支持输入核心概念自动生成可交互知识图谱。具备AI驱动发散扩展、深度内容挖掘、视觉配图生成、沉浸式演示模式等功能，采用Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core技术栈，实现本地优先的零平台锁定体验。
items.e: ThinkFlow AI is a lightweight 'idea-to-structured-graph' workspace that transforms core concepts into interactive knowledge graphs. Features AI-driven divergence expansion, deep content mining, visual image generation, immersive presentation mode, and local-first architecture with zero platform lock-in. Built with Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core stack.

items.d: Easy PJAX for Django
items.z: django-easy-pjax 是一个为 Django 项目提供 PJAX 支持的轻量级应用，通过智能模板切换实现无刷新页面加载，提升用户体验。它自动根据请求头选择基础模板，支持缓存清理与 URL 净化，无需修改视图或 URL 配置，集成简单且兼容性强。
items.e: django-easy-pjax is a lightweight Django app that enables PJAX support by intelligently switching templates to enable partial page loads without full reloads. It auto-selects base or PJAX-specific templates based on HTTP headers, supports cache-busting cleanup, and requires no view or URL changes, making integration seamless and non-intrusive.

items.d: 一个强大的 VS Code AI 编程助手
items.z: LimCode 是一款强大的 VS Code AI 编程助手，支持多模态 AI 模型（Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic）及自定义格式，具备智能工具调用能力，可读写文件、执行命令、处理图像等。采用模块化架构，集成 MCP 协议扩展功能，支持对话存档与上下文总结，显著提升开发效率。
items.e: LimCode is a powerful VS Code AI programming assistant supporting multi-modal models (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and custom formats. It features intelligent tool-calling for file operations, command execution, image processing, and MCP protocol integration. With conversation archiving, context summarization, and modular architecture, it enhances developer productivity significantly.

items.d: Get a better UI of V2EX.
items.z: v2ex.k 是一款专为 V2EX 设计的界面增强浏览器插件，采用 Vue 重构，提供全新配色、左侧导航栏和快速阅读模式。支持主题切换、全键盘操作及 URL 动态更新，显著提升浏览效率与视觉体验。
items.e: v2ex.k is a browser extension that enhances the V2EX website with a modern UI, featuring new themes, sidebar navigation, quick-read mode, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic URL updates for improved browsing efficiency and user experience.

items.d: It is a materializecss.com implementation with Vue.js.
items.z: material-ui-vue 是一个基于 Vue.js 的 MaterializeCSS 组件库实现，提供 Material Design 风格的 UI 组件封装。支持通过 npm 安装，需配合 MaterializeCSS 资源文件使用，适用于快速构建现代化前端界面，但当前版本为试验性质，稳定性未经验证。
items.e: material-ui-vue is a Vue.js implementation of MaterializeCSS, offering Material Design UI components. It can be installed via npm and requires MaterializeCSS assets including CSS, JS, and jQuery. Designed for rapid development of modern web interfaces, though marked as unstable and not recommended for production use.

items.d: Detect file modification in background and push it to git automatically.
items.z: file_sync 是一个轻量级自动化工具，通过监听文件变化并自动提交到 Git 仓库，实现配置文件的实时同步与版本追踪。支持跨平台运行，可设置开机自启，适用于个人配置文件管理场景。
items.e: file_sync is a lightweight automation tool that monitors file modifications in the background and automatically pushes changes to a Git repository, enabling real-time synchronization and version tracking of configuration files. It supports cross-platform operation and can be configured to run at system startup.

items.d: 股票数据接口
items.z: stock-open-api 是一个开源的股票数据接口库，提供从上海证券交易所和东方财富等公开数据源的股票信息查询功能，支持A股、港股、科创板、新三板及中国概念股等市场数据，适用于学习交流与量化研究场景，不可用于商业用途。
items.e: stock-open-api is an open-source library providing stock data interfaces from public sources like the Shanghai Stock Exchange and East Money, supporting queries for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, STAR Market, New Third Board, and US-listed Chinese companies, intended for educational and research use only.

items.d: 文科生也会配的微信个人号后台，Content based wechat massive platform framework, what you need to do is only adding your articles in :)
items.z: MyPlatform 是一个专为非技术用户设计的微信个人号内容管理平台，支持通过添加文章快速搭建微信公众号。基于 Python 开发，部署于新浪云（SAE），完全免费且配置简单，文科生也可在20分钟内完成搭建，实现内容分发与互动功能。
items.e: MyPlatform is a content-based WeChat personal account backend framework designed for non-technical users. Built with Python and hosted on SAE, it enables quick setup by adding articles, allowing anyone to create a functional WeChat content platform in under 20 minutes with zero cost.

items.d: Deployed on Cloudflare Worker, using the free Flux model and optimizing prompts with LLM. It can be called from any application compatible with the OpenAI API. 部署于Cloudflare Worker，免费使用Flux模型，并通过LLM进行提示词优化，支持在任何兼容OpenAI API的应用中调用。
items.z: Flux-API-Worker 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Worker 上的 AI 图像生成服务，免费使用 Flux 模型并通过 LLM 优化提示词，提供兼容 OpenAI API 的接口，支持自定义提示、多尺寸输出、KV 缓存及 CORS，适用于各类应用集成。
items.e: Flux-API-Worker is an AI image generation service deployed on Cloudflare Workers, utilizing the free Flux model and LLM-powered prompt optimization. It offers an OpenAI-compatible API for seamless integration into any application, supporting custom prompts, multiple aspect ratios, KV storage, and streaming responses.

items.d: Snapifit AI：开箱即用， 您的专属 AI 教练和营养师。即刻获取个性化健康管理指导。 Your personal AI trainer and nutritionist. Get instant, personalized health management guidance, right out of the box.
