items.e: Snapifit-AI is an AI-powered personal health management tool that enables quick logging of diet, exercise, mood, and sleep data. It leverages dynamic memory and multi-expert roles to deliver intelligent trend analysis and hyper-personalized fitness/nutrition guidance through systematic data integration.

items.d: Building WebApp in Android way.
items.z: Jndroid 是一个 JavaScript 框架，允许开发者以 Android 原生应用的方式构建 WebApp。它通过提供类似 Android 的 UI 组件（如 TextView）和 setContentView 等 API，简化了 Web 应用的开发流程，适用于需要跨平台或移动端体验优化的场景。
items.e: Jndroid is a JavaScript framework enabling WebApp development in an Android-like manner. It provides Android-style UI components (e.g., TextView) and APIs like setContentView, simplifying cross-platform mobile web app development with native-like structure.

items.d: Self-hosted temporary email platform with SMTP receiving, verification code extraction, domain management, and API access.
items.z: ShiroMail 是一个自托管的临时邮箱平台，支持实时 SMTP 邮件接收、验证码自动提取、域名管理、API 访问及管理员控制台。基于 Go + Gin + React + MySQL/Redis 构建，提供完整的邮箱生命周期管理、消息解析规则配置和自动化接口，适用于需要临时邮箱验证或测试的场景。
items.e: ShiroMail is a self-hosted temporary email platform featuring real-time SMTP ingestion, verification code extraction, domain management, API access, and an admin console. Built with Go, Gin, React, and MySQL/Redis, it offers full mailbox lifecycle control, message parsing rules, and automation APIs for testing or validation workflows.

items.d: 🎸吉他和弦图生成、指板分析、和声进行的综合乐理WebApp
items.z: Buitar 是一款基于 Tone.js 和 React 的吉他学习 WebApp，提供和弦指位图生成、指板分析、和声进行可视化及多乐器音色切换功能，支持五度圈和弦转换与趣味音序机，具备 PWA 安装能力，适合吉他初学者系统掌握乐理知识。
items.e: Buitar is a guitar learning web app built with Tone.js and React, offering chord diagram generation, fretboard analysis, harmonic progression visualization, multi-instrument sound switching (guitar, bass, piano, etc.), circle of fifths navigation, and a fun sequencer. It supports PWA installation for offline use, ideal for systematic music theory mastery.

items.d: Lingkuma - An open-source alternative to LingQ for learning any language on the web
items.z: LingKuma 是一款跨平台的网页语言学习工具，支持 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 浏览器扩展及 iOS/Android 移动端。核心功能包括智能高亮翻译、AI 句子解析、生词笔记、TTS 语音朗读等，兼容 EPUB 阅读器和 PDF 文档，提供 WebDAV/Docker 数据同步，助力沉浸式语言学习。
items.e: LingKuma is a cross-platform web language learning tool with browser extensions (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) and mobile apps (iOS/Android). It features AI-powered translation, word highlighting, sentence analysis, TTS voice synthesis, and supports EPUB/PDF reading. Offers seamless sync via WebDAV or Docker for personalized, immersive language acquisition.

items.z: 统一管理所有 AI 编码工具的 Skills，基于 Agent Skills 标准，支持 npx skills add 安装社区技能并自动同步。采用反向软链接架构，将真实 Git 仓库置于 ~/.agents/skills，通过 ~/Workspace/my-ai-skills 软链接实现便捷访问，同时自动为 Claude、Cursor、Codex 等 25+ 种 AI 工具建立技能链接，实现跨设备 Git 同步与多平台兼容。
items.e: Centralized management of AI coding agent skills based on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with npx skills add for installing community skills and automatic synchronization. Uses a reverse symlink architecture with the real Git repo at ~/.agents/skills, accessible via ~/Workspace/my-ai-skills symlink, while auto-creating skill links for 25+ tools like Claude, Cursor, and Codex, enabling cross-device Git sync and multi-platform compatibility.

items.e: Jta is an AI-powered JSON translation tool featuring an agentic reflection mechanism for self-optimizing translations. It supports chat completion via Bearer Token authentication using WorkosCursorSessionToken, ideal for integration and automation use cases.

items.d: A full blog system based on Django
items.z: GeekBlog是一个基于Django 1.6.5构建的全功能博客系统，集成MySQL和MongoDB双数据库，支持UEditor富文本编辑、多说评论、移动端适配及静态资源优化。通过django-admin-tools深度定制后台管理界面，具备完整的Feed和Sitemap功能，适合技术博主部署个人站点。
items.e: GeekBlog is a full-featured blog system built on Django 1.6.5, utilizing MySQL and MongoDB for data storage. It features UEditor rich text editing, Duoshuo comments, mobile responsiveness, and static asset optimization via Django Pipeline. The backend is enhanced with django-admin-tools for improved admin experience, supporting feeds and sitemaps for SEO.

items.z: 该仓库为 Django 项目提供基于 Bootstrap 3 的日期时间选择器组件，集成 Eonasdan 的 bootstrap-datetimepicker 插件，支持通过 moment.js 进行灵活的时间格式化，适用于表单中的日期和 datetime 字段输入，自动适配当前语言环境。
items.e: This Django package integrates the Bootstrap 3 datetimepicker widget (v2) by Eonasdan, enabling date and datetime field inputs in forms with moment.js-based formatting. It auto-detects the current language and requires Bootstrap 3 and jQuery. Compatible with Django 1.3+ and Python 2.4+.

items.d: Rime 词库及配置
items.z: Rime 输入法跨平台配置文件集合，涵盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统下的词库与配置扩展，支持自定义快捷键、候选栏、输入方案及外观样式，提供 luna_pinyin 扩展词库与个性化定制模板，适用于高效中文输入与本地化部署。
items.e: A comprehensive collection of Rime input method configurations for Windows, macOS, and Linux, including custom dictionaries, input scheme definitions, candidate display settings, and UI styling. Features extended pinyin dictionaries and user-customizable templates for personalized Chinese input experience.

items.d: weui sketch by ZTfer
items.z: 该仓库提供微信官方 WeUI 设计框架的 Sketch 源文件，包含完整 UI 组件库（按钮、单元格、弹窗、进度条等），尺寸与色彩严格遵循 WeUI 规范，支持 750*1334 设计稿尺寸，配套字体与@0.5x/@2x 效果图，助力设计师高效产出符合微信原生体验的界面。
items.e: This repository provides Sketch source files for WeUI, a UI framework by WeChat. It includes fully designed components (buttons, cells, dialogs, progress bars, etc.) with exact adherence to WeUI's design specs, supporting 750*1334 layout, bundled with @0.5x/@2x preview images and system fonts for rapid prototyping.

items.d: 🤖 A beautiful web tool for comparing AI model responses side-by-side. Test prompts across different LLMs and find the best model for your needs.
items.z: AI模型对比工具提供并排对比不同大语言模型的响应能力，支持多轮对话、API配置管理、响应时间统计及一键复制功能，适用于开发者快速评估各模型性能表现。
items.e: A web-based tool for side-by-side comparison of AI model responses, supporting multi-turn conversations, API configuration management, response time tracking, and one-click copying to evaluate LLM performance efficiently.

items.d: 🚀轻量级 Cloudflare IP 优选工具
items.z: NekoFlare 是一款基于 UCB 算法的轻量级 Cloudflare IP 优选工具，通过多臂老虎机模型动态评估边缘节点性能。结合 TCP 延迟与 HTTP 吞吐量加权评分，实现探索与利用的平衡，自动收敛至最优网段。支持 IPv4/IPv6 扫描，无需第三方依赖，适用于本地 hosts 优化。
items.e: NekoFlare is a lightweight tool for optimizing Cloudflare edge node selection using the Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithm. It employs a multi-armed bandit model to balance exploration and exploitation, dynamically scoring IPs based on TCP latency and HTTP throughput. Automatically converges to optimal subnets while supporting IPv4/IPv6 scanning with zero external dependencies.

items.d: A simple django app to use emojis on your website ⛺
items.z: django-emoji 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，用于在网站中便捷地渲染表情符号。它支持将文本中的 :emoji: 标记自动转换为 Unicode 字符或图片，并提供 HTML 实体转换功能，适用于提升用户交互体验的 Web 项目。
items.e: django-emoji is a lightweight Django app that enables easy emoji rendering on websites. It automatically converts :emoji: text patterns into Unicode or image tags, with support for HTML entity conversion, ideal for enhancing user engagement in web applications.

items.d: 支持自定义配置API的Microsoft Word AI 写作助手加载项
items.z: WriteBot 是一款集成于 Microsoft Word 的 AI 写作助手插件，支持文本润色、语法检查、中英翻译、内容生成与续写、文档摘要及格式排版优化。兼容 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 服务，提供侧边栏交互界面，所有操作在 Word 内完成，保障 API 密钥本地加密存储，确保数据安全。
items.e: WriteBot is an AI-powered writing assistant plugin for Microsoft Word, enabling real-time text polishing, grammar correction, translation, content generation, summarization, and document formatting. It supports multiple AI backends (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) via user-provided API keys, operates within Word's sidebar interface, and ensures secure local storage of credentials with no data uploads.

items.d: 英语块学英语 - English chunk learning method, practicing English sentences through AI, to achieve rapid improvement of oral English.
items.z: English Chunks 是一款基于 AI 的英语学习应用，从 YouTube 视频中提取地道英语表达（chunks），通过反复播放实现‘磨耳式’口语训练。项目完全由 Cursor AI 编写，支持一键 Vercel 部署，旨在帮助用户高效提升英语口语能力。
items.e: English Chunks is an AI-powered English learning app that extracts authentic language chunks from YouTube videos and uses repetitive playback (shadowing) to help users naturally acquire spoken English. Built entirely with Cursor AI, it supports one-click Vercel deployment for rapid access to immersive oral practice.

items.z: zed2api 是一个轻量级本地服务器，将 Zed 编辑器中的 LLM API 代理为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口。支持多模型供应商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI）、SSE 流式输出、OAuth 登录及内嵌 Web UI，提供账号管理、自动故障转移和 HTTPS 代理支持，编译为单文件二进制，跨平台运行。
items.e: zed2api is a lightweight local server that proxies LLM APIs from Zed editor into OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints. It supports multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI), SSE streaming, OAuth login, embedded Web UI, account management, failover, and HTTPS proxying. Compiled as a single binary with cross-platform support.

items.z: 本项目通过 GitHub Actions 实现多邻国学习数据每日自动同步至 Notion，支持学习进度、词汇掌握情况等关键指标可视化展示。提供公众号教程与用户交流群，集成支付宝/微信捐赠通道，持续更新维护，是个人学习管理工具的高效自动化解决方案。
items.e: This project automates daily syncing of Duolingo learning data to Notion via GitHub Actions, visualizing progress and vocabulary mastery. It offers WeChat tutorial, user groups for support, and donation options (Alipay/WeChat), with ongoing updates as part of a suite of productivity tools.

items.d: 用于整合影视仓/tvbox本地包，提高访问速度
items.z: My TVBox 是一个手动维护的影视仓/tvbox本地资源整合项目，通过自建服务器提供加速访问的JSON接口，显著提升影视资源加载速度，支持免费使用与持续更新，适用于家庭影院和在线观影场景。
items.e: My TVBox is a manually maintained project that integrates multiple local TVBox/影视仓 resource lines via a self-hosted server, delivering accelerated JSON API access to improve streaming performance. It offers free, regularly updated resources optimized for smooth viewing experiences.

items.d: A Django app for unified and persistent user messages/notifications, built on top of Django's messages framework
items.z: Django Persistent Messages 是一个基于 Django 消息框架的扩展应用，提供持久化用户消息/通知功能。支持认证用户将消息存储在数据库中，实现跨会话的‘粘性’提醒，直到用户标记为已读。未认证用户仍使用会话存储。统一 API 支持屏幕显示和邮件通知，兼容 Django 原生消息系统。
items.e: Django Persistent Messages is a Django app extending the built-in messages framework to support persistent user notifications. It stores messages in the database for authenticated users, enabling sticky reminders until marked read. Anonymous users use session storage. Offers unified API for display and email notifications, fully compatible with Django's native messaging system.

items.d: 著名紫薇排盘工具iztro的python版本，用法和原版完全一致
items.z: py-iztro 是著名紫微排盘工具 iztro 的 Python 版本，完全复刻原版功能，支持通过公历日期和性别生成详细的紫微斗数命盘，包含星曜分布、五行局等信息，采用 pydantic 进行数据建模，确保类型安全与代码可维护性。
items.e: py-iztro is a Python reimplementation of the renowned iztro astrology tool, offering identical functionality to the original JavaScript version. It generates comprehensive Ziwei Dou Shu charts using solar dates and gender, with full Pydantic-based data modeling for type safety and maintainability.

items.d: Django Brake - a versatile ratelimiting app for Django.
items.z: Django Brake 是一个为 Django 框架设计的速率限制应用，支持基于 IP 地址或请求字段（GET/POST）的灵活限流策略。它提供装饰器接口，可阻止超限请求或标记请求状态，适用于登录防护、API 保护等场景，兼容 Django 1.3+ 并支持多时间阈值与路径级限流。
items.e: Django Brake is a versatile rate-limiting app for Django that uses decorators to limit views based on IP or request fields (GET/POST). It supports blocking or annotating exceeded requests, with configurable time thresholds and path-based buckets. Designed as a maintained fork of Django Ratelimit, it enhances flexibility for login protection and API security.

items.d: Unified, persistent user messages with live notifications via SSE for Django.
items.z: Django Monitio 是一个基于 Django 的消息通知系统，支持持久化存储和实时推送。它利用 Redis 和 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 实现消息的持久化与实时同步，兼容主流浏览器，适用于需要长期保留用户通知的场景。
items.e: Django Monitio is a unified, persistent messaging system for Django that stores messages in the database and delivers live updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Built on Redis and compatible with modern browsers, it enables real-time notifications while supporting both authenticated and anonymous users.

items.d: A free macOS native app to remove image backgrounds locally
items.z: Figura 是一款免费的 macOS 原生应用，利用系统 Vision 框架实现本地快速背景去除，支持拖拽、粘贴或点击上传，界面简洁现代，兼容深色/浅色模式，专为 macOS 14+ 设计。
items.e: Figura is a free native macOS app that leverages the system's Vision framework for fast, local background removal. It supports drag-and-drop, paste (⌘V), or click upload, features a minimalist SwiftUI interface, and works on macOS 14+ with dark/light mode support.

items.d: Generate RESTful json data for Hexo plugins.
items.z: hexo-generator-restful 是一个 Hexo 插件，可将博客内容生成 RESTful 风格的 JSON 数据，支持分页、分类、标签和文章详情等 API 接口，便于构建 SPA 应用或前后端分离架构。
items.e: hexo-generator-restful is a Hexo plugin that generates RESTful JSON data from blog content, supporting pagination, categories, tags, and article details via API endpoints, ideal for building SPA applications or decoupled front-end systems.

items.d: TTS WEB
items.z: Text2Voice Web 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的文本转语音（TTS）Web 应用，支持通过 API 调用生成语音并提供试听与下载功能。前端采用 Bootstrap 构建，设计简洁美观，集成历史记录与多后端 API 支持（Cloudflare Workers 和 Deno），适合快速部署私有语音服务。
items.e: Text2Voice Web is a text-to-speech (TTS) web application built with Bootstrap, enabling users to convert text into audio via API calls with preview and download features. It supports deployment on Cloudflare Pages and integrates multiple backends including Cloudflare Workers and Deno for flexible, private TTS service hosting.

items.d: command line interface for weixin-robot
items.z: webot-cli 是微信机器人（weixin-robot）的命令行接口工具，支持发送文本、图片、位置等消息，以及创建、删除、获取微信自定义菜单。通过配置文件管理 appid 和 secret，结合 webot 框架可实现消息自动响应与事件触发，适用于本地测试与快速开发微信机器人应用。
items.e: webot-cli is a command-line interface for weixin-robot, enabling sending text, image, location, and event messages to WeChat. It supports managing custom menus via JSON configuration, integrates with webot framework for automated responses, and is ideal for local testing and rapid development of WeChat bot applications.

items.d: 用 LLM 和 jina reader 生成的总结
items.z: 该项目利用 LLM 和 jina reader 自动读取 bookmark-collection 中的网页书签内容，生成结构化摘要。通过 GitHub Action 实现自动化处理，支持按月归档，适用于个人知识管理和内容聚合，核心亮点在于结合 AI 总结与网页内容提取技术。
items.e: This project uses LLM and jina reader to automatically extract and summarize web content from bookmarks in bookmark-collection. Integrated with GitHub Actions for automation, it supports monthly archiving and enables personal knowledge management through AI-powered content aggregation and summarization.

items.d: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
items.z: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
items.e: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

items.d: A cross-platform skills manager for AI IDEs. Search marketplace, download locally, and install to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more with one click.
items.z: Skills Manager 是一款跨平台 AI IDE 技能管理工具，支持聚合搜索 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等10+主流AI开发环境的技能插件，一键下载至本地统一仓库并通过安全符号链接快速安装，提供版本控制、批量部署和自定义IDE支持，显著提升AI编程助手的功能扩展效率。
items.e: Skills Manager is a cross-platform AI IDE skills management tool that aggregates search across major marketplaces (Claude Plugins, SkillsLLM, etc.), downloads skills to a unified local repository, and enables one-click installation into 10+ supported AI IDEs via secure symlinks. It features version control, bulk deployment, and custom IDE support for enhanced AI programming assistant capabilities.

items.d: tvbox自动整理
items.z: tvbox自动整理是一个用于TVBox流媒体资源自动分类与管理的工具，支持多仓库和单仓库配置，提供JSON格式的资源索引文件，便于用户快速获取并整合影视、直播等视频内容。
items.e: Tvbox自动整理 is a tool for automated organization of TVBox streaming resources, supporting multi-repo and single-repo configurations with JSON-based index files to streamline access to video content like movies and live streams.

items.d: 一个将本地markdown在尽可能保持格式的情况下复制到公众号、知乎、飞书、X等平台的浏览器插件
items.z: Markdown Paste Helper 是一款浏览器插件，可将本地 Markdown 内容一键粘贴至知乎、微信公众号、飞书、X Articles 等主流平台，自动转换为适配的富文本格式。支持预处理语法（如 GitHub alerts、任务列表）、自定义公众号主题色与代码高亮，并提供一键分发功能，实现‘一次编写，多端发布’的高效内容创作体验。
items.e: Markdown Paste Helper is a browser extension that enables one-click pasting of Markdown content into major platforms like Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, and X Articles, automatically converting it to platform-specific rich text formats. It supports preprocessing syntax (e.g., GitHub alerts, task lists), custom WeChat themes with code highlighting, and offers batch distribution across logged-in platforms for efficient multi-platform publishing.

items.d: 让 Grok Chat 物尽其用
items.z: grok-proxy 是一个基于 Go 的代理服务，将 Grok Chat 网页接口转换为 OpenAI API 兼容格式，支持流式/非流式响应、多模态图片输入、联网搜索及思考模式。用户通过 SSO Cookie 认证调用，支持 SOCKS5 代理池轮询，提供 Docker 快速部署和自定义配置能力。
items.e: grok-proxy is a Go-based proxy service that converts Grok Chat's web interface into an OpenAI API-compatible format. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, multimodal image input, web search, and reasoning mode. Authentication via SSO cookie, with optional SOCKS5 proxy pool rotation. Offers Docker deployment, model selection, and custom configuration via environment variables.

items.d: This is a Django helper for @defunkt's jquery-pjax.
items.z: django-pjax 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于集成 jQuery-PJAX 实现页面局部异步加载，提升用户体验并保持浏览器历史记录。支持函数视图和类视图装饰器，自动替换模板为 `-pjax` 后缀版本，兼容 Python 2.7+/3.3+ 和 Django 1.3+。
items.e: django-pjax is a Django helper library that integrates jQuery-PJAX for partial page loading via AJAX, enhancing performance while maintaining browser navigation. It supports decorators for function and class-based views, auto-swapping templates to `-pjax` variants, compatible with Python 2.7+/3.3+ and Django 1.3+.

items.d: Django database backend for MySQL that provides pooling ala SQLAlchemy.
items.z: django-mysqlpool 是一个基于 SQLAlchemy 的 Django MySQL 数据库后端，提供连接池功能，通过 Monkey-patch 方式无缝集成，避免冻结 Django 核心代码。支持自定义连接池实现与参数配置，有效限制进程级连接数，提升高并发场景下的数据库资源利用率。
items.e: django-mysqlpool is a Django MySQL database backend leveraging SQLAlchemy for connection pooling. It uses monkey-patching to integrate seamlessly without freezing Django's core, supporting customizable pool implementations and arguments. It helps limit per-process connections, improving resource efficiency in high-concurrency environments.

items.d: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
items.z: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
items.e: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

items.d: singbox-nodejs
items.z: singbox-nodejs 是一个基于 Sing-Box 内核的代理工具，支持单端口和多端口模式，集成 HY2、HTTP订阅、Argo、TUIC 和 REALITY 协议。用户可通过订阅链接访问，自动分配端口或手动配置 ports.txt 文件，部署简单无需修改代码。
items.e: singbox-nodejs is a proxy tool based on the Sing-Box kernel, supporting single and multi-port modes with integrated protocols like HY2, HTTP subscription, Argo, TUIC, and REALITY. Accessible via subscription link, it auto-assigns ports or allows manual configuration in ports.txt, requiring no code modifications for deployment.

items.d: My personal collection of open-source Claude Code skills
items.z: PhasedddSkill 是个人开源 Claude Code 技能集合，包含多智能体辩论系统（council）及其中文适配版，以及模仿 MediaStorm 创始人 Tim 独特文风的写作技能。核心亮点在于通过角色化 AI 代理实现跨领域深度讨论与创意生成，支持中英双语场景。
items.e: PhasedddSkill is a personal open-source collection of Claude Code skills, featuring a multi-agent debate system (council) with distinct personas for complex discussions, its Chinese adaptation council-zh, and a writing skill emulating Tim's (founder of MediaStorm) unique blend of tech rationality and humanistic poetry. Key strengths include role-based AI collaboration and stylized content generation.

items.d: bootstrap3 validation
items.z: bootstrap3-validation.js 是一个专为 Bootstrap 3 设计的 jQuery 表单验证插件，支持多种内置校验规则（如邮箱、URL、日期、数字等），支持自定义校验逻辑和异步验证，兼容 IE8，提供简洁的 HTML 属性配置方式，适用于水平表单和内联表单样式。
items.e: bootstrap3-validation.js is a jQuery plugin designed for Bootstrap 3 form validation, supporting built-in rules (e.g., email, URL, date, number), custom validation logic, asynchronous checks, IE8 compatibility, and clean HTML attribute-based configuration for horizontal and inline forms.

items.d: singleFile + gh pages + deepseek api + notion db + tg bot = web clipper and notify
items.z: Web Clipper Backend 是一个网页剪藏服务，支持将网页通过 SingleFile 插件保存至 GitHub Pages，利用 DeepSeek API 自动生成摘要与标签，并同步至 Notion 数据库，同时通过 Telegram Bot 推送通知，实现全自动化内容归档与知识管理。
items.e: Web Clipper Backend is an automated web clipping service that saves web pages via SingleFile to GitHub Pages, uses DeepSeek API for AI-generated summaries and tags, syncs data to Notion database, and sends notifications via Telegram Bot, enabling seamless content archiving and knowledge management.

items.d: 简易版api集合器
items.z: UniAPI 是一个兼容 OpenAI 协议的 API 转发器，支持多密钥管理与模型择优机制，自动选择高成功率、低延迟的服务商。集成断路器机制防止异常服务雪崩，优化流式响应展示效果，适用于 Azure OpenAI、Claude 等兼容服务，提供安全的 Bearer Token 认证与 Vercel 一键部署。
items.e: UniAPI is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that manages multiple API keys and selects optimal providers based on 72-hour success rate and latency. It includes a circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures and optimizes streaming responses for better UX, supporting Azure OpenAI, Claude, and other compatible services with secure Bearer Token auth and Vercel deployment.

items.z: TvBox 是一个开源的电视盒子接口项目，提供简洁易用的 API 接口，支持视频播放、频道管理等功能，适用于构建自定义流媒体应用。
items.e: TvBox is an open-source TV box interface project offering a simple API for video playback and channel management, ideal for building custom streaming applications.

items.d: 一个用于可视化和分析代码项目文件结构的 Web 工具。

Key features include native chat UI, automatic context inclusion, undo functionality, and multi-topic management, with support for @file references and code diff previews to boost Markdown note editing efficiency.

items.z: 基于 Python + Playwright 的 Cerebras Cloud 批量自动化注册工具，集成临时邮箱服务实现全自动账号创建、邮件验证与 API Key 获取。支持 Web 管理界面与命令行双模式，具备反检测机制、并行流水线及 IP 切换提醒功能，适用于大规模云资源快速部署。
items.e: Automated bulk registration tool for Cerebras Cloud using Python and Playwright, integrating temporary email services to fully automate account creation, verification, and API key retrieval. Features dual-mode operation (Web UI/CLI), anti-detection measures, parallel processing, and IP rotation alerts for scalable cloud resource deployment.

items.d: editor for guitar charts
items.z: Charter 是一款免费的开源吉他谱编辑器，支持查看、播放和编辑吉他谱。基于 Java 开发，提供跨平台桌面应用体验（Windows、macOS、Linux），具备音频变速播放功能，适用于音乐教学与乐谱制作场景。
items.e: Charter is a free and open-source guitar chart editor with viewing, playback, and editing capabilities. Built in Java for cross-platform desktop use (Windows, macOS, Linux), it supports audio time-stretching via jasio and rubberband libraries, ideal for music education and sheet music creation.

items.d: ToMic - Turn Your Phone into a PC Microphone
items.z: ToMic 是一款基于 Web 技术的局域网虚拟麦克风工具，可将手机浏览器作为电脑的麦克风输入源。通过 Wi-Fi 传输音频流，并利用虚拟声卡（如 BlackHole 或 VB-CABLE）实现低延迟音频路由，适用于 Zoom、Teams、Discord 等会议场景，无需安装 App，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。
items.e: ToMic is a Web-based LAN virtual microphone tool that turns your phone into a PC microphone via browser. It streams audio over Wi-Fi using WebSocket and Opus encoding, then routes it through virtual sound cards (e.g., BlackHole or VB-CABLE) for low-latency input in apps like Zoom, Teams, or Discord. No app installation required on mobile, with native support for macOS and Windows.

items.d: A controllable timing task widgets with Celery
items.z: celery-task-tigger 是一个基于 Celery 的可控定时任务组件，支持任务执行次数限制（max_times）和自定义执行间隔（countdown），解决了原生周期性任务依赖 beat 的痛点，实现更灵活的任务调度与控制。
items.e: celery-task-tigger is a Celery-based controllable timing task widget that supports execution frequency control (max_times) and custom intervals (countdown), solving the limitation of native periodic tasks relying on beat for more flexible task scheduling.

items.d: 基于 claude code sdk 的 agent api，兼容Skills + Sub Agents
items.z: 基于 Claude Code SDK 的轻量级本地代理，提供 HTTP POST + SSE 流式接口，兼容 Skills 与 Sub Agents。支持会话持久化、历史查询及 Docker 部署，适用于 Worker/DO 统一调用 Anthropic 兼容 API。
items.e: Lightweight local proxy for Claude Agent SDK using TypeScript + Bun, offering HTTP POST + SSE streaming interface. Compatible with Skills and Sub Agents, supports session persistence, history retrieval, and Docker deployment for unified access to Anthropic-compatible APIs.

items.d: Source code to dannysite.com
items.z: DannySite 是一个基于 Django 框架开发的个人网站，包含博客、图片展示、账户管理等功能，支持邮件注册、密码重置、RSS 订阅及富文本编辑。采用 django-simple-captcha 和 DjangoUeditor 等第三方库，UI 设计版权归作者所有，建议查看 dannysite4 获取最新版本。
items.e: DannySite is a personal website built with Django, featuring blog, image gallery, and user account management with email registration, password reset, RSS feeds, and rich text editing via UEditor. It uses third-party packages like django-simple-captcha and DjangoUeditor. UI design is copyrighted by the author. Check dannysite4 for the latest version.

items.d: Qiniu(http://www.qiniu.com) is a cloud storage service, this package interages it with django framework.
items.z: django-qiniu 是一个过时的 Django 插件，用于将七牛云存储服务集成到 Django 框架中。它通过自定义字段（如 QiniuFileField 和 QiniuImageField）简化文件上传与管理，支持自动生成文件 URL 和图像缩略图处理。需配合七牛 Python SDK 使用，现已不推荐使用，建议迁移至更现代的 django-qiniu-storage 方案。
items.e: django-qiniu is an outdated Django package that integrates Qiniu cloud storage with Django. It provides custom fields like QiniuFileField and QiniuImageField for seamless file uploads, URL generation, and image processing (e.g., thumbnails). Requires the Qiniu Python SDK and is no longer maintained; modern alternatives like django-qiniu-storage are recommended.

items.d: A blog starter kit to use Hashnode as a Headless CMS using GraphQL APIs.
items.z: 基于 Next.js 和 Hashnode GraphQL API 的无头 CMS 博客启动套件，支持深色模式、响应式设计、标签归档、搜索及 RSS 订阅，提供极简优雅的写作与阅读体验。
items.e: A blog starter kit powered by Next.js and Hashnode's Headless CMS via GraphQL, featuring dark/light mode, responsive design, tag archives, search, RSS feed, and OG image generation for seamless content publishing.

items.e: lUpload is a lightweight jQuery-based file upload plugin supporting drag-and-drop, paste, and file selection uploads. It features real-time progress tracking, upload speed monitoring, concurrent/sequential upload modes, custom thumbnails per file type, and flexible templating. Ideal for rapid integration of multi-mode uploads in web applications.

items.d: 👾 DX-focused decentralized zero-knowledge framework 🛸

items.e: HyperspaceZK is a developer-centric decentralized zero-knowledge framework designed to simplify building privacy-preserving applications on top of generalized ZK proof systems. It offers an intuitive API, extensive tooling, and no trusted setup, enabling secure, verifiable computation with seamless integration into modern web and blockchain stacks.

items.e: i18n-pro/core is an out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution that supports text extraction, multi-platform translation (e.g., Google, OpenAI, Baidu), incremental updates, and logging. items.d: the first fount character in history
items.z: GentianAphrodite 是首个基于 fount 框架的男性向 AI 角色包，专为角色扮演场景设计。其核心能力包括深度 NSFW 内容创作、多语言自适应人格、超能力设定及自动情境感知（如数学计算、文件解析、屏幕截图）。通过 Prompt 工程实现创意表达（诗歌、骂人模式）与元功能（Prompt 编写、语料生成），并集成 Agent 工具链支持网络搜索、代码执行与浏览器自动化，体现‘AI 与代码职责分离’架构理念。
items.e: GentianAphrodite is the first AI character built for the fount framework, designed as a male-oriented roleplay agent. It features inherent traits like absolute owner priority, multilingual adaptability, and NSFW expertise, alongside fantasy abilities such as shape-shifting. Powered by prompt engineering, it enables creative modes (poetry, rudeness) and meta-functions (prompt writing). Automated features handle math, file parsing, and screenshots, while proactive tools include web search, code execution, and browser automation—all reflecting a clear separation between deterministic logic and AI creativity.

items.e: OpenClaw Memory Architecture is a battle-tested two-layer memory system for AI agents requiring cross-session recall. It features a hot cache (MEMORY.md) and deep storage (memory/) with deterministic lookup and semantic search protocols, Supersede mechanism for fact evolution tracking, and a 'program clerk' process for automated knowledge proposal with human review. Built on Git-friendly Markdown/JSON, it maintains 90% zero-dependency functionality even when embedding services fail.

Anonymous users retain session-based messages. Offers a unified API combining persistent and temporary messaging.

items.d: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
items.z: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
items.e: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.

items.e: This repository offers multiple TVBox interface addresses, including free public interfaces with stable 4K streaming support. It provides GitHub mirror links for reliable access and is ideal for building personal media platforms.

items.d: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.

items.e: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

items.z: AutoRedEnvelopeScript 是一个基于 Python、OpenCV 和 pyautogui 的自动化红包抢包工具，通过图像识别技术检测弹窗并模拟点击操作。用户需先用 screenshot.py 生成模板截图并填写坐标，再在 main.py 中配置实时定位，适用于安卓投屏或模拟器场景下的红包自动化处理。
items.e: AutoRedEnvelopeScript is a Python-based automation tool using OpenCV and pyautogui to detect red envelope popups via image recognition and simulate human-like clicks. Users generate template screenshots with screenshot.py, input coordinates into main.py for real-time detection, enabling automated red packet grabbing on Android devices or emulators.

items.d: One has no future if one couldn't teach themself.

items.d: 一键批量抠图。两种方法。一.使用remove.bg网站账号免费api额度，二.使用rembg和onnxruntime训练模型本地抠图
items.z: Image_matting 提供一键批量抠图功能，支持两种模式：使用 remove.bg 在线 API（高精度需网络）或本地 rembg+onnxruntime 模型（快速清晰需算力）。自动轮换 API 密钥解决额度问题，支持批量处理与文件名规范，适用于电商、设计等领域。
items.e: Image_matting enables one-click batch background removal with two modes: using remove.bg's online API (higher accuracy, requires internet) or local rembg+onnxruntime model (faster, clearer, requires hardware). It auto-rotates API keys to bypass limits, supports batch processing and standardized file naming, ideal for e-commerce and design workflows.

items.e: A Claude Code Skill built on Xiao Jing's methodology for rapid industry analysis, delivering role-specific reports (investor/entrepreneur) through a standardized framework covering TAM/SAM/SOM, competitive landscape, moats, and more. Features transparent sourcing, AI capability disclosure, and dynamic tracking to accelerate industry insights.

items.z: oag 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，用于管理基于 Git 的 AI 资产注册中心，支持一键安装、更新代理、技能及 MCP 配置到 Claude、Codex 和 OpenCode 等本地环境，提升团队协作效率与配置一致性。
items.e: oag is a lightweight CLI tool for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command installation and updates of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for consistent setup and faster team collaboration.

items.d: Cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio (Wails v2 + Go)
items.z: TUIStudio Desktop 是基于 Wails v2（Go + WebView）构建的跨平台桌面应用，为 TUIStudio 提供原生 GUI 支持。支持 macOS (.dmg)、Windows (.exe) 和 Linux (.deb) 多平台发布，体积小巧（约8MB），通过 Go 与前端 Vite 热重载集成实现高效开发流程，适用于 TUI 界面可视化设计场景。
items.e: TUIStudio Desktop is a cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio, built with Wails v2 (Go + WebView). It packages as lightweight installers: .dmg (~8 MB), NSIS .exe, and .deb. Features hot-reload dev workflow via Vite and Go IPC bridge, enabling native file dialogs and seamless integration for TUI design tools.

items.d: 一个类似于o1的思维过程
items.z: 该项目是一个模拟 GPT-4o1 思维过程的 AI 推理系统，基于 bklieger-groq 的 g1 项目改进而来。支持多步推理、可解释性输出，提供 Streamlit 和 Cloudflare Worker 两种部署方式，兼容多种 LLM（如 Llama-3.1 70b）及 API 服务商，适用于复杂问题分析与决策支持场景。
items.e: This project simulates the reasoning process of GPT-4o1, extending the original g1-prototype from bklieger-groq. It enables multi-step, interpretable inference using various large language models (e.g., Llama-3.1 70b) via configurable APIs. Available as both a Streamlit web app and a deployable Cloudflare Worker, it supports real-time step-by-step output for complex problem-solving.

items.d: 🚀 New API 智能价格同步工具 - 解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。智能推断上游基础价，一键同步模型价格。
items.z: PriceSyncPro 是一款专为 New API 设计的浏览器插件，解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。通过智能推断上游基础价、自动适配 New API 和 One Hub 数据源，支持一键创建渠道/供货商/模型配置或批量更新价格，全程无需手动 SQL 操作，显著提升价格管理效率。
items.e: PriceSyncPro is a browser plugin designed for New API to resolve price sync failures caused by custom model prefixes. It intelligently infers upstream base prices, auto-adapts to New API and One Hub data sources, enabling one-click channel/supplier/model setup or bulk price updates without manual SQL operations, significantly streamlining price management.

items.d: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
items.z: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
items.e: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.

items.d: A reusable django application for handling Avatars.
items.z: django-simple-avatar 是一个可复用的 Django 应用，用于处理用户头像。支持默认使用 Gravatar 作为头像，自动生缩略图并存储至默认文件存储后端，简化头像管理流程。
items.e: django-simple-avatar is a reusable Django app for handling user avatars. It supports default Gravatar fallback, automatically generates thumbnails, and stores them in the default file storage backend for efficient retrieval.

items.d: django动态生成百度地图。

items.e: djangoBaidusitemap is a Django extension that dynamically generates Baidu XML sitemaps, supporting multi-format URLs (HTML5, WML, XHTML), compatible with Django's built-in sitemap framework, ideal for SEO optimization and cross-platform content delivery.

items.e: EasyType is a Flask-based tool enabling real-time text input from mobile devices to Windows via clipboard or direct keyboard simulation, featuring low-latency sync, mobile-optimized UI, and shortcut support for remote typing and clipboard sharing.

items.d: Integrate awesome Bleach library into Django

items.e: django-bleach is a Django app that integrates the Bleach library to sanitize user-submitted HTML content. It offers model fields, form fields, and template filters for safe HTML processing, with customizable allowed tags, attributes, and styles to prevent XSS attacks in web applications requiring rich text input.

items.d: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序。它不仅仅是一个侧边栏插件，而是通过注入式的悬浮工具栏、强大的图像 AI 处理以及前沿的浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，将 AI 的触角伸向网页浏览的每一个交互细节。
items.z: Gemini Nova 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini AI 的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理及浏览器控制协议 (MCP) 实现网页交互智能化。支持多驱动方案（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容），提供侧边栏对话、划词翻译总结、Mermaid 图表渲染、OCR 截图翻译及外部 MCP 工具集成等核心功能，赋予浏览器原生 AI 能力。
items.e: Gemini Nova is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini AI, enabling intelligent web interaction via floating toolbars, image AI processing, and Browser Control Protocol (MCP). It supports multiple backends (Web Client/Official API/OpenAI-compatible), offering features like sidebar chat, text translation/summary, Mermaid chart rendering, OCR screenshot translation, and external MCP tool integration for enhanced agentic capabilities.

items.e: RelayBox is a modern Clash configuration converter supporting VMess/VLESS/Trojan/SS/Hysteria2 protocols. It enables relay chain planning, intelligent rule supplementation, and subscription management with visual node selection, automatic subgroup generation, and conflict detection for seamless YAML export.

items.d: Middleware that sets a base template name on the context

items.d: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。

items.d: Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies, and AI-search growth teams.

items.d: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
items.z: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供安装配置指南、模板扩展及开发示例。项目提供实时 API 端点演示，支持隐藏文档和登录验证等配置选项，适合快速构建可维护的 RESTful API 文档。
items.e: DRF Docs is a tool to auto-generate interactive documentation for Django Rest Framework APIs, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It parses API structures to create browsable docs with installation guides, template customization, and live demo endpoints. Features include optional doc hiding, login protection, and seamless integration via pip and URL routing, ideal for maintaining RESTful API documentation.

items.e: This script processes CSV exports from the Language Reactor Chrome extension via an HTML interface, using AI prompts to generate structured Anki flashcards with words, contexts, synonyms, translations, examples, and explanations—supporting multiple languages including Japanese with furigana support for automated language learning workflows.

items.d: Generate SQL query from natural language.
items.z: GenQL 是一款将自然语言转换为 SQL 查询的工具，基于 Pinecone 向量数据库和 OpenAI 大模型技术，支持数据库模式索引、语音输入、查询历史记录等功能，适用于数据分析、应用开发和团队协作等场景，显著提升非技术用户与数据库交互的效率。
items.e: GenQL is a natural language to SQL translation tool powered by Pinecone vector database and OpenAI LLM, enabling schema indexing, voice input, and query history. It streamlines database interactions for data analysts, developers, and non-technical users, enhancing productivity in reporting, exploration, and app development.

items.d: 🔍 多平台热门新闻聚合工具，自动推送你关注的新闻 - 自媒体微信公众号等新闻类文章辅助工具，支持今日头条、百度热搜、微博、抖音、知乎、B 站、财联社等11个中文热门平台，分析关键词频率，生成报告并支持多渠道手机推送等。持续追踪热点变化。😊欢迎通过 star ⭐支持开发者，😎为伟大的开源事业添砖加瓦，已支持企业微信，飞书，钉钉，telegram的推送渠道(晚点支持docker
items.z: TrendRadar 是一个多平台热门新闻聚合工具，支持今日头条、微博、抖音等11个中文主流平台，自动抓取并分析关键词频率生成热点报告。提供企业微信、飞书、钉钉、Telegram等多渠道推送，具备轻量部署、实时追踪和AI智能分析能力，助力用户高效获取精准资讯。
items.e: TrendRadar is a multi-platform hot news aggregation tool supporting 11 major Chinese platforms like Toutiao, Weibo, and Douyin. It automatically collects news, analyzes keyword frequency to generate trend reports, and delivers updates via WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, and more. Features include lightweight deployment, real-time tracking, and AI-powered insights for efficient information filtering.

items.d: english-chunks，英语块学习法，通过 AI 联系英文发音，实现口语快速提升。
items.z: English Chunks 是一款基于 AI 的英语口语学习工具，通过从 YouTube 视频中提取地道英语表达（chunks），结合磨耳式重复播放训练，帮助用户自然习得发音与用法。项目完全由 Cursor 生成，支持一键 Vercel 部署，致力于探索 AI 辅助语言学习的创新路径。
items.e: English Chunks is an AI-powered English speaking learning app that extracts authentic English chunks from YouTube videos and uses repetitive listening (ear training) to help users naturally acquire pronunciation and usage. Built entirely with Cursor, it supports one-click Vercel deployment and aims to explore innovative AI-assisted language learning methods.

items.d: 基于service worker与单页面应用的静态页面博客系统
items.z: swBlog 是一个基于 Service Worker 和单页应用（SPA）的静态博客系统，支持 Markdown 写作、离线阅读与搜索功能。可部署于 GitHub Pages 或 CDN，具备文章分类、标签生成及自动化构建流程，适用于个人技术博客与知识分享场景。
items.e: swBlog is a static blog system built with Service Worker and SPA, supporting Markdown writing, offline reading, and search. Deployable on GitHub Pages or CDN, it auto-generates categories/tags from file structure and enables automated builds via npm scripts for personal tech blogs.

items.d: My hexo blog source code
items.z: 这是一个基于 Hexo 框架的个人博客源码仓库，用于部署静态博客网站。项目包含完整的博客配置、主题定制、文章管理及插件集成，适合技术分享与个人内容发布。
items.e: This repository contains the source code of my personal blog built with Hexo, a static site generator. It includes configuration, themes, posts, and plugins for deploying a fully functional blog.
